################################################################################
# FILE: app.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import time
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if str(PROJECT_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QFont
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from darkitten.config import APP_NAME, LOG_DIR, Config, ensure_dirs
from darkitten.ui import icons, theme
from darkitten.ui.animations import SplashScreen
from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow


def _install_exception_hook() -> None:
    def handler(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb):
        text = "".join(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb))
        try:
            LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (LOG_DIR / "crash.log").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        except Exception:
            pass
        sys.__excepthook__(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb)

    sys.excepthook = handler


def _arg_value(name: str, default: str = "") -> str:
    try:
        index = sys.argv.index(name)
        return sys.argv[index + 1]
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        return default


def _debug(message: str) -> None:
    if "--debug" in sys.argv:
        print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {message}", flush=True)


def main() -> int:
    if "--debug" in sys.argv:
        import faulthandler

        faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(25, exit=True)

    os.environ.setdefault("QT_AUTO_SCREEN_SCALE_FACTOR", "1")
    ensure_dirs()
    _install_exception_hook()

    _debug("creating QApplication")
    app = QApplication(sys.argv[:1])
    app.setApplicationName(APP_NAME)
    app.setApplicationDisplayName(APP_NAME)
    app.setOrganizationName("DarkittenLauncher")
    app.setWindowIcon(icons.app_icon())
    app.setFont(QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 9))
    app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(True)

    config = Config.load()
    theme.set_current(config.theme)
    app.setStyleSheet(theme.stylesheet(config.theme))

    shot = _arg_value("--screenshot")
    use_splash = not shot and "--no-splash" not in sys.argv
    if use_splash:
        # splash 是启动阶段唯一的可见窗口，先关闭自动退出，避免它收尾时
        # 触发 quitOnLastWindowClosed 把整个启动器带走。
        app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
    splash: SplashScreen | None = None
    if use_splash:
        _debug("showing splash")
        splash = SplashScreen()
        splash.start()
        app.processEvents()

    _debug("building main window")
    window = MainWindow(config)

    def offer_shortcut() -> None:
        if shot or os.environ.get("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "").lower() == "offscreen":
            return
        QTimer.singleShot(900, window.offer_shortcut_once)

    if use_splash and splash is not None:
        revealed = False

        def reveal() -> None:
            nonlocal revealed
            if revealed:
                return
            revealed = True
            _debug("showing main window")
            window.show()
            window.raise_()
            window.activateWindow()
            # 先隐藏 splash 再销毁，等主窗口真正显示后再恢复“最后一个窗口
            # 关闭即退出”，避免 splash 收尾时把整个启动器带走。
            splash.hide()
            QTimer.singleShot(0, splash.deleteLater)
            app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(True)
            offer_shortcut()

        splash.finished.connect(reveal)
        # finished 依赖淡出动画收尾，极端情况下可能不再发出，这里兜底。
        QTimer.singleShot(4000, reveal)
    else:
        _debug("showing main window")
        window.show()
        window.raise_()
        window.activateWindow()
        offer_shortcut()
    _debug("window shown")
    if shot:
        page = _arg_value("--page", "home")
        delay = int(_arg_value("--delay", "2200"))
        forced_theme = _arg_value("--theme")
        if forced_theme in ("light", "dark"):
            window.apply_theme(forced_theme)
        if page in ("home", "download", "mods", "skin", "room", "server", "settings"):
            window.switch_page(page)

        def prepare() -> None:
            _debug("capturing screenshot")
            saved = window.grab().save(shot)
            _debug(f"screenshot saved={saved}")
            app.quit()

        QTimer.singleShot(max(300, delay), prepare)

    _debug("entering event loop")
    code = app.exec()
    _debug(f"event loop exited {code}")
    return code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Darkitten Launcher (DKL) —— 恶魔小猫的 Minecraft 秘密基地。"""

__version__ = "1.7.2"

# FILE: darkitten/accounts.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import re
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from .secret import protect, unprotect

NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,16}$")


def valid_player_name(name: str) -> bool:
    return bool(NAME_RE.fullmatch(name.strip()))


def offline_uuid(name: str) -> str:
    """生成与 Minecraft 离线模式一致的 UUID（MD5 version 3）。"""
    digest = bytearray(hashlib.md5(f"OfflinePlayer:{name}".encode("utf-8")).digest())
    digest[6] = (digest[6] & 0x0F) | 0x30
    digest[8] = (digest[8] & 0x3F) | 0x80
    return str(uuid.UUID(bytes=bytes(digest)))


@dataclass
class Account:
    kind: str = "offline"
    name: str = ""
    uuid: str = ""
    access_token: str = ""
    refresh_token: str = ""
    expires_at: float = 0.0
    mc_access_token: str = ""
    mc_expires_at: float = 0.0
    xuid: str = ""

    @property
    def is_msa(self) -> bool:
        return self.kind == "msa"

    @property
    def display_name(self) -> str:
        return self.name or "Steve"

    @classmethod
    def offline(cls, name: str) -> "Account":
        return cls(kind="offline", name=name, uuid=offline_uuid(name))

    @classmethod
    def from_config(cls, data: dict[str, Any] | None) -> "Account":
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            return cls()
        kind = str(data.get("kind") or "offline")
        if kind != "msa":
            return cls()
        return cls(
            kind="msa",
            name=str(data.get("name") or ""),
            uuid=str(data.get("uuid") or ""),
            access_token=unprotect(str(data.get("access_token") or "")),
            refresh_token=unprotect(str(data.get("refresh_token") or "")),
            expires_at=float(data.get("expires_at") or 0),
            mc_access_token=unprotect(str(data.get("mc_access_token") or "")),
            mc_expires_at=float(data.get("mc_expires_at") or 0),
            xuid=str(data.get("xuid") or ""),
        )

    def to_config(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if not self.is_msa:
            return {}
        return {
            "kind": "msa",
            "name": self.name,
            "uuid": self.uuid,
            "access_token": protect(self.access_token),
            "refresh_token": protect(self.refresh_token),
            "expires_at": self.expires_at,
            "mc_access_token": protect(self.mc_access_token),
            "mc_expires_at": self.mc_expires_at,
            "xuid": self.xuid,
        }


################################################################################
# FILE: darkitten/config.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field, fields
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

APP_NAME = "Darkitten Launcher"
APP_NAME_EN = "Darkitten Launcher"
APP_SHORT_NAME = "DKL"
APP_TAGLINE = "恶魔小猫的秘密基地"
APP_AUTHOR = "LFELKEEA"
APP_EMAIL = "lfel278623@outlook.com"
APP_VERSION = "1.9.21"
APP_ID = "DarkittenLauncher"
DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL = "https://lfelkeea.github.io/darkitten-launcher/update.json"

if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
    APP_DIR = Path(sys.executable).resolve().parent
else:
    APP_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

CONFIG_PATH = APP_DIR / "config.json"
LOG_DIR = APP_DIR / "logs"
LOG_FILE = LOG_DIR / "launcher.log"


def default_game_dir() -> str:
    """新安装默认把游戏目录放在启动器文件夹内。"""
    return str(APP_DIR / "minecraft")


@dataclass
class Config:
    game_dir: str = ""
    java_path: str = ""
    memory_mb: int = 4096
    jvm_args: str = ""
    download_source: str = "auto"
    download_threads: int = 8
    theme: str = "dark"
    last_version: str = ""
    player_name: str = "Steve"
    window_width: int = 1180
    window_height: int = 760
    auto_complete: bool = True
    version_isolation: bool = True
    shortcut_offered: bool = False
    microsoft_client_id: str = ""
    microsoft_email: str = ""
    account: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    skin_path: str = ""
    skin_variant: str = "classic"
    sakura_token: str = ""
    sakura_frpc_path: str = ""
    sakura_node_id: int = 0
    sakura_tunnel_id: int = 0
    update_url: str = DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL
    update_auto_check: bool = True
    update_skipped_version: str = ""
    update_last_check: str = ""
    # 游戏版本 -> 纯加载器配置。没有条目表示原版启动。
    version_loaders: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    # 1.9.14 之前加载器版本直接出现在首页。首次运行时把旧选择迁移成绑定，
    # 之后尊重用户手动选择的“原版启动”，不再自动改回来。
    loaders_migrated: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not self.game_dir:
            self.game_dir = default_game_dir()

    @property
    def game_path(self) -> Path:
        return Path(os.path.expandvars(self.game_dir)).expanduser()

    def version_game_path(self, version_id: str) -> Path:
        from .paths import version_game_dir

        return version_game_dir(
            self.game_path, version_id, self.version_isolation
        )

    def mods_path(self, version_id: str = "") -> Path:
        return self.version_game_path(version_id) / "mods"

    def resourcepacks_path(self, version_id: str = "") -> Path:
        return self.version_game_path(version_id) / "resourcepacks"

    def shaderpacks_path(self, version_id: str = "") -> Path:
        return self.version_game_path(version_id) / "shaderpacks"

    def loader_for(self, version_id: str) -> str:
        return str(self.version_loaders.get(version_id) or "").strip()

    def bind_loader(self, version_id: str, loader_id: str) -> None:
        version_id = str(version_id or "").strip()
        loader_id = str(loader_id or "").strip()
        if not version_id:
            return
        if loader_id:
            self.version_loaders[version_id] = loader_id
        else:
            self.version_loaders.pop(version_id, None)

    @classmethod
    def load(cls) -> "Config":
        data: dict = {}
        try:
            if CONFIG_PATH.exists():
                data = json.loads(CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            data = {}

        known = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
        clean = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in known}
        cfg = cls(**clean)

        # 1.6.x 及更早版本没有线程设置；旧配置里的 BMCLAPI 单源容易在
        # 镜像不稳定时拖慢整个安装，这里一次性迁移到智能加速。
        if "download_threads" not in data and cfg.download_source == "bmclapi":
            cfg.download_source = "auto"

        if not str(cfg.player_name).strip():
            cfg.player_name = "Steve"
        try:
            cfg.memory_mb = max(512, min(65536, int(cfg.memory_mb)))
        except Exception:
            cfg.memory_mb = 4096
        if cfg.theme not in ("light", "dark"):
            cfg.theme = "light"
        if cfg.download_source not in ("auto", "official", "bmclapi"):
            cfg.download_source = "auto"
        try:
            cfg.download_threads = max(1, min(16, int(cfg.download_threads)))
        except Exception:
            cfg.download_threads = 8
        cfg.version_isolation = bool(cfg.version_isolation)
        cfg.shortcut_offered = bool(cfg.shortcut_offered)
        cfg.microsoft_client_id = str(cfg.microsoft_client_id or "").strip()
        cfg.microsoft_email = str(cfg.microsoft_email or "").strip()
        if not isinstance(cfg.account, dict):
            cfg.account = {}
        cfg.skin_path = str(cfg.skin_path or "").strip()
        cfg.skin_variant = (
            "slim" if str(cfg.skin_variant or "").lower() == "slim" else "classic"
        )
        cfg.sakura_token = str(cfg.sakura_token or "").strip()
        cfg.sakura_frpc_path = str(cfg.sakura_frpc_path or "").strip()
        try:
            cfg.sakura_node_id = max(0, int(cfg.sakura_node_id))
        except Exception:
            cfg.sakura_node_id = 0
        try:
            cfg.sakura_tunnel_id = max(0, int(cfg.sakura_tunnel_id))
        except Exception:
            cfg.sakura_tunnel_id = 0
        # 旧版本留下过本机、临时托管和测试源。现在只保留官方 GitHub Pages
        # 地址，避免升级后仍然去请求已经失效的旧地址。
        cfg.update_url = DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL
        cfg.update_auto_check = bool(cfg.update_auto_check)
        cfg.update_skipped_version = str(
            cfg.update_skipped_version or ""
        ).strip()
        cfg.update_last_check = str(cfg.update_last_check or "").strip()
        if not isinstance(cfg.version_loaders, dict):
            cfg.version_loaders = {}
        cfg.version_loaders = {
            str(key): str(value)
            for key, value in cfg.version_loaders.items()
            if str(key).strip() and str(value).strip()
        }
        cfg.loaders_migrated = bool(cfg.loaders_migrated)
        return cfg

    @property
    def sakura_access_token(self) -> str:
        from .secret import unprotect

        return unprotect(self.sakura_token)

    def set_sakura_token(self, token: str) -> None:
        from .secret import protect

        self.sakura_token = protect(str(token or "").strip())

    def save(self) -> None:
        try:
            CONFIG_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            tmp = CONFIG_PATH.with_name(CONFIG_PATH.name + ".tmp")
            tmp.write_text(
                json.dumps(asdict(self), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            os.replace(tmp, CONFIG_PATH)
        except Exception:
            pass


def ensure_dirs() -> None:
    LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    config = Config.load()
    try:
        config.game_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    except Exception:
        pass


def append_log(message: str) -> None:
    """把启动器日志写入文件；失败时静默忽略。"""
    try:
        LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        from datetime import datetime

        stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        with LOG_FILE.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fp:
            fp.write(f"[{stamp}] {message}\n")
    except Exception:
        pass

# FILE: darkitten/curseforge.py
################################################################################
"""CurseForge 模组数据适配层。

官方 CurseForge API 需要申请 API Key。为了开箱即用，这里默认通过
MCIM 镜像访问 CurseForge API；如果设置了环境变量 CURSEFORGE_API_KEY
（或 DKL_CURSEFORGE_API_KEY），则优先直连官方 API。

下载文件时优先走 MCIM 文件镜像，失败后回退到 CurseForge CDN。
所有返回结构都尽量贴近 Modrinth 的字段，便于现有界面复用。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import threading
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from .downloader import DownloadCancelled, download_to_file, http_open

CURSEFORGE_API = "https://api.curseforge.com/v1"
MCIM_CURSEFORGE_API = "https://mod.mcimirror.top/curseforge/v1"
MCIM_CDN_HOST = "mod.mcimirror.top"
FORGE_CDN_HOSTS = ("mediafilez.forgecdn.net", "media.forgecdn.net")
GAME_ID = 432
CLASS_ID_MODS = 6
CLASS_IDS = {
    "mod": CLASS_ID_MODS,
    "modpack": 4471,
    "resourcepack": 12,
    "shader": 6552,
}
CONTENT_PATHS = {
    CLASS_ID_MODS: "mc-mods",
    4471: "modpacks",
    12: "texture-packs",
    6552: "shaders",
}
PAGE_SIZE_MAX = 50

LOADER_TYPES = {
    "fabric": 4,
    "forge": 1,
    "neoforge": 6,
    "quilt": 5,
}
LOADER_NAMES = {
    1: "Forge",
    2: "LiteLoader",
    3: "CraftBukkit",
    4: "Fabric",
    5: "Quilt",
    6: "NeoForge",
}
_RELEASE_TYPES = {1: "release", 2: "beta", 3: "alpha"}
_MC_VERSION_RE = re.compile(r"^\d+(?:\.\d+)*(?:[-+].*)?$")
ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]


class CurseForgeError(Exception):
    pass


def _as_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def _loader_key(loader: str) -> str:
    text = str(loader or "").strip().lower()
    return text if text in LOADER_TYPES else ""


def _loader_type(loader: str) -> int | None:
    return LOADER_TYPES.get(_loader_key(loader))


def _class_id(content_type: str) -> int:
    kind = str(content_type or "mod").strip().lower()
    return CLASS_IDS.get(kind, CLASS_ID_MODS)


def _content_type(class_id: Any) -> str:
    value = _as_int(class_id, CLASS_ID_MODS)
    for key, known in CLASS_IDS.items():
        if known == value:
            return key
    return "mod"


def _api_sources() -> list[tuple[str, dict[str, str]]]:
    key = (
        os.environ.get("CURSEFORGE_API_KEY")
        or os.environ.get("DKL_CURSEFORGE_API_KEY")
        or ""
    ).strip()
    sources: list[tuple[str, dict[str, str]]] = []
    if key:
        sources.append((CURSEFORGE_API, {"x-api-key": key}))
    sources.append((MCIM_CURSEFORGE_API, {}))
    return sources


def _request_json(
    path: str, params: dict[str, Any] | None = None, timeout: int = 35
) -> Any:
    query = urllib.parse.urlencode(
        {
            key: value
            for key, value in (params or {}).items()
            if value not in (None, "")
        }
    )
    suffix = f"?{query}" if query else ""
    errors: list[str] = []
    for base, headers in _api_sources():
        url = f"{base}{path}{suffix}"
        request_headers = {
            "Accept": "application/json",
            "User-Agent": "DarkittenLauncher CurseForge/1.9",
        }
        request_headers.update(headers)
        for attempt in range(2):
            try:
                with http_open(url, timeout=timeout, headers=request_headers) as resp:
                    raw = resp.read()
                return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
            except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
                detail = ""
                try:
                    detail = exc.read(300).decode("utf-8", "replace")
                except Exception:
                    pass
                errors.append(f"HTTP {exc.code}{(' ' + detail) if detail else ''}")
                # 4xx 通常重试也无用，5xx / 429 再试一次。
                if exc.code < 500 and exc.code != 429:
                    break
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))
                if attempt == 0:
                    continue
                break
    message = "；".join(item for item in errors if item) or "未知错误"
    raise CurseForgeError(f"无法连接 CurseForge：{message}")


def _extract_data(payload: Any) -> Any:
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise CurseForgeError("CurseForge 返回了无法识别的数据")
    return payload.get("data")


def _logo_url(data: dict) -> str:
    logo = data.get("logo") or {}
    if isinstance(logo, dict):
        return str(logo.get("thumbnailUrl") or logo.get("url") or "")
    return str(logo or "")


def _project_url(data: dict) -> str:
    links = data.get("links") or {}
    url = ""
    if isinstance(links, dict):
        url = str(links.get("websiteUrl") or "")
    if not url and data.get("slug"):
        path = CONTENT_PATHS.get(_as_int(data.get("classId"), CLASS_ID_MODS), "mc-mods")
        url = (
            f"https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/{path}/"
            + urllib.parse.quote(str(data.get("slug")), safe="")
        )
    return url


def _author_name(data: dict) -> str:
    authors = data.get("authors") or []
    if isinstance(authors, list) and authors:
        first = authors[0]
        if isinstance(first, dict):
            return str(first.get("name") or "")
        return str(first or "")
    return ""


def _category_names(data: dict) -> list[str]:
    names: list[str] = []
    for item in data.get("categories") or []:
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("name"):
            names.append(str(item["name"]))
    return names


def _game_versions(data: dict) -> list[str]:
    versions: list[str] = []
    for item in data.get("latestFilesIndexes") or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        version = str(item.get("gameVersion") or "").strip()
        if version and version not in versions:
            versions.append(version)
    if not versions:
        for file in data.get("latestFiles") or []:
            if not isinstance(file, dict):
                continue
            for version in file.get("gameVersions") or []:
                text = str(version or "").strip()
                if _MC_VERSION_RE.match(text) and text not in versions:
                    versions.append(text)
    return versions


def _project_loaders(data: dict) -> list[str]:
    names: list[str] = []
    for item in data.get("latestFilesIndexes") or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        name = LOADER_NAMES.get(_as_int(item.get("modLoader")), "")
        if name and name not in names:
            names.append(name)
    if not names:
        for file in data.get("latestFiles") or []:
            if not isinstance(file, dict):
                continue
            for version in file.get("gameVersions") or []:
                name = str(version or "")
                if name in LOADER_NAMES.values() and name not in names:
                    names.append(name)
    return names


def _gallery(data: dict) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    gallery: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for item in data.get("screenshots") or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        full = str(item.get("url") or "")
        preview = str(item.get("thumbnailUrl") or full)
        if not preview:
            continue
        gallery.append(
            {
                "url": preview,
                "full_url": full or preview,
                "title": str(item.get("title") or ""),
                "description": str(item.get("description") or ""),
            }
        )
    return gallery


def normalize_hit(data: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """把 CurseForge 搜索结果转成界面使用的摘要结构。"""
    kind = _content_type(data.get("classId"))
    return {
        "project_id": str(data.get("id") or ""),
        "slug": str(data.get("slug") or ""),
        "title": str(data.get("name") or data.get("slug") or "未知项目"),
        "description": str(data.get("summary") or ""),
        "author": _author_name(data),
        "downloads": data.get("downloadCount") or 0,
        "categories": _category_names(data),
        "icon_url": _logo_url(data),
        "project_url": _project_url(data),
        "date_modified": str(data.get("dateModified") or ""),
        "content_type": kind,
        "source": "curseforge",
        "source_label": "CurseForge",
    }


def normalize_project(data: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """把 CurseForge 项目详情转成界面使用的结构。"""
    links = data.get("links") if isinstance(data.get("links"), dict) else {}
    project = normalize_hit(data)
    project.update(
        {
            "id": str(data.get("id") or ""),
            "body": str(data.get("description") or data.get("summary") or ""),
            "followers": data.get("favoriteCount") or 0,
            "updated": str(data.get("dateModified") or data.get("dateReleased") or ""),
            "loaders": _project_loaders(data),
            "game_versions": _game_versions(data),
            "license": "",
            "gallery": _gallery(data),
            "source_url": str(links.get("sourceUrl") or ""),
            "issues_url": str(links.get("issuesUrl") or ""),
            "wiki_url": str(links.get("wikiUrl") or ""),
            "discord_url": str(links.get("discordUrl") or ""),
            "allow_mod_distribution": bool(data.get("allowModDistribution", True)),
        }
    )
    return project


def _file_hashes(file: dict) -> dict[str, str]:
    hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
    raw = file.get("hashes")
    if isinstance(raw, dict):
        for key, value in raw.items():
            if value:
                hashes[str(key).lower()] = str(value)
    elif isinstance(raw, list):
        for item in raw:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            algo = _as_int(item.get("algo"))
            value = str(item.get("value") or "")
            if not value:
                continue
            if algo == 1:
                hashes["sha1"] = value
            elif algo == 2:
                hashes["md5"] = value
    return hashes


def _file_game_versions(file: dict) -> list[str]:
    versions: list[str] = []
    for raw in file.get("gameVersions") or []:
        text = str(raw or "").strip()
        if _MC_VERSION_RE.match(text) and text not in versions:
            versions.append(text)
    return versions


def _file_loaders(file: dict) -> list[str]:
    loaders: list[str] = []
    for raw in file.get("gameVersions") or []:
        text = str(raw or "").strip()
        key = text.lower()
        if key in LOADER_TYPES and key not in loaders:
            loaders.append(key)
    return loaders


def _required_dependencies(file: dict) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    deps: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in file.get("dependencies") or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        if _as_int(item.get("relationType")) != 3:
            continue
        mod_id = str(item.get("modId") or "").strip()
        if not mod_id or mod_id == "0":
            continue
        deps.append(
            {
                "project_id": mod_id,
                "version_id": "",
                "dependency_type": "required",
            }
        )
    return deps


def normalize_file(
    file: dict,
    project_slug: str = "",
    project_url: str = "",
    content_type: str = "mod",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """把 CurseForge 文件转成 Modrinth 风格的版本字典。"""
    filename = Path(str(file.get("fileName") or "").replace("\\", "/")).name
    file_id = str(file.get("id") or "")
    display_name = str(
        file.get("displayName") or (filename[:-4] if filename.endswith(".jar") else filename)
    )
    download_url = str(file.get("downloadUrl") or "")
    page_url = project_url
    if project_slug and file_id:
        path = CONTENT_PATHS.get(_class_id(content_type), "mc-mods")
        page_url = (
            f"https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/{path}/"
            f"{urllib.parse.quote(project_slug, safe='')}/files/{file_id}"
        )
    release_type = _as_int(file.get("releaseType"), 1)
    return {
        "id": file_id,
        "version_number": display_name,
        "version_type": _RELEASE_TYPES.get(release_type, "release"),
        "files": [
            {
                "primary": True,
                "url": download_url,
                "filename": filename,
                "size": _as_int(file.get("fileLength")),
                "hashes": _file_hashes(file),
            }
        ],
        "dependencies": _required_dependencies(file),
        "game_versions": _file_game_versions(file),
        "loaders": _file_loaders(file),
        "source": "curseforge",
        "source_label": "CurseForge",
        "content_type": str(content_type or "mod"),
        "page_url": page_url,
        "file_date": str(file.get("fileDate") or ""),
        "download_count": file.get("downloadCount") or 0,
    }


def search_mods(
    query: str,
    *,
    loader: str = "",
    game_version: str = "",
    limit: int = 20,
    offset: int = 0,
    content_type: str = "mod",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    text = str(query or "").strip()
    kind = str(content_type or "mod").strip().lower()
    if kind not in CLASS_IDS:
        kind = "mod"
    page_size = max(1, min(PAGE_SIZE_MAX, int(limit)))
    index = max(0, int(offset))
    params: dict[str, Any] = {
        "gameId": GAME_ID,
        "classId": CLASS_IDS[kind],
        "index": index,
        "pageSize": page_size,
        "sortField": 11 if text else 2,
    }
    if text:
        params["searchFilter"] = text
    else:
        # 空搜索时按总下载量展示热门 Mod；有搜索词时由 sortField=11
        # 交给 CurseForge 内部的相关度排序（不要传 sortOrder）。
        params["sortOrder"] = "desc"
    if game_version:
        params["gameVersion"] = str(game_version).strip()
    loader_type = _loader_type(loader) if kind == "mod" else None
    if loader_type is not None:
        params["modLoaderType"] = loader_type
    payload = _request_json("/mods/search", params)
    data = _extract_data(payload)
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise CurseForgeError("CurseForge 搜索结果格式不正确")
    pagination = payload.get("pagination") if isinstance(payload, dict) else {}
    total = 0
    if isinstance(pagination, dict):
        try:
            total = int(pagination.get("totalCount") or 0)
        except Exception:
            total = 0
    hits = [normalize_hit(item) for item in data if isinstance(item, dict)]
    return {
        "hits": hits,
        "total_hits": total or len(hits),
        "offset": index,
        "limit": page_size,
    }


def fetch_project(project_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    project_id = str(project_id or "").strip()
    if not project_id:
        raise CurseForgeError("缺少 CurseForge 项目 ID")
    payload = _request_json(
        f"/mods/{urllib.parse.quote(project_id, safe='')}"
    )
    data = _extract_data(payload)
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get("id"):
        raise CurseForgeError("CurseForge 项目详情无法识别")
    return normalize_project(data)


def fetch_file(
    project_id: str, file_id: str, content_type: str = "mod"
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """读取单个文件的下载地址与校验信息，供整合包导入使用。"""
    project_id = str(project_id or "").strip()
    file_id = str(file_id or "").strip()
    if not project_id or not file_id:
        raise CurseForgeError("缺少 CurseForge 文件 ID")
    payload = _request_json(
        f"/mods/{urllib.parse.quote(project_id, safe='')}/files/"
        f"{urllib.parse.quote(file_id, safe='')}"
    )
    data = _extract_data(payload)
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get("id"):
        raise CurseForgeError("CurseForge 文件详情无法识别")
    return normalize_file(data, content_type=content_type)


def fetch_projects(project_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """批量读取前置项目；单个失败不影响其他项目。"""
    ids = list(
        dict.fromkeys(
            str(item).strip() for item in project_ids if str(item).strip()
        )
    )
    if not ids:
        return {}

    def load(project_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        try:
            return fetch_project(project_id)
        except Exception:
            return None

    result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(4, len(ids))) as pool:
        for project in pool.map(load, ids):
            if not project:
                continue
            for key in (project.get("id"), project.get("slug")):
                if key:
                    result[str(key)] = project
    return result


def fetch_mod_versions(
    project_id: str,
    loader: str = "",
    game_version: str = "",
    content_type: str = "mod",
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    project_id = str(project_id or "").strip()
    kind = str(content_type or "mod").strip().lower()
    if kind not in CLASS_IDS:
        kind = "mod"
    if not project_id:
        raise CurseForgeError("缺少 CurseForge 项目 ID")
    params: dict[str, Any] = {"index": 0, "pageSize": PAGE_SIZE_MAX}
    if game_version:
        params["gameVersion"] = str(game_version).strip()
    loader_type = _loader_type(loader) if kind == "mod" else None
    if loader_type is not None:
        params["modLoaderType"] = loader_type
    payload = _request_json(
        f"/mods/{urllib.parse.quote(project_id, safe='')}/files", params
    )
    data = _extract_data(payload)
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise CurseForgeError("CurseForge 文件列表格式不正确")

    key = _loader_key(loader)
    versions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for file in data:
        if not isinstance(file, dict) or file.get("isAvailable") is False:
            continue
        file_id = str(file.get("id") or "")
        if not file_id or file_id in seen:
            continue
        version = normalize_file(file, content_type=kind)
        if not version["files"][0]["filename"]:
            continue
        if game_version and game_version not in version["game_versions"]:
            continue
        if kind == "mod" and key and key not in version["loaders"]:
            continue
        seen.add(file_id)
        versions.append(version)
    return versions


def candidate_download_urls(url: str) -> list[str]:
    """为 CurseForge CDN 地址生成镜像与回退地址。"""
    url = str(url or "").strip()
    if not url:
        return []
    parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
    host = (parts.hostname or "").lower()
    candidates: list[str] = []
    if parts.path.startswith("/files/"):
        candidates.append(
            urllib.parse.urlunsplit(
                ("https", MCIM_CDN_HOST, parts.path, parts.query, "")
            )
        )
        for cdn_host in FORGE_CDN_HOSTS:
            if cdn_host != host:
                candidates.append(
                    urllib.parse.urlunsplit(
                        ("https", cdn_host, parts.path, parts.query, "")
                    )
                )
    candidates.append(url)
    result: list[str] = []
    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate and candidate not in result:
            result.append(candidate)
    return result


def _primary_file(version: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    files = [f for f in version.get("files") or [] if isinstance(f, dict)]
    for item in files:
        if item.get("primary") and item.get("url"):
            return item
    for item in files:
        if item.get("url"):
            return item
    for item in files:
        if item.get("filename"):
            return item
    return None


def download_mod_file(
    version: dict[str, Any],
    mods_dir: Path,
    *,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    threads: int = 8,
) -> Path:
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    file = _primary_file(version)
    if not file:
        raise CurseForgeError("这个版本没有可下载的文件")
    filename = Path(str(file.get("filename") or "")).name
    if not filename:
        raise CurseForgeError("这个版本的文件名无效")
    url = str(file.get("url") or "")
    if not url:
        raise CurseForgeError(
            "作者未开放第三方下载，请点击 CurseForge 链接手动下载"
        )

    mods_dir = Path(mods_dir)
    mods_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = mods_dir / filename
    hashes = file.get("hashes") or {}
    sha1 = str(hashes.get("sha1") or "")
    size = _as_int(file.get("size"))

    if dest.exists():
        if not size or dest.stat().st_size == size:
            progress(100, f"{filename} 已存在")
            return dest

    progress(1, f"正在下载 {filename}")
    candidates = candidate_download_urls(url)

    def on_bytes(done: int, total: int) -> None:
        if total:
            percent = max(1, min(99, int(done * 100 / total)))
            progress(
                percent,
                f"{filename} · {done / 1024 / 1024:.1f}/{total / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB",
            )
        else:
            progress(50, f"正在下载 {filename}")

    last_error: Exception | None = None
    for candidate in candidates:
        try:
            download_to_file(
                candidate,
                dest,
                sha1=sha1,
                size=size,
                cancel_event=cancel_event,
                progress_cb=on_bytes,
                connections=min(4, max(2, int(threads) // 2)),
            )
            last_error = None
            break
        except DownloadCancelled:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            last_error = exc
            if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
                raise DownloadCancelled() from exc
    if last_error is not None:
        raise CurseForgeError(f"下载失败：{last_error}") from last_error
    progress(100, "下载完成")
    return dest

    "mods",
    "config",
    "defaultconfigs",

class CurseForgePackError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class CurseForgeFile:
    project_id: str
    file_id: str
    required: bool = True


@dataclass
class CurseForgeOverride:
    member: str
    relative: str
    size: int


@dataclass
class CurseForgePackInfo:
    path: Path
    manifest: dict[str, Any]
    files: list[CurseForgeFile]
    overrides: list[CurseForgeOverride]
    counts: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    total_files: int = 0
    total_bytes: int = 0
    archive_bytes: int = 0

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("name") or self.path.stem or "CurseForge 整合包")

    @property
    def description(self) -> str:
        text = str(self.manifest.get("author") or "").strip()
        return f"作者：{text}" if text else ""

    @property
    def version_id(self) -> str:
        return str(self.manifest.get("version") or "")

    @property
    def created_at(self) -> str:
        return ""

    @property
    def created_with(self) -> str:
        return "CurseForge"

    @property
    def minecraft_version(self) -> str:
        minecraft = self.manifest.get("minecraft") or {}
        if not isinstance(minecraft, dict):
            return ""
        return str(minecraft.get("version") or "")

    @property
    def loader_key(self) -> str:
        minecraft = self.manifest.get("minecraft") or {}
        if not isinstance(minecraft, dict):
            return ""
        loaders = minecraft.get("modLoaders") or []
        if not isinstance(loaders, list):
            return ""
        chosen = next(
            (
                item
                for item in loaders
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("primary")
            ),
            loaders[0] if loaders else None,
        )
        if not isinstance(chosen, dict):
            return ""
        raw = str(chosen.get("id") or "").strip().lower()
        for key in ("neoforge", "fabric", "forge", "quilt"):
            if raw.startswith(key + "-"):
                return key
        return ""

    @property
    def loader(self) -> str:
        return {
            "fabric": "Fabric",
            "forge": "Forge",
            "neoforge": "NeoForge",
            "quilt": "Quilt",
        }.get(self.loader_key, "")

    @property
    def loader_version(self) -> str:
        minecraft = self.manifest.get("minecraft") or {}
        if not isinstance(minecraft, dict):
            return ""
        loaders = minecraft.get("modLoaders") or []
        if not isinstance(loaders, list) or not loaders:
            return ""
        chosen = next(
            (
                item
                for item in loaders
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("primary")
            ),
            loaders[0],
        )
        if not isinstance(chosen, dict):
            return ""
        raw = str(chosen.get("id") or "").strip()
        prefix = self.loader_key + "-"
        if prefix and raw.lower().startswith(prefix):
            return raw[len(prefix) :]
        return ""


def _safe_path(name: str, label: str = "整合包") -> str:
    value = str(name or "").replace("\\", "/")
    if not value or value.startswith("/") or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", value):
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"{label}内包含非法路径：{name}")
    parts = PurePosixPath(value).parts
    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"{label}内包含越界路径：{name}")
    for part in parts:
        if (
            re.search(r'[<>:"|?*\x00-\x1f]', part)
            or part.endswith((" ", "."))
            or part.split(".", 1)[0].upper() in _WINDOWS_RESERVED
        ):
            raise CurseForgePackError(f"{label}内包含 Windows 无法使用的路径：{name}")
    return "/".join(parts)


def _read_manifest(zf: zipfile.ZipFile, info: zipfile.ZipInfo) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
        raise CurseForgePackError("manifest.json 过大，已拒绝读取")
    if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
        raise CurseForgePackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法读取")
    try:
        raw = zf.read(info)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"读取 CurseForge 清单失败：{exc}") from exc
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError("manifest.json 不是有效的 JSON") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise CurseForgePackError("manifest.json 格式不正确")
    return data


def _parse_files(manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> list[CurseForgeFile]:
    raw_files = manifest.get("files")
    if not isinstance(raw_files, list):
        raise CurseForgePackError("CurseForge 清单缺少 files 列表")
    result: list[CurseForgeFile] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    for item in raw_files:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise CurseForgePackError("CurseForge 清单里的文件条目格式不正确")
        project_id = str(item.get("projectID") or item.get("projectId") or "").strip()
        file_id = str(item.get("fileID") or item.get("fileId") or "").strip()
        if not project_id or not file_id:
            continue
        key = (project_id, file_id)
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        result.append(
            CurseForgeFile(
                project_id=project_id,
                file_id=file_id,
                required=bool(item.get("required", True)),
            )
        )
    return result


def _load_archive(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[CurseForgeOverride]]:
    archive = Path(path)
    if not archive.is_file():
        raise CurseForgePackError("整合包文件不存在")
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            infos = zf.infolist()
            if len(infos) > MAX_TOTAL_FILES:
                raise CurseForgePackError("整合包内文件数量过多，已拒绝读取")
            seen: set[str] = set()
            total = 0
            manifest_info: zipfile.ZipInfo | None = None
            for info in infos:
                name = _safe_path(info.filename, "整合包")
                key = name.lower()
                if key in seen:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(f"整合包内存在重复文件：{name}")
                seen.add(key)
                mode = (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000
                if mode == 0o120000:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(f"整合包内不允许符号链接：{name}")
                if info.is_dir():
                    continue
                if info.flag_bits & 0x1:
                    raise CurseForgePackError("整合包中的文件被加密，无法导入")
                total += max(0, int(info.file_size))
                if total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
                    raise CurseForgePackError("整合包解压后体积超过 64 GB，已拒绝导入")
                if name.lower() == CURSEFORGE_MANIFEST:
                    manifest_info = info
            if manifest_info is None:
                raise CurseForgePackError(
                    "这不是 CurseForge 整合包：缺少 manifest.json"
                )
            manifest = _read_manifest(zf, manifest_info)
            raw_override_dir = str(manifest.get("overrides") or "overrides")
            override_dir = _safe_path(raw_override_dir.strip("/"), "整合包")
            prefix = override_dir + "/"
            overrides: list[CurseForgeOverride] = []
            for info in infos:
                name = _safe_path(info.filename, "整合包")
                if info.is_dir() or not name.startswith(prefix):
                    continue
                relative = name[len(prefix) :]
                if not relative:
                    continue
                relative = _safe_path(relative, "整合包")
                reserved = relative.split("/", 1)[0].lower()
                if reserved in _RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(
                        f"整合包覆盖文件写入了保留目录：{relative}"
                    )
                overrides.append(
                    CurseForgeOverride(
                        member=info.filename,
                        relative=relative,
                        size=max(0, int(info.file_size)),
                    )
                )
    except CurseForgePackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError("文件不是有效的 ZIP 压缩包") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"无法打开整合包：{exc}") from exc
    return manifest, overrides


def looks_like_curseforge_pack(path: Path | str) -> bool:
    archive = Path(path)
    if not archive.is_file():
        return False
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
            info = next(
                (
                    item
                    for item in zf.infolist()
                    if item.filename.replace("\\", "/").lower()
                    == CURSEFORGE_MANIFEST
                ),
                None,
            )
            if info is None or info.file_size > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES:
                return False
            data = json.loads(zf.read(info).decode("utf-8-sig"))
            return (
                isinstance(data, dict)
                and str(data.get("manifestType") or "") == "minecraftModpack"
            )
    except Exception:
        return False


def inspect_curseforge_pack(path: Path | str) -> CurseForgePackInfo:
    archive = Path(path)
    manifest, overrides = _load_archive(archive)
    if str(manifest.get("manifestType") or "") != "minecraftModpack":
        raise CurseForgePackError("这个压缩包不是 CurseForge Minecraft 整合包")
    try:
        manifest_version = int(manifest.get("manifestVersion") or 0)
    except Exception:
        manifest_version = 0
    if manifest_version != 1:
        raise CurseForgePackError(
            f"CurseForge 整合包格式版本 {manifest_version or '未知'} 不受支持"
        )
    minecraft = manifest.get("minecraft") or {}
    if not isinstance(minecraft, dict):
        raise CurseForgePackError("CurseForge 清单缺少 minecraft 配置")
    mc_version = str(minecraft.get("version") or "").strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Za-z._-]{1,40}", mc_version):
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"Minecraft 版本号不正确：{mc_version or '未知'}")
    files = _parse_files(manifest)
    if not files and not overrides:
        raise CurseForgePackError("整合包里没有任何需要导入的内容")

    counts = {name: 0 for name in CONTENT_DIRS}
    for item in overrides:
        first = item.relative.split("/", 1)[0]
        if first in counts:
            counts[first] += 1
    counts["mods"] += len(files)

    return CurseForgePackInfo(
        path=archive,
        manifest=manifest,
        files=files,
        overrides=overrides,
        counts=counts,
        total_files=len(files) + len(overrides),
        total_bytes=sum(item.size for item in overrides),
        archive_bytes=archive.stat().st_size,
    )


@dataclass
class CurseForgeImportResult:
    version_id: str
    imported_files: int
    skipped_files: int
    imported_bytes: int
    downloaded_files: int


def _inside(root: Path, path: Path) -> Path:
    try:
        path.resolve().relative_to(root.resolve())
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"整合包路径越界：{path}") from exc
    return path


def _write_version_wrapper(
    game_dir: Path, version_id: str, inherits_from: str
) -> Path:
    path = version_json_path(game_dir, version_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = {
        "id": version_id,
        "inheritsFrom": inherits_from,
        "type": "release",
        "name": version_id,
    }
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def import_curseforge_pack(
    pack_path: Path | str,
    game_dir: Path | str,
    version_id: str,
    *,
    java_path: str = "",
    overwrite: bool = False,
    resume: bool = False,
    isolated: bool = True,
    source: str = "official",
    threads: int = 8,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    loader_installer: Callable[..., str] | None = None,
    download_func: Callable[..., int] | None = None,
    file_fetcher: Callable[..., dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    installer: Any | None = None,
) -> CurseForgeImportResult:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    info = inspect_curseforge_pack(pack_path)
    version_id = normalize_version_id(version_id)
    version_dir = game_dir / "versions" / version_id
    if version_dir.exists() and not resume:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"版本 {version_id} 已经存在，请换一个导入名称")
    if resume and not version_json_path(game_dir, version_id).is_file():
        raise CurseForgePackError("上次导入的版本骨架不存在，请换一个导入名称重新开始")

    progress = progress_cb or (lambda _p, _m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda _m: None)
    cancel = cancel_event or threading.Event()
    loader_installer = loader_installer or install_loader
    download_func = download_func or download_to_file
    fetch_meta = file_fetcher or fetch_file
    connections = min(6, max(2, max(1, int(threads)) // 2))

    def check_cancel() -> None:
        if cancel.is_set():
            raise CurseForgePackError("导入已取消")

    def loader_progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        check_cancel()
        progress(3 + int(max(0, min(100, percent)) * 0.42 / 100), message)

    mc_version = info.minecraft_version
    loader_kind = info.loader_key
    if loader_kind == "quilt":
        raise CurseForgePackError(
            "这个整合包使用 Quilt 加载器，当前启动器还不支持 Quilt。"
            "可以尝试使用 Prism 等其他启动器。"
        )
    log(
        f"CurseForge 整合包：{info.name} · Minecraft {mc_version} · "
        f"{info.loader or '原版'}"
        + (f" {info.loader_version}" if info.loader_version else "")
    )
    progress(2, "检查整合包与加载器…")
    check_cancel()

    inherits_from = ""
    if loader_kind:
        if loader_kind in ("forge", "neoforge") and not java_path:
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"安装 {info.loader} 需要 Java，请先在设置里选择 Java。"
            )
        progress(3, f"安装 Minecraft {mc_version} + {info.loader}…")
        inherits_from = loader_installer(
            game_dir,
            mc_version,
            loader_kind,
            info.loader_version,
            java_path=java_path,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=loader_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
        )
        check_cancel()
    else:
        progress(3, f"安装 Minecraft {mc_version}…")
        target_installer = installer or Installer(
            game_dir,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=loader_progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            threads=threads,
        )
        target_installer.install(mc_version)
        check_cancel()
        inherits_from = mc_version

    if inherits_from == version_id:
        raise CurseForgePackError("导入名称不能和加载器版本名称相同，请换一个名称")
    progress(46, "写入版本骨架…")
    _write_version_wrapper(game_dir, version_id, inherits_from)
    log(f"已创建版本 {version_id}，继承 {inherits_from}")

    run_dir = version_game_dir(game_dir, version_id, isolated)
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    mods_dir = run_dir / "mods"

    imported = 0
    skipped = 0
    imported_bytes = 0
    downloaded = 0
    total_files = max(1, len(info.files))

    def resolve(item: CurseForgeFile) -> tuple[CurseForgeFile, dict[str, Any]]:
        check_cancel()
        try:
            version = fetch_meta(
                item.project_id, item.file_id, content_type="mod"
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"读取 CurseForge 文件 {item.project_id}/{item.file_id} 失败：{exc}"
            ) from exc
        files = [
            entry
            for entry in version.get("files") or []
            if isinstance(entry, dict)
        ]
        file = next(
            (entry for entry in files if entry.get("primary") and entry.get("url")),
            next((entry for entry in files if entry.get("url")), None),
        )
        if not isinstance(file, dict):
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"作者未开放文件 {item.project_id}/{item.file_id} 的第三方下载，"
                "请到 CurseForge 页面手动下载"
            )
        return item, file

    resolved: list[tuple[CurseForgeFile, dict[str, Any]]] = []
    if info.files:
        metadata_workers = min(8, max(2, int(threads)), len(info.files))
        if metadata_workers > 1:
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=metadata_workers) as pool:
                resolved = list(pool.map(resolve, info.files))
        else:
            resolved = [resolve(item) for item in info.files]

    pending: list[BatchDownload] = []
    seen_dest: set[str] = set()
    for item, file in resolved:
        check_cancel()
        filename = Path(str(file.get("filename") or "")).name
        if not filename:
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"CurseForge 文件 {item.file_id} 的文件名无效"
            )
        destination = _inside(run_dir, mods_dir / filename)
        size = int(file.get("size") or 0)
        sha1 = str((file.get("hashes") or {}).get("sha1") or "")
        if destination.is_file() and size and destination.stat().st_size == size:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        key = str(destination).lower()
        if key in seen_dest:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        seen_dest.add(key)

        raw_url = str(file.get("url") or "")
        if not candidate_download_urls(raw_url):
            raise CurseForgePackError(f"文件 {filename} 没有可用的下载地址")

        def candidates(url: str = raw_url) -> list[str]:
            return candidate_download_urls(url)

        pending.append(
            BatchDownload(
                dest=destination,
                urls=candidates,
                sha1=sha1,
                size=size,
                label=f"mods/{filename}",
            )
        )

    if pending:
        start_percent = 48 + int(44 * skipped / total_files)
        downloaded, failures = download_batch(
            pending,
            cancel_event=cancel,
            connections=connections,
            max_workers=min(8, max(2, int(threads))),
            progress_cb=progress,
            percent_range=(start_percent, 92),
            log_cb=log,
            label="下载整合包文件",
            download_func=download_func,
        )
        imported += downloaded
        imported_bytes += sum(max(0, int(task.size)) for task in pending)
        if failures:
            detail = failures[0]
            raise CurseForgePackError(
                f"{len(failures)} 个文件下载失败：{detail}"
            )
    else:
        downloaded = 0

    override_total = sum(max(0, item.size) for item in info.overrides) or 1
    override_done = 0
    written: set[str] = set()
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(info.path) as zf:
            for item in info.overrides:
                check_cancel()
                destination = _inside(run_dir, run_dir / item.relative)
                reserved = item.relative.split("/", 1)[0].lower()
                if reserved in _RESERVED_OVERRIDE_DIRS:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(
                        f"整合包覆盖文件写入了保留目录：{item.relative}"
                    )
                if item.relative.lower() == f"{version_id}.json".lower():
                    raise CurseForgePackError(
                        "整合包覆盖文件试图替换版本 JSON，已拒绝导入"
                    )
                key = item.relative.lower()
                if destination.exists() and not overwrite and key not in written:
                    skipped += 1
                    override_done += max(0, item.size)
                    progress(
                        min(99, 92 + int(7 * override_done / override_total)),
                        f"跳过已有文件 {item.relative}",
                    )
                    continue
                destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                try:
                    with zf.open(item.member) as src, destination.open("wb") as out:
                        shutil.copyfileobj(src, out, 1024 * 1024)
                except Exception as exc:
                    raise CurseForgePackError(
                        f"解压覆盖文件 {item.relative} 失败：{exc}"
                    ) from exc
                written.add(key)
                imported += 1
                imported_bytes += max(0, item.size)
                override_done += max(0, item.size)
                progress(
                    min(99, 92 + int(7 * override_done / override_total)),
                    f"放入 {item.relative}",
                )
    except CurseForgePackError:
        raise
    except zipfile.BadZipFile as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError("整合包在导入过程中损坏") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise CurseForgePackError(f"写入整合包文件失败：{exc}") from exc

    check_cancel()
    progress(100, "猫猫已经把 CurseForge 整合包搬进猫窝")
    log(
        f"导入完成：{version_id} · 下载 {downloaded} 个文件 · "
        f"新增 {imported} 个文件"
        + (f" · 跳过 {skipped} 个已存在文件" if skipped else "")
    )
    return CurseForgeImportResult(
        version_id=version_id,
        imported_files=imported,
        skipped_files=skipped,
        imported_bytes=imported_bytes,
        downloaded_files=downloaded,
    )

def has_chinese(text: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.search(r"[\u3400-\u9fff]", str(text or "")))


def _human_number(value: Any) -> str:
    try:
        number = int(value)
    except Exception:
        return ""
    if number >= 1_000_000:
        return f"{number / 1_000_000:.1f}M"
    if number >= 1_000:
        return f"{number / 1_000:.1f}K"
    return str(number)


def _text_list(value: Any, limit: int = 0) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
        return []
    items = [str(item).strip() for item in value if str(item).strip()]
    return items[:limit] if limit else items


def category_labels(categories: Any, limit: int = 3) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    for item in _text_list(categories):
        label = CATEGORY_ZH.get(item.lower().replace("_", "-"))
        if label and label not in result:
            result.append(label)
        if len(result) >= limit:
            break
    return result


def loader_labels(loaders: Any, fallback: str = "", limit: int = 3) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    for item in _text_list(loaders) or ([fallback] if fallback else []):
        label = LOADER_LABELS.get(item.lower(), item)
        if label and label not in result:
            result.append(label)
        if len(result) >= limit:
            break
    return result


def _project_keys(data: dict) -> list[str]:
    keys: list[str] = []
    for name in ("project_id", "id", "slug", "title"):
        value = str(data.get(name) or "").strip().lower()
        if value and value not in keys:
            keys.append(value)
    return keys


def _versions_text(data: dict, fallback: str = "", limit: int = 4) -> str:
    versions = _text_list(data.get("game_versions"))
    if not versions and fallback:
        versions = [fallback]
    if not versions:
        return ""
    shown = versions[:limit]
    if len(versions) > limit:
        return "、".join(shown) + f" 等 {len(versions)} 个版本"
    return "、".join(shown)


def project_zh_intro(
    data: dict,
    content_type: str = "mod",
    loader: str = "",
    game_version: str = "",
    limit: int = 0,
) -> str:
    """根据项目元数据生成中文介绍；常用 Mod 使用人工整理文案。"""
    data = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
    for key in _project_keys(data):
        curated = CURATED.get(key)
        if curated:
            return _trim(curated, limit)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", key).strip("-")
        if cleaned and cleaned in CURATED:
            return _trim(CURATED[cleaned], limit)

    title = str(data.get("title") or data.get("slug") or "这个项目").strip()
    kind = CONTENT_KIND.get(str(content_type or "mod").lower(), "Mod")
    categories = category_labels(data.get("categories"), 2)
    loaders = loader_labels(data.get("loaders"), loader)
    versions = _versions_text(data, game_version)
    author = str(data.get("author") or "").strip()
    downloads = _human_number(data.get("downloads"))

    parts: list[str] = []
    if content_type == "resourcepack":
        parts.append(f"{title} 是一款 Minecraft 材质包")
        if categories:
            parts.append(f"，整体偏向{('、'.join(categories))}风格")
    elif content_type == "shader":
        parts.append(f"{title} 是一款 Minecraft 光影包")
        if categories:
            parts.append(f"，画面风格以{('、'.join(categories))}为主")
    elif content_type == "modpack":
        parts.append(f"{title} 是一个 Minecraft 整合包")
        if loaders:
            parts.append(f"，基于 {' / '.join(loaders)} 加载器")
    else:
        parts.append(f"{title} 是一个")
        if loaders:
            parts.append(f"面向 {' / '.join(loaders)} 的")
        parts.append(f"{('、'.join(categories) + '类') if categories else '综合性'} Mod")

    if versions:
        parts.append(f"，支持 Minecraft {versions}")
    parts.append("。")
    if author:
        parts.append(f"作者是 {author}。")
    if downloads:
        parts.append(f"项目累计下载约 {downloads} 次。")
    if not author and not downloads:
        parts.append("详细信息可以在项目页面查看，安装前请确认前置与游戏版本。")
    return _trim("".join(parts), limit)


def local_mod_zh_intro(
    name: str,
    loader: str = "",
    version: str = "",
    description: str = "",
) -> str:
    """为本地导入的 Mod 生成中文说明；原简介本身是中文时直接使用。"""
    if has_chinese(description):
        return _trim(description, 140)
    title = str(name or "这个 Mod").strip()
    loader_text = f"{loader} 平台的 " if loader else ""
    version_text = f"（版本 {version}）" if version else ""
    return (
        f"{title}{version_text} 是一个 {loader_text}本地 Mod，"
        "文件已经放入当前游戏版本的 mods 文件夹，启用后会被游戏加载。"
    )


def project_title(data: dict) -> str:
    return str(data.get("title") or data.get("name") or data.get("slug") or "").strip()


def _trim(text: str, limit: int) -> str:
    text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
    if limit and len(text) > limit:
        return text[: max(1, limit - 1)] + "…"
    return text

from __future__ import annotations

from .accounts import Account

DEVELOPER_NAME = "LFELKEEA"
DEVELOPER_EMAIL = "lfel278623@outlook.com"

_developer_mode = False


def is_developer(config, account: Account | None) -> bool:
    """只把 LFELKEEA 且填写了指定 Microsoft 邮箱的账户识别为开发者。"""
    if account is None or not account.is_msa:
        return False
    if str(account.name or "").strip().casefold() != DEVELOPER_NAME.casefold():
        return False
    email = str(getattr(config, "microsoft_email", "") or "").strip().casefold()
    return email == DEVELOPER_EMAIL.casefold()


def set_developer_mode(enabled: bool) -> None:
    global _developer_mode
    _developer_mode = bool(enabled)


def developer_mode() -> bool:
    return _developer_mode
