)

MANIFEST_URL = "https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json"
BMCL_MANIFEST_URL = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json"
CACHE_DIR = APP_DIR / "cache"
MANIFEST_CACHE = CACHE_DIR / "version_manifest_v2.json"
ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
LogCallback = Callable[[str], None]


class InstallCancelled(Exception):
    pass


class DownloadError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class _FileTask:
    url: str
    dest: Path
    sha1: str = ""
    size: int = 0
    label: str = ""


THIRD_PARTY_MAVENS = (
    "https://maven.minecraftforge.net/",
    "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/",
    "https://maven.fabricmc.net/",
)
BMCL_MAVEN = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/maven/"
CENTRAL_MAVEN = "https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/"
CENTRAL_FIRST_PREFIXES = (
    "org/ow2/asm/",
    "org/slf4j/",
    "org/apache/",
    "org/jetbrains/",
    "org/joml/",
    "com/google/",
    "com/mojang/",
    "net/java/",
    "io/netty/",
    "it/unimi/",
    "org/lwjgl/",
)


def mirror_urls(url: str, source: str) -> list[str]:
    """返回按优先级排列的下载地址。

    auto / official 保持官方地址优先，但保留 BMCLAPI 作为兜底，避免官方源
    缓慢或临时不可用时直接失败；bmclapi 会优先使用国内镜像。
    Forge、NeoForge、Fabric 的 Maven 在国内经常无法直连，
    因此始终优先尝试 BMCLAPI 镜像。
    """
    urls: list[str] = []
    mirrored = ""
    relative = ""
    is_mojang = False

    if url.startswith("https://libraries.minecraft.net/"):
        mirrored = BMCL_MAVEN + url.split(
            "https://libraries.minecraft.net/", 1
        )[1]
        is_mojang = True
    elif url.startswith("https://resources.download.minecraft.net/"):
        mirrored = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/assets/" + url.split(
            "https://resources.download.minecraft.net/", 1
        )[1]
        is_mojang = True
    elif url.startswith("http://resources.download.minecraft.net/"):
        mirrored = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/assets/" + url.split(
            "http://resources.download.minecraft.net/", 1
        )[1]
        is_mojang = True

    if not mirrored:
        for base in THIRD_PARTY_MAVENS:
            if url.startswith(base):
                relative = url.split(base, 1)[1]
                mirrored = BMCL_MAVEN + relative
                break

    central = CENTRAL_MAVEN + relative if relative else ""
    candidates: list[str] = []
    if mirrored and is_mojang:
        if source in ("auto", "bmclapi"):
            candidates.extend([mirrored, url])
        else:
            candidates.extend([url, mirrored])
    elif mirrored:
        if central and any(
            relative.startswith(prefix) for prefix in CENTRAL_FIRST_PREFIXES
        ):
            candidates.extend([central, mirrored, url])
        else:
            candidates.extend([mirrored, central, url])
    else:
        candidates.append(url)

    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate and candidate not in urls:
            urls.append(candidate)
    return urls


def fetch_json(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with _http_open(url, timeout=timeout) as resp:
        raw = resp.read()
    data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise DownloadError("服务器返回了无法识别的数据")
    return data


def get_manifest(
    source: str = "official",
    force: bool = False,
    log: LogCallback | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """获取版本清单，优先网络，失败时回退到本地缓存。"""
    if not force and MANIFEST_CACHE.exists():
        try:
            age = time.time() - MANIFEST_CACHE.stat().st_mtime
            if age < 900:
                return json.loads(MANIFEST_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception:
            pass

    urls = [MANIFEST_URL, BMCL_MANIFEST_URL]
    if source == "bmclapi":
        urls.reverse()

    last_error: Exception | None = None
    for url in urls:
        try:
            data = fetch_json(url, timeout=12)
            if isinstance(data.get("versions"), list):
                CACHE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                MANIFEST_CACHE.write_text(
                    json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
                )
                if log:
                    log("版本清单已更新")
                return data
        except Exception as exc:
            last_error = exc

    if MANIFEST_CACHE.exists():
        try:
            data = json.loads(MANIFEST_CACHE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if log:
                log("网络不可用，已使用本地缓存的版本清单")
            return data
        except Exception:
            pass

    raise DownloadError(f"获取版本清单失败：{last_error}")


def _sha1_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    with path.open("rb") as fp:
        while True:
            chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


class Installer:
    STAGE_CLIENT = (3, 12)
    STAGE_LIBS = (12, 36)
    STAGE_ASSETS = (36, 94)
    STAGE_FINISH = (94, 100)

    def __init__(
        self,
        game_dir: Path,
        source: str = "official",
        progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
        log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
        cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
        threads: int = 8,
    ) -> None:
        self.game_dir = Path(game_dir)
        self.source = source
        self.effective_source = source
        self._bmcl_checked = False
        self._bmcl_ok = False
        self.progress_cb = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
        self.log_cb = log_cb or (lambda m: None)
        self.cancel_event = cancel_event or threading.Event()
        self.threads = max(1, min(16, int(threads)))
        self.segments = min(8, max(2, self.threads // 2))

        self._last_percent = 0
        self._downloaded_bytes = 0
        self._speed_mark_time = time.time()
        self._speed_mark_bytes = 0
        self._speed = 0.0
        self._speed_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._progress_lock = threading.Lock()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 基础回调 / 进度

    def log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log_cb(message)

    def _check_cancel(self) -> None:
        if self.cancel_event.is_set():
            raise InstallCancelled()

    def _bmcl_reachable(self) -> bool:
        """短超时探测 BMCLAPI，避免镜像不可用时每个文件都等超时。"""
        if self._bmcl_checked:
            return self._bmcl_ok
        self._bmcl_checked = True
        try:
            with _http_open(
                BMCL_MANIFEST_URL, timeout=5, headers={"Range": "bytes=0-0"}
            ) as resp:
                resp.read(1)
            self._bmcl_ok = True
        except Exception:
            self._bmcl_ok = False
        return self._bmcl_ok

    def _resolve_source(self) -> None:
        if self.source != "bmclapi":
            self.effective_source = "official"
            return
        if self._bmcl_reachable():
            self.effective_source = "bmclapi"
            return
        self.effective_source = "official"
        self.log("BMCLAPI 当前不可用，已自动切换为 Mojang 官方源")

    def _set_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        with self._progress_lock:
            percent = max(self._last_percent, min(100, int(percent)))
            self._last_percent = percent
            self.progress_cb(percent, message)

    def _stage_percent(
        self, stage: tuple[int, int], done: int, total: int
    ) -> int:
        start, end = stage
        if total <= 0:
            return end
        return int(start + (end - start) * min(1.0, done / total))

    def _add_bytes(self, count: int) -> None:
        if count <= 0:
            return
        with self._speed_lock:
            self._downloaded_bytes += count
            now = time.time()
            elapsed = now - self._speed_mark_time
            if elapsed >= 0.8:
                recent = self._downloaded_bytes - self._speed_mark_bytes
                instant = recent / elapsed
                self._speed = instant if self._speed <= 0 else (
                    self._speed * 0.6 + instant * 0.4
                )
                self._speed_mark_time = now
                self._speed_mark_bytes = self._downloaded_bytes

    @property
    def speed_text(self) -> str:
        with self._speed_lock:
            speed = self._speed
        if speed <= 0:
            return ""
        if speed >= 1024 * 1024:
            return f"{speed / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB/s"
        return f"{speed / 1024:.0f} KB/s"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 单文件下载

    def _download_file(
        self,
        url: str,
        dest: Path,
        sha1: str = "",
        size: int = 0,
        verify: bool = False,
        label: str = "",
        skipped_bytes: list[int] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """下载单个文件。返回是否真正执行了下载。"""
        self._check_cancel()
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        if dest.exists():
            try:
                existing_size = dest.stat().st_size
                size_ok = (not size) or existing_size == size
                if size_ok and (not verify or not sha1 or _sha1_file(dest) == sha1):
                    if skipped_bytes is not None:
                        skipped_bytes[0] += existing_size
                    return False
                if size_ok and not sha1:
                    return False
            except OSError:
                pass

        errors: list[str] = []
        for candidate in mirror_urls(url, self.effective_source):
            self._check_cancel()
            last = [0]

            def on_bytes(done: int, _total: int) -> None:
                delta = done - last[0]
                last[0] = done
                self._add_bytes(delta)

            try:
                download_to_file(
                    candidate,
                    dest,
                    sha1=sha1,
                    size=size,
                    cancel_event=self.cancel_event,
                    progress_cb=on_bytes,
                    connections=self.segments,
                )
                return True
            except DownloadCancelled:
                raise InstallCancelled() from None
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))
                time.sleep(0.25)
                continue

        raise DownloadError(
            f"{label or dest.name} 下载失败：{errors[-1] if errors else '未知错误'}"
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 版本 JSON

    def _ensure_json(self, version_id: str, url: str = "") -> Path:
        path = version_json_path(self.game_dir, version_id)
        if path.exists():
            return path

        sources: list[str] = []
        if self.effective_source == "bmclapi":
            sources.append(
                f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/{version_id}/json"
            )
        if url:
            sources.append(url)
        sources.append(
            f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/{version_id}/json"
        )

        last_error: Exception | None = None
        for src in dict.fromkeys(sources):
            self._check_cancel()
            try:
                data = fetch_json(src)
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                path.write_text(
                    json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
                )
                return path
            except InstallCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                last_error = exc
                self._check_cancel()
        raise DownloadError(f"获取版本 {version_id} 的 JSON 失败：{last_error}")

    def _manifest_version_url(self, version_id: str) -> str:
        try:
            manifest = get_manifest(self.effective_source)
            for item in manifest.get("versions") or []:
                if str(item.get("id")) == version_id:
                    return str(item.get("url") or "")
        except Exception:
            pass
        return ""

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 安装入口

    def install(
        self,
        version_id: str,
        version_url: str = "",
        verify: bool = False,
        check_assets: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        self._set_progress(1, "准备安装…")
        self.log(f"开始处理版本 {version_id}")
        self._resolve_source()
        self.log(
            "下载线路：BMCLAPI 镜像"
            if self.effective_source == "bmclapi"
            else "下载线路：Mojang 官方"
        )

        self._ensure_json(version_id, version_url)
        # 逐级补齐父版本 JSON（例如 Forge 的父级原版）
        current_id = version_id
        seen: set[str] = set()
        while current_id and current_id not in seen:
            seen.add(current_id)
            path = version_json_path(self.game_dir, current_id)
            if not path.exists():
                self._ensure_json(current_id, self._manifest_version_url(current_id))
            try:
                data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            except Exception as exc:
                raise DownloadError(f"版本 JSON 损坏：{exc}") from exc
            current_id = str(data.get("inheritsFrom") or "")

        resolved = resolve_version(self.game_dir, version_id)

        if resolved.client_download.get("url"):
            self._install_client(resolved, verify=verify)
        elif not client_jar_path(self.game_dir, resolved).exists():
            raise DownloadError(
                "版本缺少客户端 jar，且没有可用的下载地址。请先安装对应的原版。"
            )

        self._install_libraries(resolved, verify=verify)
        self._install_natives(resolved)
        self._install_assets(resolved, verify=verify)
        self._install_logging(resolved, verify=verify)

        remaining = check_installation(
            self.game_dir, resolved, check_assets=check_assets
        )
        if remaining:
            raise DownloadError(
                "安装未完成，仍缺少：" + "、".join(remaining[:5])
            )

        self._set_progress(100, "安装完成")
        self.log(f"{version_id} 已准备就绪")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 客户端 / 依赖库 / natives

    def _install_client(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion, verify: bool = False) -> None:
        info = resolved.client_download
        url = str(info.get("url", ""))
        dest = self.game_dir / "versions" / resolved.jar_id / f"{resolved.jar_id}.jar"
        fallback = (
            f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/{resolved.jar_id}/client"
        )
        urls = mirror_urls(url, self.effective_source)
        if self.effective_source == "bmclapi":
            urls.insert(0, fallback)
        elif fallback not in urls:
            urls.append(fallback)
        self.log(f"检查客户端 jar：{resolved.jar_id}.jar")
        existing = dest.stat().st_size if dest.exists() else 0
        total = int(info.get("size") or 0) or 1
        self._set_progress(
            self._stage_percent(self.STAGE_CLIENT, min(existing, total), total),
            "检查客户端文件…",
        )
        last_error: Exception | None = None
        for candidate in dict.fromkeys(urls):
            try:
                self._download_file(
                    candidate,
                    dest,
                    sha1=str(info.get("sha1", "")),
                    size=int(info.get("size") or 0),
                    verify=verify,
                    label="客户端 jar",
                )
                self._set_progress(self.STAGE_CLIENT[1], "客户端文件就绪")
                return
            except InstallCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                last_error = exc
        raise DownloadError(f"客户端 jar 下载失败：{last_error}")

    def _install_libraries(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion, verify: bool = False) -> None:
        arts = active_library_artifacts(resolved)
        native_arts = [n.artifact for n in active_natives(resolved)]
        all_arts = []
        seen: set[str] = set()
        for art in arts + native_arts:
            if art.path and art.path not in seen:
                seen.add(art.path)
                all_arts.append(art)

        total = len(all_arts)
        self.log(f"检查依赖库（{total} 个文件）")
        done = 0
        failures: list[str] = []
        lock = threading.Lock()

        def worker(art) -> None:
            nonlocal done
            self._check_cancel()
            dest = libraries_dir(self.game_dir) / art.path
            try:
                if not (dest.exists() and not verify):
                    self._download_file(
                        art.url,
                        dest,
                        sha1=art.sha1,
                        size=art.size,
                        verify=verify,
                        label=art.name or Path(art.path).name,
                    )
            except InstallCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                with lock:
                    if len(failures) < 50:
                        failures.append(str(exc))
            finally:
                with lock:
                    done += 1
                    current = done
                self._set_progress(
                    self._stage_percent(self.STAGE_LIBS, current, total),
                    f"下载依赖库 {current}/{total}",
                )

        if total:
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(
                max_workers=max(6, min(16, self.threads + 4))
            ) as pool:
                futures = [pool.submit(worker, art) for art in all_arts]
                try:
                    for future in futures:
                        future.result()
                except InstallCancelled:
                    for future in futures:
                        future.cancel()
                    raise
        else:
            self.log("没有需要下载的依赖库")

        if failures:
            raise DownloadError(
                f"{len(failures)} 个依赖库下载失败：{failures[0]}"
            )
        self._set_progress(self.STAGE_LIBS[1], "依赖库就绪")

    def _install_natives(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion) -> None:
        natives = active_natives(resolved)
        target = natives_dir(self.game_dir, resolved)
        target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for sub in ("java", "jna", "lwjgl", "netty"):
            (target / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        if not natives:
            return

        self.log(f"解压运行库（{len(natives)} 个）")
        for native in natives:
            self._check_cancel()
            art = native.artifact
            jar_path = libraries_dir(self.game_dir) / art.path
            if not jar_path.exists():
                self._download_file(
                    art.url,
                    jar_path,
                    sha1=art.sha1,
                    size=art.size,
                    label=f"运行库 {art.name}",
                )
            try:
                with zipfile.ZipFile(jar_path) as zf:
                    for item in zf.infolist():
                        if item.is_dir():
                            continue
                        name = item.filename.replace("\\", "/")
                        if name.startswith("META-INF/"):
                            continue
                        if any(name.startswith(prefix) for prefix in native.excludes):
                            continue
                        relative = Path(name)
                        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
                            continue
                        dest = target / relative
                        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        with zf.open(item) as src, dest.open("wb") as out:
                            shutil.copyfileobj(src, out)
            except Exception as exc:
                raise DownloadError(f"解压运行库失败：{exc}") from exc
        self._set_progress(self.STAGE_LIBS[1], "运行库就绪")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 资源文件

    def _install_assets(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion, verify: bool = False) -> None:
        index_path = asset_index_path(self.game_dir, resolved)
        if not index_path.exists():
            url = resolved.asset_index_url
            if not url:
                raise DownloadError("版本缺少资源索引下载地址")
            self._set_progress(
                self._stage_percent(self.STAGE_ASSETS, 0, 100),
                "下载资源索引…",
            )
            self._download_file(
                url,
                index_path,
                sha1=resolved.asset_index_sha1,
                size=resolved.asset_index_size,
                label="资源索引",
            )

        try:
            index = json.loads(index_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except Exception as exc:
            raise DownloadError(f"资源索引损坏：{exc}") from exc

        objects = index.get("objects") or {}
        total = len(objects)
        self.log(f"检查资源文件（{total} 个）")
        if total == 0:
            return

        objects_root = assets_dir(self.game_dir) / "objects"
        tasks: list[tuple[str, int, Path]] = []
        completed = 0
        for _name, obj in objects.items():
            h = str(obj.get("hash", ""))
            if not h:
                continue
            dest = objects_root / h[:2] / h
            size = int(obj.get("size") or 0)
            if dest.exists():
                try:
                    size_ok = not size or dest.stat().st_size == size
                    if size_ok and not verify:
                        completed += 1
                        continue
                    if size_ok and _sha1_file(dest) == h:
                        completed += 1
                        continue
                except OSError:
                    pass
            tasks.append((h, size, dest))

        self._set_progress(
            self._stage_percent(self.STAGE_ASSETS, completed, total),
            f"资源文件 {completed}/{total}",
        )

        failures: list[str] = []
        failure_lock = threading.Lock()
        progress_lock = threading.Lock()

        def worker(task: tuple[str, int, Path]) -> None:
            h, size, dest = task
            self._check_cancel()
            url = f"https://resources.download.minecraft.net/{h[:2]}/{h}"
            try:
                self._download_file(
                    url,
                    dest,
                    sha1=h,
                    size=size,
                    verify=verify,
                    label="资源文件",
                )
            except InstallCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                with failure_lock:
                    if len(failures) < 50:
                        failures.append(str(exc))
            finally:
                nonlocal completed
                with progress_lock:
                    completed += 1
                    current = completed
                self._set_progress(
                    self._stage_percent(self.STAGE_ASSETS, current, total),
                    f"正在补全资源文件 {current}/{total}",
                )

        if tasks:
            self.log(f"需要下载 {len(tasks)} 个资源文件")
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(
                max_workers=max(8, min(32, self.threads * 3))
            ) as pool:
                futures = [pool.submit(worker, task) for task in tasks]
                try:
                    for future in as_completed(futures):
                        future.result()
                except InstallCancelled:
                    for future in futures:
                        future.cancel()
                    raise
        else:
            self.log("资源文件完整")

        if failures:
            raise DownloadError(
                f"{len(failures)} 个资源文件下载失败：{failures[0]}"
            )

        self._copy_legacy_assets(index, objects, verify=verify)
        self._set_progress(self.STAGE_ASSETS[1], "资源文件就绪")

    def _copy_legacy_assets(
        self,
        index: dict[str, Any],
        objects: dict[str, Any],
        verify: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        asset_id = str(index.get("id") or "")
        virtual = bool(index.get("virtual"))
        map_resources = bool(index.get("map_to_resources"))
        if not virtual and not map_resources:
            return

        self.log("正在生成旧版本资源目录…")
        objects_root = assets_dir(self.game_dir) / "objects"
        destinations: list[Path] = []
        if virtual and asset_id:
            destinations.append(assets_dir(self.game_dir) / "virtual" / asset_id)
        if map_resources:
            destinations.append(self.game_dir / "resources")

        for base in destinations:
            for name, obj in objects.items():
                h = str(obj.get("hash", ""))
                if not h:
                    continue
                src = objects_root / h[:2] / h
                if not src.exists():
                    continue
                relative = Path(str(name).replace("\\", "/"))
                if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts:
                    continue
                dest = base / relative
                if dest.exists():
                    if not verify:
                        continue
                    try:
                        if _sha1_file(dest) == h:
                            continue
                    except OSError:
                        pass
                    try:
                        dest.unlink()
                    except OSError:
                        continue
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                try:
                    os.link(src, dest)
                except OSError:
                    shutil.copy2(src, dest)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 日志配置

    def _install_logging(self, resolved: ResolvedVersion, verify: bool = False) -> None:
        client = (resolved.logging or {}).get("client") or {}
        file_info = client.get("file") or {}
        file_id = str(file_info.get("id") or "")
        if not file_id:
            return
        dest = assets_dir(self.game_dir) / "log_configs" / file_id
        if dest.exists() and not verify:
            return
        self._download_file(
            str(file_info.get("url", "")),
            dest,
            sha1=str(file_info.get("sha1", "")),
            size=int(file_info.get("size") or 0),
            verify=verify,
            label="日志配置",
        )
        self._set_progress(self.STAGE_FINISH[0], "日志配置就绪")


def install_version_worker(
    game_dir: Path,
    version_id: str,
    version_url: str = "",
    source: str = "official",
    verify: bool = False,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    threads: int = 8,
) -> None:
    installer = Installer(
        game_dir=game_dir,
        source=source,
        progress_cb=progress_cb,
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
        threads=threads,
    )
    installer.install(version_id, version_url=version_url, verify=verify)

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

CREATE_NO_WINDOW = 0x08000000


@dataclass
class JavaInfo:
    path: str
    version: str = ""
    major: int = 0
    arch: str = ""
    vendor: str = ""

    @property
    def display(self) -> str:
        bits = f" · {self.arch}" if self.arch else ""
        ver = self.version or "未知版本"
        return f"Java {ver} ({Path(self.path).parent.parent.name}){bits}"


def _java_roots() -> list[Path]:
    roots: list[Path] = []
    env_home = os.environ.get("JAVA_HOME")
    if env_home:
        roots.append(Path(env_home))

    candidates = [
        Path("C:/Program Files/Java"),
        Path("C:/Program Files/Eclipse Adoptium"),
        Path("C:/Program Files/Microsoft"),
        Path("C:/Program Files/BellSoft"),
        Path("C:/Program Files/Zulu"),
        Path("C:/Program Files (x86)/Java"),
        Path("D:/developer/Java"),
        Path.home() / ".jdks",
        Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", Path.home())) / "Programs/Eclipse Adoptium",
        Path(os.environ.get("APPDATA", Path.home())) / ".minecraft/runtime",
    ]
    roots.extend(candidates)
    return roots


def _candidate_executables(extra: list[str] | None = None) -> list[Path]:
    found: list[Path] = []

    for raw in extra or []:
        if raw:
            p = Path(os.path.expandvars(raw)).expanduser()
            if p.name.lower() in ("java.exe", "java"):
                found.append(p)
            else:
                found.append(p / "bin/java.exe")

    path_java = shutil.which("java")
    if path_java:
        found.append(Path(path_java))

    for root in _java_roots():
        if not root.exists():
            continue
        try:
            direct = root / "bin/java.exe"
            if direct.exists():
                found.append(direct)
            for exe in root.glob("*/bin/java.exe"):
                found.append(exe)
            for exe in root.glob("*/*/bin/java.exe"):
                found.append(exe)
            if root.name == "runtime":
                for exe in root.glob("**/bin/java.exe"):
                    found.append(exe)
        except OSError:
            continue

    unique: list[Path] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for path in found:
        try:
            resolved = path.resolve()
        except OSError:
            continue
        key = str(resolved).lower()
        if resolved.exists() and key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            unique.append(resolved)
    return unique


def _probe_java(exe: Path) -> JavaInfo | None:
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [str(exe), "-XshowSettings:properties", "-version"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=12,
            creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
        )
    except Exception:
        return None

    text = (proc.stdout or "") + "\n" + (proc.stderr or "")
    major = 0
    version = ""
    arch = ""
    vendor = ""

    m = re.search(r"java\.version\s*=\s*([^\s]+)", text)
    if m:
        version = m.group(1)
    else:
        m = re.search(r'version "([^"]+)"', text)
        if m:
            version = m.group(1)

    if version:
        vm = re.match(r"(?:1\.)?(\d+)", version)
        if vm:
            major = int(vm.group(1))

    m = re.search(r"os\.arch\s*=\s*([^\s]+)", text)
    if m:
        arch = m.group(1)
    m = re.search(r"java\.vendor\s*=\s*([^\n\r]+)", text)
    if m:
        vendor = m.group(1).strip()

    return JavaInfo(path=str(exe), version=version, major=major, arch=arch, vendor=vendor)


def probe_java(path: str) -> JavaInfo | None:
    exe = Path(os.path.expandvars(path)).expanduser()
    if exe.name.lower() != "java.exe":
        exe = exe / "bin/java.exe"
    if not exe.exists():
        return None
    return _probe_java(exe)


def detect_java_installs(preferred: str = "", max_workers: int = 8) -> list[JavaInfo]:
    exes = _candidate_executables([preferred] if preferred else [])
    if not exes:
        return []

    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as pool:
        infos = list(pool.map(_probe_java, exes))

    result = [info for info in infos if info is not None]
    result.sort(key=lambda x: (-x.major, x.path.lower()))
    return result


def pick_java(
    installs: list[JavaInfo], required_major: int, preferred: str = ""
) -> JavaInfo | None:
    if preferred:
        pref = str(Path(os.path.expandvars(preferred)).expanduser()).lower()
        for info in installs:
            if info.path.lower() == pref:
                return info
        p = Path(os.path.expandvars(preferred)).expanduser()
        if p.exists():
            probed = _probe_java(p)
            if probed:
                return probed

    required = max(8, int(required_major or 8))
    suitable = [i for i in installs if i.major >= required]
    if not suitable:
        return installs[0] if installs else None
    return min(suitable, key=lambda i: i.major)

from __future__ import annotations

import ctypes
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
import uuid
from ctypes import wintypes
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal

from .accounts import Account, offline_uuid, valid_player_name
from .config import APP_NAME, APP_VERSION, Config
from .java import JavaInfo, detect_java_installs, pick_java
from .paths import version_game_dir
from .versions import (
    OS_NAME,
    ResolvedVersion,
    active_library_artifacts,
    active_natives,
    asset_index_path,
    assets_dir,
    check_installation,
    client_jar_path,
    features_for,
    libraries_dir,
    natives_dir,
    resolve_version,
    rules_allowed,
)

CREATE_NO_WINDOW = 0x08000000 if OS_NAME == "windows" else 0
SYSTEM_SEPARATOR = ";" if OS_NAME == "windows" else ":"


class LaunchError(Exception):
    pass


class MissingFilesError(LaunchError):
    def __init__(self, missing: list[str]):
        self.missing = missing
        super().__init__("游戏文件不完整：" + "、".join(missing[:5]))


@dataclass
class LaunchPlan:
    command: list[str]
    cwd: str
    java: JavaInfo
    version: ResolvedVersion
    log_file: str = ""
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def command_line(self) -> str:
        return subprocess.list2cmdline(self.command)


def redacted_command_line(command: list[str]) -> str:
    """生成可以安全写入日志的命令行，隐藏访问令牌。"""
    result: list[str] = []
    hide_next = False
    secret_flags = {"--accessToken", "--auth_session", "--clientid"}
    for arg in command:
        if hide_next:
            result.append("***")
            hide_next = False
            continue
        result.append(arg)
        if arg in secret_flags:
            hide_next = True
    return subprocess.list2cmdline(result)


def _flatten(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return [value]
    if isinstance(value, list):
        result: list[str] = []
        for item in value:
            result.extend(_flatten(item))
        return result
    return []


def _substitute(value: str, mapping: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    result = value
    for key, replacement in mapping.items():
        result = result.replace("${" + key + "}", replacement)
    return result


def _unresolved(value: str) -> list[str]:
    import re

    return re.findall(r"\$\{([^}]+)\}", value)


def _split_legacy_args(template: str, mapping: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
    """先分词再替换，避免 Windows 路径中的反斜杠被 shlex 当成转义符。"""
    try:
        tokens = shlex.split(template, posix=False)
    except ValueError:
        tokens = template.split()
    result: list[str] = []
    for token in tokens:
        if len(token) >= 2 and token[0] == token[-1] and token[0] in "\"'":
            token = token[1:-1]
        result.append(_substitute(token, mapping))
    return result


def _extract_args(arguments: list[Any], mapping: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    features = features_for()
    for item in arguments:
        if isinstance(item, str):
            result.append(_substitute(item, mapping))
            continue
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        if not rules_allowed(item.get("rules"), features):
            continue
        for value in _flatten(item.get("value")):
            result.append(_substitute(value, mapping))
    return result


def _ignore_client_jar(args: list[str], jar_name: str) -> list[str]:
    """把真实的客户端 jar 补进 Forge/NeoForge 的 ignoreList。

    安装器写入的是 ``-DignoreList=client-extra,${version_name}.jar``，官方
    启动器会把客户端 jar 复制成 ``<版本名>.jar`` 来匹配。我们直接复用父版本
    的 ``1.21.1.jar``，若不补上真实文件名，ModLauncher 会把它和 NeoForge 的
    ``minecraft`` 模块同时加载，导致两个模块导出相同包而启动失败。
    """
    if not jar_name:
        return args
    prefix = "-DignoreList="
    lowered = jar_name.lower()
    result = list(args)
    changed = False
    for index, arg in enumerate(args):
        if not arg.startswith(prefix):
            continue
        values = [item for item in arg[len(prefix) :].split(",") if item]
        if any(item.lower() == lowered for item in values):
            continue
        values.append(jar_name)
        result[index] = prefix + ",".join(values)
        changed = True
    return result if changed else args


def _java_info_for(
    required_major: int, cfg: Config, installs: list[JavaInfo] | None = None
) -> JavaInfo:
    pool = installs
    if not pool:
        pool = detect_java_installs(cfg.java_path)
    chosen = pick_java(pool, required_major, cfg.java_path) if pool else None
    if chosen is None:
        raise LaunchError(
            "没有找到可用的 Java。请到“设置”中选择 java.exe，或安装 Java 运行环境。"
        )
    if required_major and chosen.major and chosen.major < required_major:
        raise LaunchError(
            f"该版本需要 Java {required_major} 或更高版本，"
            f"当前选择的是 Java {chosen.major}。请到设置中切换 Java。"
        )
    return chosen


def _check_files(game_dir: Path, resolved: ResolvedVersion) -> list[str]:
    missing = check_installation(game_dir, resolved, check_assets=False)
    for native in active_natives(resolved):
        if not (libraries_dir(game_dir) / native.artifact.path).exists():
            missing.append(f"运行库 {native.artifact.name}")
    return missing


def prepare_launch(
    game_dir: Path,
    version_id: str,
    cfg: Config,
    installs: list[JavaInfo] | None = None,
    java_info: JavaInfo | None = None,
    account: Account | None = None,
    server_address: str = "",
    instance_id: str = "",
) -> LaunchPlan:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    # version_id 决定用哪套加载器/依赖启动；instance_id 决定存档、Mod、
    # 材质和光影放在哪个游戏版本目录。分离后同一个加载器可以服务多个实例。
    run_dir = version_game_dir(
        game_dir, instance_id or version_id, cfg.version_isolation
    )
    account = account or Account.offline(cfg.player_name.strip())

    if account.is_msa:
        name = account.name.strip()
        if not name or not account.uuid or not account.mc_access_token:
            raise LaunchError("正版登录状态无效，请重新登录 Microsoft 账户。")
        auth_uuid = account.uuid
        access_token = account.mc_access_token
        auth_xuid = account.xuid
        user_type = "msa"
        client_id = cfg.microsoft_client_id
    else:
        name = cfg.player_name.strip()
        if not valid_player_name(name):
            raise LaunchError("玩家名称需为 3-16 位字母、数字或下划线。")
        auth_uuid = offline_uuid(name)
        access_token = uuid.uuid4().hex
        auth_xuid = ""
        user_type = "legacy"
        client_id = ""

    resolved = resolve_version(game_dir, version_id)
    if not resolved.main_class:
        raise LaunchError("版本缺少主类信息，无法启动。")

    missing = _check_files(game_dir, resolved)
    if missing:
        raise MissingFilesError(missing)

    java = java_info or _java_info_for(resolved.java_major, cfg, installs)
    early_warnings: list[str] = []
    if resolved.java_major and resolved.java_major <= 8 and java.major > 8:
        early_warnings.append(
            f"该版本较旧，建议使用 Java 8；当前使用 Java {java.major}，可能无法正常启动。"
        )

    client_jar = client_jar_path(game_dir, resolved)
    libs_root = libraries_dir(game_dir)
    entries: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for art in active_library_artifacts(resolved):
        path = str(libs_root / art.path)
        if path not in seen:
            seen.add(path)
            entries.append(path)
    entries.append(str(client_jar))
    classpath = SYSTEM_SEPARATOR.join(entries)

    native_dir = natives_dir(game_dir, resolved)
    native_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for sub in ("java", "jna", "lwjgl", "netty"):
        (native_dir / sub).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    assets_root = assets_dir(game_dir)
    index_file = asset_index_path(game_dir, resolved)
    log_config = ""
    client_log = ((resolved.logging or {}).get("client") or {}).get("file") or {}
    if client_log.get("id"):
        candidate = assets_root / "log_configs" / str(client_log["id"])
        if candidate.exists():
            log_config = str(candidate)

    placeholder = {
        "auth_player_name": name,
        "version_name": resolved.id,
        "game_directory": str(run_dir),
        "game_assets": str(assets_root),
        "assets_root": str(assets_root),
        "assets_index_name": resolved.asset_index_id,
        "auth_uuid": auth_uuid,
        "auth_access_token": access_token,
        "auth_session": f"token:{access_token}:{auth_uuid}",
        "clientid": client_id,
        "auth_xuid": auth_xuid,
        "user_type": user_type,
        "version_type": resolved.type or "release",
        "user_properties": "{}",
        "natives_directory": str(native_dir),
        "launcher_name": APP_NAME.replace(" ", ""),
        "launcher_version": APP_VERSION,
        "classpath": classpath,
        "classpath_separator": SYSTEM_SEPARATOR,
        "library_directory": str(libs_root),
        "resolution_width": "854",
        "resolution_height": "480",
        "quickPlayPath": "",
        "quickPlaySingleplayer": "",
        "quickPlayMultiplayer": "",
        "quickPlayRealms": "",
    }

    command: list[str] = [java.path]
    command.append(f"-Xmx{cfg.memory_mb}M")
    command.append(f"-Xms{min(cfg.memory_mb, 2048)}M")

    default_jvm = _extract_args(resolved.default_user_jvm, placeholder)
    default_jvm = _ignore_client_jar(default_jvm, client_jar.name)
    for arg in default_jvm:
        low = arg.lower()
        if low.startswith("-xmx") or low.startswith("-xms") or low.startswith("-xmn"):
            continue
        command.append(arg)

    version_jvm = _extract_args(resolved.arguments.get("jvm", []), placeholder)
    version_jvm = _ignore_client_jar(version_jvm, client_jar.name)
    command.extend(version_jvm)

    has_cp = False
    has_library_path = False
    for index, arg in enumerate(command):
        if arg == "-cp" or arg == "-classpath":
            has_cp = True
            if index + 1 < len(command):
                command[index + 1] = classpath
        if arg.startswith("-Djava.library.path="):
            has_library_path = True
            command[index] = "-Djava.library.path=" + str(native_dir)
    if not has_cp:
        command.extend(["-cp", classpath])
    if not has_library_path:
        command.append("-Djava.library.path=" + str(native_dir))
    if log_config and not any(a.startswith("-Dlog4j.configurationFile=") for a in command):
        command.append("-Dlog4j.configurationFile=" + log_config)

    if cfg.jvm_args.strip():
        try:
            extra = shlex.split(cfg.jvm_args, posix=True)
        except ValueError:
            extra = cfg.jvm_args.split()
        command.extend(extra)

    # 防止 JVM 参数中的未知占位符漏到命令行
    command = [
        _substitute(arg, placeholder) for arg in command
    ]

    warnings: list[str] = list(early_warnings)
    unresolved = []
    for arg in command:
        unresolved.extend(_unresolved(arg))
    if unresolved:
        warnings.append("存在未解析的启动参数占位符：" + ", ".join(sorted(set(unresolved))))

    game_arguments: list[str]
    if resolved.arguments.get("game"):
        game_arguments = _extract_args(resolved.arguments["game"], placeholder)
    elif resolved.minecraft_arguments:
        game_arguments = _split_legacy_args(
            resolved.minecraft_arguments, placeholder
        )
    else:
        raise LaunchError("版本缺少游戏启动参数。")

    for arg in game_arguments:
        unresolved.extend(_unresolved(arg))
    if any(_unresolved(a) for a in game_arguments):
        warnings.append("游戏参数中存在未解析的占位符。")

    command.append(resolved.main_class)
    command.extend(game_arguments)

    if str(server_address or "").strip():
        from .sakura import parse_server_address

        server_host, server_port = parse_server_address(server_address)
        command.extend(["--server", server_host, "--port", str(server_port)])

    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (run_dir / "mods").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    return LaunchPlan(
        command=command,
        cwd=str(run_dir),
        java=java,
        version=resolved,
        log_file=log_config,
        warnings=warnings,
    )


class GameProcess(QObject):
    """用守护线程读取游戏输出，关闭启动器也不会杀掉游戏进程。"""

    output = Signal(str)
    started_ok = Signal(int)
    game_finished = Signal(int)

    def __init__(self, plan: LaunchPlan, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.plan = plan
        self._process: subprocess.Popen[str] | None = None
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._finished = threading.Event()

    def start(self) -> None:
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()

    def _run(self) -> None:
        startupinfo = None
        flags = CREATE_NO_WINDOW
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
            startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
            startupinfo.wShowWindow = subprocess.SW_HIDE

        try:
            self._process = subprocess.Popen(
                self.plan.command,
                cwd=self.plan.cwd,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
                bufsize=1,
                creationflags=flags,
                startupinfo=startupinfo,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.output.emit(f"[启动失败] {exc}")
            self._finish(-1)
            return

        process = self._process
        self.started_ok.emit(process.pid)

        # 输出读取必须和进程等待分开：某些子进程（如 Forge 安装器或游戏内
        # 拉起的辅助进程）会继承 stdout 管道，父进程退出后管道仍被占住。
        # 如果在这里同步迭代 stdout，就会永远等不到 EOF，UI 便一直停在
        # “游戏运行中”。wait() 只看游戏主进程本身，能第一时间拿到退出码。
        reader = threading.Thread(
            target=self._pump_output, args=(process,), daemon=True
        )
        reader.start()

        try:
            code = process.wait()
        except Exception as exc:
            self.output.emit(f"[进程错误] {exc}")
            code = -1

        # 给读取线程一点时间把缓冲区里剩余的日志吐完，然后立刻通知界面。
        reader.join(0.25)
        self._finish(code)

    def _pump_output(self, process: subprocess.Popen[str]) -> None:
        stream = process.stdout
        if stream is None:
            return
        try:
            for line in stream:
                if line:
                    self.output.emit(line.rstrip("\r\n"))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _finish(self, code: int) -> None:
        if self._finished.is_set():
            return
        self._finished.set()
        # 先通知界面，再尝试关闭管道。TextIOWrapper.close() 会等待读取线程
        # 持有的缓冲区锁；如果子进程还占着管道，这里会一直阻塞。
        self.game_finished.emit(code)
        if self._process and self._process.stdout:
            threading.Thread(target=self._close_stream, daemon=True).start()

    def _close_stream(self) -> None:
        try:
            if self._process and self._process.stdout:
                self._process.stdout.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self._process and self._process.poll() is None)

    @property
    def pid(self) -> int:
        return self._process.pid if self._process else 0

    def stop(self, graceful: bool = True) -> None:
        process = self._process
        if not process or process.poll() is not None:
            return
        if not graceful or sys.platform != "win32":
            try:
                process.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
        threading.Thread(
            target=self._close_gracefully, args=(process,), daemon=True
        ).start()

    def _close_gracefully(self, process: subprocess.Popen) -> None:
        """先向游戏窗口发送 WM_CLOSE，超时后再结束进程。"""
        try:
            user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
            callback_type = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(
                wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.HWND, wintypes.LPARAM
            )
            user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId.argtypes = [
                wintypes.HWND,
                ctypes.POINTER(wintypes.DWORD),
            ]
            user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId.restype = wintypes.DWORD
            user32.IsWindowVisible.argtypes = [wintypes.HWND]
            user32.IsWindowVisible.restype = wintypes.BOOL
            user32.PostMessageW.argtypes = [
                wintypes.HWND,
                wintypes.UINT,
                wintypes.WPARAM,
                wintypes.LPARAM,
            ]
            user32.PostMessageW.restype = wintypes.BOOL
            user32.EnumWindows.argtypes = [callback_type, wintypes.LPARAM]
            user32.EnumWindows.restype = wintypes.BOOL
            pid = process.pid
            found = [0]

            def enum_window(hwnd, _lparam) -> bool:
                window_pid = wintypes.DWORD()
                user32.GetWindowThreadProcessId(
                    hwnd, ctypes.byref(window_pid)
                )
                if window_pid.value == pid and user32.IsWindowVisible(hwnd):
                    found[0] += 1
                    user32.PostMessageW(hwnd, 0x0010, 0, 0)  # WM_CLOSE
                return True

            callback = callback_type(enum_window)
            user32.EnumWindows(callback, 0)
        except Exception:
            found = [0]

        deadline = time.time() + (12 if found[0] else 5)
        while time.time() < deadline and process.poll() is None:
            time.sleep(0.2)
        if process.poll() is not None:
            return
        try:
            process.terminate()
        except Exception:
            return
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=4)
        except Exception:
            try:
                process.kill()
            except Exception:
                pass

    BMCL_MAVEN,
    InstallCancelled,
    Installer,
    _http_open,
    mirror_urls,
)
from .versions import scan_versions, version_json_path

ProgressCallback = Callable[[int, str], None]
LogCallback = Callable[[str], None]
ProcessCallback = Callable[[subprocess.Popen | None], None]

FABRIC_META_BMCL = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/fabric-meta/v2"
FABRIC_META = "https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2"
FORGE_LIST_BMCL = "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/forge/minecraft/{mc}"
FORGE_LIST_OFFICIAL = (
    "https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/maven-metadata.json"
)

    "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/neoforge/meta/api/maven/details/"
    "releases/net/neoforged/{group}"
)
NEOFORGE_OFFICIAL_MAVEN = "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases"
FORGE_OFFICIAL_MAVEN = "https://maven.minecraftforge.net"
INSTALLER_CACHE = APP_DIR / "cache" / "loaders"
CREATE_NO_WINDOW = 0x08000000 if sys.platform == "win32" else 0
CENTRAL_MAVEN = "https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/"
CREEPER_MAVEN = "https://maven.creeperhost.net/"

LOADER_NAMES = {"fabric": "Fabric", "neoforge": "NeoForge", "forge": "Forge"}


class LoaderError(Exception):
    pass


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 基础网络工具


def _get_json(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> Any:
    with _http_open(url, timeout=timeout) as resp:
        raw = resp.read()
    return json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))


def _first_json(urls: list[str], timeout: int = 30) -> Any:
    errors: list[str] = []
    for url in urls:
        try:
            return _get_json(url, timeout=timeout)
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"{url}：{exc}")
    raise LoaderError("；".join(errors[-2:]) or "网络请求失败")


def _version_key(value: str) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    return tuple(int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+", str(value)))


def _check_cancel(cancel_event: threading.Event | None) -> None:
    if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
        raise InstallCancelled()


def _sha1_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1()
    with path.open("rb") as fp:
        while True:
            chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _download(
    urls: list[str],
    dest: Path,
    *,
    sha1: str = "",
    size: int = 0,
    label: str = "",
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> bool:
    """按顺序尝试多个地址下载文件；返回是否真正下载。"""
    _check_cancel(cancel_event)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    if dest.exists():
        try:
            size_ok = (not size) or dest.stat().st_size == size
            if size_ok and (not sha1 or _sha1_file(dest) == sha1):
                return False
        except OSError:
            pass

    part = dest.with_name(dest.name + ".part")
    errors: list[str] = []
    for url in dict.fromkeys(urls):
        # 同一地址重试一次，利用 .part 断点续传，慢速镜像中途断开也能续上。
        for _attempt in range(2):
            _check_cancel(cancel_event)
            offset = part.stat().st_size if part.exists() else 0
            headers = {"Range": f"bytes={offset}-"} if offset else None
            try:
                with _http_open(url, timeout=45, headers=headers) as resp:
                    status = getattr(resp, "status", 200)
                    if offset and status != 206:
                        offset = 0
                    if status == 206:
                        match = re.search(
                            r"/(\d+)\s*$", resp.headers.get("Content-Range", "")
                        )
                        total = int(match.group(1)) if match else 0
                    else:
                        total = int(resp.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
                    expected = size or total
                    if expected and offset > expected:
                        offset = 0
                    digest = hashlib.sha1()
                    if offset:
                        with part.open("rb") as fp:
                            while True:
                                chunk = fp.read(1024 * 1024)
                                if not chunk:
                                    break
                                digest.update(chunk)
                    written = offset
                    with part.open("ab" if offset else "wb") as fp:
                        while True:
                            _check_cancel(cancel_event)
                            chunk = resp.read(256 * 1024)
                            if not chunk:
                                break
                            fp.write(chunk)
                            digest.update(chunk)
                            written += len(chunk)
                    if expected and written != expected:
                        raise LoaderError(
                            f"文件大小不一致（期望 {expected}，实际 {written}）"
                        )
                    if sha1 and digest.hexdigest().lower() != sha1.lower():
                        raise LoaderError("SHA1 校验失败")
                os.replace(part, dest)
                return True
            except InstallCancelled:
                try:
                    part.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                except OSError:
                    pass
                raise
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))
                text = str(exc)
                if "SHA1" in text or "大小不一致" in text:
                    try:
                        part.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    except OSError:
                        pass
                time.sleep(0.15)

    try:
        part.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    except OSError:
        pass
    raise LoaderError(f"{label or dest.name} 下载失败：{errors[-1] if errors else '未知错误'}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 版本列表


def fetch_fabric_versions(mc_version: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    try:
        data = _first_json(
            [
                f"{FABRIC_META_BMCL}/versions/loader/{mc_version}",
                f"{FABRIC_META}/versions/loader/{mc_version}",
            ]
        )
    except LoaderError as exc:
        text = str(exc)
        if "HTTP Error 400" in text or "HTTP Error 404" in text:
            raise LoaderError(
                f"Fabric 目前没有适配 Minecraft {mc_version} 的版本，"
                "请确认游戏版本是否正确"
            ) from exc
        raise
    if not isinstance(data, list):
        raise LoaderError("Fabric 版本列表格式不正确")
    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in data:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        loader = item.get("loader") or {}
        version = str(loader.get("version") or "")
        if version:
            result.append(
                {
                    "version": version,
                    "stable": bool(loader.get("stable")),
                }
            )
    result.sort(key=lambda x: _version_key(x["version"]), reverse=True)
    return result


def _short_forge_version(mc_version: str, value: str) -> str:
    prefix = f"{mc_version}-"
    return value[len(prefix) :] if value.startswith(prefix) else value


def fetch_forge_versions(mc_version: str) -> list[str]:
    try:
        data = _first_json([FORGE_LIST_BMCL.format(mc=mc_version)])
        result: list[str] = []
        if isinstance(data, list):
            for item in data:
                if isinstance(item, dict):
                    version = str(item.get("version") or "")
                    if version:
                        result.append(_short_forge_version(mc_version, version))
        if result:
            return sorted(dict.fromkeys(result), key=_version_key, reverse=True)
    except LoaderError:
        pass

    data = _first_json([FORGE_LIST_OFFICIAL])
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        values = data.get(mc_version) or []
        if isinstance(values, list):
            return sorted(
                {
                    _short_forge_version(mc_version, str(v))
                    for v in values
                    if v
                },
                key=_version_key,
                reverse=True,
            )
    raise LoaderError(f"没有找到 Minecraft {mc_version} 的 Forge 版本")


def _neoforge_group(mc_version: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """返回 (maven group, 版本前缀)。"""
    if mc_version == "1.20.1":
        return "forge", "1.20.1-"
    parts = mc_version.split(".")
    if len(parts) >= 2 and parts[0] == "1":
        major = parts[1]
        minor = parts[2] if len(parts) >= 3 else "0"
    else:
        major = parts[0] if parts else "0"
        minor = parts[1] if len(parts) >= 2 else "0"
    return "neoforge", f"{major}.{minor}."


def fetch_neoforge_versions(mc_version: str) -> list[str]:
    group, prefix = _neoforge_group(mc_version)
    data = _first_json([NEOFORGE_META_BMCL.format(group=group)])
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise LoaderError("NeoForge 版本列表格式不正确")
    names: list[str] = []
    for item in data.get("files") or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        name = str(item.get("name") or "")
        if item.get("type") != "DIRECTORY" and not name:
            continue
        if name.startswith(prefix) or (group == "forge" and name.startswith(prefix)):
            names.append(name)
    names.sort(key=_version_key, reverse=True)
    if not names:
        raise LoaderError(
            f"NeoForge 目前没有适用于 Minecraft {mc_version} 的版本"
        )
    return names


def loader_versions(kind: str, mc_version: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    if kind == "fabric":
        return fetch_fabric_versions(mc_version)
    if kind == "forge":
        return [
            {"version": v, "stable": False}
            for v in fetch_forge_versions(mc_version)
        ]
    if kind == "neoforge":
        return [
            {"version": v, "stable": False}
            for v in fetch_neoforge_versions(mc_version)
        ]
    raise LoaderError("未知的加载器类型")

def _ensure_launcher_profiles(game_dir: Path) -> None:
    path = game_dir / "launcher_profiles.json"
    if path.exists():
        return
    try:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(
            json.dumps({"profiles": {}, "settings": {}, "version": 3}),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    except OSError:
        pass


def _installer_urls(kind: str, mc_version: str, loader_version: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    if kind == "forge":
        if loader_version.startswith(f"{mc_version}-"):
            loader_version = loader_version[len(mc_version) + 1 :]
        name = f"forge-{mc_version}-{loader_version}-installer.jar"
        rel = f"net/minecraftforge/forge/{mc_version}-{loader_version}/{name}"
        return (
            [
                BMCL_MAVEN + rel,
                CREEPER_MAVEN + rel,
                f"{FORGE_OFFICIAL_MAVEN}/{rel}",
            ],
            name,
        )
    if loader_version.startswith("1.20.1-"):
        # NeoForge 1.20.1 的构件发布在 net/neoforged/forge 下，
        # 文件名沿用 Forge 的 forge-<版本>-installer.jar。
        name = f"forge-{loader_version}-installer.jar"
        rel = f"net/neoforged/forge/{loader_version}/{name}"
    else:
        name = f"neoforge-{loader_version}-installer.jar"
        rel = f"net/neoforged/neoforge/{loader_version}/{name}"
    urls = [
        BMCL_MAVEN + rel,
        CREEPER_MAVEN + rel,
        f"{NEOFORGE_OFFICIAL_MAVEN}/{rel}",
        f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/neoforge/version/{loader_version}/download/installer.jar",
    ]
    return urls, name


def _patch_installer(source: Path, dest: Path, kind: str) -> None:
    """把安装器内的 Maven 地址替换为国内可用的镜像。"""
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(source) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(
            dest, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
        ) as zout:
            for info in zin.infolist():
                name = info.filename
                # 修改内容会让原 jar 的签名校验失败，重打包时移除签名文件。
                if name.upper().startswith("META-INF/") and name.upper().endswith(
                    (".SF", ".RSA", ".DSA", ".EC")
                ):
                    continue
                data = zin.read(info.filename)
                if info.filename.endswith((".json", ".txt", ".properties")):
                    text = data.decode("utf-8", "replace")
                    if kind == "neoforge":
                        text = text.replace(
                            "https://maven.neoforged.net/releases/", BMCL_MAVEN
                        )
                        text = text.replace(
                            "https://maven.neoforged.net/", BMCL_MAVEN
                        )
                        text = text.replace(
                            '"mirrorList": "https://mirrors.neoforged.net"',
                            '"mirrorList": ""',
                        )
                        text = text.replace(
                            '"mirrorList":"https://mirrors.neoforged.net"',
                            '"mirrorList":""',
                        )
                    else:
                        text = text.replace(
                            "https://maven.minecraftforge.net/", BMCL_MAVEN
                        )
                        text = text.replace(
                            "http://maven.minecraftforge.net/", BMCL_MAVEN
                        )
                        text = text.replace(
                            "http://files.minecraftforge.net/maven/", BMCL_MAVEN
                        )
                        text = text.replace(
                            '"mirrorList": "https://files.minecraftforge.net/mirrors-2.0.json"',
                            '"mirrorList": ""',
                        )
                        text = text.replace(
                            '"mirrorList":"https://files.minecraftforge.net/mirrors-2.0.json"',
                            '"mirrorList":""',
                        )
                    data = text.encode("utf-8")
                zout.writestr(info, data)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise LoaderError(f"准备 {LOADER_NAMES[kind]} 安装器失败：{exc}") from exc


def _installer_libraries(jar: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    entries: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as zf:
            for name in ("install_profile.json", "version.json"):
                if name not in zf.namelist():
                    continue
                try:
                    data = json.loads(zf.read(name).decode("utf-8"))
                except Exception:
                    continue
                for lib in data.get("libraries") or []:
                    if not isinstance(lib, dict):
                        continue
                    art = (lib.get("downloads") or {}).get("artifact") or {}
                    path = str(art.get("path") or "")
                    url = str(art.get("url") or "")
                    if not path or not url:
                        continue
                    entries[path] = {
                        "path": path,
                        "url": url,
                        "sha1": str(art.get("sha1") or ""),
                        "size": int(art.get("size") or 0),
                        "name": str(lib.get("name") or path),
                    }
    except Exception as exc:
        raise LoaderError(f"读取安装器依赖失败：{exc}") from exc
    return list(entries.values())


def _preseed_libraries(
    game_dir: Path,
    jar: Path,
    *,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> int:
    libs = _installer_libraries(jar)
    if not libs:
        return 0

    total = len(libs)
    log_cb(f"预下载加载器依赖（{total} 个）")
    done = 0
    failed = 0
    lock = threading.Lock()

    def task(lib: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        path = str(lib["path"])
        dest = game_dir / "libraries" / path
        bmcl_url = BMCL_MAVEN + path
        creeper_url = CREEPER_MAVEN + path
        central_url = CENTRAL_MAVEN + path
        # Forge/NeoForge 自有构件在 Central 上没有，先走 BMCL；
        # 其余第三方库优先 Central，速度通常更快。
        if path.startswith(
            ("net/minecraftforge/", "net/neoforged/", "de/oceanlabs/",
             "com/nothome/", "trove/")
        ):
            urls = [bmcl_url, creeper_url]
        else:
            urls = [central_url, bmcl_url, creeper_url]
        urls += mirror_urls(str(lib["url"]), "bmclapi")
        urls.append(central_url)
        if not str(lib["url"]).startswith("https://libraries.minecraft.net/"):
            urls.append(FORGE_OFFICIAL_MAVEN + "/" + path)
            urls.append(f"{NEOFORGE_OFFICIAL_MAVEN}/{path}")
        seen: set[str] = set()
        urls = [u for u in urls if not (u in seen or seen.add(u))]
        try:
            _download(
                urls,
                dest,
                sha1=str(lib.get("sha1") or ""),
                size=int(lib.get("size") or 0),
                label=str(lib.get("name") or path),
                cancel_event=cancel_event,
            )
            return True
        except InstallCancelled:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            log_cb(f"依赖预下载失败：{path}（{exc}）")
            return False

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(task, lib) for lib in libs]
        try:
            for future in as_completed(futures):
                try:
                    ok = future.result()
                except InstallCancelled:
                    for f in futures:
                        f.cancel()
                    raise
                with lock:
                    done += 1
                    if not ok:
                        failed += 1
                    current = done
                progress_cb(
                    12 + int(43 * current / total),
                    f"准备加载器依赖 {current}/{total}",
                )
        except InstallCancelled:
            for f in futures:
                f.cancel()
            raise

    if failed:
        log_cb(f"{failed} 个依赖未能预下载，安装器会再尝试一次")
    return failed


def _run_installer(
    java_path: str,
    jar: Path,
    game_dir: Path,
    *,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
    process_cb: ProcessCallback | None,
) -> None:
    cmd = [
        java_path,
        "-jar",
        str(jar),
        "--installClient",
        str(game_dir),
    ]
    log_cb("运行安装器：" + subprocess.list2cmdline(cmd))
    startupinfo = None
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
        startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
        startupinfo.wShowWindow = subprocess.SW_HIDE

    try:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(
            cmd,
            cwd=str(game_dir),
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            bufsize=1,
            creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
            startupinfo=startupinfo,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise LoaderError(f"无法启动安装器：{exc}") from exc

    if process_cb:
        process_cb(proc)
    try:
        assert proc.stdout is not None
        for line in proc.stdout:
            _check_cancel(cancel_event)
            text = line.rstrip("\r\n")
            if text:
                log_cb(text)
        code = proc.wait()
    finally:
        if process_cb:
            process_cb(None)

    if cancel_event is not None and cancel_event.is_set():
        raise InstallCancelled()
    if code != 0:
        raise LoaderError(f"安装器退出代码 {code}，请查看上方日志")


def _find_loader_version(
    game_dir: Path,
    mc_version: str,
    kind: str,
    loader_version: str,
    before: set[str],
) -> str:
    candidates = []
    for summary in scan_versions(game_dir):
        if summary.id == mc_version:
            continue
        if summary.id in before:
            continue
        if summary.loader != LOADER_NAMES[kind]:
            continue
        score = 0
        if loader_version in summary.id:
            score += 2
        candidates.append((score, summary.folder_mtime, summary.id))
    if candidates:
        candidates.sort(reverse=True)
        return candidates[0][2]

    # 安装器生成的版本 ID 不一定带完整的加载器版本（例如 NeoForge 1.20.1
    # 会生成 1.20.1-forge-47.1.106），重装时该目录也已在 before 集合里，
    # 因此这里用兼容的短版本号做一次确定性查找。
    short_version = loader_version
    if short_version.startswith(f"{mc_version}-"):
        short_version = short_version[len(mc_version) + 1 :]
    expected: list[str] = []
    if kind == "forge":
        expected.append(f"{mc_version}-forge-{short_version}")
    else:
        expected.extend(
            [
                f"neoforge-{loader_version}",
                f"{mc_version}-neoforge-{loader_version}",
                f"{mc_version}-forge-{short_version}",
                f"{mc_version}-neoforge-{short_version}",
            ]
        )
    for version_id in dict.fromkeys(expected):
        if version_json_path(game_dir, version_id).exists():
            return version_id
    raise LoaderError("安装器已结束，但没有找到生成的版本，请查看日志")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 安装入口


def _install_fabric(
    game_dir: Path,
    mc_version: str,
    loader_version: str,
    *,
    source: str,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> str:
    progress_cb(3, "获取 Fabric 配置…")
    try:
        data = _first_json(
            [
                f"{FABRIC_META_BMCL}/versions/loader/{mc_version}/{loader_version}/profile/json",
                f"{FABRIC_META}/versions/loader/{mc_version}/{loader_version}/profile/json",
            ]
        )
    except LoaderError as exc:
        text = str(exc)
        if "HTTP Error 400" in text or "HTTP Error 404" in text:
            raise LoaderError(
                f"Fabric 没有找到 Minecraft {mc_version} 与加载器 "
                f"{loader_version} 的组合，请重新选择版本"
            ) from exc
        raise
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get("libraries"):
        raise LoaderError("Fabric 返回的版本配置不完整")
    version_id = str(data.get("id") or f"fabric-loader-{loader_version}-{mc_version}")
    data["id"] = version_id
    data.setdefault("inheritsFrom", mc_version)

    path = version_json_path(game_dir, version_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    log_cb(f"已生成 Fabric 版本配置：{version_id}")

    progress_cb(8, "补全原版与 Fabric 依赖…")
    installer = Installer(
        game_dir,
        source=source,
        progress_cb=lambda p, m: progress_cb(8 + int(p * 0.92), m),
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )
    installer.install(version_id, verify=False, check_assets=True)
    return version_id


def _install_forge_family(
    game_dir: Path,
    mc_version: str,
    loader_version: str,
    kind: str,
    *,
    java_path: str,
    source: str,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
    process_cb: ProcessCallback | None,
) -> str:
    name = LOADER_NAMES[kind]
    INSTALLER_CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    urls, filename = _installer_urls(kind, mc_version, loader_version)
    installer_path = INSTALLER_CACHE / f"{kind}-{mc_version}-{loader_version}.jar"

    progress_cb(2, f"下载 {name} 安装器…")
    log_cb(f"下载 {name} 安装器 {loader_version}")
    _download(
        urls,
        installer_path,
        label=f"{name} 安装器",
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )

    run_path = INSTALLER_CACHE / f"{kind}-{mc_version}-{loader_version}-bmcl.jar"
    _patch_installer(installer_path, run_path, kind)
    log_cb(f"已将 {name} 安装器切换到 BMCLAPI 镜像")

    _ensure_launcher_profiles(game_dir)
    before = {v.id for v in scan_versions(game_dir)}
    _preseed_libraries(
        game_dir,
        run_path,
        progress_cb=progress_cb,
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )

    progress_cb(57, f"运行 {name} 安装器…")
    _run_installer(
        java_path,
        run_path,
        game_dir,
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
        process_cb=process_cb,
    )

    version_id = _find_loader_version(
        game_dir, mc_version, kind, loader_version, before
    )
    log_cb(f"{name} 安装器已生成版本：{version_id}")

    progress_cb(88, "补全加载器与游戏文件…")
    installer = Installer(
        game_dir,
        source=source,
        progress_cb=lambda p, m: progress_cb(88 + int(p * 0.12), m),
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )
    installer.install(version_id, verify=False, check_assets=True)
    return version_id


def install_loader(
    game_dir: Path,
    mc_version: str,
    kind: str,
    loader_version: str,
    *,
    java_path: str = "",
    source: str = "official",
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    process_cb: ProcessCallback | None = None,
) -> str:
    game_dir = Path(game_dir)
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda m: None)

    if kind not in LOADER_NAMES:
        raise LoaderError("未知的加载器类型")
    if kind != "fabric" and not java_path:
        raise LoaderError(f"安装 {LOADER_NAMES[kind]} 需要 Java，请先在设置中选择 Java")

    progress(1, f"准备安装 {LOADER_NAMES[kind]}…")
    if kind == "fabric":
        return _install_fabric(
            game_dir,
            mc_version,
            loader_version,
            source=source,
            progress_cb=progress,
            log_cb=log,
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
        )
    return _install_forge_family(
        game_dir,
        mc_version,
        loader_version,
        kind,
        java_path=java_path,
        source=source,
        progress_cb=progress,
        log_cb=log,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
        process_cb=process_cb,
    )
