# 安装服务端


def _vanilla_server_jar(
    info: ServerInfo,
    *,
    source: str,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> Path:
    dest = info.path / "server.jar"
    progress_cb(60, "获取 Minecraft 服务端文件…")
    manifest = get_manifest(source, log=log_cb)
    entry = next(
        (
            item
            for item in manifest.get("versions") or []
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("id") == info.mc_version
        ),
        None,
    )
    if not entry or not entry.get("url"):
        raise ServerError(f"版本清单里没有 Minecraft {info.mc_version}")

    version_data: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    errors: list[str] = []
    for version_url in (
        str(entry.get("url") or ""),
        f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/{urllib.parse.quote(info.mc_version)}/json",
    ):
        if not version_url:
            continue
        try:
            data = fetch_json(version_url)
            if isinstance(data.get("downloads"), dict):
                version_data = data
                break
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(str(exc))
    if version_data is None:
        raise ServerError(f"无法读取 Minecraft {info.mc_version} 的版本信息：{errors[-1] if errors else '未知错误'}")

    server = (version_data.get("downloads") or {}).get("server") or {}
    if not server.get("url"):
        raise ServerError(f"Minecraft {info.mc_version} 没有可用的服务端下载地址")
    urls = [
        f"https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/{urllib.parse.quote(info.mc_version)}/server",
        str(server["url"]),
    ]
    log_cb(f"下载 Minecraft {info.mc_version} 服务端")
    _download(
        urls,
        dest,
        sha1=str(server.get("sha1") or ""),
        size=int(server.get("size") or 0),
        label="Minecraft 服务端",
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )
    if not zipfile.is_zipfile(dest):
        raise ServerError("下载到的 Minecraft 服务端不是有效的 jar 文件")
    return dest


def _install_paper(
    info: ServerInfo,
    *,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> None:
    progress_cb(3, f"查询 Paper {info.mc_version} 构建…")
    mc = urllib.parse.quote(info.mc_version, safe="")
    url = f"{PAPER_API}/versions/{mc}/builds"
    try:
        data = _get_json(url, timeout=60)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ServerError(f"无法获取 Paper 构建列表：{exc}") from exc
    builds = [item for item in data if isinstance(item, dict)] if isinstance(data, list) else []
    if not builds:
        raise ServerError(
            f"Paper 没有 Minecraft {info.mc_version} 的构建，"
            "请换一个版本，或改用 Spigot。"
        )
    stable = [item for item in builds if str(item.get("channel")).upper() == "STABLE"]
    candidates = stable or builds
    try:
        build = max(candidates, key=lambda item: int(item.get("id") or 0))
    except Exception:
        build = candidates[0]
    downloads = build.get("downloads") or {}
    download = downloads.get("server:default")
    if not isinstance(download, dict):
        download = next(
            (
                item
                for item in downloads.values()
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("url")
            ),
            None,
        )
    if not isinstance(download, dict) or not download.get("url"):
        raise ServerError("Paper 构建里没有服务端下载地址")

    build_id = int(build.get("id") or 0)
    filename = str(download.get("name") or f"paper-{info.mc_version}-{build_id}.jar")
    size = int(download.get("size") or 0)
    sha256 = str((download.get("checksums") or {}).get("sha256") or "")
    log_cb(f"Paper 构建 #{build_id} · {filename} · {size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB")
    progress_cb(8, f"下载 Paper #{build_id}…")

    dest = info.path / "server.jar"
    last_error = ""
    for attempt in range(2):
        _download(
            [str(download["url"])],
            dest,
            size=size,
            label=f"Paper #{build_id}",
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
        )
        if not sha256 or _sha256_file(dest).lower() == sha256.lower():
            break
        last_error = "SHA256 校验失败"
        try:
            dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            pass
    else:
        raise ServerError(f"Paper 服务端下载失败：{last_error}")
    if not zipfile.is_zipfile(dest):
        raise ServerError("Paper 服务端不是有效的 jar 文件")

    info.paper_build = build_id
    info.launch_kind = "jar"
    info.launch_target = "server.jar"
    progress_cb(92, "Paper 服务端已就绪")
    _preseed_paper_cache(
        info,
        dest,
        progress_cb=progress_cb,
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )


def _paper_download_contexts(jar_path: Path) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(jar_path) as jar:
            try:
                raw = jar.read("META-INF/download-context").decode("utf-8", "replace")
            except KeyError:
                return []
    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
        return []
    contexts: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    for line in raw.splitlines():
        parts = line.strip().split("\t")
        if len(parts) != 3:
            continue
        digest, url, filename = (part.strip() for part in parts)
        if digest and url and filename and "/" not in filename and "\\" not in filename:
            contexts.append((digest.lower(), url, filename))
    return contexts


def _preseed_paper_cache(
    info: ServerInfo,
    jar_path: Path,
    *,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> None:
    """预先下载 Paperclip 需要的 Mojang 服务端缓存，避免首次启动卡在官方源。"""
    contexts = _paper_download_contexts(jar_path)
    if not contexts:
        return
    cache_dir = info.path / "cache"
    for index, (digest, url, filename) in enumerate(contexts):
        cache_file = cache_dir / filename
        if cache_file.exists() and _sha256_file(cache_file).lower() == digest:
            continue
        if cache_file.exists():
            try:
                cache_file.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass
        candidates = []
        if filename.startswith("mojang_"):
            candidates.append(
                "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/"
                + urllib.parse.quote(info.mc_version, safe="")
                + "/server"
            )
        candidates.append(url)
        progress_cb(
            min(96, 94 + index),
            f"预下载 Paper 启动缓存 {filename}…",
        )
        log_cb(f"预下载 Paper 启动缓存：{filename}")
        seeded = False
        for candidate in dict.fromkeys(candidates):
            _check_cancel(cancel_event)
            try:
                _download(
                    [candidate],
                    cache_file,
                    label=filename,
                    cancel_event=cancel_event,
                )
            except InstallCancelled:
                raise
            except Exception:
                continue
            if cache_file.exists() and _sha256_file(cache_file).lower() == digest:
                seeded = True
                break
            try:
                cache_file.unlink()
            except OSError:
                pass
        if seeded:
            log_cb(f"Paper 启动缓存已准备：{filename}")
        else:
            log_cb(
                "无法预下载 Paper 启动缓存，首次启动时 Paperclip 会自行下载；"
                "如果官方源不可用，启动可能失败。"
            )
    progress_cb(97, "Paper 启动缓存已准备")


def _install_spigot(
    info: ServerInfo,
    *,
    java_path: str,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
    process_cb: ProcessCallback | None,
) -> None:
    git = _find_git()
    build_dir = SERVER_CACHE / "spigot" / _safe_folder(info.mc_version)
    build_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    buildtools = build_dir / "BuildTools.jar"

    progress_cb(4, "下载 Spigot BuildTools…")
    _download(
        [BUILDTOOLS_URL],
        buildtools,
        label="Spigot BuildTools",
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )

    def find_jar() -> Path | None:
        candidates = []
        for item in build_dir.glob("spigot-*.jar"):
            name = item.name.lower()
            if any(
                part in name
                for part in ("-sources", "-javadoc", "-original", "-deprecated")
            ):
                continue
            candidates.append(item)
        if not candidates:
            return None
        return max(candidates, key=lambda item: item.stat().st_mtime)

    existing = find_jar()
    if existing:
        log_cb(f"复用缓存中的 {existing.name}")
    else:
        log_cb("Spigot 首次构建需要 Git 和较长时间（通常 10-30 分钟），请耐心等待。")
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env["PATH"] = str(Path(git).parent) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")
        progress_cb(10, "BuildTools 正在编译 Spigot（耗时较长）…")
        network_error = False

        def build_log(message: str) -> None:
            nonlocal network_error
            if any(
                token in message
                for token in (
                    "ConnectException",
                    "UnknownHostException",
                    "Connection timed out",
                    "Network is unreachable",
                )
            ):
                network_error = True
            log_cb(message)

        code = _run_process(
            [java_path, "-jar", "BuildTools.jar", "--rev", info.mc_version, "--compile", "spigot"],
            build_dir,
            log_cb=build_log,
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
            process_cb=process_cb,
            env=env,
        )
        if code != 0:
            if network_error:
                raise ServerError(
                    "Spigot BuildTools 无法访问 hub.spigotmc.org（Java 网络受限）。"
                    "请检查网络或代理后重试；也可以改用 Paper 服务端，它兼容 Spigot 插件。"
                )
            raise ServerError(f"Spigot BuildTools 退出代码 {code}，请查看日志")
        existing = find_jar()
    if not existing:
        raise ServerError("BuildTools 已结束，但没有找到生成的 Spigot jar")

    progress_cb(90, "复制 Spigot 服务端…")
    dest = info.path / "server.jar"
    shutil.copy2(existing, dest)
    info.launch_kind = "jar"
    info.launch_target = "server.jar"
    log_cb(f"Spigot 服务端：{existing.name}")


def _install_fabric(
    info: ServerInfo,
    *,
    source: str,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> None:
    progress_cb(3, "读取 Fabric 服务端配置…")
    meta: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    errors: list[str] = []
    for url in (
        f"{FABRIC_META_BMCL}/versions/loader/{info.mc_version}/{info.loader_version}/server/json",
        f"{FABRIC_META}/versions/loader/{info.mc_version}/{info.loader_version}/server/json",
    ):
        try:
            data = _get_json(url, timeout=45)
            if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("libraries"):
                meta = data
                break
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(str(exc))
    if meta is None:
        raise ServerError(
            "无法获取 Fabric 服务端配置："
            + (errors[-1] if errors else "Fabric 返回内容为空")
        )

    libraries = [lib for lib in meta.get("libraries") or [] if isinstance(lib, dict)]
    if not libraries:
        raise ServerError("Fabric 服务端配置缺少依赖库")
    log_cb(f"Fabric 服务端依赖 {len(libraries)} 个")

    classpath: list[str] = []
    total = len(libraries)
    for index, lib in enumerate(libraries, start=1):
        _check_cancel(cancel_event)
        path = maven_path(str(lib.get("name") or ""))
        if not path:
            continue
        dest = info.path / "libraries" / Path(path)
        base = str(lib.get("url") or "https://maven.fabricmc.net/")
        if not base.endswith("/"):
            base += "/"
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(path, safe="/")
        urls = [
            BMCL_MAVEN + encoded,
            BMCL_MAVEN + path,
            CENTRAL_MAVEN + path,
            base + path,
        ]
        _download(
            urls,
            dest,
            sha1=str(lib.get("sha1") or ""),
            size=int(lib.get("size") or 0),
            label=str(lib.get("name") or path),
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
        )
        classpath.append(str(Path("libraries") / Path(path)))
        progress_cb(
            6 + int(45 * index / max(1, total)),
            f"下载 Fabric 依赖 {index}/{total}",
        )

    _vanilla_server_jar(
        info,
        source=source,
        progress_cb=progress_cb,
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )
    classpath.append("server.jar")

    info.launch_kind = "classpath"
    info.launch_target = str(
        meta.get("mainClass")
        or "net.fabricmc.loader.impl.launch.knot.KnotServer"
    )
    info.launch_classpath = classpath
    progress_cb(94, "Fabric 服务端已就绪")


def _read_install_profile(jar_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(jar_path) as jar:
            try:
                raw = jar.read("install_profile.json")
            except KeyError:
                return {}
    except (OSError, zipfile.BadZipFile):
        return {}
    try:
        data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return {}
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def _preseed_forge_server_jar(
    info: ServerInfo,
    installer: Path,
    *,
    source: str,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> None:
    """Forge/NeoForge 安装器会从 Mojang 官网下载原版服务端，这里提前放到它期望的路径。"""
    profile = _read_install_profile(installer)
    template = str(profile.get("serverJarPath") or "")
    if not template:
        return
    relative = (
        template.replace("{LIBRARY_DIR}", "libraries")
        .replace("{MINECRAFT_VERSION}", info.mc_version)
        .replace("\\", "/")
        .lstrip("/")
    )
    target = (info.path / relative).resolve()
    try:
        target.relative_to(info.path.resolve())
    except ValueError:
        return
    if target.exists() and zipfile.is_zipfile(target):
        log_cb(f"原版服务端已存在：{target.name}")
        return
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    server: dict[str, Any] = {}
    try:
        manifest = get_manifest(source, log=log_cb)
        entry = next(
            (
                item
                for item in manifest.get("versions") or []
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("id") == info.mc_version
            ),
            None,
        )
        if entry and entry.get("url"):
            data = fetch_json(str(entry["url"]))
            server = (data.get("downloads") or {}).get("server") or {}
    except Exception as exc:
        log_cb(f"读取 Mojang 服务端信息失败：{exc}")
    if not server.get("url"):
        try:
            data = _get_json(
                "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/"
                + urllib.parse.quote(info.mc_version, safe="")
                + "/json",
                timeout=30,
            )
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                server = (data.get("downloads") or {}).get("server") or {}
        except Exception as exc:
            log_cb(f"读取 BMCL 服务端信息失败：{exc}")

    urls = [
        "https://bmclapi2.bangbang93.com/version/"
        + urllib.parse.quote(info.mc_version, safe="")
        + "/server"
    ]
    if server.get("url"):
        urls.append(str(server["url"]))
    progress_cb(44, f"预下载 {SERVER_NAMES[info.kind]} 需要的原版服务端…")
    log_cb(f"预下载 Minecraft {info.mc_version} 原版服务端：{relative}")
    _download(
        urls,
        target,
        sha1=str(server.get("sha1") or ""),
        size=int(server.get("size") or 0),
        label="Minecraft 服务端",
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )
    if not zipfile.is_zipfile(target):
        try:
            target.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise ServerError("预下载的原版服务端不是有效的 jar 文件")


_PROGUARD_CLASS = re.compile(r"^(\S+) -> (\S+):$")
_PROGUARD_FIELD = re.compile(r"^\s+(\S+) ([^\s(]+) -> (\S+)$")
_PROGUARD_METHOD = re.compile(
    r"^\s+(?:\d+:\d+:)?(\S+) ([^\s(]+)\((.*)\) -> (\S+)$"
)
_JAVA_PRIMITIVES = {
    "void": "V",
    "boolean": "Z",
    "byte": "B",
    "char": "C",
    "short": "S",
    "int": "I",
    "long": "J",
    "float": "F",
    "double": "D",
}


def _proguard_type(value: str) -> str:
    dims = ""
    while value.endswith("[]"):
        dims += "["
        value = value[:-2]
    if value in _JAVA_PRIMITIVES:
        return dims + _JAVA_PRIMITIVES[value]
    return dims + "L" + value.replace(".", "/") + ";"


def _proguard_descriptor(return_type: str, args: str) -> str:
    parts: list[str] = []
    depth = 0
    current = ""
    for char in args:
        if char == "<":
            depth += 1
        elif char == ">":
            depth = max(0, depth - 1)
        if char == "," and depth == 0:
            parts.append(current)
            current = ""
        else:
            current += char
    if current.strip():
        parts.append(current)
    params = "".join(_proguard_type(part.strip()) for part in parts if part.strip())
    return f"({params}){_proguard_type(return_type)}"


def _java_string_hash(value: str) -> int:
    result = 0
    for char in value:
        result = (31 * result + ord(char)) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return result


def _hashmap_iteration_order(keys: list[str]) -> dict[str, int]:
    """复刻 Java HashMap 的桶遍历顺序，srgutils 输出同名字方法时依赖这个顺序。"""
    unique = list(dict.fromkeys(keys))
    capacity = 16
    while len(unique) > capacity * 0.75:
        capacity *= 2
    buckets: dict[int, list[str]] = {}
    for key in unique:
        h = _java_string_hash(key)
        index = ((h ^ (h >> 16)) & 0xFFFFFFFF) & (capacity - 1)
        buckets.setdefault(index, []).append(key)
    order: dict[str, int] = {}
    for index in range(capacity):
        for key in buckets.get(index, []):
            order[key] = len(order)
    return order


def _proguard_to_tsrg(raw: bytes) -> bytes:
    """把 Mojang ProGuard 映射转换成 srgutils 生成的 TSRG 文本。"""
    classes: list[tuple[str, str, list[tuple[int, str, str, str]]]] = []
    current: list[tuple[str, str, list[tuple[int, str, str, str]]]] | None = None
    for line in raw.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if not line[0].isspace():
            match = _PROGUARD_CLASS.match(line)
            if match:
                current = (match.group(1), match.group(2), [])
                classes.append(current)
            continue
        if current is None:
            continue
        match = _PROGUARD_METHOD.match(line)
        if match:
            return_type, name, args, mapped = match.groups()
            current[2].append(
                (1, name, mapped, _proguard_descriptor(return_type, args))
            )
            continue
        match = _PROGUARD_FIELD.match(line)
        if match:
            field_type, name, mapped = match.groups()
            current[2].append((0, name, mapped, _proguard_type(field_type)))

    classes.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    lines: list[str] = []
    for original, mapped, members in classes:
        lines.append(original.replace(".", "/") + " " + mapped.replace(".", "/"))
        fields = sorted((item for item in members if item[0] == 0), key=lambda x: x[1])
        methods = [item for item in members if item[0] == 1]
        order = _hashmap_iteration_order([item[1] + item[3] for item in methods])
        methods.sort(key=lambda item: (item[1], order.get(item[1] + item[3], 0)))
        for _, name, mapped_name, _ in fields:
            lines.append(f"\t{name} {mapped_name}")
        for _, name, mapped_name, descriptor in methods:
            lines.append(f"\t{name} {descriptor} {mapped_name}")
    return ("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


def _preseed_forge_mappings(
    info: ServerInfo,
    installer: Path,
    *,
    source: str,
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> None:
    """提前生成 Forge/NeoForge 安装器需要的 Mojang 映射，避开它写死的官网地址。"""
    profile = _read_install_profile(installer)
    data = profile.get("data") or {}
    coordinate = data.get("MOJMAPS")
    expected = data.get("MOJMAPS_SHA")
    if isinstance(coordinate, dict):
        coordinate = coordinate.get("server")
    if isinstance(expected, dict):
        expected = expected.get("server")
    coordinate = str(coordinate or "").strip().strip("[]")
    expected = str(expected or "").strip().strip("'\"")
    if not coordinate or not expected:
        return
    name = coordinate.split("@", 1)[0]
    parts = name.split(":")
    if len(parts) < 3:
        return
    classifier = parts[3] if len(parts) > 3 else ""
    filename = f"{parts[1]}-{parts[2]}"
    if classifier:
        filename += f"-{classifier}"
    filename += ".tsrg"
    relative = "/".join(parts[0].split(".") + [parts[1], parts[2], filename])
    target = (info.path / "libraries" / relative).resolve()
    try:
        target.relative_to(info.path.resolve())
    except ValueError:
        return
    if target.exists() and _sha1_file_bytes(target.read_bytes()) == expected.lower():
        return

    server_mappings: dict[str, Any] = {}
    try:
        manifest = get_manifest(source, log=log_cb)
        entry = next(
            (
                item
                for item in manifest.get("versions") or []
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("id") == info.mc_version
            ),
            None,
        )
        if entry and entry.get("url"):
            version_data = fetch_json(str(entry["url"]))
            server_mappings = (version_data.get("downloads") or {}).get(
                "server_mappings"
            ) or {}
    except Exception as exc:
        log_cb(f"读取 Mojang 映射信息失败：{exc}")
    if not server_mappings.get("url"):
        log_cb("没有找到 Mojang 映射下载地址，安装器会尝试自行下载")
        return

    cache_file = SERVER_CACHE / "mappings" / f"server-{info.mc_version}.txt"
    progress_cb(45, "准备 Mojang 映射文件…")
    log_cb(f"预生成 Mojang 映射：{filename}")
    _download(
        [str(server_mappings["url"])],
        cache_file,
        sha1=str(server_mappings.get("sha1") or ""),
        size=int(server_mappings.get("size") or 0),
        label="Mojang 映射",
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )
    try:
        converted = _proguard_to_tsrg(cache_file.read_bytes())
    except Exception as exc:
        log_cb(f"转换 Mojang 映射失败：{exc}")
        return
    actual = _sha1_file_bytes(converted)
    if actual != expected.lower():
        log_cb(
            f"Mojang 映射校验不一致（期望 {expected[:8]}，实际 {actual[:8]}），"
            "仍写入文件供安装器尝试"
        )
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(converted)


def _sha1_file_bytes(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()


def _patch_class_string(data: bytes, old: bytes, new: bytes) -> bytes:
    """替换 class 常量池里的 UTF-8 字符串，允许新字符串长度不同。"""
    if data[:4] != b"\xca\xfe\xba\xbe":
        raise ValueError("不是有效的 class 文件")
    count = int.from_bytes(data[8:10], "big")
    pos = 10
    output = bytearray(data[:10])
    patched = 0
    index = 1
    while index < count:
        tag = data[pos]
        start = pos
        pos += 1
        if tag == 1:
            length = int.from_bytes(data[pos : pos + 2], "big")
            pos += 2
            raw = data[pos : pos + length]
            pos += length
            if raw == old:
                raw = new
                patched += 1
            output.append(tag)
            output += len(raw).to_bytes(2, "big")
            output += raw
        elif tag in (7, 8, 16, 19, 20):
            output.append(tag)
            output += data[pos : pos + 2]
            pos += 2
        elif tag == 15:
            output.append(tag)
            output += data[pos : pos + 3]
            pos += 3
        elif tag in (3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 12, 17, 18):
            output.append(tag)
            output += data[pos : pos + 4]
            pos += 4
        elif tag in (5, 6):
            output.append(tag)
            output += data[pos : pos + 8]
            pos += 8
            index += 1
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"未知常量池标签：{tag}（偏移 {start}）")
        index += 1
    output += data[pos:]
    if not patched:
        raise ValueError("class 里没有找到目标字符串")
    return bytes(output)


def _class_utf8_strings(data: bytes) -> list[bytes]:
    if data[:4] != b"\xca\xfe\xba\xbe":
        raise ValueError("不是有效的 class 文件")
    count = int.from_bytes(data[8:10], "big")
    pos = 10
    index = 1
    strings: list[bytes] = []
    while index < count:
        tag = data[pos]
        pos += 1
        if tag == 1:
            length = int.from_bytes(data[pos : pos + 2], "big")
            pos += 2
            strings.append(data[pos : pos + length])
            pos += length
        elif tag in (7, 8, 16, 19, 20):
            pos += 2
        elif tag == 15:
            pos += 3
        elif tag in (3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 12, 17, 18):
            pos += 4
        elif tag in (5, 6):
            pos += 8
            index += 1
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"未知常量池标签：{tag}")
        index += 1
    return strings


def _patch_jar_manifest_url(
    jar_path: Path,
    class_suffix: str,
    new_url: bytes,
) -> bool:
    """把 class 里任意指向版本清单的 URL 常量替换成 new_url。"""
    changed = False
    temp = jar_path.with_name(jar_path.name + ".patchtmp")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(jar_path) as src, zipfile.ZipFile(
        temp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
    ) as dst:
        for item in src.infolist():
            data = src.read(item.filename)
            if item.filename.endswith(class_suffix):
                try:
                    strings = _class_utf8_strings(data)
                except ValueError:
                    strings = []
                old = next(
                    (
                        value
                        for value in strings
                        if b"version_manifest" in value
                        and value.startswith((b"http://", b"https://", b"file:"))
                    ),
                    None,
                )
                if old is not None and old != new_url:
                    data = _patch_class_string(data, old, new_url)
                    changed = True
            dst.writestr(item, data)
    if changed:
        os.replace(temp, jar_path)
    else:
        try:
            temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            pass
    return changed


def _rewrite_installer_profile(jar_path: Path, profile: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    temp = jar_path.with_name(jar_path.name + ".profiletmp")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(jar_path) as src, zipfile.ZipFile(
        temp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
    ) as dst:
        for item in src.infolist():
            data = src.read(item.filename)
            if item.filename == "install_profile.json":
                data = json.dumps(profile, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
            dst.writestr(item, data)
    os.replace(temp, jar_path)


def _prepare_neoforge_local_manifest(
    info: ServerInfo,
    *,
    source: str,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
) -> Path | None:
    """生成本地版本清单与版本 JSON，让 NeoForge 映射下载器完全离线读取。"""
    version_data: dict[str, Any] = {}
    try:
        manifest = get_manifest(source, log=log_cb)
        entry = next(
            (
                item
                for item in manifest.get("versions") or []
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("id") == info.mc_version
            ),
            None,
        )
        if entry and entry.get("url"):
            version_data = fetch_json(str(entry["url"]))
    except Exception as exc:
        log_cb(f"读取 Mojang 版本信息失败：{exc}")
        return None

    mappings = (version_data.get("downloads") or {}).get("server_mappings") or {}
    if not mappings.get("url"):
        log_cb("没有找到 Mojang 服务端映射地址，安装器会尝试自行下载")
        return None

    raw_file = SERVER_CACHE / "mappings" / f"server-{info.mc_version}.txt"
    try:
        _download(
            [str(mappings["url"])],
            raw_file,
            sha1=str(mappings.get("sha1") or ""),
            size=int(mappings.get("size") or 0),
            label="Mojang 服务端映射",
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        log_cb(f"下载 Mojang 服务端映射失败：{exc}")
        return None

    folder = SERVER_CACHE / "neoforge-local" / _safe_folder(info.mc_version)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    version_file = folder / "version.json"
    manifest_file = folder / "version_manifest_v2.json"
    raw_bytes = raw_file.read_bytes()
    version_payload = {
        "id": info.mc_version,
        "downloads": {
            "server_mappings": {
                "sha1": _sha1_file_bytes(raw_bytes),
                "size": len(raw_bytes),
                "url": raw_file.resolve().as_uri(),
            }
        },
    }
    version_file.write_text(
        json.dumps(version_payload, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    manifest_payload = {
        "latest": {"release": info.mc_version, "snapshot": info.mc_version},
        "versions": [
            {
                "id": info.mc_version,
                "type": "release",
                "url": version_file.resolve().as_uri(),
            }
        ],
    }
    manifest_file.write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest_payload, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    log_cb(f"已生成离线映射清单：{manifest_file.name}")
    return manifest_file


def _patch_neoforge_mojmaps(
    info: ServerInfo,
    installer: Path,
    manifest_file: Path,
    *,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
) -> None:
    """把 NeoForge 映射下载器的清单地址改成刚生成的本地 file: 地址。"""
    profile = _read_install_profile(installer)
    libraries = [item for item in profile.get("libraries") or [] if isinstance(item, dict)]
    target_lib = None
    for item in libraries:
        if str(item.get("name") or "").startswith(
            "net.neoforged.installertools:installertools:"
        ):
            target_lib = item
            break
    if target_lib is None:
        log_cb("没有找到 NeoForge installertools 依赖")
        return
    artifact = (target_lib.get("downloads") or {}).get("artifact") or {}
    relative = str(artifact.get("path") or "")
    if not relative:
        return
    jar_path = info.path / "libraries" / relative
    if not jar_path.exists():
        log_cb("NeoForge installertools 尚未下载，跳过映射下载器补丁")
        return
    new_url = manifest_file.resolve().as_uri().encode("utf-8")
    try:
        changed = _patch_jar_manifest_url(
            jar_path,
            "net/neoforged/installertools/DownloadMojmaps.class",
            new_url,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        log_cb(f"修补 NeoForge 映射下载器失败：{exc}")
        return
    actual_sha = _sha1_file_bytes(jar_path.read_bytes())
    if not changed and str(artifact.get("sha1") or "").lower() == actual_sha:
        log_cb("NeoForge 映射下载器已使用本地清单")
        return
    artifact["sha1"] = actual_sha
    artifact["size"] = jar_path.stat().st_size
    _rewrite_installer_profile(installer, profile)
    log_cb("已将 NeoForge 映射下载器切换到本地清单")


def _find_forge_args(info: ServerInfo) -> Path | None:
    files = list(info.path.glob("libraries/**/win_args.txt"))
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        files.extend(info.path.glob("libraries/**/unix_args.txt"))
    if not files:
        return None
    keywords = ("forge", "neoforge")
    preferred = [
        item
        for item in files
        if any(word in str(item).lower() for word in keywords)
    ]
    pool = preferred or files
    return max(pool, key=lambda item: item.stat().st_mtime)


def _find_forge_jar(info: ServerInfo) -> Path | None:
    prefixes = ("forge-", "neoforge-")
    candidates = []
    for item in info.path.glob("*.jar"):
        name = item.name.lower()
        if not name.startswith(prefixes):
            continue
        if any(part in name for part in ("installer", "sources", "javadoc", "shim")):
            continue
        candidates.append(item)
    if not candidates:
        return None
    return max(candidates, key=lambda item: item.stat().st_mtime)


def _install_forge_family(
    info: ServerInfo,
    *,
    java_path: str,
    source: str = "official",
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback,
    log_cb: LogCallback,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None,
    process_cb: ProcessCallback | None,
) -> None:
    kind = info.kind
    name = SERVER_NAMES[kind]
    SERVER_CACHE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    urls, filename = _installer_urls(kind, info.mc_version, info.loader_version)
    raw = SERVER_CACHE / f"{kind}-{info.mc_version}-{info.loader_version}-installer.jar"
    patched = SERVER_CACHE / f"{kind}-{info.mc_version}-{info.loader_version}-bmcl.jar"

    progress_cb(3, f"下载 {name} 安装器…")
    log_cb(f"下载 {name} 安装器 {info.loader_version}")
    _download(
        urls,
        raw,
        label=f"{name} 安装器",
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )
    _patch_installer(raw, patched, kind)
    log_cb(f"已将 {name} 安装器切换到 BMCLAPI 镜像")

    def preseed_progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        progress_cb(8 + int(max(0, min(100, percent)) * 0.35), message)

    _preseed_libraries(
        info.path,
        patched,
        progress_cb=preseed_progress,
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )
    if kind == "neoforge":
        local_manifest = _prepare_neoforge_local_manifest(
            info,
            source=source,
            log_cb=log_cb,
            cancel_event=cancel_event,
        )
        if local_manifest is not None:
            _patch_neoforge_mojmaps(
                info, patched, local_manifest, log_cb=log_cb
            )
    _preseed_forge_server_jar(
        info,
        patched,
        source=source,
        progress_cb=progress_cb,
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )
    _preseed_forge_mappings(
        info,
        patched,
        source=source,
        progress_cb=progress_cb,
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
    )

    progress_cb(48, f"运行 {name} 服务端安装器…")
    code = _run_process(
        [
            java_path,
            "-jar",
            str(patched),
            "--installServer",
            str(info.path),
        ],
        info.path,
        log_cb=log_cb,
        cancel_event=cancel_event,
        process_cb=process_cb,
    )
    if code != 0:
        raise ServerError(f"{name} 安装器退出代码 {code}，请查看日志")

    progress_cb(90, "检查服务端启动文件…")
    args_file = _find_forge_args(info)
    if args_file is not None:
        info.launch_kind = "args"
        info.launch_target = str(args_file.relative_to(info.path))
        log_cb(f"服务端启动参数：{info.launch_target}")
    else:
        jar = _find_forge_jar(info)
        if jar is None:
            raise ServerError(
                f"{name} 安装器已结束，但没有找到 win_args.txt 或服务端 jar，"
                "请查看日志了解安装器失败原因。"
            )
        info.launch_kind = "jar"
        info.launch_target = jar.name
        log_cb(f"服务端启动文件：{jar.name}")


def install_server(
    info: ServerInfo,
    *,
    java_path: str = "",
    accept_eula: bool = False,
    source: str = "official",
    progress_cb: ProgressCallback | None = None,
    log_cb: LogCallback | None = None,
    cancel_event: threading.Event | None = None,
    process_cb: ProcessCallback | None = None,
) -> None:
    progress = progress_cb or (lambda p, m: None)
    log = log_cb or (lambda m: None)
    info.kind = info.kind if info.kind in SERVER_NAMES else "paper"
    info.installed = False
    info.install_error = ""
    info.path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    save_server(info)
    update_server_properties(info)
    if accept_eula:
        write_eula(info)

    try:
        if info.kind == "paper":
            _install_paper(
                info,
                progress_cb=progress,
                log_cb=log,
                cancel_event=cancel_event,
            )
        elif info.kind == "spigot":
            if not java_path:
                raise ServerError("编译 Spigot 需要 Java")
            _install_spigot(
                info,
                java_path=java_path,
                progress_cb=progress,
                log_cb=log,
                cancel_event=cancel_event,
                process_cb=process_cb,
            )
        elif info.kind == "fabric":
            _install_fabric(
                info,
                source=source,
                progress_cb=progress,
                log_cb=log,
                cancel_event=cancel_event,
            )
        else:
            if not java_path:
                raise ServerError(f"安装 {SERVER_NAMES[info.kind]} 需要 Java")
            _install_forge_family(
                info,
                java_path=java_path,
                source=source,
                progress_cb=progress,
                log_cb=log,
                cancel_event=cancel_event,
                process_cb=process_cb,
            )
    except InstallCancelled:
        info.install_error = "安装已取消"
        save_server(info)
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        info.install_error = str(exc)
        save_server(info)
        raise

    info.installed = True
    info.install_error = ""
    info.installed_at = _now()
    save_server(info)
    update_server_properties(info)
    if accept_eula:
        write_eula(info)
    progress(100, "安装完成")
    log(f"{info.type_name} 服务端安装完成")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 目录 / 插件文件


@dataclass
class AddonFile:
    path: Path
    name: str
    filename: str
    size: int
    enabled: bool

    @property
    def size_text(self) -> str:
        if self.size >= 1024 * 1024:
            return f"{self.size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
        if self.size >= 1024:
            return f"{self.size / 1024:.0f} KB"
        return f"{self.size} B"


def list_addons(info: ServerInfo) -> list[AddonFile]:
    directory = addons_dir(info)
    if not directory.exists():
        return []
    result: list[AddonFile] = []
    try:
        files = [p for p in directory.iterdir() if p.is_file()]
    except OSError:
        return []
    for path in files:
        name = path.name
        lower = name.lower()
        if lower.endswith(".jar"):
            enabled = True
            display = name[:-4]
        elif lower.endswith(".jar.disabled"):
            enabled = False
            display = name[: -len(".jar.disabled")]
        else:
            continue
        try:
            size = path.stat().st_size
        except OSError:
            size = 0
        result.append(
            AddonFile(
                path=path,
                name=display,
                filename=name,
                size=size,
                enabled=enabled,
            )
        )
    result.sort(key=lambda item: item.name.lower())
    return result


def toggle_addon(addon: AddonFile) -> Path:
    if addon.enabled:
        dest = addon.path.with_name(addon.path.name + ".disabled")
    else:
        if addon.path.name.lower().endswith(".jar.disabled"):
            dest = addon.path.with_name(addon.path.name[: -len(".disabled")])
        else:
            dest = addon.path.with_suffix(".jar")
    if dest.exists():
        raise ServerError(f"目标文件已存在：{dest.name}")
    os.replace(addon.path, dest)
    return dest


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 启动


def build_server_command(info: ServerInfo, java_path: str = "") -> list[str]:
    java = str(java_path or info.java_path or "").strip()
    if not java:
        raise ServerError("没有可用的 Java，请先在设置中选择 Java。")
    info.path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    memory = max(512, min(65536, int(info.memory_mb or 4096)))
    initial = min(memory, 1024)
    command = [
        java,
        f"-Xms{initial}M",
        f"-Xmx{memory}M",
        "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8",
        "-Dterminal.jline=false",
    ]
    if info.launch_kind == "args":
        target = info.launch_target
        if not target or not (info.path / target).exists():
            raise ServerError("服务端启动参数文件缺失，请重新安装服务端。")
        command.append("@" + target)
        try:
            text = (info.path / target).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except OSError:
            text = ""
        if "nogui" not in text.lower():
            command.append("nogui")
    elif info.launch_kind == "classpath":
        if not info.launch_classpath or not info.launch_target:
            raise ServerError("Fabric 启动信息不完整，请重新安装服务端。")
        command.extend(
            [
                "-cp",
                os.pathsep.join(info.launch_classpath),
                info.launch_target,
                "nogui",
            ]
        )
    else:
        target = info.launch_target or "server.jar"
        if not (info.path / target).exists():
            raise ServerError(f"服务端文件不存在：{target}")
        command.extend(["-jar", target, "nogui"])
    return command


_ANSI_RE = re.compile(r"\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[ -/]*[@-~]")


class ServerProcess(QObject):
    """仅管理本启动器创建的服务端进程。"""

    output = Signal(str)
    started = Signal(int)
    ready = Signal()
    stopped = Signal(int)
    state_changed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(
        self,
        info: ServerInfo,
        java_path: str = "",
        parent: QObject | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.info = info
        self.java_path = java_path
        self.process: subprocess.Popen | None = None
        self.state = "stopped"
        self.buffer: list[str] = []
        self._thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._ready = False
        self._stopping = False
        self._force_timer: threading.Timer | None = None

    def start(self) -> None:
        if self.process is not None and self.process.poll() is None:
            raise ServerError("服务端已经在运行")
        if not eula_path(self.info).exists():
            raise ServerError("还没有同意 Minecraft EULA")
        command = build_server_command(self.info, self.java_path)
        startupinfo = None
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
            startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
            startupinfo.wShowWindow = subprocess.SW_HIDE
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.pop("JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS", None)
        try:
            self.process = subprocess.Popen(
                command,
                cwd=str(self.info.path),
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
                bufsize=1,
                creationflags=CREATE_NO_WINDOW,
                startupinfo=startupinfo,
                env=env,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.process = None
            raise ServerError(f"无法启动服务端：{exc}") from exc
        self._ready = False
        self._stopping = False
        self.state = "starting"
        self.buffer.clear()
        self.state_changed.emit(self.state)
        self.started.emit(int(self.process.pid))
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._read_output, daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()

    def _read_output(self) -> None:
        proc = self.process
        if proc is None or proc.stdout is None:
            return
        try:
            for raw in proc.stdout:
                line = _ANSI_RE.sub("", raw.rstrip("\r\n"))
                if not line:
                    continue
                self.buffer.append(line)
                if len(self.buffer) > 3000:
                    del self.buffer[:500]
                self.output.emit(line)
                if not self._ready and (
                    "Done (" in line or 'For help, type "help"' in line
                ):
                    self._ready = True
                    self.state = "running"
                    self.state_changed.emit(self.state)
                    self.ready.emit()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            code = proc.wait(timeout=10)
        except Exception:
            code = -1
        self.state = "stopped"
        self.process = None
        self._cancel_force_timer()
        self.state_changed.emit(self.state)
        self.stopped.emit(int(code))

    @property
    def is_running(self) -> bool:
        proc = self.process
        return proc is not None and proc.poll() is None

    def send(self, command: str) -> None:
        text = str(command or "").rstrip("\r\n")
        if not text:
            return
        proc = self.process
        if proc is None or proc.poll() is not None or proc.stdin is None:
            raise ServerError("服务端未在运行")
        try:
            proc.stdin.write(text + "\n")
            proc.stdin.flush()
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ServerError(f"发送命令失败：{exc}") from exc

    def stop(self, wait_seconds: int = 20) -> None:
        proc = self.process
        if proc is None or proc.poll() is not None:
            return
        self._stopping = True
        self.state = "stopping"
        self.state_changed.emit(self.state)
        try:
            self.send("stop")
        except ServerError:
            pass
        self._cancel_force_timer()
        timer = threading.Timer(max(3, wait_seconds), self._force_stop)
        timer.daemon = True
        self._force_timer = timer
        timer.start()

    def force_stop(self) -> None:
        self._force_stop()

    def _force_stop(self) -> None:
        proc = self.process
        if proc is None or proc.poll() is not None:
            return
        try:
            proc.terminate()
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(3)
        proc = self.process
        if proc is not None and proc.poll() is None:
            try:
                proc.kill()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _cancel_force_timer(self) -> None:
        timer = self._force_timer
        self._force_timer = None
        if timer is not None:
            try:
                timer.cancel()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def wait(self, timeout: float = 10) -> int | None:
        proc = self.process
        if proc is None:
            return 0
        try:
            return proc.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except Exception:
            return None


################################################################################
# FILE: darkitten/shortcut.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import ctypes
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from .config import APP_DIR

SHORTCUT_NAME = "Darkitten Launcher.lnk"
DESKTOP_CSIDL = 0x0010


class ShortcutError(Exception):
    pass


def _desktop_dir() -> Path:
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        raise ShortcutError("只有 Windows 支持创建桌面快捷方式。")
    try:
        buffer = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(260)
        result = ctypes.windll.shell32.SHGetFolderPathW(
            None, DESKTOP_CSIDL, None, 0, buffer
        )
        if result == 0 and buffer.value:
            return Path(buffer.value)
    except Exception:
        pass
    for name in ("Desktop", "桌面"):
        candidate = Path.home() / name
        if candidate.is_dir():
            return candidate
    raise ShortcutError("找不到桌面文件夹。")


def shortcut_path() -> Path:
    return _desktop_dir() / SHORTCUT_NAME


def shortcut_exists() -> bool:
    try:
        return shortcut_path().is_file()
    except ShortcutError:
        return False


def _ps_quote(value: str | Path) -> str:
    return "'" + str(value).replace("'", "''") + "'"


def _launch_target() -> tuple[Path, str]:
    if getattr(sys, "frozen", False):
        return Path(sys.executable).resolve(), ""
    script = (APP_DIR / "app.py").resolve()
    if not script.is_file():
        raise ShortcutError(f"找不到启动脚本：{script}")
    executable = Path(sys.executable).resolve()
    if executable.name.lower() == "python.exe":
        windowless = executable.with_name("pythonw.exe")
        if windowless.is_file():
            executable = windowless
    return executable, f'"{script}"'


def create_desktop_shortcut() -> Path:
    if sys.platform != "win32":
        raise ShortcutError("只有 Windows 支持创建桌面快捷方式。")
    executable, arguments = _launch_target()
    if not executable.is_file():
        raise ShortcutError(f"找不到启动程序：{executable}")
    icon = (APP_DIR / "assets" / "dkl.ico").resolve()
    target = shortcut_path()
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    lines = [
        "$ws = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell",
        f"$link = $ws.CreateShortcut({_ps_quote(target)})",
        f"$link.TargetPath = {_ps_quote(executable)}",
        f"$link.Arguments = {_ps_quote(arguments)}",
        f"$link.WorkingDirectory = {_ps_quote(APP_DIR.resolve())}",
        "$link.Description = 'Darkitten Launcher - Minecraft'",
        "$link.WindowStyle = 1",
    ]
    if icon.is_file():
        lines.append(f"$link.IconLocation = {_ps_quote(str(icon) + ',0')}")
    lines.append("$link.Save()")
    script = "\n".join(lines)
    encoded = base64.b64encode(script.encode("utf-16le")).decode("ascii")
    flags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [
                "powershell.exe",
                "-NoProfile",
                "-NonInteractive",
                "-EncodedCommand",
                encoded,
            ],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=30,
            creationflags=flags,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ShortcutError(f"调用 PowerShell 失败：{exc}") from exc
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        detail = (completed.stderr or completed.stdout or "").strip()
        raise ShortcutError(detail or "系统拒绝了快捷方式创建请求。")
    if not target.is_file():
        raise ShortcutError("快捷方式创建后没有出现在桌面上。")
    return target

# FILE: darkitten/skins.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from PySide6.QtCore import QRect, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QImage, QPainter

from .config import APP_DIR
from .installer import _http_open
from .microsoft_auth import USER_AGENT, fetch_profile

SKIN_API_URL = "https://api.minecraftservices.com/minecraft/profile/skins"
SKIN_DIR = APP_DIR / "skins"
LOCAL_SKIN_NAME = "local-skin.png"
PNG_SIGNATURE = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
VALID_VARIANTS = ("classic", "slim")


class SkinError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class SkinFile:
    image: QImage
    data: bytes
    legacy: bool = False
    source: str = ""


@dataclass
class CurrentSkin:
    image: QImage
    variant: str = "classic"
    url: str = ""
    skin_id: str = ""
    alias: str = ""


def _friendly_size(width: int, height: int) -> str:
    return f"{width}×{height}"


def validate_skin_bytes(data: bytes, *, source: str = "") -> SkinFile:
    if not data:
        raise SkinError("皮肤文件是空的，请选择有效的 PNG 图片。")
    if not data.startswith(PNG_SIGNATURE):
        raise SkinError("这不是 PNG 图片。Minecraft 皮肤必须使用 PNG 格式。")
    if len(data) > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise SkinError("皮肤文件过大，请选择 64×64 或 64×32 的 PNG 图片。")
    image = QImage.fromData(data, "PNG")
    if image.isNull():
        raise SkinError("无法读取这张 PNG 图片，文件可能已损坏。")
    width, height = image.width(), image.height()
    if (width, height) not in ((64, 64), (64, 32)):
        raise SkinError(
            f"皮肤尺寸为 {_friendly_size(width, height)}，"
            "Minecraft 仅支持 64×64（现代）或 64×32（旧版）皮肤。"
        )
    image = image.convertToFormat(QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    return SkinFile(
        image=image,
        data=data,
        legacy=height == 32,
        source=source,
    )


def load_skin_file(path: str | Path) -> SkinFile:
    file_path = Path(path)
    try:
        data = file_path.read_bytes()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"无法读取皮肤文件：{exc}") from exc
    return validate_skin_bytes(data, source=str(file_path))


def save_local_skin(skin: SkinFile) -> Path:
    SKIN_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = SKIN_DIR / LOCAL_SKIN_NAME
    try:
        dest.write_bytes(skin.data)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"无法保存皮肤预览副本：{exc}") from exc
    return dest


def local_skin_path() -> Path:
    return SKIN_DIR / LOCAL_SKIN_NAME


def active_skin(profile: dict[str, Any] | None) -> CurrentSkin | None:
    if not isinstance(profile, dict):
        return None
    skins = profile.get("skins")
    if not isinstance(skins, list):
        return None
    chosen: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    for entry in skins:
        if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("url"):
            if str(entry.get("state") or "").upper() == "ACTIVE":
                chosen = entry
                break
    if chosen is None:
        chosen = next(
            (entry for entry in skins if isinstance(entry, dict) and entry.get("url")),
            None,
        )
    if chosen is None:
        return None
    return CurrentSkin(
        image=QImage(),
        variant=str(chosen.get("variant") or "classic").lower(),
        url=str(chosen.get("url") or ""),
        skin_id=str(chosen.get("id") or ""),
        alias=str(chosen.get("alias") or ""),
    )


def download_skin_image(url: str, timeout: int = 30) -> QImage:
    if not url:
        raise SkinError("没有可下载的皮肤地址。")
    try:
        with _http_open(
            url,
            timeout=timeout,
            headers={"Accept": "image/png,image/*;q=0.8"},
        ) as response:
            raw = response.read()
    except Exception as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"下载皮肤纹理失败：{exc}") from exc
    skin = validate_skin_bytes(raw, source=url)
    return skin.image


def fetch_account_skin(
    account, client_id: str
) -> tuple[CurrentSkin | None, Any]:
    """刷新正版令牌并读取当前皮肤，返回 (皮肤, 更新后的账户)。"""
    from .microsoft_auth import ensure_minecraft_token

    account = ensure_minecraft_token(account, client_id)
    profile = fetch_profile(account.mc_access_token)
    skin = active_skin(profile)
    if skin is not None:
        skin.image = download_skin_image(skin.url)
        if skin.variant not in VALID_VARIANTS:
            skin.variant = "classic"
    return skin, account


def _api_message(raw: bytes, status: int) -> str:
    try:
        payload = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        payload = {}
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        for key in ("errorMessage", "error_message", "message", "error", "details"):
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                return value.strip()[:240]
    if status == 401:
        return "Minecraft 登录已失效，请重新登录正版账户。"
    if status == 403:
        return "该账户没有修改皮肤的权限。"
    if status == 429:
        return "皮肤服务请求过于频繁，请稍后再试。"
    return f"皮肤服务返回了错误（HTTP {status}）。"


def _skin_request(
    method: str, access_token: str, data: bytes | None = None, content_type: str = ""
) -> None:
    if not access_token:
        raise SkinError("Minecraft 登录令牌为空，请重新登录正版账户。")
    headers = {
        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",
    }
    if content_type:
        headers["Content-Type"] = content_type
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        SKIN_API_URL, data=data, headers=headers, method=method
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=45) as response:
            response.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raw = exc.read()
        raise SkinError(_api_message(raw, exc.code)) from None
    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"无法连接 Minecraft 皮肤服务：{exc.reason}") from None
    except OSError as exc:
        raise SkinError(f"皮肤请求失败：{exc}") from None


def change_skin(access_token: str, png_data: bytes, variant: str = "classic") -> None:
    variant = (variant or "classic").lower()
    if variant not in VALID_VARIANTS:
        variant = "classic"
    if not png_data:
        raise SkinError("没有可上传的皮肤文件。")
    boundary = "----DarkittenSkin" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    chunks: list[bytes] = [
        f"--{boundary}\r\n".encode("ascii"),
        b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="variant"\r\n\r\n',
        variant.encode("ascii"),
        b"\r\n",
        f"--{boundary}\r\n".encode("ascii"),
        b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="skin.png"\r\n',
        b"Content-Type: image/png\r\n\r\n",
        png_data,
        b"\r\n",
        f"--{boundary}--\r\n".encode("ascii"),
    ]
    _skin_request(
        "POST",
        access_token,
        b"".join(chunks),
        f"multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}",
    )


def reset_skin(access_token: str) -> None:
    _skin_request("DELETE", access_token)


def variant_text(variant: str) -> str:
    return "Slim（Alex 细手臂）" if str(variant).lower() == "slim" else "Classic（Steve 标准手臂）"


def _fill(painter: QPainter, x: int, y: int, w: int, h: int, color: str) -> None:
    painter.fillRect(QRect(x, y, w, h), QColor(color))


def bundled_skin_path() -> Path:
    return APP_DIR / "assets" / "dkl_skin.png"


def default_skin() -> QImage:
    """优先使用内置的官方 Steve 皮肤，缺失时回退到程序绘制的 Steve 占位皮肤。"""
    bundled = bundled_skin_path()
    if bundled.is_file():
        image = QImage(str(bundled), "PNG")
        if not image.isNull() and (image.width(), image.height()) in ((64, 64), (64, 32)):
            return image.convertToFormat(QImage.Format_ARGB32)

    image = QImage(64, 64, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    image.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(image)
    painter.setPen(Qt.NoPen)

    skin = "#C99C6E"
    skin_dark = "#B5875C"
    hair = "#3B2B20"
    shirt = "#2E8E9C"
    shirt_dark = "#257680"
    pants = "#3C4F9E"
    pants_dark = "#314181"
    shoe = "#57534E"
    eye = "#2F4F73"
    mouth = "#8A5A45"

    # 头部
    _fill(painter, 8, 0, 8, 8, hair)
    _fill(painter, 16, 0, 8, 8, skin_dark)
    _fill(painter, 0, 8, 8, 8, hair)
    _fill(painter, 8, 8, 8, 8, skin)
    _fill(painter, 16, 8, 8, 8, hair)
    _fill(painter, 24, 8, 8, 8, hair)
    _fill(painter, 8, 8, 8, 2, hair)
    _fill(painter, 8, 10, 1, 3, hair)
    _fill(painter, 15, 10, 1, 3, hair)
    _fill(painter, 9, 12, 2, 1, "#F2F2F2")
    _fill(painter, 13, 12, 2, 1, "#F2F2F2")
    _fill(painter, 10, 12, 1, 1, eye)
    _fill(painter, 13, 12, 1, 1, eye)
    _fill(painter, 11, 13, 2, 1, skin_dark)
    _fill(painter, 11, 14, 2, 1, mouth)

    # 身体
    for rect in ((20, 16, 8, 4), (28, 16, 8, 4), (16, 20, 4, 12),
                 (20, 20, 8, 12), (24, 20, 4, 12), (32, 20, 8, 12)):
        _fill(painter, *rect, shirt)
    _fill(painter, 20, 28, 8, 4, shirt_dark)

    # 右臂 / 左臂
    for ox, oy in ((40, 16), (32, 48)):
        for rect in ((ox + 4, oy, 4, 4), (ox + 8, oy, 4, 4),
                     (ox, oy + 4, 4, 12), (ox + 4, oy + 4, 4, 12),
                     (ox + 8, oy + 4, 4, 12), (ox + 12, oy + 4, 4, 12)):
            _fill(painter, *rect, skin)
        _fill(painter, ox + 4, oy, 4, 4, shirt)
        _fill(painter, ox, oy + 4, 16, 4, shirt)

    # 右腿 / 左腿
    for ox, oy in ((0, 16), (16, 48)):
        for rect in ((ox + 4, oy, 4, 4), (ox + 8, oy, 4, 4),
                     (ox, oy + 4, 4, 12), (ox + 4, oy + 4, 4, 12),
                     (ox + 8, oy + 4, 4, 12), (ox + 12, oy + 4, 4, 12)):
            _fill(painter, *rect, pants)
        _fill(painter, ox, oy + 13, 16, 3, shoe)
        _fill(painter, ox + 12, oy + 4, 4, 12, pants_dark)

    painter.end()
    return image

# FILE: darkitten/social.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import json
import re
import secrets
import time
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .config import APP_DIR

SOCIAL_PATH = APP_DIR / "social.json"
INVITE_PREFIX = "DKLF1:"
ID_RE = re.compile(r"^DKL-[A-Z0-9]{4,16}$")
ROOM_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.:\-]{3,80}$")


class SocialError(Exception):
    pass


def new_profile_id() -> str:
    return "DKL-" + secrets.token_hex(4).upper()


@dataclass
class SocialProfile:
    id: str = ""
    name: str = ""
    created_at: float = 0.0
    room_code: str = ""
    room_version: str = ""

    def ensure(self, fallback_name: str = "Steve") -> "SocialProfile":
        if not ID_RE.fullmatch(self.id or ""):
            self.id = new_profile_id()
        self.name = str(self.name or fallback_name or "Steve").strip()[:24]
        if not self.created_at:
            self.created_at = time.time()
        return self


@dataclass
class Friend:
    id: str
    name: str
    room_code: str = ""
    room_version: str = ""
    note: str = ""
    added_at: float = 0.0
    last_room_at: float = 0.0

    def ensure(self) -> "Friend":
        self.id = str(self.id or "").strip().upper()
        if not ID_RE.fullmatch(self.id):
            raise SocialError("好友 ID 格式不正确，应以 DKL- 开头。")
        self.name = str(self.name or "未命名好友").strip()[:24]
        self.room_code = str(self.room_code or "").strip()[:80]
        self.room_version = str(self.room_version or "").strip()[:64]
        self.note = str(self.note or "").strip()[:120]
        if not self.added_at:
            self.added_at = time.time()
        return self


@dataclass
class Invite:
    id: str
    name: str
    room_code: str = ""
    room_version: str = ""
    note: str = ""
    kind: str = "friend"


def encode_invite(
    profile: SocialProfile,
    room_code: str = "",
    room_version: str = "",
    note: str = "",
    kind: str = "friend",
) -> str:
    payload = {
        "v": 1,
        "kind": kind,
        "id": profile.id,
        "name": profile.name,
        "room": str(room_code or profile.room_code or "").strip(),
        "mc": str(room_version or profile.room_version or "").strip(),
        "note": str(note or "").strip()[:120],
        "ts": int(time.time()),
    }
    raw = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    token = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
    return INVITE_PREFIX + token


def parse_invite(text: str) -> Invite:
    raw = str(text or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        raise SocialError("请先粘贴好友发来的 DKL 邀请卡。")
    if not raw.startswith(INVITE_PREFIX):
        raise SocialError(
            "邀请卡格式不正确。请让好友在“个人资料与好友”里复制 DKL 邀请卡。"
        )
    token = raw[len(INVITE_PREFIX) :].strip()
    try:
        padding = "=" * (-len(token) % 4)
        data = json.loads(
            base64.urlsafe_b64decode(token + padding).decode("utf-8")
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise SocialError("邀请卡已损坏，无法解析。") from exc
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise SocialError("邀请卡内容无法识别。")
    invite = Invite(
        id=str(data.get("id") or "").strip().upper(),
        name=str(data.get("name") or "").strip()[:24],
        room_code=str(data.get("room") or "").strip()[:80],
        room_version=str(data.get("mc") or "").strip()[:64],
        note=str(data.get("note") or "").strip()[:120],
        kind=str(data.get("kind") or "friend"),
    )
    if not ID_RE.fullmatch(invite.id):
        raise SocialError("邀请卡里的 DKL ID 无效。")
    if not invite.name:
        invite.name = "未命名好友"
    return invite


@dataclass
class SocialStore:
    path: Path = field(default_factory=lambda: SOCIAL_PATH)
    profile: SocialProfile = field(default_factory=SocialProfile)
    friends: list[Friend] = field(default_factory=list)

    def load(self) -> "SocialStore":
        try:
            if self.path.is_file():
                data = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            else:
                data = {}
        except Exception:
            data = {}
        if isinstance(data.get("profile"), dict):
            allowed = {
                key: data["profile"].get(key)
                for key in ("id", "name", "created_at", "room_code", "room_version")
            }
            self.profile = SocialProfile(**allowed)
        self.friends = []
        for item in data.get("friends") or []:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            allowed = {
                key: item.get(key)
                for key in (
                    "id",
                    "name",
                    "room_code",
                    "room_version",
                    "note",
                    "added_at",
                    "last_room_at",
                )
            }
            try:
                self.friends.append(Friend(**allowed).ensure())
            except (SocialError, TypeError):
                continue
        self.friends.sort(
            key=lambda friend: (friend.last_room_at, friend.added_at), reverse=True
        )
        return self

    def ensure_profile(self, fallback_name: str = "Steve") -> SocialProfile:
        before = asdict(self.profile)
        self.profile.ensure(fallback_name)
        if asdict(self.profile) != before:
            self.save()
        return self.profile

    def rename_profile(self, name: str) -> SocialProfile:
        clean = str(name or "").strip()
        if not 1 <= len(clean) <= 24:
            raise SocialError("昵称需要 1-24 个字符。")
        self.profile.name = clean
        self.save()
        return self.profile

    def set_room(self, room_code: str, room_version: str = "") -> None:
        self.profile.room_code = str(room_code or "").strip()[:80]
        self.profile.room_version = str(room_version or "").strip()[:64]
        self.save()

    def add_invite(self, invite: Invite) -> Friend:
        if invite.id == self.profile.id:
            raise SocialError("这是你自己的邀请卡，换一张好友的吧。")
        friend = Friend(
            id=invite.id,
            name=invite.name,
            room_code=invite.room_code,
            room_version=invite.room_version,
            note=invite.note,
        ).ensure()
        existing = self.find(friend.id)
        if existing is not None:
            existing.name = friend.name or existing.name
            existing.note = friend.note or existing.note
            if friend.room_code:
                existing.room_code = friend.room_code
                existing.room_version = friend.room_version
                existing.last_room_at = time.time()
            friend = existing
        else:
            if friend.room_code:
                friend.last_room_at = time.time()
            self.friends.insert(0, friend)
        self.save()
        return friend

    def add_friend(
        self, name: str, friend_id: str, room_code: str = "", room_version: str = ""
    ) -> Friend:
        friend = Friend(
            id=str(friend_id or "").strip().upper(),
            name=str(name or "").strip(),
            room_code=room_code,
            room_version=room_version,
        ).ensure()
        if friend.id == self.profile.id:
            raise SocialError("不能把自己添加为好友。")
        existing = self.find(friend.id)
        if existing is not None:
            existing.name = friend.name
            if friend.room_code:
                existing.room_code = friend.room_code
                existing.room_version = friend.room_version
                existing.last_room_at = time.time()
            self.save()
            return existing
        if friend.room_code:
            friend.last_room_at = time.time()
        self.friends.insert(0, friend)
        self.save()
        return friend

    def find(self, friend_id: str) -> Friend | None:
        key = str(friend_id or "").strip().upper()
        return next((friend for friend in self.friends if friend.id == key), None)

    def update_room(
        self, friend_id: str, room_code: str, room_version: str = ""
    ) -> Friend | None:
        friend = self.find(friend_id)
        if friend is None:
            return None
        friend.room_code = str(room_code or "").strip()[:80]
        friend.room_version = str(room_version or "").strip()[:64]
        friend.last_room_at = time.time() if friend.room_code else 0.0
        self.save()
        return friend

    def remove_friend(self, friend_id: str) -> bool:
        friend = self.find(friend_id)
        if friend is None:
            return False
        self.friends.remove(friend)
        self.save()
        return True

    def save(self) -> None:
        data = {
            "version": 1,
            "profile": asdict(self.profile),
            "friends": [asdict(friend) for friend in self.friends],
        }
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tmp = self.path.with_name(self.path.name + ".tmp")
        tmp.write_text(
            json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        tmp.replace(self.path)


def load_store(path: Path | None = None) -> SocialStore:
    return SocialStore(path=Path(path or SOCIAL_PATH)).load()

class BrowserLoginDialog(StyledDialog):
    """用系统浏览器完成 Microsoft 登录，邮箱会预填到官方登录页。"""

    def __init__(self, main, client_id: str, email: str = "") -> None:
        super().__init__(
            main,
            "登录 Microsoft 账户",
            "user",
            icon_color="#3B6FF5",
            width=560,
        )
        self.main = main
        self.client_id = client_id
        self._worker: BrowserLoginWorker | None = None
        self._account = None
        self._url = ""
        self._closed = False

        intro = QLabel(
            "启动器会打开系统浏览器，并把邮箱预填到 Microsoft 官方登录页。"
            "密码只在浏览器中输入，授权完成后会自动返回启动器，无需复制验证码。"
        )
        intro.setObjectName("DialogText")
        intro.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(intro)

        email_box = QFrame()
        email_box.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        email_box.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        email_layout = QVBoxLayout(email_box)
        email_layout.setContentsMargins(13, 11, 13, 11)
        email_layout.setSpacing(6)
        email_title = QLabel("Microsoft 邮箱")
        email_title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600;")
        email_layout.addWidget(email_title)
        self.email_edit = QLineEdit(email)
        self.email_edit.setPlaceholderText("name@example.com（可留空）")
        self.email_edit.returnPressed.connect(self._start)
        email_layout.addWidget(self.email_edit)
        email_hint = QLabel(
            "填写后会自动预填到登录页，减少一次输入；不会保存密码。"
        )
        email_hint.setObjectName("Tiny")
        email_hint.setWordWrap(True)
        email_layout.addWidget(email_hint)
        self.body.addWidget(email_box)

        steps = QFrame()
        steps.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        steps.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        steps_layout = QVBoxLayout(steps)
        steps_layout.setContentsMargins(13, 11, 13, 11)
        steps_layout.setSpacing(4)
        for text in (
            "1. 点击“打开浏览器登录”，启动器会自动打开 Microsoft 登录页。",
            "2. 在浏览器中输入密码并同意授权；密码不会经过启动器。",
            "3. 页面显示“登录完成”后回到启动器，账户会自动完成验证。",
        ):
            label = QLabel(text)
            label.setObjectName("Tiny")
            label.setWordWrap(True)
            steps_layout.addWidget(label)
        self.body.addWidget(steps)

        self.status = QLabel("")
        self.status.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(self.status)

        self.open_btn = QPushButton("重新打开登录页")
        self.open_btn.setObjectName("Secondary")
        self.open_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.open_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_page)
        self.open_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.open_btn, 0, Qt.AlignLeft)

        self.error = QLabel("")
        self.error.setWordWrap(True)
        self.error.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.error)

        self.cancel_btn = self.add_button("取消", "Secondary", self.reject)
        self.start_btn = self.add_button(
            "打开浏览器登录", "Primary", self._start
        )
        self.start_btn.setMinimumWidth(132)

    @property
    def account(self):
        return self._account

    def _start(self) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            return
        email = self.email_edit.text().strip()
        if email and ("@" not in email or any(ch.isspace() for ch in email)):
            self.error.setText("请输入完整的 Microsoft 邮箱地址，或留空。")
            self.error.setVisible(True)
            self.email_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.status.setText("正在启动本地登录服务并打开浏览器…")
        self._url = ""
        self.open_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.email_edit.setEnabled(False)
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.start_btn.setText("等待浏览器登录…")
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消登录")
        self.main.config.microsoft_email = email
        self.main.config.save()
        worker = BrowserLoginWorker(self.client_id, email, self)
        self._worker = worker
        worker.url_ready.connect(self._url_ready)
        worker.status.connect(self._set_status)
        worker.finished.connect(self._finished)
        worker.start()

    def _url_ready(self, url: str) -> None:
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._url = url
        self.open_btn.setVisible(True)
        self.adjustSize()

    def _set_status(self, text: str) -> None:
        if not self._closed:
            self.status.setText(text)

    def _open_page(self) -> None:
        if self._url:
            QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(self._url))

    def _finished(self, account, error: str) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        if self._closed:
            return
        if account is not None:
            self._account = account
            self.accept()
            return
        self.error.setText(error or "Microsoft 登录失败，请重试。")
        self.error.setVisible(True)
        self.status.setText("")
        self._url = ""
        self.open_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.email_edit.setEnabled(True)
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.start_btn.setText("重新尝试")
        self.cancel_btn.setText("关闭")
        self.adjustSize()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        self._closed = True
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.cancel()
            self._worker = None
        super().reject()

        self.body.addWidget(self.code_box)

        self.status = QLabel("")
        self.status.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(self.status)
