        self.error.setWordWrap(True)
        self.error.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.error)

        self.cancel_btn = self.add_button("关闭", "Secondary", self.reject)
        self.login_btn = self.add_button("获取验证码", "Primary", self._start)
        self.login_btn.setMinimumWidth(112)

    @property
    def account(self):
        return self._account

    def _start(self) -> None:
        if self._worker is not None:
            return
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.code_box.setVisible(False)
        self.status.setText("正在向 Microsoft 请求验证码…")
        self.login_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消登录")
        worker = DeviceLoginWorker(self.client_id, self)
        self._worker = worker
        worker.code_ready.connect(self._code_ready)
        worker.status.connect(self._set_status)
        worker.finished.connect(self._finished)
        worker.start()

    def _code_ready(self, device: DeviceCode) -> None:
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._device = device
        self.code_label.setText(device.user_code)
        self.code_box.setVisible(True)
        self._copy_code()
        self.status.setText(
            "验证码已复制到剪贴板。请在浏览器中输入验证码并登录。"
        )
        self._open_page()
        self.adjustSize()

    def _set_status(self, text: str) -> None:
        if not self._closed:
            self.status.setText(text)

    def _copy_code(self) -> None:
        if self._device:
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(self._device.user_code)
            self.status.setText("验证码已复制到剪贴板。")

    def _open_page(self) -> None:
        if not self._device:
            return
        url = (
            self._device.verification_uri_complete
            or self._device.verification_uri
            or "https://microsoft.com/devicelogin"
        )
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    def _finished(self, account, error: str) -> None:
        self._worker = None
        if self._closed:
            return
        self.login_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.login_btn.setText("重新登录")
        self.cancel_btn.setText("关闭")
        if account is not None:
            self._account = account
            self.accept()
            return
        self.error.setText(error or "Microsoft 登录失败，请重试。")
        self.error.setVisible(True)
        self.status.setText("")
        self.code_box.setVisible(False)
        self.adjustSize()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        self._closed = True
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.cancel()
            self._worker = None
        super().reject()

def _center_on_screen(widget: QWidget) -> None:
    screen = QApplication.primaryScreen()
    if not screen:
        return
    area = screen.availableGeometry()
    widget.move(
        area.x() + (area.width() - widget.width()) // 2,
        area.y() + (area.height() - widget.height()) // 2,
    )


def _draw_paw(
    p: QPainter, center: QPointF, size: float, color: QColor, rotation: float = 0.0
) -> None:
    p.save()
    p.translate(center)
    p.rotate(rotation)
    p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
    p.setBrush(color)
    p.drawEllipse(QPointF(0, size * 0.22), size * 1.05, size * 0.86)
    for dx, dy in ((-1.10, -1.00), (-0.38, -1.48), (0.38, -1.48), (1.10, -1.00)):
        p.drawEllipse(
            QPointF(dx * size, dy * size), size * 0.42, size * 0.52
        )
    p.restore()


def _draw_cat_ears(p: QPainter, rect: QRectF, color: QColor) -> None:
    """在圆角卡片顶部画一对猫耳。"""
    left = QPolygonF(
        [
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.16, rect.top() + 10),
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.24, rect.top() - 30),
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.36, rect.top() + 6),
        ]
    )
    right = QPolygonF(
        [
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.64, rect.top() + 6),
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.76, rect.top() - 30),
            QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.84, rect.top() + 10),
        ]
    )
    p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
    p.setBrush(color)
    p.drawPolygon(left)
    p.drawPolygon(right)
    inner = QColor("#E23A5E")
    inner.setAlpha(90)
    p.setBrush(inner)
    p.drawPolygon(
        QPolygonF(
            [
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.205, rect.top() - 2),
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.247, rect.top() - 19),
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.30, rect.top() + 0),
            ]
        )
    )
    p.drawPolygon(
        QPolygonF(
            [
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.70, rect.top() + 0),
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.753, rect.top() - 19),
                QPointF(rect.left() + rect.width() * 0.795, rect.top() - 2),
            ]
        )
    )


class SplashScreen(QWidget):
    """启动器开场：恶魔小猫贴纸、猫耳卡片和磨爪子进度。"""

    finished = Signal()

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            None,
            Qt.FramelessWindowHint
            | Qt.WindowStaysOnTopHint
            | Qt.SplashScreen
            | Qt.WindowDoesNotAcceptFocus,
        )
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)
        # 不抢焦点，也不接收键盘输入：启动阶段按键不会影响窗口生命周期。
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_ShowWithoutActivating, True)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.NoFocus)
        self.setFixedSize(560, 340)
        self.setWindowTitle(APP_NAME)
        self.setWindowIcon(icons.app_icon())
        self._pixmap: QPixmap = icons.chibi_pixmap(460)
        self._progress = 0.0
        self._elapsed = 0
        self._done = False
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(16)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)
        self._fade: QPropertyAnimation | None = None
        _center_on_screen(self)

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.setWindowOpacity(0.0)
        self.show()
        self.raise_()
        self._fade = QPropertyAnimation(self, b"windowOpacity", self)
        self._fade.setDuration(260)
        self._fade.setStartValue(0.0)
        self._fade.setEndValue(1.0)
        self._fade.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)
        self._fade.start()
        self._timer.start()

    def _tick(self) -> None:
        if self._done:
            return
        self._elapsed += 16
        self._progress = min(1.0, self._elapsed / 1900.0)
        self.update()
        if self._progress >= 1.0 and not self._done:
            self._finish()

    def _finish(self) -> None:
        if self._done:
            return
        self._done = True
        self._timer.stop()
        if self._fade:
            self._fade.stop()
        self._fade = QPropertyAnimation(self, b"windowOpacity", self)
        self._fade.setDuration(300)
        self._fade.setStartValue(self.windowOpacity())
        self._fade.setEndValue(0.0)
        self._fade.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.InCubic)
        self._fade.finished.connect(self.finished.emit)
        self._fade.start()

    def mousePressEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self._finish()
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def keyPressEvent(self, event) -> None:
        # 启动画面不响应键盘，按键一律吞掉。
        event.accept()

    def keyReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        event.accept()

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if not self._done:
            self._done = True
            self._timer.stop()
            self.finished.emit()
        super().closeEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event) -> None:
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.SmoothPixmapTransform)

        card = QRectF(18, 32, self.width() - 36, self.height() - 48)
        _draw_cat_ears(p, card, QColor("#1C1019"))

        shadow = QColor(0, 0, 0, 120)
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(shadow)
        p.drawRoundedRect(card.translated(0, 8), 24, 24)

        gradient = QLinearGradient(card.topLeft(), card.bottomRight())
        gradient.setColorAt(0, QColor("#24101C"))
        gradient.setColorAt(0.55, QColor("#160D15"))
        gradient.setColorAt(1, QColor("#2A0C1A"))
        p.setBrush(gradient)
        p.drawRoundedRect(card, 24, 24)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(226, 58, 94, 75), 1))
        p.drawRoundedRect(card, 24, 24)

        glow = QRadialGradient(card.center(), card.height() * 0.75)
        glow.setColorAt(0, QColor(226, 58, 94, 46))
        glow.setColorAt(1, QColor(226, 58, 94, 0))
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(glow)
        p.drawEllipse(card.center(), card.height() * 0.75, card.height() * 0.75)

        # 左侧圆形肖像
        radius = 58.0
        center = QPointF(card.left() + 88, card.top() + 112)
        disc = QRectF(
            center.x() - radius, center.y() - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2
        )
        p.setBrush(QColor("#FFF4F7"))
        p.drawEllipse(disc)
        clip = QPainterPath()
        clip.addEllipse(disc.adjusted(5, 5, -5, -5))
        p.save()
        p.setClipPath(clip)
        if self._pixmap.isNull():
            p.fillRect(disc, QColor("#3D1226"))
        else:
            p.drawPixmap(disc.adjusted(5, 5, -5, -5).toRect(), self._pixmap)
        p.restore()
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor("#E23A5E"), 2))
        p.drawEllipse(disc)

        text_left = card.left() + 170
        p.setPen(QColor("#F8E9EF"))
        title_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 21)
        title_font.setBold(True)
        p.setFont(title_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(text_left, card.top() + 42, card.width() - 220, 36),
            Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
            APP_NAME,
        )

        p.setPen(QColor("#E23A5E"))
        tag_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 8)
        tag_font.setBold(True)
        tag_font.setLetterSpacing(QFont.AbsoluteSpacing, 2.0)
        p.setFont(tag_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(text_left + 1, card.top() + 77, card.width() - 220, 20),
            Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
            f"{APP_SHORT_NAME} · {APP_TAGLINE}",
        )

        p.setPen(QColor(240, 220, 229, 210))
        note_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 10)
        p.setFont(note_font)
        index = min(len(SPLASH_NOTES) - 1, int(self._progress * len(SPLASH_NOTES)))
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(text_left, card.top() + 112, card.width() - 220, 24),
            Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
            SPLASH_NOTES[index],
        )

        # 爪印进度
        base_y = card.bottom() - 66
        total = 5
        filled = self._progress * total
        for i in range(total):
            x = text_left + 16 + i * 38
            active = i < int(filled)
            pulse = 1.0
            if active and i == int(filled) - 1:
                pulse = 1.0 + 0.16 * math.sin(self._elapsed / 90.0)
            color = QColor("#E23A5E") if active else QColor(255, 255, 255, 30)
            _draw_paw(p, QPointF(x, base_y), 7.2 * pulse, color)

        track = QRectF(text_left, card.bottom() - 40, card.width() - 250, 4)
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(QColor(255, 255, 255, 22))
        p.drawRoundedRect(track, 2, 2)
        p.setBrush(QColor("#E23A5E"))
        p.drawRoundedRect(
            QRectF(track.left(), track.top(), track.width() * self._progress, 4), 2, 2
        )

        p.setPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 70))
        foot_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 8)
        p.setFont(foot_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(card.left() + 32, card.bottom() - 28, card.width() - 64, 18),
            Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
            f"v{APP_VERSION} · 点击任意处跳过",
        )
        p.end()


class GameLoadingOverlay(QWidget):
    """启动游戏时覆盖主窗口的加载动画。"""

    cancel_requested = Signal()

    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, False)
        self.setVisible(False)
        self._pixmap = icons.chibi_pixmap(420)
        self._angle = 0.0
        self._elapsed = 0
        self._status = "正在准备启动…"
        self._version = ""
        self._closing = False
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(16)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)

        self.cancel_btn = QPushButton("收回猫爪（取消启动）", self)
        self.cancel_btn.setObjectName("Secondary")
        self.cancel_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.cancel_btn.setFixedSize(184, 34)
        self.cancel_btn.clicked.connect(self._request_cancel)
        self.cancel_btn.hide()

    def show_loading(self, version: str, status: str = "") -> None:
        self._version = version
        self._status = status or "正在准备启动…"
        self._elapsed = 0
        self._closing = False
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("收回猫爪（取消启动）")
        self.cancel_btn.show()
        self.setGeometry(self.parentWidget().rect())
        self.raise_()
        self.show()
        self._timer.start()

    def set_status(self, text: str) -> None:
        if text:
            self._status = text
            self.update()

    def finish(self, message: str = "世界已加载，去玩吧喵。", delay_ms: int = 650) -> None:
        if not self.isVisible():
            return
        self._closing = True
        self._status = message
        self.cancel_btn.hide()
        self.update()
        QTimer.singleShot(max(0, delay_ms), self._hide_now)

    def abort(self) -> None:
        self._closing = True
        self._timer.stop()
        self.hide()
        self.cancel_btn.hide()

    def _hide_now(self) -> None:
        self._timer.stop()
        self.hide()
        self.cancel_btn.hide()

    def _request_cancel(self) -> None:
        if not self._closing:
            self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.cancel_btn.setText("正在收回猫爪…")
            self.cancel_requested.emit()

    def _tick(self) -> None:
        self._elapsed += 16
        self._angle = (self._angle + 2.2) % 360.0
        self.update()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        self.cancel_btn.move(
            (self.width() - self.cancel_btn.width()) // 2,
            int(self.height() * 0.5) + 176,
        )
        super().resizeEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event) -> None:
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.SmoothPixmapTransform)
        w, h = self.width(), self.height()

        p.fillRect(self.rect(), QColor(12, 7, 11, 214))
        glow = QRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2 - 40, max(w, h) * 0.42)
        glow.setColorAt(0, QColor(226, 58, 94, 64))
        glow.setColorAt(1, QColor(226, 58, 94, 0))
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(glow)
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w / 2, h / 2 - 40), max(w, h) * 0.42, max(w, h) * 0.42)

        cx, cy = w / 2, h / 2 - 54
        radius = 62.0
        disc = QRectF(cx - radius, cy - radius, radius * 2, radius * 2)
        p.setBrush(QColor(0, 0, 0, 80))
        p.drawEllipse(disc.translated(0, 7))
        p.setBrush(QColor("#FFF4F7"))
        p.drawEllipse(disc)
        clip = QPainterPath()
        clip.addEllipse(disc.adjusted(5, 5, -5, -5))
        p.save()
        p.setClipPath(clip)
        if self._pixmap.isNull():
            p.fillRect(disc, QColor("#3D1226"))
        else:
            p.drawPixmap(disc.adjusted(5, 5, -5, -5).toRect(), self._pixmap)
        p.restore()
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        p.setPen(QPen(QColor("#E23A5E"), 2))
        p.drawEllipse(disc)

        # 环绕的爪印
        for i in range(6):
            angle = math.radians(self._angle + i * 60)
            px = cx + math.cos(angle) * (radius + 26)
            py = cy + math.sin(angle) * (radius + 26)
            alpha = 90 + int(120 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(angle)))
            _draw_paw(
                p,
                QPointF(px, py),
                5.5,
                QColor(255, 190, 208, alpha),
                math.degrees(angle) + 90,
            )

        # 旋转弧线
        arc = QRectF(cx - radius - 11, cy - radius - 11, (radius + 11) * 2, (radius + 11) * 2)
        pen = QPen(QColor("#E23A5E"), 2.5)
        pen.setCapStyle(Qt.RoundCap)
        p.setPen(pen)
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        start = int(-self._angle * 16)
        p.drawArc(arc, start, 70 * 16)

        p.setPen(QColor("#F8E9EF"))
        title_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 17)
        title_font.setBold(True)
        p.setFont(title_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(0, cy + radius + 32, w, 32),
            Qt.AlignCenter,
            "正在把猫猫送进世界…",
        )

        p.setPen(QColor(236, 210, 220, 210))
        status_font = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 10)
        p.setFont(status_font)
        p.drawText(
            QRectF(w * 0.1, cy + radius + 68, w * 0.8, 26),
            Qt.AlignCenter,
            self._status,
        )

        if self._version:
            badge_w, badge_h = 210.0, 26.0
            badge = QRectF(
                cx - badge_w / 2, cy + radius + 104, badge_w, badge_h
            )
            p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
            p.setBrush(QColor(255, 255, 255, 26))
            p.drawRoundedRect(badge, 13, 13)
            p.setPen(QColor(255, 220, 230, 210))
            small = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 9)
            p.setFont(small)
            p.drawText(badge, Qt.AlignCenter, self._version)

        if not self._closing:
            p.setPen(QColor(255, 255, 255, 55))
            foot = QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 8)
            p.setFont(foot)
            p.drawText(
                QRectF(0, h - 38, w, 20),
                Qt.AlignCenter,
                "如果猫猫卡住了，可以随时收回猫爪",
            )
        p.end()

class StyledDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: QWidget | None,
        title: str,
        icon_name: str = "bolt",
        icon_color: str | None = None,
        width: int = 440,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowFlags(Qt.Dialog | Qt.FramelessWindowHint)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TranslucentBackground)
        self.setModal(True)
        self._width = width

        outer = QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer.setContentsMargins(24, 24, 24, 24)
        outer.setSpacing(0)

        self.card = QFrame()
        self.card.setObjectName("DialogCard")
        self.card.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        shadow = QGraphicsDropShadowEffect(self.card)
        shadow.setBlurRadius(38)
        shadow.setOffset(0, 10)
        shadow.setColor(QColor(10, 20, 40, 80))
        self.card.setGraphicsEffect(shadow)
        outer.addWidget(self.card)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self.card)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 20, 24, 20)
        layout.setSpacing(14)

        header = QHBoxLayout()
        header.setSpacing(10)
        icon_badge = QLabel()
        icon_badge.setFixedSize(36, 36)
        icon_badge.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        color = icon_color or theme.colors()["accent"]
        icon_badge.setPixmap(icons.pixmap(icon_name, color, 22))
        icon_badge.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {theme.colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 10px;"
        )
        self.title_label = QLabel(title)
        self.title_label.setObjectName("DialogTitle")
        close_btn = icon_button("close", "关闭", size=28, icon_size=15)
        close_btn.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        header.addWidget(icon_badge)
        header.addWidget(self.title_label, 1)
        header.addWidget(close_btn, 0, Qt.AlignTop)
        layout.addLayout(header)

        self.body = QVBoxLayout()
        self.body.setSpacing(10)
        layout.addLayout(self.body, 1)

        self.footer = QHBoxLayout()
        self.footer.setSpacing(8)
        self.footer.addStretch(1)
        layout.addLayout(self.footer)

        self.setFixedWidth(width)
        self.adjustSize()

    def add_button(
        self, text: str, style: str = "Secondary", callback=None
    ) -> QPushButton:
        button = QPushButton(text)
        button.setObjectName(style)
        button.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        button.setMinimumWidth(78)
        if callback:
            button.clicked.connect(callback)
        self.footer.addWidget(button)
        return button

    def showEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().showEvent(event)
        parent = self.parentWidget()
        if parent:
            geo = parent.window().frameGeometry()
            self.adjustSize()
            x = geo.x() + (geo.width() - self.width()) // 2
            y = geo.y() + (geo.height() - self.height()) // 2
            self.move(x, y)

class NoticeDialog(StyledDialog):

class TextInputDialog(StyledDialog):
    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: QWidget | None,
        title: str,
        message: str,
        value: str,
        button_text: str = "保存",
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent, title, "user", width=440)
        self._result = value

        text = QLabel(message)
        text.setObjectName("DialogText")
        text.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(text)

        self.edit = QLineEdit(value)
        self.edit.setMaxLength(16)
        self.edit.setPlaceholderText("3-16 位字母、数字或下划线")
        self.edit.returnPressed.connect(self._save)
        self.body.addWidget(self.edit)

        self.error = QLabel("")
        self.error.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme.colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.error)

        self.add_button("取消", "Secondary", self.reject)
        self.add_button(button_text, "Primary", self._save)
        self.edit.setFocus()

    def _save(self) -> None:
        value = self.edit.text().strip()
        if not valid_player_name(value):
            self.error.setText("名称需为 3-16 位字母、数字或下划线。")
            self.error.setVisible(True)
            return
        self._result = value
        self.accept()

    def value(self) -> str:
        return self._result

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Qt, QTimer, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QFrame,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QProgressBar,
    QPushButton,
    QScrollArea,
    QSizePolicy,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from ..workers import ModDownloadWorker
from . import icons
from .dialogs import StyledDialog
from .widgets import badge, colors, icon_button, repolish, transparent_children

TASK_RUNNING = "running"
TASK_SUCCESS = "success"
TASK_ERROR = "error"
TASK_CANCELLED = "cancelled"


IMPORT_TYPES = {"modpack", "version-import", "local-import"}
INSTALL_TYPES = {"version-install", "loader-install", "server-install"}


@dataclass
class DownloadTask:
    id: int
    title: str
    content_type: str
    source: str
    target: Path
    pack_mode: bool = False
    progress: int = 0
    message: str = "准备下载…"
    status: str = TASK_RUNNING
    filename: str = ""
    error: str = ""
    metadata: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    worker: QObject | None = None
    cancel_cb: Callable[[], None] | None = None
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    finished_at: float = 0.0

    @property
    def running(self) -> bool:
        return self.status == TASK_RUNNING

    @property
    def action_text(self) -> str:
        if self.content_type in IMPORT_TYPES:
            return "导入中"
        if self.content_type in INSTALL_TYPES:
            return "安装中"
        return "下载中"

    @property
    def status_text(self) -> str:
        return {
            TASK_RUNNING: self.action_text,
            TASK_SUCCESS: "已完成",
            TASK_ERROR: "失败",
            TASK_CANCELLED: "已取消",
        }.get(self.status, self.status)

    @property
    def display_name(self) -> str:
        return self.filename or self.title


class _TaskRelay(QObject):
    """把工作线程信号排队回主线程，避免下载过程中直接操作界面数据。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        center: "DownloadCenter",
        task_id: int,
        finished_adapter: Callable[..., tuple[bool, str, str]] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(center)
        self.center = center
        self.task_id = task_id
        self.finished_adapter = finished_adapter

    def on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.center._on_progress(self.task_id, percent, message)

    def on_finished(self, *args) -> None:
        try:
            if self.finished_adapter is not None:
                success, message, filename = self.finished_adapter(*args)
            else:
                success = bool(args[0]) if args else False
                message = str(args[1]) if len(args) > 1 else ""
                filename = str(args[2]) if len(args) > 2 else ""
        except Exception as exc:
            success, message, filename = False, str(exc), ""
        self.center._on_finished(self.task_id, success, message, filename)


class DownloadCenter(QObject):
    """启动器级下载任务中心：窗口关闭后任务继续，由顶栏接管显示。"""

    task_progress = Signal(int, int, str)
    task_finished = Signal(object)
    tasks_changed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, main) -> None:
        super().__init__(main)
        self.main = main
        self._tasks: dict[int, DownloadTask] = {}
        self._order: list[int] = []
        self._relays: dict[int, _TaskRelay] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 任务生命周期

    def start_mod_download(
        self,
        version: dict,
        target_dir: Path,
        *,
        threads: int,
        title: str,
        content_type: str,
        source: str,
        metadata: dict | None = None,
        pack_mode: bool = False,
    ) -> DownloadTask:
        task_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        target = Path(target_dir)
        task = DownloadTask(
            id=task_id,
            title=str(title or "下载内容"),
            content_type=str(content_type or "mod"),
            source=str(source or "modrinth"),
            target=target,
            pack_mode=bool(pack_mode),
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
        )
        worker = ModDownloadWorker(
            version,
            target,
            threads=threads,
            parent=self,
            source=source,
            metadata=task.metadata if task.content_type == "mod" else None,
        )
        task.worker = worker
        self._tasks[task_id] = task
        self._order.append(task_id)
        relay = _TaskRelay(self, task_id)
        self._relays[task_id] = relay
        worker.progress.connect(relay.on_progress)
        worker.finished.connect(relay.on_finished)
        self.tasks_changed.emit()
        worker.start()
        return task

    def start_worker(
        self,
        worker: QObject,
        *,
        title: str,
        content_type: str,
        target: Path,
        source: str = "",
        pack_mode: bool = False,
        metadata: dict | None = None,
        finished_adapter: Callable[..., tuple[bool, str, str]] | None = None,
        cancel_cb: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
        forward_log: bool = True,
    ) -> DownloadTask:
        """接管任意带 progress/finished/cancel 的工作线程。

        finished_adapter 负责把不同 worker 的 finished 参数归一成
        (success, message, filename)。worker 会改由下载中心持有，
        因此发起它的对话框关闭后任务仍会继续。
        """
        task_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        target_path = Path(target)
        task = DownloadTask(
            id=task_id,
            title=str(title or "后台任务"),
            content_type=str(content_type or "download"),
            source=str(source or ""),
            target=target_path,
            pack_mode=bool(pack_mode),
            metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
            worker=worker,
            cancel_cb=cancel_cb,
        )
        worker.setParent(self)
        self._tasks[task_id] = task
        self._order.append(task_id)
        relay = _TaskRelay(self, task_id, finished_adapter)
        self._relays[task_id] = relay
        progress = getattr(worker, "progress", None)
        if progress is not None:
            progress.connect(relay.on_progress)
        finished = getattr(worker, "finished", None)
        if finished is not None:
            finished.connect(relay.on_finished)
        log_line = getattr(worker, "log_line", None)
        if forward_log and log_line is not None:
            log_line.connect(self.main.log)
        self.tasks_changed.emit()
        worker.start()
        return task

    def task(self, task_id: int) -> DownloadTask | None:
        return self._tasks.get(int(task_id))

    def active_tasks(self) -> list[DownloadTask]:
        return [
            self._tasks[task_id]
            for task_id in self._order
            if self._tasks[task_id].running
        ]

    def latest_task(self) -> DownloadTask | None:
        for task_id in reversed(self._order):
            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
            if task is not None:
                return task
        return None

    def recent_tasks(self, limit: int = 12) -> list[DownloadTask]:
        result: list[DownloadTask] = []
        for task_id in reversed(self._order):
            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
            if task is not None:
                result.append(task)
            if len(result) >= max(1, int(limit)):
                break
        return result

    def has_running(self) -> bool:
        return any(task.running for task in self._tasks.values())

    def cancel(self, task_id: int) -> None:
        task = self._tasks.get(int(task_id))
        if task is None or not task.running:
            return
        task.message = "正在取消，请稍候…"
        cancel = task.cancel_cb
        if cancel is None and task.worker is not None:
            cancel = getattr(task.worker, "cancel", None)
        if callable(cancel):
            cancel()
        self.tasks_changed.emit()

    def clear_finished(self) -> None:
        for task_id in list(self._order):
            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
            if task is None or task.running:
                continue
            self._tasks.pop(task_id, None)
            self._order.remove(task_id)
            relay = self._relays.pop(task_id, None)
            if relay is not None:
                relay.deleteLater()
        self.tasks_changed.emit()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 信号转发

    def _on_progress(self, task_id: int, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
        if task is None or not task.running:
            return
        task.progress = max(0, min(100, int(percent)))
        task.message = str(message or "")
        self.task_progress.emit(task.id, task.progress, task.message)
        self.tasks_changed.emit()

    def _on_finished(
        self, task_id: int, success: bool, message: str, filename: str
    ) -> None:
        task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
        if task is None:
            return
        task.worker = None
        task.filename = str(filename or "")
        task.finished_at = time.time()
        if success:
            task.status = TASK_SUCCESS
            task.progress = 100
            if task.content_type in IMPORT_TYPES:
                task.message = "导入完成"
            elif task.content_type in INSTALL_TYPES:
                task.message = "安装完成"
            else:
                task.message = "下载完成"
        elif "取消" in str(message):
            task.status = TASK_CANCELLED
            task.message = "任务已取消"
        else:
            task.status = TASK_ERROR
            task.error = str(message or "任务失败")
            task.message = task.error
        self.task_finished.emit(task)
        self.tasks_changed.emit()

class DownloadTasksDialog(StyledDialog):
    def __init__(self, main) -> None:
        super().__init__(main, "下载任务", "download", icon_color="#3FB3AA", width=640)
        self.main = main
        self.center = main.download_center
        self.body.setSpacing(8)
        self.summary = QLabel("")
        self.summary.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.body.addWidget(self.summary)

        card = QFrame()
        card.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        card.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        card_layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
        card_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        card_layout.setSpacing(4)

        self.scroll = QScrollArea()
        self.scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self.scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.scroll.setMinimumHeight(260)
        self.scroll.setMaximumHeight(460)
        self.holder = QWidget()
        self.list_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.holder)
        self.list_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 4, 0)
        self.list_layout.setSpacing(4)
        self.list_layout.addStretch(1)
        self.scroll.setWidget(self.holder)
        card_layout.addWidget(self.scroll, 1)
        self.empty = QLabel(
            "暂时没有下载、导入或安装任务。关闭下载、整合包、版本导入、"
            "加载器或服务端安装窗口后，任务会继续并显示在这里。"
        )
        self.empty.setObjectName("Muted")
        self.empty.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        self.empty.setWordWrap(True)
        card_layout.addWidget(self.empty)
        self.body.addWidget(card, 1)

        self.clear_btn = self.add_button("清空已完成", "Secondary", self.center.clear_finished)
        self.add_button("关闭", "Secondary", self.reject)

        self._rows: dict[int, DownloadTaskRow] = {}
        self.center.tasks_changed.connect(self.refresh)
        self.center.task_progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        self.finished.connect(self._on_closed)
        self.refresh()

    def _on_closed(self, _result: int = 0) -> None:
        try:
            self.center.tasks_changed.disconnect(self.refresh)
            self.center.task_progress.disconnect(self._on_progress)
        except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
            pass

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        tasks = self.center.recent_tasks(12)
        active = self.center.active_tasks()
        self.summary.setText(
            f"{len(active)} 个任务正在进行，关闭此窗口不会中断。"
            if active
            else "下载、导入和安装任务会在启动器顶栏显示进度，关闭原窗口不会取消任务。"
        )
        if not tasks:
            self._clear_rows()
            self.empty.setVisible(True)
            self.scroll.setVisible(False)
            self.clear_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self.empty.setVisible(False)
        self.scroll.setVisible(True)
        self.clear_btn.setEnabled(any(not item.running for item in tasks))
        existing = set()
        for index, task in enumerate(tasks):
            existing.add(task.id)
            row = self._rows.get(task.id)
            if row is None:
                row = DownloadTaskRow(task, self.holder)
                row.cancel_requested.connect(self.center.cancel)
                row.import_requested.connect(self._import_pack)
                row.folder_requested.connect(self.main.open_path)
                self._rows[task.id] = row
            else:
                row.update_task(task)
            if self.list_layout.indexOf(row) != index:
                self.list_layout.removeWidget(row)
                self.list_layout.insertWidget(index, row)
        for task_id, row in list(self._rows.items()):
            if task_id not in existing:
                row.setParent(None)
                row.deleteLater()
                self._rows.pop(task_id, None)
        self.list_layout.activate()

    def _clear_rows(self) -> None:
        for row in self._rows.values():
            row.setParent(None)
            row.deleteLater()
        self._rows.clear()

    def _on_progress(self, task_id: int, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        row = self._rows.get(int(task_id))
        task = self.center.task(task_id)
        if row is not None and task is not None:
            row.update_task(task)

    def _import_pack(self, task: DownloadTask) -> None:
        path = task.target / task.filename
        if not path.is_file():
            self.main.toast("文件没有保存成功，请重新下载", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_local_import(path)
        self.refresh()


class _ChipLabel(QLabel):
    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self._full_text = str(text or "")
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Preferred)

    def setText(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._full_text = str(text or "")
        self._refresh()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._refresh()

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        width = self.contentsRect().width()
        if width <= 0:
            QLabel.setText(self, self._full_text)
            return
        QLabel.setText(
            self,
            self.fontMetrics().elidedText(self._full_text, Qt.ElideRight, width),
        )


class TopDownloadChip(QFrame):
    clicked = Signal()

    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("DownloadChip")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFixedHeight(38)
        self.setMinimumWidth(38)
        self.setMaximumWidth(196)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
        self._task: DownloadTask | None = None
        self._final_task_id = 0
        self._hide_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._hide_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._hide_timer.setInterval(8000)
        self._hide_timer.timeout.connect(self._apply_idle)

        outer = QHBoxLayout(self)
        outer.setContentsMargins(7, 4, 9, 4)
        outer.setSpacing(7)

        self.icon_box = QLabel()
        self.icon_box.setFixedSize(24, 24)
        self.icon_box.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("download", colors()["accent"], 14))
        self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
        )
        outer.addWidget(self.icon_box)

        text_box = QVBoxLayout()
        text_box.setSpacing(0)
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.setSpacing(4)
        self.status_label = QLabel("下载中")
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;")
        self.percent_label = QLabel("0%")
        self.percent_label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        top.addWidget(self.status_label)
        top.addStretch(1)
        top.addWidget(self.percent_label)
        text_box.addLayout(top)
        self.message_label = _ChipLabel("")
        self.message_label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        text_box.addWidget(self.message_label)
        self.progress = QProgressBar()
        self.progress.setObjectName("ChipProgress")
        self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
        self.progress.setTextVisible(False)
        self.progress.setFixedHeight(3)
        text_box.addWidget(self.progress)
        outer.addLayout(text_box, 1)
        transparent_children(self)
        self._apply_idle()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        compact = self.width() < 104
        self.message_label.setVisible(not compact)
        self.percent_label.setVisible(self.width() >= 72)
        self.status_label.setVisible(self.width() >= 84)
        if compact:
            self.progress.setVisible(False)
        else:
            self.progress.setVisible(True)

    def sync(self, center: DownloadCenter) -> None:
        active = center.active_tasks()
        if active:
            task = active[-1]
            self._hide_timer.stop()
            self._final_task_id = 0
            self._apply(task, running_count=len(active))
            return
        latest = center.latest_task()
        if latest is None:
            self._apply_idle()
            return
        self._apply(latest, running_count=0, final=True)
        if self._final_task_id != latest.id:
            self._final_task_id = latest.id
            self._hide_timer.start()

    def _apply_idle(self) -> None:
        self._task = None
        self._hide_timer.stop()
        self.setProperty("state", "idle")
        repolish(self)
        self.setMinimumWidth(48)
        self.setMaximumWidth(48)
        self.status_label.setText("下载中心")
        self.percent_label.setText("")
        self.message_label.setText("没有进行中的任务")
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("download", colors()["accent"], 14))
        self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
        )
        self.setToolTip("下载中心\n没有进行中的任务\n点击查看下载与导入记录")
        self.show()
        self.updateGeometry()

    def _apply(
        self, task: DownloadTask, running_count: int, final: bool = False
    ) -> None:
        self._task = task
        if final:
            self.setMinimumWidth(48)
            self.setMaximumWidth(196)
        else:
            self.setMinimumWidth(120)
            self.setMaximumWidth(196)
        self.setProperty("state", task.status)
        repolish(self)
        self.status_label.setText(
            f"{task.action_text} · {running_count} 项"
            if running_count > 1
            else (task.action_text if task.running else task.status_text)
        )
        self.percent_label.setText(f"{task.progress}%")
        self.message_label.setText(task.message or task.display_name)
        self.progress.setValue(task.progress)
        self.setToolTip(
            f"{task.title}\n{task.message}\n目标：{task.target}\n点击查看下载任务"
        )
        if task.status == TASK_SUCCESS:
            self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("check", colors()["green"], 14))
            self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['green_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
            )
        elif task.status in (TASK_ERROR, TASK_CANCELLED):
            self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("warning", colors()["orange"], 14))
            self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['orange_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
            )
        else:
            self.icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("download", colors()["accent"], 14))
            self.icon_box.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 7px;"
            )
        self.show()
        self.updateGeometry()

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

KIND_ORDER = ("bug", "suggestion", "ui", "download", "update", "other")
KIND_BADGES = {
    "bug": "red",
    "suggestion": "green",
    "ui": "blue",
    "download": "orange",
    "update": "purple",
    "other": "gray",
}
STATUS_BADGES = {
    "open": "orange",
    "resolved": "green",
    "archived": "gray",
    "closed": "gray",
}


def _short_time(value: object) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return "时间未知"
    text = text.replace("T", " ")
    return text[:16]


def _kind_badge(kind: str) -> QLabel:
    return badge(KIND_LABELS.get(kind, "其他"), KIND_BADGES.get(kind, "gray"))


def _status_badge(status: str) -> QLabel:
    return badge(STATUS_LABELS.get(status, status or "待处理"), STATUS_BADGES.get(status, "gray"))


def _source_text(item: dict) -> str:
    source = str(item.get("source") or "")
    label = SOURCE_LABELS.get(source, source or "反馈")
    if item.get("platform") == "github":
        return f"GitHub 公开反馈 · {label}"
    return f"反馈中心 · {label}"

        if preview_text:
            preview = QLabel(preview_text[:120])
            preview.setObjectName("Muted")
            preview.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px;")
            texts.addWidget(preview)

        layout.addLayout(texts, 1)
        arrow = QLabel()
        arrow.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("chevron-right", colors()["muted"], 16))
        arrow.setFixedWidth(20)
        layout.addWidget(arrow, 0, Qt.AlignVCenter)
        transparent_children(self)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit(self.item)
            event.accept()
            return
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)


class FeedbackDetailDialog(StyledDialog):
    status_requested = Signal(object, str)

    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget, item: dict) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            parent,
            "反馈详情",
            "message",
            colors()["accent"],
            width=700,
        )
        self.item = dict(item)
        self._build()

    def _build(self) -> None:
        item = self.item
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.setSpacing(6)
        top.addWidget(_kind_badge(str(item.get("kind") or "other")))
        top.addWidget(_status_badge(str(item.get("status") or "open")))
        if item.get("platform") == "github":
            top.addWidget(badge("GitHub", "blue"))
        top.addStretch(1)
        self.body.addLayout(top)

        title = QLabel(str(item.get("title") or "未命名反馈"))
        title.setStyleSheet("font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800;")
        title.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(title)

        meta_bits = [
            f"编号 {item.get('id') or '—'}",
            _source_text(item),
            _short_time(item.get("created_at")),
        ]
        version = str(item.get("version") or "").strip()
        if version:
            meta_bits.append(f"启动器 v{version}")
        meta = QLabel(" · ".join(meta_bits))
        meta.setObjectName("Tiny")
        meta.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(meta)

        contact = str(item.get("contact") or "").strip()
        page = str(item.get("page") or "").strip()
        system = str(item.get("system") or "").strip()
        details = []
        if contact:
            details.append(f"联系方式：{contact}")
        if page:
            details.append(f"页面：{page}")
        if system:
            details.append(f"系统：{system}")
        if details:
            detail_label = QLabel("\n".join(details))
            detail_label.setObjectName("Tiny")
            detail_label.setWordWrap(True)
            self.body.addWidget(detail_label)

        description = QPlainTextEdit()
        description.setReadOnly(True)
        description.setMinimumHeight(230)
        description.setPlainText(str(item.get("description") or "（没有填写描述。）"))
        self.body.addWidget(description, 1)

        if item.get("platform") == "center":
            status_row = QHBoxLayout()
            status_row.setSpacing(8)
            status_label = QLabel("处理状态")
            status_label.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600;")
            status_row.addWidget(status_label)
            self.status_combo = QComboBox()
            for value in ("open", "resolved", "archived"):
                self.status_combo.addItem(STATUS_LABELS[value], value)
            current = str(item.get("status") or "open")
            index = self.status_combo.findData(current)
            if index >= 0:
                self.status_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
            status_row.addWidget(self.status_combo)
            status_hint = QLabel("状态会保存到反馈中心，网站和启动器同步显示。")
            status_hint.setObjectName("Tiny")
            status_hint.setWordWrap(True)
            status_row.addWidget(status_hint, 1)
            self.body.addLayout(status_row)

        copy_btn = QPushButton("复制内容")
        copy_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
        copy_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        copy_btn.clicked.connect(self._copy)
        self.footer.addWidget(copy_btn)

        if item.get("platform") == "github":
            github_btn = QPushButton("在 GitHub 打开")
            github_btn.setObjectName("Secondary")
            github_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
            github_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_github)
            self.footer.addWidget(github_btn)
        elif hasattr(self, "status_combo"):
            save_btn = QPushButton("保存状态")
            save_btn.setObjectName("Primary")
            save_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
            save_btn.clicked.connect(self._save_status)
            self.footer.addWidget(save_btn)

        self.add_button("关闭", "Secondary", self.accept)

    def _copy(self) -> None:
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(feedback_as_text(self.item))

    def _open_github(self) -> None:
        url = str(self.item.get("html_url") or GITHUB_ISSUES_PAGE)
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    def _save_status(self) -> None:
        status = str(self.status_combo.currentData() or "open")
        self.status_requested.emit(self.item, status)
        self.accept()


class FeedbackDialog(StyledDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent, kind: str = "bug") -> None:
        super().__init__(
            parent,
            "猫猫的意见箱",
            "message",
            colors()["accent"],
            width=840,
        )
        self.main = parent
        self._kind = kind if kind in KIND_LABELS else "bug"
        self._items: list[dict] = []
        self._list_worker: FeedbackListWorker | None = None
        self._submit_worker: FeedbackSubmitWorker | None = None
        self._update_worker: FeedbackUpdateWorker | None = None
        self._pending_update: tuple[str, str] | None = None
        self._fallback_payload: dict | None = None
        self._closed = False
        self._inbox_loaded = False
        self._build()
        self.set_kind(self._kind)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build(self) -> None:
        self.intro = QLabel(
            "遇到 bug，或者想让 DKL 更顺手，都可以写在这里。反馈会进入猫猫的收件箱，"
            "网站和启动器共用同一套反馈。"
        )
        self.intro.setObjectName("Muted")
        self.intro.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(self.intro)

        if developer_mode():
            banner = Card(soft=True)
            banner_layout = QHBoxLayout(banner)
            banner_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 9, 12, 9)
            banner_layout.setSpacing(9)
            banner_layout.addWidget(badge("DEV", "red"))
            texts = QVBoxLayout()
            texts.setSpacing(1)
            title = QLabel("开发者模式 · LFELKEEA")
            title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
            note = QLabel("正版账户与 Microsoft 邮箱匹配。你可以查看其他人提交的 Bug 和改进建议。")
            note.setObjectName("Tiny")
            note.setWordWrap(True)
            texts.addWidget(title)
            texts.addWidget(note)
            banner_layout.addLayout(texts, 1)
            self.body.addWidget(banner)

        self.tabs = SegmentedControl()
        self.tabs.add_item("写反馈", "compose")
        if developer_mode():
            self.tabs.add_item("收件箱", "inbox")
            self.tabs.changed.connect(self._switch_tab)
        else:
            self.tabs.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.tabs)

        self.stack = QStackedWidget()
        self.stack.setMinimumHeight(440)
        self.compose_page = self._build_compose()
        self.inbox_page = self._build_inbox()
        self.stack.addWidget(self.compose_page)
        self.stack.addWidget(self.inbox_page)
        self.body.addWidget(self.stack, 1)

        self.add_button("打开网站反馈", "Ghost", self._open_site)
        self.add_button("关闭", "Secondary", self.reject)

    def _build_inbox(self) -> QWidget:
        page = QWidget()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(page)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        layout.setSpacing(9)

        head = QHBoxLayout()
        head.setSpacing(8)
        title = QLabel("其他人提交的反馈")
        title.setObjectName("H2")
        self.inbox_count = badge("0 条", "blue")
        head.addWidget(title)
        head.addWidget(self.inbox_count)
        head.addStretch(1)
        github_btn = icon_button(
            "external", "打开 GitHub Issues", colors()["muted"], 30, 15
        )
        github_btn.clicked.connect(
            lambda: QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(GITHUB_ISSUES_PAGE))
        )
        self.refresh_btn = icon_button(
            "refresh", "刷新反馈列表", colors()["muted"], 30, 15
        )
        self.refresh_btn.clicked.connect(self._load_inbox)
        head.addWidget(github_btn)
        head.addWidget(self.refresh_btn)
        layout.addLayout(head)

        filters = QHBoxLayout()
        filters.setSpacing(8)
        self.filter_status = QComboBox()
        self.filter_status.addItem("全部状态", "")
        self.filter_status.addItem("待处理", "open")
        self.filter_status.addItem("已处理", "resolved")
        self.filter_status.addItem("已归档", "archived")
        self.filter_status.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index: self._render_inbox()
        )
        self.filter_kind = QComboBox()
        self.filter_kind.addItem("全部类型", "")
        for value in KIND_ORDER:
            self.filter_kind.addItem(KIND_LABELS[value], value)
        self.filter_kind.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            lambda _index: self._render_inbox()
        )
        filters.addWidget(self.filter_status)
        filters.addWidget(self.filter_kind)
        filters.addStretch(1)
        layout.addLayout(filters)

        self.inbox_note = QLabel("打开收件箱后会读取反馈中心，并合并 GitHub 公开反馈。")
        self.inbox_note.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.inbox_note.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.inbox_note)

        self.inbox_scroll = QScrollArea()
        self.inbox_scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self.inbox_scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.inbox_scroll.setMinimumHeight(350)
        self._reset_inbox_container()
        layout.addWidget(self.inbox_scroll, 1)
        return page

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_kind(self, kind: str) -> None:
        kind = kind if kind in KIND_LABELS else "bug"
        self._kind = kind
        index = self.type_combo.findData(kind)
        if index >= 0:
            self.type_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        if kind == "suggestion":
            self.title_label.setText("给猫猫提个改进建议")
            self.form_title.setText("提一个改进建议")
            self.form_hint.setText(
                "希望启动器多做什么、少做什么，或者哪里用起来不顺手？"
                "具体的使用场景比一句“优化一下”更有帮助。"
            )
            self.title_edit.setPlaceholderText("例如：希望下载中心支持按完成时间排序")
            self.submit_btn.setText("提交建议")
        else:
            self.title_label.setText("猫猫收到一只虫子")
            self.form_title.setText("报告一个 Bug")
            self.form_hint.setText(
                "描述发生了什么、你期待什么，以及能否稳定复现。"
                "带版本号和报错信息的反馈最有用。"
            )
            self.title_edit.setPlaceholderText("例如：安装 1.21.1 后启动时报错")
            self.submit_btn.setText("提交反馈")

    def _switch_tab(self, value: str) -> None:
        if value == "inbox":
            self.stack.setCurrentIndex(1)
            if not self._inbox_loaded:
                self._load_inbox()
        else:
            self.stack.setCurrentIndex(0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _current_account(self) -> Account:
        try:
            return self.main.current_account()
        except Exception:
            return Account.from_config(getattr(self.main.config, "account", {}))

    def _client_id(self) -> str:
        return str(getattr(self.main.config, "microsoft_client_id", "") or "").strip()

    def _save_account(self, account) -> None:
        if account is None or not getattr(account, "is_msa", False):
            return
        try:
            self.main.config.account = account.to_config()
            self.main.config.save()
            signal = getattr(self.main, "account_changed", None)
            if signal is not None:
                signal.emit()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _set_status(self, text: str, kind: str = "") -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "status_label"):
            return
        self.status_label.setText(text)
        color = colors()["muted"]
        if kind == "ok":
            color = colors()["green"]
        elif kind == "err":
            color = colors()["red"]
        elif kind == "busy":
            color = colors()["accent"]
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px;")

    def _copy_compose(self) -> None:
        payload = self._payload()
        if not payload.get("title") and not payload.get("description"):
            self._set_status("先写一点内容再复制。", "err")
            return
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(feedback_payload_text(payload))
        self._set_status("反馈内容已复制到剪贴板。", "ok")

    def _payload(self) -> dict:
        return build_feedback_payload(
            kind=str(self.type_combo.currentData() or "other"),
            title=self.title_edit.text(),
            description=self.desc_edit.toPlainText(),
            version=self.version_edit.text() or APP_VERSION,
            contact=self.contact_edit.text(),
        )

    def _submit(self) -> None:
        if self._submit_worker is not None:
            return
        payload = self._payload()
        if len(payload["title"]) < 2:
            self._set_status("标题至少需要 2 个字。", "err")
            self.title_edit.setFocus()
            return
        if len(payload["description"]) < 10:
            self._set_status("描述至少需要 10 个字，写清楚操作步骤会更容易定位。", "err")
            self.desc_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self._fallback_payload = payload
        self.fallback_box.setVisible(False)
        self.submit_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.submit_btn.setText("正在提交…")
        self._set_status("正在把反馈送进猫猫的收件箱…", "busy")
        worker = FeedbackSubmitWorker(payload, self)
        self._submit_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._submit_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _submit_finished(self, ok: bool, message: str, feedback_id: str) -> None:
        self._submit_worker = None
        if self._closed:
            return
        self.submit_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.submit_btn.setText(
            "提交建议" if self._kind == "suggestion" else "提交反馈"
        )
        if ok:
            self._set_status(
                f"已经收到啦，反馈编号 {feedback_id or '已记录'}。猫猫会认真看。",
                "ok",
            )
            self.title_edit.clear()
            self.desc_edit.clear()
            self.fallback_box.setVisible(False)
            if developer_mode():
                self._inbox_loaded = False
            try:
                self.main.toast("反馈已提交，谢谢", "success")
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
        detail = message or "反馈没有成功保存。"
        self._set_status(
            f"{detail}\n反馈中心可能还在部署。可以先公开提交到 GitHub，或改用邮件发送。",
            "err",
        )
        self.fallback_box.setVisible(True)

    def _open_github_fallback(self) -> None:
        payload = self._fallback_payload or self._payload()
        if not payload.get("title") and not payload.get("description"):
            self._set_status("先写一点内容再提交。", "err")
            return
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(feedback_payload_text(payload))
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(build_github_issue_url(payload)))
        self._set_status(
            "已打开 GitHub 新建 Issue 页面，完整内容也复制到了剪贴板。"
            "公开提交后，开发者收件箱会读取到这条反馈。",
            "ok",
        )

    def _open_email_fallback(self) -> None:
        payload = self._fallback_payload or self._payload()
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(feedback_payload_text(payload))
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(build_mailto_url(payload)))
        self._set_status("已打开邮件草稿，完整内容也复制到了剪贴板。", "ok")

    def _open_site(self) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(FEEDBACK_SITE))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _reset_inbox_container(self) -> QVBoxLayout:
        old = self.inbox_scroll.takeWidget()
        if old is not None:
            old.deleteLater()
        container = QWidget()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 4, 0)
        layout.setSpacing(8)
        layout.addStretch(1)
        self.inbox_scroll.setWidget(container)
        return layout

    def _load_inbox(self) -> None:
        if not developer_mode() or self._list_worker is not None:
            return
        self.refresh_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.inbox_note.setText("正在读取反馈中心与 GitHub 公开反馈…")
        self.inbox_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['muted']};")
        account = self._current_account()
        worker = FeedbackListWorker(account, self._client_id(), self)
        self._list_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._list_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _list_finished(self, items, account, source: str, warning: str) -> None:
        self._list_worker = None
        if self._closed:
            return
        self.refresh_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self._save_account(account)
        self._items = list(items or [])
        self._inbox_loaded = True
        if source == "center+github":
            note = f"已合并反馈中心与 GitHub 公开反馈，共 {len(self._items)} 条。"
            color = colors()["green"]
        elif source == "center":
            note = f"已连接反馈中心，共 {len(self._items)} 条反馈。"
            color = colors()["green"]
        elif source == "github":
            note = (
                f"反馈中心暂时不可用，已显示 GitHub 公开反馈，共 {len(self._items)} 条。"
                + (f"\n{warning}" if warning else "")
            )
            color = colors()["orange"]
        else:
            note = warning or "暂时没有读取到反馈。"
            color = colors()["red"]
        self.inbox_note.setText(note)
        self.inbox_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px;")
        self._render_inbox()

    def _filtered_items(self) -> list[dict]:
        status = str(self.filter_status.currentData() or "")
        kind = str(self.filter_kind.currentData() or "")
        result = []
        for item in self._items:
            item_status = str(item.get("status") or "open")
            if status and item_status != status:
                continue
            if kind and str(item.get("kind") or "other") != kind:
                continue
            result.append(item)
        return result

    def _render_inbox(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "inbox_scroll"):
            return
        layout = self._reset_inbox_container()
        items = self._filtered_items()
        self.inbox_count.setText(f"{len(items)} 条")
        if not items:
            empty = QLabel(
                "没有符合筛选条件的反馈。换一个筛选，或点右上角刷新。"
                if self._items
                else "收件箱还是空的。等第一条反馈进来，猫猫会第一时间告诉你。"
            )
            empty.setObjectName("Muted")
            empty.setWordWrap(True)
            empty.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            empty.setMinimumHeight(180)
            layout.insertWidget(0, empty)
            return
        for item in items:
            row = FeedbackRow(item)
            row.clicked.connect(self._open_detail)
            layout.insertWidget(layout.count() - 1, row)

    def _open_detail(self, item: dict) -> None:
        dialog = FeedbackDetailDialog(self, item)
        dialog.status_requested.connect(self._request_status)
        dialog.exec()

    def _request_status(self, item: dict, status: str) -> None:
        if item.get("platform") != "center" or self._update_worker is not None:
            return
        feedback_id = str(item.get("id") or "")
        if not feedback_id:
            return
        self._pending_update = (feedback_id, status)
        self.inbox_note.setText(
            f"正在把 {feedback_id} 标记为 {STATUS_LABELS.get(status, status)}…"
        )
        self.inbox_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['accent']}; font-size: 11px;")
        worker = FeedbackUpdateWorker(
            self._current_account(),
            self._client_id(),
            feedback_id,
            status,
            self,
        )
        self._update_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._update_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _update_finished(self, ok: bool, message: str, account, item) -> None:
        self._update_worker = None
        if self._closed:
            return
        self._save_account(account)
        pending = self._pending_update
        self._pending_update = None
        if not ok:
            self.inbox_note.setText(message or "更新反馈状态失败。")
            self.inbox_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
            return
        if pending and isinstance(item, dict):
            feedback_id, status = pending
            for index, existing in enumerate(self._items):
                if str(existing.get("id") or "") == feedback_id:
                    merged = dict(existing)
                    merged.update(item)
                    self._items[index] = merged
                    break
            else:
                self._items.insert(0, item)
            self.inbox_note.setText(
                f"反馈状态已更新为 {STATUS_LABELS.get(status, status)}。"
            )
            self.inbox_note.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['green']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )
        self._render_inbox()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def reject(self) -> None:
        self._closed = True
        super().reject()

def _new_painter(size: int) -> tuple[QPixmap, QPainter, int]:
    scale = 2
    pixmap = QPixmap(size * scale, size * scale)
    pixmap.setDevicePixelRatio(scale)
    pixmap.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(pixmap)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
    return pixmap, painter, size


def _line(painter: QPainter, points: list[tuple[float, float]]) -> None:
    path = QPainterPath(QPointF(*points[0]))
    for point in points[1:]:
        path.lineTo(QPointF(*point))
    painter.drawPath(path)

def icon(name: str, color: str = "#59637A", size: int = 18) -> QIcon:
    return QIcon(pixmap(name, color, size))


def logo_pixmap(size: int = 40) -> QPixmap:
    """内部品牌图标：与桌面图标一致的低像素恶魔小猫。"""
    return app_icon_pixmap(size)


def chibi_face_pixmap(size: int) -> QPixmap:
    """Q 版 OC 的正面头像，正方形裁切，适合圆形徽章。"""
    image = QImage(str(ASSETS_DIR / "chibi_face.png"))
    if image.isNull():
        return app_icon_pixmap(size)
    side = min(image.width(), image.height())
    left = (image.width() - side) // 2
    top = (image.height() - side) // 2
    square = image.copy(left, top, side, side)
    return QPixmap.fromImage(
        square.scaled(
            QSize(size, size),
            Qt.IgnoreAspectRatio,
            Qt.SmoothTransformation,
        )
    )


def chibi_pixmap(height: int) -> QPixmap:
    """Q 版 OC 头像立绘，保持宽高比缩放到指定高度。"""
    image = QImage(str(ASSETS_DIR / "chibi_oc.png"))
    if image.isNull():
        return app_icon_pixmap(height)
    return QPixmap.fromImage(
        image.scaledToHeight(max(1, height), Qt.SmoothTransformation)
    )


def mascot_pixmap(size: int) -> QPixmap:
    """兼容旧调用：返回 Q 版 OC 的圆形头像。"""
    return chibi_face_pixmap(size)


def skin_face_pixmap(size: int) -> QPixmap:
    """把玩家当前皮肤的脸部（含帽子层）渲染成小头像。"""
    image = active_skin_image()
    if image.isNull():
        return logo_pixmap(size)
    face = QImage(8, 8, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    face.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(face)
    painter.drawImage(0, 0, image.copy(8, 8, 8, 8))
    painter.drawImage(0, 0, image.copy(40, 8, 8, 8))
    painter.end()
    scaled = face.scaled(
        QSize(size, size), Qt.IgnoreAspectRatio, Qt.FastTransformation
    ).convertToFormat(QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    return QPixmap.fromImage(scaled)


_SKIN_IMAGE_CACHE: dict[str, tuple[float, QImage]] = {}


def active_skin_image() -> QImage:
    """读取启动器当前使用的皮肤：优先 config.skin_path，其次本地预览副本。"""
    try:
        from ..config import Config

        configured = str(Config.load().skin_path or "").strip()
    except Exception:
        configured = ""
    candidates: list[Path] = []
    if configured:
        candidates.append(Path(configured))
    try:
        from ..skins import local_skin_path

        local = local_skin_path()
        if local not in candidates:
            candidates.append(local)
    except Exception:
        pass

    for path in candidates:
        try:
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
            cached = _SKIN_IMAGE_CACHE.get(str(path))
            if cached and cached[0] == mtime:
                return cached[1]
            from ..skins import load_skin_file

            image = load_skin_file(path).image
            if not image.isNull():
                _SKIN_IMAGE_CACHE[str(path)] = (mtime, image)
                return image
        except Exception:
            continue
    try:
        from ..skins import default_skin

        return default_skin()
    except Exception:
        return QImage()

_APP_ICON_BASE: QImage | None = None


def _app_icon_base() -> QImage:
    global _APP_ICON_BASE
    if _APP_ICON_BASE is not None:
        return _APP_ICON_BASE

    band_colors: list[QColor | None] = [None] * 32
    for lo, hi, value in _APP_ICON_BANDS:
        for y in range(lo, hi + 1):
            band_colors[y] = QColor(value)

    image = QImage(32, 32, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    image.fill(Qt.transparent)
    for y, row in enumerate(_APP_ICON_ROWS):
        for x, ch in enumerate(row):
            if ch == " ":
                continue
            if ch == ".":
                color = band_colors[y]
            else:
                color = QColor(_APP_ICON_PALETTE[ch])
            if color is not None:
                image.setPixelColor(x, y, color)
    _APP_ICON_BASE = image
    return image


def app_icon_image(size: int) -> QImage:
    """低像素恶魔小猫：玫瑰渐变底，奶白侧影，头朝左，尾巴卷在右侧。"""
    base = _app_icon_base()
    if size == base.width():
        return base.copy()
    return base.scaled(size, size, Qt.IgnoreAspectRatio, Qt.FastTransformation)


def app_icon_pixmap(size: int) -> QPixmap:
    return QPixmap.fromImage(app_icon_image(size))


def app_icon() -> QIcon:
    icon = QIcon()
    ico = ASSETS_DIR / "dkl.ico"
    if ico.is_file():
        icon.addFile(str(ico))
        return icon
    for size in (16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256):
        icon.addPixmap(app_icon_pixmap(size))
    return icon
