    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _populate_bases(self) -> None:
        self.base_combo.blockSignals(True)
        for summary in self._bases:
            label = summary.id
            if summary.type_name:
                label += f" · {summary.type_name}"
            self.base_combo.addItem(label, summary.id)
        preferred = self.main.selected_version
        index = self.base_combo.findData(preferred)
        if index < 0:
            summary = next(
                (v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == preferred), None
            )
            if summary and summary.loader:
                try:
                    base_id = resolve_version(
                        self.main.config.game_path, summary.id
                    ).chain[0]
                    index = self.base_combo.findData(base_id)
                except Exception:
                    index = -1
        if index >= 0:
            self.base_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.base_combo.blockSignals(False)

        if not self._bases:
            self.empty_label.setText(
                "还没有安装原版游戏。请先到“下载”页面安装一个原版版本，再回来添加加载器。"
            )
            self.empty_label.setVisible(True)
            self.base_combo.setEnabled(False)
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(False)

        summary = next(
            (v for v in self._bases if v.id == self.base_combo.currentData()),
            None,
        )
        if summary and summary.loader:
            self.loader_tabs.set_value(
                {"Fabric": "fabric", "Forge": "forge", "NeoForge": "neoforge"}.get(
                    summary.loader, "fabric"
                )
            )

    def _current_base(self):
        base_id = self.base_combo.currentData()
        return next((v for v in self._bases if v.id == base_id), None)

    def _refresh_java(self, _installs=None) -> None:
        self._update_info()
        self._update_action()

    def _chosen_java(self):
        summary = self._current_base()
        required = max(8, summary.java_major if summary else 8)
        java = pick_java(
            self.main.java_installs, required, self.main.config.java_path
        )
        if java and java.major and java.major < required:
            return None, required, java
        return java, required, None

    def _update_info(self) -> None:
        summary = self._current_base()
        if not summary:
            self.info_label.setText("")
            return
        kind = self.loader_tabs.current()
        parts = [LOADER_HINTS.get(kind, "")]
        if kind in ("forge", "neoforge"):
            java, required, fallback = self._chosen_java()
            if java:
                parts.append(
                    f"将使用 Java {java.major or '?'}（{java.path}）"
                )
            elif fallback:
                parts.append(
                    f"需要 Java {required}+，当前只有 Java {fallback.major or '?'}，请先在设置中指定 Java。"
                )
            else:
                parts.append(f"未检测到 Java，安装 {LOADER_NAMES[kind]} 需要 Java {required}+。")
        try:
            missing = check_installation(
                self.main.config.game_path,
                resolve_version(self.main.config.game_path, summary.id),
                check_assets=False,
            )
        except Exception:
            missing = []
        if missing:
            parts.append(f"基础版本缺少 {len(missing)} 项文件，安装时会自动补全。")
        self.info_label.setText("\n".join(p for p in parts if p))

    def _reload_versions(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            return
        summary = self._current_base()
        kind = self.loader_tabs.current()
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.version_combo.clear()
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self.install_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self._update_info()
        if not summary or not kind:
            self.version_combo.addItem("没有可用的游戏版本", "")
            return

        self.version_combo.addItem("正在获取版本列表…", "")
        worker = LoaderVersionsWorker(kind, summary.id, self)
        self._versions_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=worker: self._versions_ready(w, data, error)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _versions_ready(
        self, worker: LoaderVersionsWorker, data, error: str
    ) -> None:
        if worker is not self._versions_worker:
            return
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.version_combo.clear()
        if error:
            self.version_combo.addItem("获取失败", "")
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
            self.info_label.setText(f"获取 {LOADER_NAMES.get(worker.kind, '')} 版本失败：{error}")
            self._update_action()
            return
        if not data:
            self.version_combo.addItem("没有可用版本", "")
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
            self.info_label.setText(
                f"{LOADER_NAMES.get(worker.kind, '')} 目前没有适配该游戏版本的版本。"
            )
            self._update_action()
            return

        first_stable = next((i for i, item in enumerate(data) if item.get("stable")), -1)
        for index, item in enumerate(data):
            version = str(item.get("version") or "")
            suffix = ""
            if index == first_stable:
                suffix = "  ·  推荐"
            elif first_stable < 0 and index == 0:
                suffix = "  ·  最新"
            self.version_combo.addItem(version + suffix, version)
        self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(first_stable if first_stable >= 0 else 0)
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._update_action()

    def _update_action(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(True)
            return
        summary = self._current_base()
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        enabled = bool(summary and version)
        if enabled and self.loader_tabs.current() in ("forge", "neoforge"):
            java, _required, _fallback = self._chosen_java()
            enabled = java is not None
        self.install_btn.setEnabled(enabled)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _install(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            self._cancel_install()
            return
        summary = self._current_base()
        kind = self.loader_tabs.current()
        version = str(self.version_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not summary or not version:
            return
        java_path = ""
        if kind in ("forge", "neoforge"):
            java, _required, _fallback = self._chosen_java()
            if not java:
                self.main.toast("未找到满足要求的 Java，请先在设置中指定", "error")
                return
            java_path = java.path

        self._installing = True
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText("准备安装…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.log.clear()
        self.log.setVisible(True)
        self.install_btn.setText("取消安装")
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setText("后台运行")
        self.adjustSize()

        worker = LoaderInstallWorker(
            self.main.config.game_path,
            summary.id,
            kind,
            version,
            java_path=java_path,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._install_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.log_line.connect(self._append_log)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        self._task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"安装加载器 · {kind} {version}",
            content_type="loader-install",
            target=self.main.config.version_game_path(version),
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            metadata={
                "base_id": summary.id,
                "loader": kind,
                "loader_version": version,
            },
            forward_log=False,
        )

    def _cancel_install(self) -> None:
        if self._install_worker:
            self.progress_text.setText("正在取消…")
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self._install_worker.cancel()

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self.base_combo.setEnabled(not busy and bool(self._bases))
        self.loader_tabs.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.version_combo.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setText("后台运行" if busy else "关闭")
        self.install_btn.setText("取消安装" if busy else "安装")
        if not busy:
            self._update_action()

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, percent)))
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _append_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        self.log.appendPlainText(line)
        bar = self.log.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _detach_download_center(self, _result: int = 0) -> None:
        if self._task is not None and not self._task.running:
            self._task = None

    def _on_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, version_id: str) -> None:
        self._installing = False
        self._install_worker = None
        if self._task is not None:
            # 对话框还活着时由这里负责收尾，主窗口不要再弹第二次提示。
            self._task.metadata["ui_handled"] = True
        self._set_busy(False)
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.install_btn.setEnabled(True)
        if success:
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText("安装完成")
            self.main.refresh_versions()
            profile = next(
                (v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == version_id), None
            )
            meta_base = (
                str(self._task.metadata.get("base_id") or "")
                if self._task is not None
                else ""
            )
            base_id = (
                profile.base_id
                if profile and profile.base_id
                else (meta_base or str(self.base_combo.currentData() or ""))
            )
            if profile and profile.is_loader_profile and base_id:
                self.main.config.bind_loader(base_id, version_id)
                self.main.config.last_version = base_id
                self.main.config.save()
                self.main.select_version(base_id)
            elif base_id:
                self.main.select_version(base_id)
            self.main.refresh_versions()
            self.main.toast(
                f"{version_id} 已安装，并绑定到 {base_id or '游戏版本'}",
                "success",
            )
            QTimer.singleShot(450, self.accept)
        elif "取消" in str(message):
            self.progress_text.setText("安装已取消")
            self.install_btn.setText("安装")
            self.main.toast("加载器安装已取消", "info")
        else:
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self.install_btn.setText("安装")
            self.main.toast(f"安装失败：{message}", "error")

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            self.main.toast(
                "加载器安装已转到顶栏继续，可以继续操作启动器；"
                "点击顶栏进度可以查看任务",
                "info",
            )
        super().reject()

        self.finished.connect(self._detach_download_center)
        paths = [Path(item) for item in (initial_paths or [])]
        if initial_path:
            paths.append(Path(initial_path))
        if paths:
            self._load_paths(paths)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def dragEnterEvent(self, event: QDragEnterEvent) -> None:
        if self._mode == "idle" and local_transfer_paths(event.mimeData()):
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            event.ignore()

    def dragMoveEvent(self, event: QDragMoveEvent) -> None:
        if self._mode == "idle" and local_transfer_paths(event.mimeData()):
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            event.ignore()

    def dropEvent(self, event: QDropEvent) -> None:
        paths = local_transfer_paths(event.mimeData())
        if self._mode != "idle" or not paths:
            event.ignore()
            return
        event.acceptProposedAction()
        self._load_paths(paths)

    def _choose_files(self) -> None:
        files, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames(
            self,
            "选择本地内容或版本包",
            str(self.main.config.game_path),
            (
                "支持的文件 (*.jar *.litemod *.zip *.dklpack *.mrpack "
                "*.jar.disabled *.litemod.disabled);;所有文件 (*)"
            ),
        )
        if files:
            self._load_paths([Path(item) for item in files])

    def _choose_folder(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self, "选择版本文件夹或完整游戏目录", str(self.main.config.game_path)
        )
        if folder:
            self._load_paths([Path(folder)])

    def _load_paths(self, paths: list[Path]) -> None:
        self._hide_error()
        if not paths:
            return
        try:
            infos = [detect_local_import(path) for path in paths]
        except LocalImportError as exc:
            self._show_error(str(exc))
            return

        special = [info for info in infos if info.kind in ("server", "modpack", "version_zip")]
        if special:
            if len(infos) != 1:
                self._show_error("专属导入包一次只能处理一个。")
                return
            self._route_to_special(special[0])
            return

        if any(info.kind == "version_folder" for info in infos):
            if len(infos) != 1:
                self._show_error("版本文件夹一次只能导入一个。")
                return
            self._show_version(infos[0])
            return

        if any(info.kind != "content" for info in infos):
            self._show_error("有一项内容无法识别，请换一个文件试试。")
            return
        self._show_contents(infos)

    def _route_to_special(self, info: LocalImportInfo) -> None:
        path = info.path
        self._mode = "routing"
        self.accept()
        QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda p=path: self.main.open_local_import(p))

    def _show_contents(self, infos: list[LocalImportInfo]) -> None:
        self._mode = "idle"
        self._infos = infos
        self._sources = [info.path for info in infos]
        self._version_info = None
        self.path_edit.setText(
            str(infos[0].path)
            if len(infos) == 1
            else f"已选择 {len(infos)} 个本地内容文件"
        )
        labels = {info.label for info in infos}
        self.preview_name.setText(
            infos[0].title if len(infos) == 1 else f"{len(infos)} 个本地内容"
        )
        self.preview_badge.setText(next(iter(labels)) if len(labels) == 1 else "本地内容")
        self.preview_meta.setText(" · ".join(info.detail for info in infos))
        self.preview_note.setText(
            "非压缩文件直接复制到目标文件夹；材质 / 光影 ZIP 保持原样，"
            "游戏会直接读取；Mod 合集会在目标文件夹里就地解开。源文件不会被移动或删除。"
        )
        self.preview.setVisible(True)
        self.version_options.setVisible(False)
        self._fill_versions()
        self.content_options.setVisible(True)
        self.import_btn.setText("直接放进游戏")
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(self.version_combo.count() > 0)
        self._update_target_hint()

    def _show_version(self, info: LocalImportInfo) -> None:
        self._mode = "idle"
        self._sources = []
        self._infos = [info]
        self._version_info = info.version_folder
        self.path_edit.setText(str(info.path))
        candidate = self._version_info.primary if self._version_info else None
        self.preview_name.setText(info.title)
        self.preview_badge.setText("版本文件夹")
        self.preview_meta.setText(info.detail)
        self.preview_note.setText(
            "文件会直接复制进 versions/<版本名>，不经过临时 ZIP；"
            "关闭游戏后再导入更稳妥，同名版本不会覆盖。"
        )
        self.preview.setVisible(True)
        self.content_options.setVisible(False)
        self.version_options.setVisible(True)
        default_id = (
            unique_version_id(self.main.config.game_path, candidate.version_id)
            if candidate
            else info.title
        )
        self.name_edit.setText(default_id)
        isolation = (
            "版本隔离已开启，这个版本会使用自己的 mods / saves 目录。"
            if self.main.config.version_isolation
            else "版本隔离已关闭，内容会使用共享游戏目录。"
        )
        self.name_hint.setText(
            f"来源结构：{candidate.layout_label if candidate else '版本文件夹'}。"
            f"同名版本会自动改名。{isolation}"
        )
        self.complete.setChecked(bool(self.main.config.auto_complete))
        self.import_btn.setText("直接复制版本")
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(True)

    def _fill_versions(self) -> None:
        current = self.version_combo.currentData()
        preferred = self.main.selected_version or self.main.config.last_version
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.version_combo.clear()
        chosen = -1
        for index, summary in enumerate(self.main.game_version_summaries()):
            profile = self.main.loader_profile_for(summary.id)
            suffix = f" · {profile.loader}" if profile else ""
            self.version_combo.addItem(f"{summary.id}{suffix}", summary.id)
            if summary.id == (current or preferred):
                chosen = index
        if chosen < 0 and self.version_combo.count():
            chosen = 0
        if chosen >= 0:
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(chosen)
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _update_target_hint(self) -> None:
        version_id = str(self.version_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not version_id:
            self.target_hint.setText("还没有游戏版本。先安装或导入一个原版版本，猫猫才有地方放内容。")
            self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(self._mode == "idle")
        kinds = {info.content_plan.kind for info in self._infos if info.content_plan}
        if kinds and kinds <= {"resourcepack", "resourcepack_folder"}:
            target = self.main.config.resourcepacks_path(version_id)
        elif kinds and kinds <= {"shaderpack", "shaderpack_folder"}:
            target = self.main.config.shaderpacks_path(version_id)
        else:
            target = self.main.config.version_game_path(version_id)
        self.target_hint.setText(
            f"目标：{target}"
            + (
                "（同名文件自动加序号，不覆盖旧文件）"
                if "content_bundle" not in kinds
                else "（同名文件会跳过）"
            )
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def _content_result(success: bool, message: str, _result) -> tuple[bool, str, str]:
        return bool(success), str(message), ""

    def _bind_download_center(self) -> None:
        if self._download_bound:
            return
        center = self.main.download_center
        center.task_progress.connect(self._on_task_progress)
        center.task_finished.connect(self._on_task_finished)
        self._download_bound = True

    def _detach_download_center(self, _result: int = 0) -> None:
        if not self._download_bound:
            return
        center = self.main.download_center
        try:
            center.task_progress.disconnect(self._on_task_progress)
            center.task_finished.disconnect(self._on_task_finished)
        except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
            pass
        self._download_bound = False

    def _on_task_progress(self, task_id: int, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        if self._task is None or int(task_id) != self._task.id:
            return
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_task_finished(self, task: DownloadTask) -> None:
        if self._task is None or task.id != self._task.id:
            return
        self._task = None
        self._mode = "idle"
        if task.status == TASK_SUCCESS:
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText(task.message)
            if task.content_type == "version-import":
                self.imported_version = task.filename
            self.accept()
            return
        self._finish_busy()
        self._show_error(task.error or task.message or "导入失败")

    def _start_import(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle":
            return
        self._hide_error()
        if self._version_info is not None:
            self._start_version_import()
            return
        if not self._sources:
            self._show_error("还没有选择要导入的内容。")
            return
        version_id = str(self.version_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not version_id:
            self._show_error("先选择一个游戏版本。")
            return
        self._begin_busy()
        worker = LocalContentImportWorker(
            self._sources,
            self.main.config.game_path,
            version_id,
            isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._bind_download_center()
        self._task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"导入本地内容 · {version_id}",
            content_type="local-import",
            target=self.main.config.version_game_path(version_id),
            finished_adapter=self._content_result,
        )

    def _start_version_import(self) -> None:
        if not self._version_info:
            return
        target = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text())
        if not target:
            self._show_error("版本名称不能为空。")
            return
        if version_json_path(self.main.config.game_path, target).is_file() or (
            self.main.config.game_path / "versions" / target
        ).exists():
            suggestion = unique_version_id(self.main.config.game_path, target)
            self.name_edit.setText(suggestion)
            self._show_error(f"版本 {target} 已经存在，已换成 {suggestion}。")
            return
        candidate = self._version_info.primary
        self._begin_busy()
        worker = VersionFolderImportWorker(
            self._version_info.path,
            self.main.config.game_path,
            target,
            candidate_json=candidate.json_path,
            complete=self.complete.isChecked(),
            isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._bind_download_center()
        self._task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"导入版本文件夹 · {target}",
            content_type="version-import",
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            target=self.main.config.game_path / "versions" / target,
        )

    def _begin_busy(self) -> None:
        self._mode = "import"
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText("准备导入…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.choose_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.folder_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(False)
        self.complete.setEnabled(False)
        self.version_combo.setEnabled(False)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消导入")
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(True)

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_cancel(self) -> None:
        if self._task is not None and self._mode == "import":
            self.main.download_center.cancel(self._task.id)
            self.cancel_btn.setText("正在取消…")
            self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self.reject()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._task is not None and self._mode == "import":
            self._detach_download_center()
            self.main.toast(
                "任务已转到顶栏继续，可以继续操作启动器；点击顶栏进度查看任务",
                "info",
            )
        super().reject()

    def _show_error(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.error.setText(message)
        self.error.setVisible(True)

    def _hide_error(self) -> None:
        self.error.setVisible(False)

    def _clear_error(self, _text: str = "") -> None:
        self._hide_error()

class TitleBar(QFrame):
    def __init__(self, window: "MainWindow") -> None:
        super().__init__(window)
        self._window = window
        self.setObjectName("TitleBar")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.setFixedHeight(56)
        self._drag_offset: QPoint | None = None

    def mousePressEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton and not self._window.isMaximized():
            self._drag_offset = event.globalPosition().toPoint() - self._window.frameGeometry().topLeft()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        if self._drag_offset is not None and event.buttons() & Qt.LeftButton:
            if self._window.isMaximized():
                return
            self._window.move(event.globalPosition().toPoint() - self._drag_offset)
            event.accept()
            return
        super().mouseMoveEvent(event)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        self._drag_offset = None
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self, event: QMouseEvent) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self._window.toggle_maximize()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().mouseDoubleClickEvent(event)

        self.mode = QLabel("离线")
        self.mode.setObjectName("Tiny")

        self.dev_badge.setStyleSheet(
            "background: rgba(226,58,94,40); color: #E23A5E;"
            " border-radius: 6px; padding: 1px 5px;"
            " font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800;"
        )
        self.dev_badge.setToolTip("开发者模式：可查看其他人提交的反馈")
        self.dev_badge.setVisible(False)
        layout.addWidget(self.avatar)

        self.dev_badge.setVisible(bool(enabled))

        self.name.setText(name)
        self.name.setToolTip(name)
        self.mode.setText(mode)
        self.mode.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {colors()['green']}; font-weight: 700;" if online else ""
        )

        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)
