def _count_files(root: Path) -> int:
    if not root.is_dir():
        return 0
    count = 0
    try:
        for path in root.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file():
                count += 1
    except OSError:
        pass
    return count


class PackExportDialog(StyledDialog):
    """把当前版本连同 mods / config 打包成 .dklpack。"""

    def __init__(self, main, version_id: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(main, "打包带走", "package", colors()["accent"], width=570)
        self.main = main
        self.version_id = version_id
        self._worker: PackExportWorker | None = None
        self._busy = False
        self._result_path = ""

        run_dir = version_game_dir(
            self.main.config.game_path,
            version_id,
            self.main.config.version_isolation,
        )
        mods = _count_files(run_dir / "mods")
        configs = _count_files(run_dir / "config") + _count_files(
            run_dir / "defaultconfigs"
        )

        intro = QLabel(
            f"把 <b>{version_id}</b> 装进猫猫的纸箱，"
            "带去别的电脑也能一键还原。"
        )
        intro.setObjectName("DialogText")
        intro.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(intro)

        state = QFrame()
        state.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        state.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        state_box = QHBoxLayout(state)
        state_box.setContentsMargins(12, 9, 12, 9)
        state_box.setSpacing(10)
        state_box.addWidget(badge(f"Mod {mods}", "purple"))
        state_box.addWidget(badge(f"配置文件 {configs}", "blue"))
        state_box.addStretch(1)
        isolated = badge(
            "版本隔离" if self.main.config.version_isolation else "共享目录",
            "green" if self.main.config.version_isolation else "orange",
        )
        state_box.addWidget(isolated)
        self.body.addWidget(state)

        self.name_edit = QLineEdit(f"{version_id} 的猫猫整合包")
        self.name_edit.setPlaceholderText("整合包名称")
        self.name_edit.setMaxLength(80)
        self.body.addWidget(self._field_label("整合包名称"))
        self.body.addWidget(self.name_edit)

        self.desc_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.desc_edit.setPlaceholderText("写一句给接手的猫猫看的话（可选）")
        self.desc_edit.setMaxLength(300)
        self.body.addWidget(self._field_label("简介"))
        self.body.addWidget(self.desc_edit)

        self.body.addWidget(self._field_label("纸箱里还要装什么？"))
        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.setHorizontalSpacing(16)
        grid.setVerticalSpacing(8)
        self.option_boxes: dict[str, QCheckBox] = {}
        options = [
            ("config", "config 配置", True),
            ("defaultconfigs", "defaultconfigs", True),
            ("resourcepacks", "资源包", False),
            ("shaderpacks", "光影包", False),
            ("saves", "存档", False),
        ]
        for index, (key, text, default) in enumerate(options):
            box = QCheckBox(text)
            box.setChecked(default)
            box.setToolTip(
                "存档可能包含大量区域文件，默认不打包，避免纸箱太重。"
                if key == "saves"
                else "会以文件夹结构原样放进整合包。"
            )
            self.option_boxes[key] = box
            grid.addWidget(box, index // 3, index % 3)
        mods_note = QLabel("mods 文件夹会自动包含，不需要额外勾选。")
        mods_note.setObjectName("Tiny")
        grid.addWidget(mods_note, 2, 0, 1, 3)
        self.body.addLayout(grid)

        note = QLabel(
            "不会打包账户令牌、启动器配置或下载缓存。"
            "导入时会自动补齐原版客户端、依赖库和资源文件。"
        )
        note.setObjectName("Tiny")
        note.setWordWrap(True)
        self.body.addWidget(note)

        if not self.main.config.version_isolation:
            warning = QLabel(
                "版本隔离当前是关闭的：这里打包的是游戏目录下共享的 "
                "mods 和 config，可能混入其他版本的文件。"
            )
            warning.setWordWrap(True)
            warning.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['orange']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )
            self.body.addWidget(warning)

        self.progress_box = QWidget()
        progress_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.progress_box)
        progress_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        progress_layout.setSpacing(5)
        self.progress = QProgressBar()
        self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
        self.progress.setTextVisible(False)
        self.progress.setFixedHeight(7)
        self.progress_text = QLabel("")
        self.progress_text.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.progress_text.setWordWrap(True)
        progress_layout.addWidget(self.progress)
        progress_layout.addWidget(self.progress_text)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.progress_box)

        self.error = QLabel("")
        self.error.setWordWrap(True)
        self.error.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;")
        self.error.setVisible(False)
        self.body.addWidget(self.error)

        self.cancel_btn = self.add_button("取消", "Secondary", self._on_cancel)
        self.pack_btn = self.add_button(
            "选择位置并打包", "Primary", self._start_export
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _field_label(text: str) -> QLabel:
        label = QLabel(text)
        label.setObjectName("SegLabel")
        return label

    def _options(self) -> PackOptions:
        values = {key: box.isChecked() for key, box in self.option_boxes.items()}
        return PackOptions(**values)

    def _start_export(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if not self.name_edit.text().strip():
            self._show_error("给纸箱写个名字吧，空名字会被猫猫叼走。")
            return
        default_name = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text()) or self.version_id
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "保存 DKL 整合包",
            str(self.main.config.game_path / f"{default_name}{PACK_EXTENSION}"),
            f"Darkitten 整合包 (*{PACK_EXTENSION})",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        output = Path(path)
        if output.suffix.lower() != PACK_EXTENSION:
            output = output.with_suffix(PACK_EXTENSION)
        self._begin_busy()
        worker = PackExportWorker(
            self.main.config.game_path,
            self.version_id,
            output,
            name=self.name_edit.text().strip(),
            description=self.desc_edit.text().strip(),
            options=self._options(),
            isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.log_line.connect(self.main.log)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _begin_busy(self) -> None:
        self._busy = True
        self._hide_error()
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(False)
        self.desc_edit.setEnabled(False)
        for box in self.option_boxes.values():
            box.setEnabled(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.progress_text.setText("正在折纸箱…")
        self.pack_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消打包")

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, path: str) -> None:
        self._busy = False
        self._worker = None
        self.progress.setValue(100 if success else 0)
        if success:
            self._result_path = path
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self.pack_btn.setText("完成")
            self.pack_btn.setEnabled(True)
            try:
                self.pack_btn.clicked.disconnect()
            except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
                pass
            self.pack_btn.clicked.connect(self.accept)
            self.cancel_btn.setVisible(False)
            self.main.log(message)
            self.main.toast("整合包已经装进纸箱，喵。", "success")
            return
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(True)
        self.desc_edit.setEnabled(True)
        for box in self.option_boxes.values():
            box.setEnabled(True)
        self.pack_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.pack_btn.setText("重新打包")
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消")
        self._show_error(message or "打包失败")
        self.main.log(f"打包失败：{message}")

    def _show_error(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.error.setText(text)
        self.error.setVisible(True)

    def _hide_error(self) -> None:
        self.error.clear()
        self.error.setVisible(False)

    def _on_cancel(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            if not self._worker:
                return
            self._worker.cancel()
            self.progress_text.setText("正在把纸箱收回来…")
            self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        self.reject()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "停止打包",
                "纸箱还没封好，现在离开会取消打包。确定吗？",
                primary_text="停止打包",
                secondary_text="继续",
                icon_name="warning",
                icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                return
            if self._worker:
                self._worker.cancel()
            self._busy = False
        super().reject()

    def result_path(self) -> str:
        return self._result_path

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _choose_file(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "选择整合包",
            str(self.main.config.game_path),
            "整合包 (*.dklpack *.mrpack *.zip);;所有文件 (*)",
        )
        if path:
            self._load_pack(Path(path))

    def _load_pack(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self._info = None
        self._kind = ""
        dkl_error: Exception | None = None
        info: PackInfo | ModrinthPackInfo | CurseForgePackInfo
        try:
            info = inspect_pack(path)
        except Exception as exc:
            dkl_error = exc
        else:
            self._kind = "dkl"

        if not self._kind:
            if looks_like_modrinth_pack(path):
                try:
                    info = inspect_modrinth_pack(path)
                except Exception as exc:
                    self._show_error(f"Modrinth 整合包无法导入：{exc}")
                    self.preview.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_options.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
                    return
                self._kind = "modrinth"
            elif looks_like_curseforge_pack(path):
                try:
                    info = inspect_curseforge_pack(path)
                except Exception as exc:
                    self._show_error(f"CurseForge 整合包无法导入：{exc}")
                    self.preview.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_options.setVisible(False)
                    self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
                    return
                self._kind = "curseforge"
            else:
                self._show_error(str(dkl_error or "无法识别这个整合包"))
                self.preview.setVisible(False)
                self.import_options.setVisible(False)
                self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)
                return

        self._info = info
        self._attempted_version_id = ""
        self.path_edit.setText(str(path))
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self._hide_error()
        self.preview.setVisible(True)
        self.import_options.setVisible(True)
        self.preview_name.setText(info.name)
        loader_text = info.loader or "原版"
        if info.loader and info.loader_version:
            loader_text += f" {info.loader_version}"
        self.preview_loader.setText(loader_text)
        self.preview_mc.setText(f"Minecraft {info.minecraft_version or '未知'}")
        self.preview_loader.setVisible(bool(info.loader))
        if self._kind == "modrinth":
            self.preview_meta.setText(
                f"来自 Modrinth · {info.total_files} 个文件 · "
                f"下载约 {human_size(info.total_bytes)} · "
                f"压缩包 {human_size(info.archive_bytes)}"
            )
        elif self._kind == "curseforge":
            self.preview_meta.setText(
                f"来自 CurseForge · 在线下载 {len(info.files)} 个文件 · "
                f"覆盖文件 {human_size(info.total_bytes)} · "
                f"压缩包 {human_size(info.archive_bytes)}"
            )
        else:
            created = (
                info.created_at[:19].replace("T", " ")
                if info.created_at
                else "未知"
            )
            self.preview_meta.setText(
                f"来自 {info.created_with or 'DKL'} · {created} · "
                f"{info.total_files} 个文件 · 解压后 {human_size(info.total_bytes)} · "
                f"压缩包 {human_size(info.archive_bytes)}"
            )
        parts = []
        for key in ("mods", "config", "defaultconfigs", "resourcepacks", "shaderpacks", "saves"):
            count = int(info.counts.get(key) or 0)
            if count:
                parts.append(f"{CONTENT_LABELS.get(key, key)} {count}")
        self.preview_contents.setText("纸箱里装着：" + ("、".join(parts) or "只有版本信息"))
        self.preview_contents.setVisible(bool(parts))
        self.preview_desc.setText(info.description)
        self.preview_desc.setVisible(bool(info.description))

        default_id = unique_version_id(self.main.config.game_path, info.name)
        self.name_edit.setText(default_id)
        hint = "默认使用整合包名称；如果已存在同名版本会自动加序号。"
        if self._kind in ("modrinth", "curseforge"):
            hint += (
                f" 导入时会安装 Minecraft {info.minecraft_version}"
                + (
                    f" + {info.loader} {info.loader_version}"
                    if info.loader
                    else ""
                )
                + "，并下载清单里的文件。"
            )
        if not self.main.config.version_isolation:
            hint += "  版本隔离关闭，mods 会写入共享目录。"
        self.name_hint.setText(hint)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.import_btn.setText("导入猫窝")

    @staticmethod
    def _fetch_result(path: str, error: str) -> tuple[bool, str, str]:
        if error:
            return False, str(error), ""
        target = Path(path)
        return True, "压缩包下载完成", target.name

    def _bind_download_center(self) -> None:
        if self._download_bound:
            return
        center = self.main.download_center
        center.task_progress.connect(self._on_task_progress)
        center.task_finished.connect(self._on_task_finished)
        self._download_bound = True

    def _detach_download_center(self, _result: int = 0) -> None:
        if not self._download_bound:
            return
        center = self.main.download_center
        try:
            center.task_progress.disconnect(self._on_task_progress)
            center.task_finished.disconnect(self._on_task_finished)
        except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
            pass
        self._download_bound = False

    def _on_task_progress(self, task_id: int, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        if self._task is None or int(task_id) != self._task.id:
            return
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_task_finished(self, task: DownloadTask) -> None:
        if self._task is None or task.id != self._task.id:
            return
        self._task = None
        self._mode = "idle"
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消")
        if task.status == TASK_SUCCESS:
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText(task.message)
            if task.content_type == "pack-fetch":
                self._set_controls_enabled(True)
                self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
                path = task.target / task.filename
                if path.is_file():
                    self._load_pack(path)
                else:
                    self._show_error("下载完成但找不到压缩包，请重试。")
                return
            self.imported_version = task.filename
            self.accept()
            return
        self._set_controls_enabled(True)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.import_btn.setText("重新导入")
        message = task.error or task.message or "导入失败"
        target = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text())
        if version_json_path(self.main.config.game_path, target).is_file():
            self._attempted_version_id = target
            message = (
                f"{message}\n已保留版本骨架，可以再次点击“重新导入”继续补全；"
                "已下载的文件不会重复下载。"
            )
        self._show_error(message)
        self.main.log(f"整合包任务失败：{message}")

    def _download_url(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle":
            return
        url = self.url_edit.text().strip()
        if not url:
            self._show_error("链接是空的，猫猫找不到纸箱。")
            return
        self._hide_error()
        self._begin_busy("fetch")
        worker = PackFetchWorker(
            url,
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            inspect_result=False,
            parent=None,
        )
        self._bind_download_center()
        self._task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title="下载整合包",
            content_type="pack-fetch",
            source="url",
            target=APP_DIR / "cache" / "packs",
            pack_mode=True,
            finished_adapter=self._fetch_result,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _start_import(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle" or not self._info:
            return
        target = normalize_version_id(self.name_edit.text())
        if not target:
            self._show_error("导入名称不能为空。")
            return
        version_dir = self.main.config.game_path / "versions" / target
        resume = bool(
            self._attempted_version_id
            and self._attempted_version_id == target
            and version_json_path(self.main.config.game_path, target).is_file()
        )
        if version_dir.exists() and not resume:
            suggestion = unique_version_id(self.main.config.game_path, target)
            self.name_edit.setText(suggestion)
            self._show_error(
                f"版本 {target} 已经存在。可以改用 {suggestion}，或先删除旧版本。"
            )
            return
        self._hide_error()
        self._begin_busy("import")
        if self._kind == "modrinth":
            worker: (
                PackImportWorker
                | ModrinthPackImportWorker
                | CurseForgePackImportWorker
            ) = (
                ModrinthPackImportWorker(
                    self._info.path,
                    self.main.config.game_path,
                    target,
                    java_path=self.main.config.java_path,
                    overwrite=self.overwrite.isChecked(),
                    resume=resume,
                    isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
                    source=self.main.config.download_source,
                    threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
                    parent=self,
                )
            )
        elif self._kind == "curseforge":
            worker = CurseForgePackImportWorker(
                self._info.path,
                self.main.config.game_path,
                target,
                java_path=self.main.config.java_path,
                overwrite=self.overwrite.isChecked(),
                resume=resume,
                isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
                source=self.main.config.download_source,
                threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
                parent=self,
            )
        else:
            worker = PackImportWorker(
                self._info.path,
                self.main.config.game_path,
                target,
                overwrite=self.overwrite.isChecked(),
                resume=resume,
                isolated=self.main.config.version_isolation,
                source=self.main.config.download_source,
                threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
                parent=self,
            )
        self._bind_download_center()
        self._task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"导入整合包 · {target}",
            content_type="modpack",
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            target=version_dir,
        )

    def _begin_busy(self, mode: str) -> None:
        self._mode = mode
        self._hide_error()
        self._set_controls_enabled(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.progress_text.setText(
            "正在下载纸箱…" if mode == "fetch" else "正在给猫窝腾位置…"
        )
        self.cancel_btn.setText("取消下载" if mode == "fetch" else "取消导入")
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(False)

    def _set_controls_enabled(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        self.choose_btn.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.download_btn.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.url_edit.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.name_edit.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.overwrite.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.import_btn.setEnabled(enabled and self._info is not None)

    def _on_cancel(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle" and self._task is not None:
            self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self.progress_text.setText("正在收回猫爪…")
            self.main.download_center.cancel(self._task.id)
            return
        self.reject()

    def _show_error(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.error.setText(text)
        self.error.setVisible(True)

    def _clear_error(self) -> None:
        self.error.clear()
        self.error.setVisible(False)

    def _hide_error(self) -> None:
        self._clear_error()

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._mode != "idle" and self._task is not None:
            self._detach_download_center()
            self.main.toast(
                "任务已转到顶栏继续，可以继续操作启动器；点击顶栏进度查看任务",
                "info",
            )
        super().reject()

    "release": "正式版",
    "snapshot": "快照",
    "old_beta": "旧测试版",
    "old_alpha": "远古版",

def _date_text(value: str) -> str:
    if not value:
        return "未知时间"
    return value[:10]


class DownloadVersionRow(QFrame):
    clicked = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, entry: dict, installed: bool, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.entry = entry
        self.setObjectName("SelectRow")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFixedHeight(52)
        self.setProperty("selected", "false")

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(11, 6, 10, 6)
        layout.setSpacing(9)

        marker = QLabel()
        marker.setFixedSize(28, 28)
        marker.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        vtype = str(entry.get("type", "release"))
        color = colors()["green"] if vtype == "release" else (
            colors()["orange"] if vtype == "snapshot" else colors()["muted"]
        )
        marker.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("cube", color, 18))

        info = QVBoxLayout()
        info.setSpacing(1)
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.setSpacing(6)
        name = QLabel(str(entry.get("id", "")))
        name.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        top.addWidget(name)
        top.addWidget(
            badge(
                TYPE_LABELS.get(vtype, vtype),
                "green" if vtype == "release" else ("orange" if vtype == "snapshot" else "gray"),
            )
        )
        top.addStretch(1)
        if installed:
            top.addWidget(badge("已安装", "blue"))
        info.addLayout(top)

        meta = QLabel(_date_text(str(entry.get("releaseTime", ""))))
        meta.setObjectName("Tiny")
        info.addWidget(meta)

        layout.addWidget(marker)
        layout.addLayout(info, 1)
        chevron = QLabel()
        chevron.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("chevron-right", colors()["muted"], 15))
        layout.addWidget(chevron)
        transparent_children(self)

    def set_selected(self, selected: bool) -> None:
        self.setProperty("selected", "true" if selected else "false")
        repolish(self)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit(str(self.entry.get("id", "")))
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _source_text(self) -> str:
        source = self.main.config.download_source
        if source == "bmclapi":
            return "BMCLAPI 镜像"
        if source == "auto":
            return "智能加速"
        return "Mojang 官方"

    def _update_source_badge(self) -> None:
        source = self.main.config.download_source
        self.source_badge.setText(self._source_text())
        self.source_badge.setProperty(
            "badge", "purple" if source == "bmclapi" else ("green" if source == "auto" else "blue")
        )
        repolish(self.source_badge)

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self._update_source_badge()
        self._update_cancel_button()
        if not self._manifest and not self._loading:
            self.load_manifest()
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._ensure_selected_visible)

    def _ensure_selected_visible(self) -> None:
        row = self._rows.get(self._selected)
        if row:
            self.list_scroll.ensureWidgetVisible(row, 0, 8)

    def load_manifest(self, force: bool = False) -> None:
        if self._loading:
            return
        self._loading = True
        self.list_status.setText("正在获取版本清单…")
        self.list_status.setVisible(True)
        self.search.setEnabled(False)
        self.filters.setEnabled(False)
        self._worker = ManifestWorker(self.main.config.download_source, force)
        self._worker.ready.connect(self._manifest_ready)
        self._worker.start()

    def _manifest_ready(self, data, error: str) -> None:
        self._loading = False
        self.search.setEnabled(True)
        self.filters.setEnabled(True)
        if not data:
            self.list_status.setText(f"获取版本清单失败：{error}")
            self.list_status.setVisible(True)
            retry = self.load_more
            retry.setVisible(True)
            retry.setText("重试")
            try:
                retry.clicked.disconnect()
            except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
                pass
            retry.clicked.connect(lambda: self.load_manifest(force=True))
            return

        self._manifest = data
        raw = data.get("versions") or []
        self._entries = [v for v in raw if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("id")]
        self._limit = 70
        self._apply_filter()
        latest = data.get("latest") or {}
        preferred = latest.get("release") or (self._entries[0]["id"] if self._entries else "")
        if self.main.selected_version in {e.get("id") for e in self._entries}:
            preferred = self.main.selected_version
        if preferred:
            self.select_version(str(preferred), scroll=False)

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self._update_source_badge()
        if self._manifest:
            self._apply_filter()
            if self._selected:
                entry = next(
                    (e for e in self._entries if str(e.get("id")) == self._selected),
                    None,
                )
                if entry and not self.main.install_active:
                    self._update_detail(entry)
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self._ensure_selected_visible)

    def _on_search(self, _text: str) -> None:
        self._limit = 70
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_filter(self, value: str) -> None:
        self._filter = value
        self._limit = 70
        self._apply_filter()

    def _filtered(self) -> list[dict]:
        query = self.search.text().strip().lower()
        result = []
        for entry in self._entries:
            vtype = str(entry.get("type", ""))
            if self._filter == "release" and vtype != "release":
                continue
            if self._filter == "snapshot" and vtype != "snapshot":
                continue
            if query and query not in str(entry.get("id", "")).lower():
                continue
            result.append(entry)
        return result

    def _apply_filter(self) -> None:
        filtered = self._filtered()
        self.count_label.setText(f"{len(filtered)} 个")
        while self.list_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.list_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.deleteLater()
        self._rows.clear()

        if not filtered:
            self.list_status.setText("没有匹配的版本")
            self.list_status.setVisible(True)
            self.load_more.setVisible(False)
            return

        self.list_status.setVisible(False)
        installed = {v.id for v in self.main.versions}
        for entry in filtered[: self._limit]:
            row = DownloadVersionRow(entry, str(entry.get("id")) in installed)
            row.clicked.connect(self.select_version)
            row.set_selected(str(entry.get("id")) == self._selected)
            self._rows[str(entry.get("id"))] = row
            self.list_layout.insertWidget(self.list_layout.count() - 1, row)

        self.load_more.setText("加载更多版本")
        self.load_more.setVisible(len(filtered) > self._limit)
        try:
            self.load_more.clicked.disconnect()
        except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
            pass
        self.load_more.clicked.connect(self._more)

    def _more(self) -> None:
        self._limit += 90
        self._apply_filter()

    def select_version(self, version_id: str, scroll: bool = True) -> None:
        entry = next(
            (e for e in self._entries if str(e.get("id")) == version_id), None
        )
        if not entry:
            return
        self._selected = version_id
        for vid, row in self._rows.items():
            row.set_selected(vid == version_id)
        self._update_detail(entry)
        if scroll:
            row = self._rows.get(version_id)
            if row:
                self.list_scroll.ensureWidgetVisible(row)

    def _update_detail(self, entry: dict) -> None:
        self.empty.setVisible(False)
        self.detail.setVisible(True)
        version_id = str(entry.get("id", ""))
        vtype = str(entry.get("type", "release"))
        type_label = TYPE_LABELS.get(vtype, vtype)
        self.detail_title.setText(version_id)
        self.detail_badge.setText(type_label)
        self.detail_badge.setProperty(
            "badge", "green" if vtype == "release" else ("orange" if vtype == "snapshot" else "gray")
        )
        repolish(self.detail_badge)

        latest = (self._manifest or {}).get("latest") or {}
        tags = []
        if latest.get("release") == version_id:
            tags.append("最新正式版")
        if latest.get("snapshot") == version_id:
            tags.append("最新快照")
        sub = " · ".join(tags + [f"Minecraft Java Edition {type_label}"])
        self.detail_sub.setText(sub)

        self.info_type.setText(type_label)
        self.info_date.setText(_date_text(str(entry.get("releaseTime", ""))))
        self.info_source.setText(self._source_text())

        installed_ids = {v.id for v in self.main.versions}
        installed = version_id in installed_ids
        self.install_state.setText("已安装" if installed else "未安装")
        self.install_state.setProperty("badge", "green" if installed else "gray")
        repolish(self.install_state)
        self.install_btn.setText("补全 / 校验文件" if installed else "安装此版本")
        self.install_btn.setEnabled(not self.main.install_active)
        self._update_cancel_button()
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.log.clear()

    def _install_selected(self) -> None:
        if not self._selected:
            return
        if self.main.install_active:
            self.main.toast("已有安装任务正在进行", "info")
            return
        entry = next(
            (e for e in self._entries if str(e.get("id")) == self._selected), None
        )
        if not entry:
            return
        installed = self._selected in {v.id for v in self.main.versions}
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText("准备安装…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.log.clear()
        self.main.begin_install(
            str(entry.get("id")),
            version_url=str(entry.get("url", "")),
            verify=installed,
        )

    def _on_install_started(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if version_id == self._selected:
            self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
            self.progress.setValue(0)
            self.progress_text.setText("准备安装…")
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self._update_cancel_button()

    def _update_cancel_button(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "cancel_btn"):
            return
        installed = self.main.install_active
        self.cancel_btn.setVisible(bool(installed))
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(bool(installed) and not self.main._install_cancelling)
        self.cancel_btn.setText(
            "正在取消…" if installed and self.main._install_cancelling else "取消安装"
        )

    def _cancel_install(self) -> None:
        self.main.cancel_install()
        self.cancel_btn.setText("正在取消…")
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)

    def _on_install_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(percent)
        self.progress_text.setText(message)
        worker = self.main.install_worker
        if worker and worker.installer:
            self.speed_text.setText(worker.installer.speed_text)

    def _on_task_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        if self.progress_box.isVisible():
            self.log.appendPlainText(line)
            bar = self.log.verticalScrollBar()
            bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _on_install_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, version_id: str) -> None:
        self._update_cancel_button()
        if version_id == self._selected:
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(True)
            if success:
                self.progress.setValue(100)
                self.progress_text.setText("安装完成")
                self.speed_text.setText("")
            else:
                self.progress_text.setText(message)
                self.speed_text.setText("")
            self.install_btn.setText("补全 / 校验文件")

    def _on_local_versions_changed(self) -> None:
        if not self._manifest:
            return
        self._apply_filter()
        if self._selected:
            entry = next(
                (e for e in self._entries if str(e.get("id")) == self._selected), None
            )
            if entry:
                installed = self._selected in {v.id for v in self.main.versions}
                self.install_state.setText("已安装" if installed else "未安装")
                self.install_state.setProperty(
                    "badge", "green" if installed else "gray"
                )
                repolish(self.install_state)
                self.install_btn.setText(
                    "补全 / 校验文件" if installed else "安装此版本"
                )

        self.account_badge = badge("离线模式", "gray")
        header.addWidget(self.account_badge)
        layout.addLayout(header)

        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(11)
        self.avatar = Avatar(48)
        row.addWidget(self.avatar)

        info = QVBoxLayout()
        info.setSpacing(2)
        self.account_name = QLabel("Steve")
        self.account_name.setStyleSheet("font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;")
        self.account_uuid = QLabel("")
        self.account_uuid.setObjectName("Tiny")
        info.addWidget(self.account_name)
        info.addWidget(self.account_uuid)
        row.addLayout(info, 1)

        self.account_btn = icon_button("edit", "修改玩家名称")
        self.account_btn.clicked.connect(self.edit_account)
        row.addWidget(self.account_btn)
        layout.addLayout(row)

        self.account_note = QLabel(
            "离线账户仅用于本地游戏，无法加入正版验证服务器。"
        )
        self.account_note.setObjectName("Tiny")
        self.account_note.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.account_note)
        return card

    def _build_quick_card(self) -> QWidget:
        card = Card()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
        layout.setContentsMargins(18, 15, 18, 15)
        layout.setSpacing(9)
        title = QLabel("猫爪快捷方式")
        title.setObjectName("H2")
        layout.addWidget(title)

        grid = QHBoxLayout()
        grid.setSpacing(8)
        col1 = QVBoxLayout()
        col1.setSpacing(8)
        col2 = QVBoxLayout()
        col2.setSpacing(8)

        actions = [
            ("folder", "游戏目录", "打开游戏文件夹", "#E23A5E", self.main.open_game_dir),
            ("package", "导入本地文件", "版本与 Mod", "#E8683F", self.main.open_local_import),
            ("migrate", "版本迁移", "搬走存档与 Mod", "#3FB3AA", lambda: self.main.open_migration_dialog(self._selected)),
            ("users", "好友与联机", "邀请卡直达房间", "#3FB3AA", self.main.open_social_dialog),
            ("cube", "模组管理", "管理已装 Mod", "#B15BE0", lambda: self.main.switch_page("mods")),
            ("download", "补全文件", "修复缺失依赖", "#C98A4B", self.main.complete_selected),
        ]
        for index, (icon_name, title_text, sub, accent, callback) in enumerate(actions):
            action = QuickAction(icon_name, title_text, sub, accent)
            action.clicked.connect(callback)
            (col1 if index % 2 == 0 else col2).addWidget(action)

        grid.addLayout(col1, 1)
        grid.addLayout(col2, 1)
        layout.addLayout(grid, 1)
        return card

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def refresh_versions(self) -> None:
        versions: list[VersionSummary] = list(self.main.game_version_summaries())
        self._game_versions = versions

        had_selection = self._selected
        if versions:
            valid_ids = {v.id for v in versions}
            target = had_selection if had_selection in valid_ids else ""
            if not target and self.main.config.last_version in valid_ids:
                target = self.main.config.last_version
            if not target:
                target = versions[0].id
            self._selected = target
            self.main.selected_version = target
            self.main.config.last_version = target
            self.main.config.save()
        else:
            self._selected = ""
            self.main.selected_version = ""
            self.main.selection_changed.emit("")
            self.hero_sub.setText("还没有版本可玩，先去游戏版本仓库叼一个回来吧。")
            self.hero_status.setText("● 猫窝是空的")
            self.hero_status.setStyleSheet(
                "color: rgba(255,220,180,220); background: rgba(255,255,255,26);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
            self.launch_btn.setEnabled(False)

        self._render_current_view()
        if self._selected and self._view == "loaders":
            self._update_hero()

    def _on_view_changed(self, value: str) -> None:
        self._view = value if value in ("games", "loaders") else "games"
        self._render_current_view()

    def _render_current_view(self) -> None:
        while self.version_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.version_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.deleteLater()
        self._version_rows.clear()
        if self._view == "loaders":
            self._render_loaders()
        else:
            self._render_games()

    def _render_games(self) -> None:
        versions = self._game_versions
        self.version_count.setText(f"{len(versions)} 个版本")
        self.import_btn.setVisible(True)
        self.loader_install_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.tip_label.setText(
            "双击启动 · 齿轮选择原版/加载器 · 交换箭头迁移存档/Mod · "
            "纸箱按钮打包 · 垃圾桶删除版本 · 文件可以直接拖进窗口"
        )
        if not versions:
            self._show_empty(
                "还没有可以住的猫窝",
                "前往“游戏版本”页面安装原版游戏，或导入版本 ZIP / 版本文件夹 / "
                "整合包，也可以直接把文件拖进窗口。",
                mode="games",
            )
            return

        self.empty_box.setVisible(False)
        self.version_scroll.setVisible(True)
        target = self._selected
        for summary in versions:
            profile = self.main.loader_profile_for(summary.id)
            bound_loader = ""
            if profile:
                bound_loader = profile.loader or profile.id
            row = VersionRow(
                summary,
                selected=(summary.id == target),
                bound_loader=bound_loader,
            )
            row.clicked.connect(self.select_version)
            row.double_clicked.connect(self._launch_version)
            row.delete_requested.connect(self.main.delete_version)
            row.export_requested.connect(self.main.export_version)
            row.migrate_requested.connect(
                lambda version_id: self.main.open_migration_dialog(version_id)
            )
            row.settings_requested.connect(self.main.open_version_settings)
            self._version_rows[summary.id] = row
            self.version_layout.insertWidget(self.version_layout.count() - 1, row)
        if target:
            self._update_hero()

    def _render_loaders(self) -> None:
        profiles = list(self.main.loader_profiles())
        self.version_count.setText(f"{len(profiles)} 个加载器")
        self.import_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.loader_install_btn.setVisible(True)
        self.tip_label.setText(
            "加载器住在独立的配置目录里。点一下加载器就能进入加载器工坊，"
            "勾选要让哪些游戏版本使用它；游戏版本本身仍然保持原版，可随时切回。"
        )
        if not profiles:
            self._show_empty(
                "还没有加载器配置",
                "先安装一个 Fabric、Forge 或 NeoForge，再去加载器工坊分配游戏版本。"
                "加载器和原版版本分开管理，不会把客户端文件混在一起。",
                mode="loaders",
            )
            return

        self.empty_box.setVisible(False)
        self.version_scroll.setVisible(True)
        for profile in profiles:
            bound = sum(
                1
                for game in self.main.compatible_game_versions(profile.id)
                if self.main.config.loader_for(game.id) == profile.id
            )
            row = LoaderOverviewRow(profile, bound)
            row.clicked.connect(lambda _profile_id: self.main.switch_page("loaders"))
            self.version_layout.insertWidget(self.version_layout.count() - 1, row)

        hint = QFrame()
        hint.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        hint.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        hint_layout = QHBoxLayout(hint)
        hint_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 8, 12, 8)
        hint_layout.setSpacing(8)
        text = QLabel("加载器只负责启动方式，Mod、存档、材质和光影仍然住在游戏版本自己的目录里。")
        text.setObjectName("Tiny")
        text.setWordWrap(True)
        hint_layout.addWidget(text, 1)
        manage = QPushButton("打开加载器工坊")
        manage.setObjectName("Soft")
        manage.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        manage.clicked.connect(lambda: self.main.switch_page("loaders"))
        hint_layout.addWidget(manage)
        self.version_layout.insertWidget(self.version_layout.count() - 1, hint)

    def _show_empty(self, title: str, subtitle: str, mode: str) -> None:
        self.empty_title.setText(title)
        self.empty_sub.setText(subtitle)
        self.empty_download_btn.setVisible(mode == "games")
        self.empty_import_btn.setVisible(mode == "games")
        self.empty_loader_btn.setVisible(mode == "loaders")
        self.empty_box.setVisible(True)
        self.version_scroll.setVisible(False)

    def _launch_version(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if version_id != self._selected:
            self.select_version(version_id)
        self.main.launch_selected()

    def select_version(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if version_id == self._selected:
            return
        self._selected = version_id
        self.main.selected_version = version_id
        self.main.config.last_version = version_id
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.selection_changed.emit(version_id)
        for vid, row in self._version_rows.items():
            row.setProperty("selected", "true" if vid == version_id else "false")
            row.style().unpolish(row)
            row.style().polish(row)
            row.update()
        self._update_hero()

    def _update_hero(self) -> None:
        summary = next((v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == self._selected), None)
        if not summary:
            return
        self.main.config.last_version = self._selected
        profile = self.main.loader_profile_for(summary.id)
        loader_name = profile.loader if profile else summary.loader
        display_type = loader_name or summary.type_name
        suffix = "（绑定加载器）" if profile else ""
        java_text = f" · Java {summary.java_major}+" if summary.java_major else ""
        self.hero_sub.setText(
            f"Minecraft {summary.id} · {display_type}{suffix}{java_text}"
        )
        self.hero_title.setText(
            f"今天也要去捣乱吗，{self.main.display_name()}？"
        )
        self._refresh_status()

    def _refresh_status(self) -> None:
        if not self._selected:
            return
        profile_id, _instance_id = self.main.launch_profile(self._selected)
        try:
            resolved = resolve_version(self.main.config.game_path, profile_id)
            missing = check_installation(
                self.main.config.game_path, resolved, check_assets=False
            )
        except Exception:
            missing = ["版本文件异常"]

        self._refresh_launch_button()
        if self._closing:
            self.hero_status.setText("● 正在把猫猫拖回来…")
            style = (
                "color: #FFD9D9; background: rgba(255,110,110,45);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        elif self.main.launch_active:
            self.hero_status.setText("● 正在磨爪子…")
            style = (
                "color: #D8E6FF; background: rgba(120,170,255,50);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        elif self.main.game_running:
            self.hero_status.setText("● 在游戏里捣乱中")
            style = (
                "color: #C9F7D8; background: rgba(80,220,140,55);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        elif missing:
            self.hero_status.setText(f"● 还差 {len(missing)} 块拼图")
            style = (
                "color: #FFE1B8; background: rgba(255,190,90,45);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        else:
            self.hero_status.setText("● 猫爪已就绪")
            style = (
                "color: #C9F7D8; background: rgba(80,220,140,45);"
                "border-radius: 9px; padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
            )
        self.hero_status.setStyleSheet(style)

        account = self.main.current_account()
        self.hero_title.setText(
            f"今天也要去捣乱吗，{self.main.display_name()}？"
        )
        self.avatar.refresh()
        self.account_name.setText(self.main.display_name())
        if account.is_msa:
            uid = account.uuid
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"正版 · UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}" if uid else "正版账户"
            )
            self.account_badge.setText("微软正版")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.account_note.setText(
                "已通过 Microsoft 正版验证，可以进入正版验证服务器。"
            )
            self.account_btn.setToolTip("管理正版账户")
        else:
            uid = offline_uuid(self.main.config.player_name)
            self.account_uuid.setText(f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}")
            self.account_badge.setText("离线模式")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            self.account_note.setText(
                "离线账户仅用于本地游戏，无法加入正版验证服务器。"
            )
            self.account_btn.setToolTip("修改玩家名称")
        repolish(self.account_badge)

    def edit_account(self) -> None:
        if self.main.current_account().is_msa:
            self.main.switch_page("settings")
            return
        dialog = TextInputDialog(
            self.main,
            "修改玩家名称",
            "离线模式使用的游戏内名称。",
            self.main.config.player_name,
        )
        if dialog.exec():
            self.main.config.player_name = dialog.value()
            self.main.config.save()
            self.main.account_changed.emit()
            self._update_hero()
            self.main.toast("玩家名称已更新", "success")

    def _on_launch_click(self) -> None:
        if self.main.launch_active:
            self.main.cancel_launch()
        elif self.main.game_running:
            self.main.close_game()
        else:
            self.main.launch_selected()

    def _refresh_launch_button(self) -> None:
        if self._closing:
            text, icon_name, color, obj = "正在关闭…", "stop", colors()["red"], "Danger"
            enabled = False
        elif self.main.launch_active:
            text, icon_name, color, obj = "取消启动", "stop", colors()["red"], "Danger"
            enabled = True
        elif self.main.game_running:
            text, icon_name, color, obj = "关闭游戏", "stop", colors()["red"], "Danger"
            enabled = True
        else:
            text, icon_name, color, obj = "启动游戏", "play", "#3A0F1C", "Launch"
            enabled = bool(self._selected) and not self.main.install_active
        self.launch_btn.setObjectName(obj)
        self.launch_btn.setText(text)
        self.launch_btn.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.launch_btn.setIcon(icons.icon(icon_name, color, 19))
        repolish(self.launch_btn)

    def set_launching(self, launching: bool) -> None:
        if launching:
            self._closing = False
        self._refresh_status()

    def set_game_closing(self) -> None:
        self._closing = True
        self._refresh_status()

    def set_game_running(self, running: bool) -> None:
        if not running:
            self._closing = False
        self._refresh_status()

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QCheckBox,
    QFrame,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QPushButton,
    QScrollArea,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from ...versions import LOADER_COLORS
from .. import icons
from ..widgets import (
    Card,
    ChibiCompanion,
    badge,
    colors,
    icon_button,
    repolish,
    transparent_children,
)


class GameBindingRow(QFrame):
    def __init__(
        self,
        game_id: str,
        game_type: str,
        checked: bool,
        current_loader: str,
        parent=None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setObjectName("SelectRow")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.setMinimumHeight(38)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 5, 10, 5)
        layout.setSpacing(8)

        self.check = QCheckBox(game_id)
        self.check.setChecked(checked)
        self.check.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        layout.addWidget(self.check, 1)

        type_badge = badge(game_type or "正式版", "gray")
        layout.addWidget(type_badge)

        if current_loader and not checked:
            layout.addWidget(badge(f"当前 {current_loader}", "orange"))
        elif checked:
            layout.addWidget(badge("使用中", "green"))
        transparent_children(self)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        # 整行可点，避免只有小方框能勾选。
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.check.toggle()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)


class LoaderCard(Card):
    def __init__(self, main, profile, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.main = main
        self.profile = profile
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(17, 14, 17, 14)
        layout.setSpacing(9)

        loader_name = profile.loader or "加载器"
        accent = LOADER_COLORS.get(loader_name, colors()["accent"])

        head = QHBoxLayout()
        head.setSpacing(9)
        mark = QLabel()
        mark.setFixedSize(34, 34)
        mark.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        mark.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("package", accent, 21))
        head.addWidget(mark)

        titles = QVBoxLayout()
        titles.setSpacing(2)
        title_row = QHBoxLayout()
        title_row.setSpacing(6)
        title = QLabel(profile.id)
        title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px;")
        title_row.addWidget(title)
        title_row.addWidget(badge(loader_name, "purple"))
        if profile.loader_version:
            title_row.addWidget(badge(f"v{profile.loader_version}", "blue"))
        title_row.addStretch(1)
        titles.addLayout(title_row)
        meta_bits = [f"基础版本 {profile.base_id or '未知'}"]
        if profile.release_time:
            meta_bits.append(profile.release_time[:10])
        if profile.java_major:
            meta_bits.append(f"Java {profile.java_major}+")
        meta = QLabel(" · ".join(meta_bits))
        meta.setObjectName("Tiny")
        titles.addWidget(meta)
        head.addLayout(titles, 1)

        folder_btn = icon_button("folder", "打开加载器配置目录", colors()["muted"], 28, 15)
        folder_btn.clicked.connect(
            lambda _=False: self.main.open_path(Path(profile.json_path).parent)
        )
        head.addWidget(folder_btn)
        delete_btn = icon_button(
            "trash", "删除这个加载器配置", colors()["muted"], 28, 15
        )
        delete_btn.clicked.connect(
            lambda _=False: self.main.delete_version(profile.id)
        )
        head.addWidget(delete_btn)
        layout.addLayout(head)

        hint = QLabel(
            "勾选要使用这个加载器的游戏版本。每个游戏版本只能绑定一个加载器，"
            "存档、Mod、材质和光影始终留在游戏版本自己的目录里。"
        )
        hint.setObjectName("Tiny")
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        games = self.main.compatible_game_versions(profile.id)
        if not games:
            empty = QLabel(
                "没有可分配的原版游戏版本。需要先安装基础版本 "
                f"{profile.base_id or '对应原版'}，或它已被其他加载器占用。"
            )
            empty.setObjectName("Muted")
            empty.setWordWrap(True)
            layout.addWidget(empty)
            return

        tools = QHBoxLayout()
        tools.setSpacing(6)
        tools.addStretch(1)
        all_btn = QPushButton("全部使用")
        all_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
        all_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        all_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._assign_all(games, True))
        none_btn = QPushButton("全部取消")
        none_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
        none_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        none_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._assign_all(games, False))
        tools.addWidget(all_btn)
        tools.addWidget(none_btn)
        layout.addLayout(tools)

        holder = QVBoxLayout()
        holder.setSpacing(3)
        for game in games:
            binding = self.main.config.loader_for(game.id)
            checked = binding == profile.id
            current = ""
            if binding and not checked:
                other = next(
                    (v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == binding), None
                )
                current = (other.loader if other and other.loader else binding)
            row = GameBindingRow(
                game.id,
                game.type_name,
                checked,
                current,
            )
            row.check.toggled.connect(
                lambda value, gid=game.id, pid=profile.id: self._assign(
                    gid, pid, value
                )
            )
            holder.addWidget(row)
        layout.addLayout(holder)

    def _assign(self, game_id: str, profile_id: str, enabled: bool) -> None:
        if enabled:
            self.main.bind_loader(game_id, profile_id)
        elif self.main.config.loader_for(game_id) == profile_id:
            self.main.bind_loader(game_id, "")
        self.main.toast(
            "已更新加载器分配" if enabled else "该版本已切回原版启动",
            "success",
        )

    def _assign_all(self, games, enabled: bool) -> None:
        for game in games:
            if enabled:
                self.main.config.bind_loader(game.id, self.profile.id)
            elif self.main.config.loader_for(game.id) == self.profile.id:
                self.main.config.bind_loader(game.id, "")
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.versions_changed.emit()
        self.main.selection_changed.emit(self.main.selected_version)
        self.main.toast(
            "已批量分配加载器" if enabled else "已批量切回原版启动",
            "success",
        )


class LoaderPage(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, main, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.main = main
        self._build()
        self.main.versions_changed.connect(self.refresh)
        self.refresh()

    def _build(self) -> None:
        outer = QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer.setContentsMargins(22, 18, 22, 18)
        outer.setSpacing(14)

        header = QHBoxLayout()
        titles = QVBoxLayout()
        titles.setSpacing(2)
        title = QLabel("猫猫的加载器工坊")
        title.setObjectName("PageTitle")
        sub = QLabel(
            "加载器住在这里，游戏版本住在猫窝。装好 Fabric、Forge 或 NeoForge 后，"
            "在下面勾选要让哪些游戏版本使用它；也可以随时切回原版启动。"
        )
        sub.setObjectName("Muted")
        sub.setWordWrap(True)
        titles.addWidget(title)
        titles.addWidget(sub)
        header.addLayout(titles, 1)
        header.addWidget(ChibiCompanion(60, "mods"), 0, Qt.AlignTop)
        self.install_btn = QPushButton("安装加载器")
        self.install_btn.setObjectName("Primary")
        self.install_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.install_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("download", "#FFFFFF", 16))
        self.install_btn.clicked.connect(self.main.open_loader_dialog)
        header.addWidget(self.install_btn)
        outer.addLayout(header)

        self.summary_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.summary_row.setSpacing(8)
        self.loader_count = badge("0 个加载器", "blue")
        self.binding_count = badge("0 个版本已绑定", "green")
        self.summary_row.addWidget(self.loader_count)
        self.summary_row.addWidget(self.binding_count)
        self.summary_row.addStretch(1)
        outer.addLayout(self.summary_row)

        self.scroll = QScrollArea()
        self.scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self.scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.holder = QWidget()
        self.card_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.holder)
        self.card_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 4, 0)
        self.card_layout.setSpacing(10)
        self.card_layout.addStretch(1)
        self.scroll.setWidget(self.holder)
        outer.addWidget(self.scroll, 1)

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self.refresh()

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self.refresh()

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        profiles = self.main.loader_profiles()
        games = self.main.game_version_summaries()
        bound = sum(
            1
            for game in games
            if not game.loader and self.main.loader_profile_for(game.id)
        )
        self.loader_count.setText(f"{len(profiles)} 个加载器")
        self.binding_count.setText(f"{bound} 个版本已绑定")
        self.install_btn.setEnabled(not self.main.install_active)

        while self.card_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.card_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.deleteLater()

        if not profiles:
            self._add_empty_state()
            return

        bound_any = set()
        for profile in profiles:
            card = LoaderCard(self.main, profile)
            self.card_layout.insertWidget(self.card_layout.count() - 1, card)
            for game in self.main.compatible_game_versions(profile.id):
                if self.main.config.loader_for(game.id) == profile.id:
                    bound_any.add(game.id)

        plain_games = [game for game in games if not game.loader]
        idle_games = [game for game in plain_games if game.id not in bound_any]
        if idle_games:
            card = Card()
            layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
            layout.setContentsMargins(17, 13, 17, 13)
            layout.setSpacing(7)
            head = QHBoxLayout()
            title = QLabel("原版启动的游戏版本")
            title.setObjectName("H2")
            head.addWidget(title)
            head.addStretch(1)
            open_btn = QPushButton("版本设置")
            open_btn.setObjectName("Ghost")
            open_btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
            open_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("settings", colors()["muted"], 15))
            open_btn.clicked.connect(
                lambda: self.main.open_version_settings(
                    idle_games[0].id if idle_games else ""
                )
            )
            head.addWidget(open_btn)
            layout.addLayout(head)
            names = QLabel("、".join(game.id for game in idle_games))
            names.setObjectName("Muted")
            names.setWordWrap(True)
            layout.addWidget(names)
            tip = QLabel("这些版本不加载任何 Mod 加载器；可以在版本行的齿轮里随时绑定加载器。")
            tip.setObjectName("Tiny")
            tip.setWordWrap(True)
            layout.addWidget(tip)
            self.card_layout.insertWidget(self.card_layout.count() - 1, card)

    def _add_empty_state(self) -> None:
        card = Card()
        layout = QVBoxLayout(card)
        layout.setContentsMargins(24, 24, 24, 24)
        layout.setSpacing(10)
        icon_label = QLabel()
        icon_label.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("package", colors()["muted"], 54))
        icon_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        title = QLabel("还没有加载器配置")
        title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        title.setStyleSheet("font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;")
        sub = QLabel(
            "先到“下载”页面安装原版游戏，再在这里添加 Fabric、Forge 或 NeoForge。"
            "加载器和游戏版本分开管理，同一个加载器可以分配给多个游戏版本。"
        )
        sub.setObjectName("Muted")
        sub.setWordWrap(True)
        sub.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        btn = QPushButton("安装第一个加载器")
        btn.setObjectName("Primary")
        btn.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        btn.setIcon(icons.icon("download", "#FFFFFF", 16))
        btn.clicked.connect(self.main.open_loader_dialog)
        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_row.addStretch(1)
        btn_row.addWidget(btn)
        btn_row.addStretch(1)
        layout.addWidget(icon_label)
        layout.addWidget(title)
        layout.addWidget(sub)
        layout.addLayout(btn_row)
        self.card_layout.insertWidget(self.card_layout.count() - 1, card)

class _ElidedLabel(QLabel):
    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._full_text = ""
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Preferred)
        self.setText(text)

    def setText(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._full_text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        self._refresh()

    def full_text(self) -> str:
        return self._full_text

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._refresh()

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        width = self.contentsRect().width()
        if width <= 0:
            QLabel.setText(self, self._full_text)
            return
        elided = self.fontMetrics().elidedText(
            self._full_text, Qt.ElideRight, width
        )
        if QLabel.text(self) != elided:
            QLabel.setText(self, elided)


def _icon_pixmap(data: bytes, size: int = 38, radius: int = 9) -> QPixmap:
    image = QImage()
    if data:
        image.loadFromData(data)
    canvas = QImage(size, size, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    canvas.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(canvas)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)
    path = QPainterPath()
    path.addRoundedRect(0.5, 0.5, size - 1, size - 1, radius, radius)
    painter.setClipPath(path)
    if not image.isNull():
        scaled = image.scaled(
            size,
            size,
            Qt.KeepAspectRatioByExpanding,
            Qt.SmoothTransformation,
        )
        painter.drawImage(
            (size - scaled.width()) // 2, (size - scaled.height()) // 2, scaled
        )
    painter.end()
    return QPixmap.fromImage(canvas)


class ModRow(QFrame):
    toggled = Signal(object, bool)
    delete_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, mod: ModInfo, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.mod = mod
        self.setObjectName("SelectRow")
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        self.setFixedHeight(82)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(13, 7, 13, 7)
        layout.setSpacing(11)

        icon_box = QLabel()
        icon_box.setFixedSize(40, 40)
        icon_box.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
        pixmap = _icon_pixmap(mod.icon_bytes, 40, 10)
        if pixmap.isNull() or not mod.icon_bytes:
            icon_box.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("cube", colors()["purple"], 22))
            icon_box.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['purple_soft']}; border-radius: 9px;"
            )
        else:
            icon_box.setPixmap(pixmap)
            icon_box.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")
        self.icon_box = icon_box

        info = QVBoxLayout()
        info.setSpacing(2)
        top = QHBoxLayout()
        top.setSpacing(6)
        name = QLabel(mod.name)
        name.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        name.setToolTip(mod.name)
        top.addWidget(name)
        if mod.version:
            version = QLabel(mod.version)
            version.setObjectName("Tiny")
            version.setToolTip(mod.version)
            top.addWidget(version)
        if mod.loader:
            top.addWidget(
                badge(
                    mod.loader,
                    "purple" if mod.loader == "Fabric" else "orange",
                )
            )
        if not mod.enabled:
            top.addWidget(badge("已禁用", "gray"))
        top.addStretch(1)
        info.addLayout(top)

        intro = _ElidedLabel(mod.intro)
        intro.setObjectName("Tiny")
        tip = mod.intro
        if mod.description and mod.description != mod.intro:
            tip += "\n\n原版简介：" + mod.description
        if mod.project_url:
            tip += "\n项目地址：" + mod.project_url
        intro.setToolTip(tip)
        self.intro_label = intro
        info.addWidget(intro)

        meta = _ElidedLabel(f"{mod.filename} · {mod.size_text}")
        meta.setObjectName("Tiny")
        meta.setToolTip(f"{mod.filename} · {mod.size_text}")
        info.addWidget(meta)

        switch = Switch()
        switch.setChecked(mod.enabled)
        switch.setToolTip("启用或禁用此 Mod")
        switch.toggled.connect(lambda checked: self.toggled.emit(self.mod, checked))

        delete_btn = icon_button("trash", "删除此 Mod", colors()["muted"], 30, 15)
        delete_btn.clicked.connect(lambda _=False: self.delete_requested.emit(self.mod))

        layout.addWidget(icon_box)
        layout.addLayout(info, 1)
        layout.addWidget(switch)
        layout.addWidget(delete_btn)
        transparent_children(self)
        switch.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, False)
        delete_btn.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _mods_dir(self) -> Path:
        return self.main.config.mods_path(self.main.selected_version)

    def _update_version_label(self) -> None:
        version = self.main.selected_version or "未选择版本"
        isolated = bool(
            self.main.selected_version and self.main.config.version_isolation
        )
        profile = (
            self.main.loader_profile_for(self.main.selected_version)
            if self.main.selected_version
            else None
        )
        summary = next(
            (v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == self.main.selected_version),
            None,
        )
        loader_name = profile.loader if profile else (
            summary.loader if summary else ""
        )
        loader_note = f" · {loader_name}" if loader_name else " · 原版"
        self.version_label.setText(
            f"当前版本：{version}{loader_note} · "
            f"{'独立目录' if isolated else '公共目录'}"
        )
        if self.main.selected_version:
            self.empty_title.setText(f"{self.main.selected_version} 的 mods 文件夹是空的")
        else:
            self.empty_title.setText("抽屉里还没有 Mod")
        self.sub.setText(
            "Mod 按游戏版本隔离存放在 versions/<版本>/mods。"
            if self.main.config.version_isolation
            else "版本隔离已关闭，所有版本共用游戏目录下的 mods 文件夹。"
        )

    def _on_selection_changed(self, _version_id: str = "") -> None:
        self._update_version_label()
        self.refresh_mods()

    def _on_filter(self, value: str) -> None:
        self._filter = value
        self.refresh_mods()

    def refresh_mods(self) -> None:
        self._mods = list_mods(self._mods_dir())
        query = self.search.text().strip().lower()
        visible = []
        for mod in self._mods:
            if self._filter == "enabled" and not mod.enabled:
                continue
            if self._filter == "disabled" and mod.enabled:
                continue
            if (
                query
                and query not in mod.name.lower()
                and query not in mod.filename.lower()
                and query not in mod.intro.lower()
            ):
                continue
            visible.append(mod)

        self.count_label.setText(f"{len(visible)} / {len(self._mods)}")
        while self.list_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.list_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.deleteLater()

        if not self._mods:
            self.empty.setVisible(True)
            self.scroll.setVisible(False)
            return
        self.empty.setVisible(False)
        self.scroll.setVisible(True)

        if not visible:
            hint = QLabel("没有匹配的 Mod")
            hint.setObjectName("Muted")
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.list_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
            return

        for mod in visible:
            row = ModRow(mod)
            row.toggled.connect(self._toggle_mod)
            row.delete_requested.connect(self._delete_mod)
            self.list_layout.insertWidget(self.list_layout.count() - 1, row)

    def _delete_mod(self, mod: ModInfo) -> None:
        if self._delete_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast("已有删除任务正在进行", "info")
            return
        if (
            self.main.game_running
            and self.main._running_version == self.main.selected_version
        ):
            self.main.toast("游戏正在运行，请先关闭游戏再删除 Mod", "error")
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "删除 Mod",
            f"确定删除 {mod.name} 吗？文件会移入系统回收站，可在回收站恢复。",
            primary_text="移入回收站",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="trash",
            icon_color=colors()["red"],
            details=f"文件：{mod.filename}\n位置：{mod.path.parent}",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self.main.set_status(f"正在删除 {mod.filename}…", "busy")
        worker = DeleteWorker(mod.path, self)
        self._delete_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(
            lambda ok, message, m=mod: self._on_mod_deleted(m, ok, message)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _on_mod_deleted(self, mod: ModInfo, success: bool, message: str) -> None:
        self._delete_worker = None
        if not success:
            self.main.set_status(f"删除失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"删除失败：{message}", "error")
            return
        self.main.set_status(f"已删除 {mod.filename}", "success")
        self.main.toast(f"{mod.name} 已移入回收站", "success")
        forget_mod_meta(mod.path.parent, mod.filename)
        self.refresh_mods()

    def _toggle_mod(self, mod: ModInfo, enabled: bool) -> None:
        if enabled == mod.enabled:
            return
        try:
            new_path = toggle_mod(mod)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"修改失败：{exc}", "error")
            self.refresh_mods()
            return
        action = "已启用" if new_path.name.endswith(".jar") else "已禁用"
        self.main.toast(f"{action} {mod.name}", "success")
        self.refresh_mods()

    def open_folder(self) -> None:
        mods_dir = self._mods_dir()
        try:
            mods_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建 mods 文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(mods_dir)

    def add_mods(self) -> None:
        files, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileNames(
            self,
            "选择要导入的本地内容",
            str(self._mods_dir()),
            (
                "Mod / 材质 / 光影 (*.jar *.litemod *.zip "
                "*.jar.disabled *.litemod.disabled);;所有文件 (*)"
            ),
        )
        if not files:
            return
        self.main.open_local_import([Path(item) for item in files])

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self._update_version_label()
        self.refresh_mods()  # 版本或隔离设置可能在其他页面变化
