        warning_box = QFrame()
        warning_box.setObjectName("SoftCard")
        warning_box.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
        warning_layout = QHBoxLayout(warning_box)
        warning_layout.setContentsMargins(11, 8, 11, 8)
        warning_layout.setSpacing(8)
        warn_icon = QLabel()
        warn_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("warning", colors()["orange"], 17))
        warning_layout.addWidget(warn_icon, 0, Qt.AlignTop)
        warning = QLabel(
            "房间号只适合朋友之间联机。若在论坛、群聊或视频平台公开宣传，"
            "必须使用带“多线”标记的公开游戏节点，否则可能被樱花穿透封号；"
            "免费账户还有流量、隧道数和实名认证限制。"
        )
        warning.setObjectName("Tiny")
        warning.setWordWrap(True)
        warning_layout.addWidget(warning, 1)
        layout.addWidget(warning_box)
        return card

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 状态与主题

    def _set_status(self, label: QLabel, text: str, kind: str = "muted") -> None:
        c = colors()
        key = STATUS_COLORS.get(kind, STATUS_COLORS["muted"])[0]
        label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {c[key]}; font-size: 11px; background: transparent;"
        )
        label.setText(text)
        if label is self.host_status:
            self._host_status_kind = kind
        elif label is self.guest_status:
            self._guest_status_kind = kind

    def _set_badge(self, label: QLabel, text: str, kind: str) -> None:
        label.setText(text)
        label.setProperty("badge", kind)
        repolish(label)

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, self.host_status.text(), self._host_status_kind
        )
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status, self.guest_status.text(), self._guest_status_kind
        )
        self.create_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("bolt", "#FFFFFF", 16))
        self.join_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("play", "#FFFFFF", 16))
        self.copy_code_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("copy", "#FFFFFF", 14))
        for button in (self.copy_address_btn, self.copy_decode_btn):
            button.setIcon(icons.icon("copy", colors()["text2"], 13))
        for label in getattr(self, "_step_numbers", []):
            label.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; color: {colors()['accent']};"
                "border-radius: 10px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800;"
            )
        for label in self.findChildren(QLabel):
            if label.property("badge"):
                repolish(label)

    def _restore_token(self) -> None:
        token = self.main.config.sakura_access_token
        if not token:
            return
        self._token = token
        self.token_edit.setText(token)
        self.token_edit.setCursorPosition(len(token))
        self.token_edit.setPlaceholderText("已保存访问密钥（已加密）")
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, "已保存访问密钥，切换到本页时自动连接。", "muted"
        )
        self.connect_btn.setText("重新验证")

    def _toggle_token_visibility(self) -> None:
        if self.token_edit.echoMode() == QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password:
            self.token_edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal)
            self.show_token_btn.setText("隐藏")
        else:
            self.token_edit.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
            self.show_token_btn.setText("显示")

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self._sync_versions()
        if (
            not self._auto_login_attempted
            and self._token
            and self._user is None
            and not self._busy
        ):
            self._auto_login_attempted = True
            QTimer.singleShot(120, lambda: self.login_sakura(silent=True))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 樱花账户

    def login_sakura(self, silent: bool = False) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._tunnel_process is not None:
            self.toast("请先关闭当前房间，再更换访问密钥。", "info")
            return
        token = self.token_edit.text().strip() or self._token
        if not token:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, "请先填写樱花穿透访问密钥。", "error"
            )
            return
        self._pending_token = token
        self._busy = True
        self.connect_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.connect_btn.setText("正在验证…")
        self.create_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.node_refresh.setEnabled(False)
        self._set_status(self.host_status, "正在验证访问密钥并读取节点…", "busy")
        worker = SakuraLoginWorker(token, self)
        self._login_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda payload, error, w=worker, s=silent: self._login_ready(
                w, payload, error, s
            )
        )
        worker.start()

    def _login_ready(
        self,
        worker: SakuraLoginWorker,
        payload,
        error: str,
        silent: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        if self._login_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._login_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self.connect_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.node_refresh.setEnabled(True)
        if error or not isinstance(payload, dict):
            self.connect_btn.setText("验证并连接")
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, error or "无法读取樱花穿透账户。", "error"
            )
            self.toast(error or "樱花穿透连接失败", "error")
            self._sync_controls()
            return

        user: SakuraUser = payload["user"]
        self._user = user
        self._nodes = payload["nodes"]
        self._tunnels = payload["tunnels"]
        self._token = self._pending_token
        old_token = self.main.config.sakura_access_token
        if old_token and old_token != self._token:
            self.main.config.sakura_tunnel_id = 0
        self.main.config.set_sakura_token(self._token)
        self.main.config.save()
        self.token_edit.setText(self._token)
        self.token_edit.setCursorPosition(len(self._token))
        self.token_edit.setPlaceholderText("已保存访问密钥（已加密）")
        self.connect_btn.setText("重新验证")
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "已连接", "green")
        self._populate_nodes()

        details = [
            f"已连接 · {user.name or '樱花账户'}",
            user.realname_text,
            user.traffic_text,
        ]
        if user.speed:
            details.append(f"限速 {user.speed}")
        if user.tunnel_limit:
            details.append(f"隧道 {len(self._tunnels)}/{user.tunnel_limit}")
        self.account_line.setText(" · ".join(details))
        if not user.realname:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "账户尚未实名认证，创建隧道可能被拒绝，请到樱花穿透面板完成认证。",
                "warning",
            )
        else:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, "账户已连接，可以创建房间。", "success"
            )
        self._sync_controls()
        if not silent:
            self.toast("樱花穿透账户已连接", "success")

    def _populate_nodes(self) -> None:
        current_id = self._selected_node_id()
        if not current_id:
            current_id = self.main.config.sakura_node_id
        preferred_tunnel = self._existing_room_tunnel()
        if preferred_tunnel and preferred_tunnel.node in self._nodes:
            current_id = preferred_tunnel.node

        self.node_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.node_combo.clear()
        self.node_combo.addItem("自动选择节点", 0)
        nodes = [
            node
            for node in self._nodes.values()
            if node.selectable and node.host
        ]
        nodes.sort(key=lambda node: (node.public_game, node.vip, not node.mainland, node.name))
        for node in nodes[:200]:
            self.node_combo.addItem(node.label, node.id)
            index = self.node_combo.count() - 1
            tip = node.description or ""
            if node.host:
                tip = (tip + "\n" if tip else "") + f"节点地址：{node.host}"
            self.node_combo.setItemData(index, tip, Qt.ToolTipRole)
        if current_id:
            index = self.node_combo.findData(current_id)
            if index >= 0:
                self.node_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.node_combo.blockSignals(False)
        if not nodes:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "没有可用节点，请稍后刷新，或到樱花穿透面板检查节点状态。",
                "error",
            )

    def _selected_node_id(self) -> int:
        data = self.node_combo.currentData()
        try:
            return int(data or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return 0

    def _existing_room_tunnel(self) -> SakuraTunnel | None:
        preferred = self.main.config.sakura_tunnel_id
        if preferred:
            for tunnel in self._tunnels:
                if tunnel.id == preferred and tunnel.type == "tcp":
                    return tunnel
        candidates = [
            tunnel
            for tunnel in self._tunnels
            if tunnel.name.startswith(ROOM_TUNNEL_NAME) and tunnel.type == "tcp"
        ]
        return max(candidates, key=lambda item: item.id) if candidates else None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 主机流程

    def detect_port(self) -> None:
        process = self.main.game_process
        pid = process.pid if process and self.main.game_running else 0
        if not pid:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "游戏还没有运行。请先启动游戏，并在单人游戏里“对局域网开放”。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        ports = detect_game_lan_ports(pid)
        if not ports:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "没有检测到游戏监听端口。请先在游戏里对局域网开放，再点一次检测。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        port = preferred_lan_port(ports)
        self.port_spin.setValue(port)
        others = [str(item) for item in ports if item != port]
        text = f"已检测到游戏端口 {port}，可以创建房间。"
        if others:
            text += f"（其他监听端口：{', '.join(others[:4])}）"
        self._set_status(self.host_status, text, "success")

    def create_room(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._user is None:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, "请先验证并连接樱花穿透访问密钥。", "error"
            )
            return
        if self.token_edit.text().strip() != self._token:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "访问密钥已修改，请先点击“验证并连接”再创建房间。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        if self._tunnel_process is not None or self._room_payload is not None:
            self.toast("房间已经开启，请先关闭当前房间。", "info")
            return
        port = int(self.port_spin.value())
        node_id = self._selected_node_id()
        if not self._notice_shown:
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "创建联机房间",
                "房间号适合朋友之间私下联机。创建后会占用一条樱花穿透隧道。",
                primary_text="仅熟人联机，继续",
                secondary_text="取消",
                icon_name="users",
                icon_color=colors()["green"],
                details=(
                    "如果你的服务器会发布到论坛、群聊、服务器列表或视频平台，"
                    "必须使用带“多线”标记的公开游戏节点，否则可能违反樱花穿透规则并被封号。"
                    "房主需要保持游戏、启动器和房间全程开启。"
                ),
            )
            if not dialog.exec():
                return
            self._notice_shown = True

        self._busy = True
        self.progress.setRange(0, 100)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress.setVisible(True)
        self.log_box.clear()
        self.log_box.setVisible(True)
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, "正在准备隧道与内置 frpc…", "busy"
        )
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "准备中", "blue")
        self._sync_controls()

        worker = SakuraRoomWorker(
            self._token,
            port,
            node_id=node_id,
            preferred_tunnel_id=self.main.config.sakura_tunnel_id,
            frpc_path=self.main.config.sakura_frpc_path,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._room_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(
            lambda value, message, w=worker: self._room_progress(w, value, message)
        )
        worker.log_line.connect(
            lambda line, w=worker: self._room_log(w, line)
        )
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda payload, error, w=worker: self._room_ready(w, payload, error)
        )
        worker.failed.connect(
            lambda error, w=worker: self._room_failed(w, error)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _room_progress(
        self, worker: SakuraRoomWorker, value: int, message: str
    ) -> None:
        if self._room_worker is not worker:
            return
        self.progress.setValue(value)
        self._set_status(self.host_status, message, "busy")

    def _room_log(self, worker: SakuraRoomWorker, line: str) -> None:
        if self._room_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._append_log(line)

    def _append_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        text = str(line or "")
        if not text:
            return
        if self._token:
            text = text.replace(self._token, "***")
        text = re.sub(
            r"(?i)((?:access[_ ]?)?token\s*[=:]\s*)\S+", r"\1***", text
        )
        if not self.log_box.isVisible():
            self.log_box.setVisible(True)
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)
        bar = self.log_box.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _room_ready(
        self, worker: SakuraRoomWorker, payload, error: str
    ) -> None:
        if self._room_worker is not worker:
            return
        self._room_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        if error or not isinstance(payload, dict):
            self.progress.setVisible(False)
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status, error or "创建房间失败。", "error"
            )
            self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "已连接", "green")
            self.toast(error or "创建房间失败", "error")
            self._sync_controls()
            return

        self._room_payload = payload
        self.main.config.sakura_tunnel_id = int(payload.get("tunnel_id") or 0)
        self.main.config.sakura_node_id = int(payload.get("node_id") or 0)
        self.main.config.save()
        self.progress.setValue(100)
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_status(
            self.host_status, "隧道已准备，正在启动内置 frpc…", "busy"
        )
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "连接中", "blue")
        self._start_tunnel(payload)

    def _start_tunnel(self, payload: dict) -> None:
        process = SakuraTunnelProcess(
            payload.get("frpc_path", ""),
            payload.get("config_path", ""),
            self,
        )
        self._tunnel_process = process
        process.log_line.connect(self._append_log)
        process.ready.connect(self._tunnel_ready)
        process.failed.connect(self._tunnel_failed)
        process.finished.connect(self._tunnel_finished)
        process.start()
        self._sync_controls()

    def _tunnel_ready(self, message: str) -> None:
        if self._closing or self._room_payload is None:
            return
        payload = self._room_payload
        self._set_badge(self.host_badge, "房间开启", "green")
        code = str(payload.get("room_code") or "")
        if code:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                f"房间已开启（{message}）。把房间号发给朋友即可。",
                "success",
            )
        else:
            self._set_status(
                self.host_status,
                "房间已开启，但房间号生成失败，请直接分享服务器地址。",
                "warning",
            )
        self._show_room_result(payload)
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._sync_controls()

    def _show_room_result(self, payload: dict) -> None:
        code = str(payload.get("room_code") or "")
        address = str(payload.get("address") or "")
        share = str(payload.get("share_address") or address)
        self.room_code_label.setText(code or "房间号不可用")
        if code:
            self.room_code_label.setStyleSheet(
                "font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 2px;"
            )
            self.copy_code_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.room_code_label.setStyleSheet(
                "font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700;"
            )
            self.copy_code_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.room_address_label.setText(f"服务器地址：{address}")
        detail = (
            f"隧道 #{payload.get('tunnel_id', '?')} · "
            f"{payload.get('node_name', '')} · "
            f"本地端口 {payload.get('local_port', '')} · "
            f"frpc {payload.get('frpc_version', '')}"
        )
        code_error = str(payload.get("code_error") or "")
        if code_error:
            detail += f"\n{code_error}"
        if share and share != address:
            detail += f"\n节点地址：{share}"
        self.room_detail_label.setText(detail)
        self.result_box.setVisible(True)
        self._sync_social_room(code or address)
        self._sync_controls()

    def _tunnel_failed(self, message: str) -> None:
        if self._closing:
            return
        process = self._tunnel_process
        if process is not None:
            try:
                process.blockSignals(True)
                process.stop()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._fail_room(message)

    def _tunnel_finished(self, code: int) -> None:
        if self._closing or self._tunnel_process is None:
            return
        self._tunnel_process = None
        if self._room_payload is not None:
            self._fail_room(f"内置 frpc 已退出（代码 {code}），房间已关闭。")

    def _fail_room(self, message: str) -> None:
        payload = self._room_payload
        if payload:
            remove_tunnel_config(payload.get("config_path"))
            self._clear_social_room()
        self._room_payload = None
        self._tunnel_process = None
        self._busy = False
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(
            self.host_badge, "已连接" if self._user else "未连接",
            "green" if self._user else "gray",
        )
        self._set_status(self.host_status, message, "error")
        self.result_box.setVisible(False)
        self.toast(message, "error")
        self._sync_controls()

    def close_room(self) -> None:
        if self._busy:
            worker = self._room_worker
            if worker:
                worker.cancel()
            self._room_worker = None
            self._busy = False
        process = self._tunnel_process
        self._closing = True
        self._tunnel_process = None
        if process is not None:
            process.blockSignals(True)
            process.stop()
        payload = self._room_payload
        if payload:
            remove_tunnel_config(payload.get("config_path"))
            self._clear_social_room()
        self._room_payload = None
        self.progress.setVisible(False)
        self._set_badge(
            self.host_badge, "已连接" if self._user else "未连接",
            "green" if self._user else "gray",
        )
        self._set_status(self.host_status, "房间已关闭。", "muted")
        self.result_box.setVisible(False)
        self._closing = False
        self._sync_controls()

    def _copy_room_code(self) -> None:
        code = self.room_code_label.text()
        if not code or code == "房间号不可用":
            self.toast("当前没有可复制的房间号", "info")
            return
        self._copy_text(code, "房间号")

    def _copy_host_address(self) -> None:
        if not self._room_payload:
            return
        self._copy_text(
            str(self._room_payload.get("address") or ""), "服务器地址"
        )

    def _sync_social_room(self, room_code: str) -> None:
        if not room_code:
            return
        try:
            self.main.social_store.set_room(
                room_code, str(self.main.selected_version or "")
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _clear_social_room(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.main.social_store.set_room("", "")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _copy_invite_card(self) -> None:
        payload = self._room_payload or {}
        code = str(payload.get("room_code") or payload.get("address") or "")
        if not code:
            self.toast("房间还没有准备好，稍等一下喵", "info")
            return
        try:
            profile = self.main.social_store.ensure_profile(
                self.main.display_name()
            )
            text = encode_invite(
                profile, code, str(self.main.selected_version or "")
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"生成邀请卡失败：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self._copy_text(text, "好友邀请卡")

    def join_friend_room(self, room_code: str, version_id: str = "") -> None:
        """从好友簿进入房间：填好房间号和版本，直接走客人启动流程。"""
        if self.main.game_running:
            self._copy_text(room_code, "好友房间地址")
            return
        text = str(room_code or "").strip()
        if not text:
            self.toast("好友还没有分享房间号", "info")
            return
        self.code_edit.setText(text)
        self._format_code_field()
        self._update_code_preview()
        if version_id:
            index = self.version_combo.findData(version_id)
            if index < 0:
                self._set_status(
                    self.guest_status,
                    f"好友房间使用 {version_id}，你还没有安装这个版本。"
                    "请先安装相同版本再加入。",
                    "error",
                )
                self.toast(f"缺少版本 {version_id}", "error")
                return
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        if not self._decoded_address:
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status, "好友房间号无效，请让对方重新发一张邀请卡。", "error"
            )
            return
        self.join_room()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 客机流程

    def _sync_versions(self) -> None:
        versions = list(self.main.game_version_summaries())
        current = self.version_combo.currentData() if self.version_combo.count() else ""
        preferred = str(current or self.main.selected_version or "")
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.version_combo.clear()
        for summary in versions:
            kind = summary.loader or summary.type_name or ""
            label = f"{summary.id} · {kind}" if kind else summary.id
            if summary.error:
                label += "（文件异常）"
            self.version_combo.addItem(label, summary.id)
        if versions:
            index = self.version_combo.findData(preferred)
            if index < 0:
                index = 0
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        else:
            self.version_combo.addItem("未安装游戏版本", "")
        self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._sync_controls()

    def _sync_selection(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        if not version_id:
            return
        index = self.version_combo.findData(version_id)
        if index >= 0 and index != self.version_combo.currentIndex():
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _update_code_preview(self) -> None:
        text = self.code_edit.text().strip()
        if not text:
            self._decoded_address = ""
            self.code_hint.setText(
                "也可以直接粘贴 host:port 形式的服务器地址。"
            )
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status, "房主创建房间后，把房间号发给你即可。", "muted"
            )
            self._sync_controls()
            return
        try:
            host, port = decode_room_input(text)
        except SakuraError as exc:
            self._decoded_address = ""
            if len(re.sub(r"[\s\-_]", "", text)) >= 8:
                self.code_hint.setText(str(exc))
                self._set_status(self.guest_status, str(exc), "error")
            else:
                self.code_hint.setText("继续输入完整的 13 位房间号…")
                self._set_status(self.guest_status, "正在读取房间号…", "muted")
            self._sync_controls()
            return
        self._decoded_address = f"{host}:{port}"
        self.code_hint.setText(f"将连接 {self._decoded_address}")
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status, "房间号有效，选择版本后即可启动。", "success"
        )
        self._sync_controls()

    def _format_code_field(self) -> None:
        text = self.code_edit.text().strip()
        if not text or ":" in text:
            return
        try:
            raw = normalize_room_code(text)
        except SakuraError:
            return
        formatted = f"{raw[:5]}-{raw[5:9]}-{raw[9:]}"
        if formatted != text:
            self.code_edit.setText(formatted)

    def _paste_code(self) -> None:
        text = QApplication.clipboard().text().strip()
        if not text:
            self.toast("剪贴板为空", "info")
            return
        self.code_edit.setText(text)
        self._format_code_field()
        self._update_code_preview()

    def _copy_guest_address(self) -> None:
        if not self._decoded_address:
            self._update_code_preview()
        if not self._decoded_address:
            self.toast("请先输入有效的房间号", "info")
            return
        self._copy_text(self._decoded_address, "服务器地址")

    def join_room(self) -> None:
        self._update_code_preview()
        if not self._decoded_address:
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status, "请先输入有效的房间号。", "error"
            )
            return
        address = self._decoded_address
        if self.main.game_running:
            self._copy_text(address, "服务器地址")
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status,
                "游戏已经在运行，地址已复制。请在多人游戏中添加服务器。",
                "warning",
            )
            return
        if self.main.install_active:
            self.toast("正在安装游戏文件，请稍候", "info")
            return
        version_id = str(self.version_combo.currentData() or "")
        if not version_id:
            self.toast("请先安装一个游戏版本", "info")
            return
        if version_id != self.main.selected_version:
            self.main.home_page.select_version(version_id)
        self._set_status(
            self.guest_status,
            f"正在启动 {version_id} 并连接 {address}…",
            "busy",
        )
        self.main.launch_selected(connect_address=address)
        if not self.main.game_running and not self.main.launch_active:
            self._set_status(
                self.guest_status,
                "启动没有完成，请查看启动器提示或运行日志。",
                "error",
            )

    def _copy_text(self, text: str, label: str) -> None:
        if not text:
            self.toast(f"没有可复制的{label}", "info")
            return
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
        self.toast(f"{label}已复制", "success")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 其他

    def _on_game_state(self, running: bool) -> None:
        if running:
            self.join_btn.setText("游戏运行中 · 复制地址")
        else:
            self.join_btn.setText("启动游戏并进入")
        self.detect_btn.setEnabled(running)
        if hasattr(self, "join_btn"):
            self.join_btn.setIcon(
                icons.icon("copy" if running else "play", "#FFFFFF", 16)
            )
        self._sync_controls()

    def _sync_controls(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "create_btn"):
            return
        room_active = self._tunnel_process is not None or self._room_payload is not None
        self.create_btn.setEnabled(
            bool(self._user) and not self._busy and not room_active
        )
        self.close_btn.setVisible(
            room_active or self._room_worker is not None
        )
        self.connect_btn.setEnabled(not self._busy and not room_active)
        self.token_edit.setEnabled(not room_active)
        self.node_combo.setEnabled(not room_active and bool(self._nodes))
        self.node_refresh.setEnabled(not self._busy and not room_active)
        self.port_spin.setEnabled(not room_active)
        self.detect_btn.setEnabled(not room_active and self.main.game_running)
        has_version = bool(self.version_combo.currentData())
        self.join_btn.setEnabled(has_version and not self._busy)
        self.copy_decode_btn.setEnabled(has_version)

    def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        self.main.toast(text, kind)

    def _open_url(self, url: str) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        self._closing = True
        worker = self._room_worker
        if worker:
            worker.cancel()
            self._room_worker = None
        login = self._login_worker
        if login:
            self._login_worker = None
        process = self._tunnel_process
        self._tunnel_process = None
        if process is not None:
            process.blockSignals(True)
            process.stop()
        payload = self._room_payload
        if payload:
            remove_tunnel_config(payload.get("config_path"))
            self._clear_social_room()
        self._room_payload = None

class _ElidedLabel(QLabel):
    def __init__(self, text: str = "", parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._full_text = ""
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Preferred)
        self.setText(text)

    def setText(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._full_text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
        self.setToolTip(self._full_text)
        self._refresh()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._refresh()

    def _refresh(self) -> None:
        width = self.contentsRect().width()
        if width <= 0:
            return
        elided = self.fontMetrics().elidedText(
            self._full_text, Qt.ElideRight, width
        )
        if QLabel.text(self) != elided:
            QLabel.setText(self, elided)


SERVER_ICON_NAMES = ("server-icon.png", "icon.png")


def _server_icon_pixmap(
    info: ServerInfo, size: int, radius: int
) -> QPixmap | None:
    """读取服务端根目录的图标；没有图标时返回 None，由调用方使用通用图标。"""
    path = None
    for name in SERVER_ICON_NAMES:
        candidate = info.path / name
        if candidate.is_file():
            path = candidate
            break
    if path is None:
        return None
    image = QImage(str(path))
    if image.isNull():
        return None
    canvas = QImage(size, size, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    canvas.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(canvas)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.SmoothPixmapTransform, True)
    clip = QPainterPath()
    clip.addRoundedRect(0.5, 0.5, size - 1, size - 1, radius, radius)
    painter.setClipPath(clip)
    scaled = image.scaled(
        size,
        size,
        Qt.KeepAspectRatioByExpanding,
        Qt.SmoothTransformation,
    )
    painter.drawImage(
        (size - scaled.width()) // 2,
        (size - scaled.height()) // 2,
        scaled,
    )
    painter.end()
    return QPixmap.fromImage(canvas)


class ServerRow(QFrame):

    def __init__(

    ) -> None:

        layout.addLayout(info_layout, 1)
        transparent_children(self)
        self.refresh_theme()

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        color = KIND_COLORS.get(self.info.kind, colors()["accent"])
        icon = _server_icon_pixmap(self.info, 38, 9)
        self.icon_label.setPixmap(icon or icons.pixmap("server", color, 22))
        self.icon_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['card2']}; border-radius: 9px;"
        )
        self.set_state(self.state)
        repolish(self.type_badge)

    def set_state(self, state: str) -> None:
        self.state = state
        color_key = {
            "stopped": "muted",
            "starting": "accent",
            "running": "green",
            "stopping": "orange",
        }.get(state, "muted")
        self.state_dot.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {colors()[color_key]}; font-size: 8px;"
        )
        self.state_text.setText(STATE_TEXT.get(state, state))
        self.state_text.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {colors()[color_key]}; font-size: 11px;"
        )

    def set_selected(self, selected: bool) -> None:
        self.setProperty("selected", "true" if selected else "false")
        repolish(self)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit(self.info.folder)
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    @staticmethod
    def _form_label(text: str) -> QLabel:
        label = QLabel(text)
        label.setFixedWidth(72)
        label.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px;")
        return label

    def _form_line(self, layout: QVBoxLayout, title: str) -> QLineEdit:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(8)
        row.addWidget(self._form_label(title))
        edit = QLineEdit()
        edit.setMaxLength(48)
        row.addWidget(edit, 1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return edit

    def _form_spin(
        self,
        layout: QVBoxLayout,
        title: str,
        minimum: int,
        maximum: int,
        step: int,
        suffix: str,
    ) -> QSpinBox:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(8)
        row.addWidget(self._form_label(title))
        spin = QSpinBox()
        spin.setRange(minimum, maximum)
        spin.setSingleStep(step)
        spin.setSuffix(suffix)
        spin.setFixedWidth(160)
        row.addWidget(spin)
        row.addStretch(1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return spin

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 列表 / 选择

    def _state_of(self, info: ServerInfo) -> str:
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        if process is not None:
            return process.state
        return "stopped"

    def refresh_servers(self, preferred_folder: str = "") -> None:
        preferred = preferred_folder or self._selected_folder
        self.servers = scan_servers()
        self.count_label.setText(f"{len(self.servers)} 个" if self.servers else "")

        while self.list_layout.count():
            item = self.list_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget is not None:
                widget.setParent(None)
                widget.deleteLater()
        self._rows = []

        if not self.servers:
            empty = QFrame()
            empty.setObjectName("SoftCard")
            empty.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
            empty_layout = QVBoxLayout(empty)
            empty_layout.setContentsMargins(14, 18, 14, 18)
            empty_layout.setSpacing(4)
            title = QLabel("还没有服务端")
            title.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            title.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700;")
            empty_layout.addWidget(title)
            hint = QLabel(
                "点击右上角“新建服务端”，或导入别人打包好的服务端。"
            )
            hint.setObjectName("Tiny")
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            hint.setWordWrap(True)
            empty_layout.addWidget(hint)
            self.list_layout.addWidget(empty)
            self.list_layout.addStretch(1)
            self._selected_folder = ""
            self.detail_placeholder.setVisible(True)
            self.detail_content.setVisible(False)
            self.empty_title.setText("还没有服务端")
            self.empty_sub.setText(
                "选择 Paper、Spigot 或模组服务端，启动器会自动下载并生成启动文件；"
                "也可以导入 ZIP 或服务端文件夹。"
            )
            self.empty_btn.setText("新建服务端")
            return

        target = preferred
        folders = {info.folder for info in self.servers}
        if target not in folders:
            target = self.servers[0].folder
        for info in self.servers:
            row = ServerRow(info, self._state_of(info), info.folder == target)
            row.clicked.connect(self._select)
            self.list_layout.addWidget(row)
            self._rows.append(row)
        self.list_layout.addStretch(1)

        self.detail_placeholder.setVisible(False)
        self.detail_content.setVisible(True)
        self._select(target, force=True)

    def _select(self, folder: str, force: bool = False) -> None:
        if not force and folder == self._selected_folder:
            self._load_console(folder)
            return
        info = next((item for item in self.servers if item.folder == folder), None)
        if info is None:
            return
        self._selected_folder = folder
        for row in self._rows:
            row.set_selected(row.info.folder == folder)
        self._show_detail(info)
        self._load_console(folder)
        self._load_settings(info)
        self.refresh_addons()
        self._update_controls()
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self.tabs.set_value("console")

    def _apply_detail_icon(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        icon = _server_icon_pixmap(info, 46, 11)
        self.detail_icon.setPixmap(
            icon
            or icons.pixmap(
                "server", KIND_COLORS.get(info.kind, colors()["accent"]), 26
            )
        )

    def _show_detail(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        self.detail_name.setText(info.name)
        self.type_badge.setText(info.type_name)
        self.type_badge.setProperty("badge", SERVER_BADGE.get(info.kind, "gray"))
        repolish(self.type_badge)
        self.version_badge.setText(info.display_version)
        self.path_label.setText(str(info.path))
        self._apply_detail_icon(info)
        self.detail_icon.setStyleSheet(
            f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 11px;"
        )
        self.tabs.set_item_text(
            "addons", "插件" if info.is_plugin_server else "Mod"
        )
        self.addon_download_btn.setText(
            "下载插件" if info.is_plugin_server else "下载 Mod"
        )
        self.addon_path_label.setText(str(addons_dir(info)))
        self.address_label.setText(f"localhost:{info.port}")
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 控制台

    def _load_console(self, folder: str) -> None:
        lines = self._buffers.get(folder, [])
        self.console.setPlainText("\n".join(lines))
        bar = self.console.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _append_console(self, folder: str, line: str) -> None:
        text = str(line or "").rstrip()
        if not text:
            return
        buffer = self._buffers.setdefault(folder, [])
        buffer.append(text)
        if len(buffer) > 2500:
            del buffer[:500]
        if folder == self._selected_folder:
            self.console.appendPlainText(text)
            bar = self.console.verticalScrollBar()
            bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _clear_console(self) -> None:
        if not self._selected_folder:
            return
        self._buffers[self._selected_folder] = []
        self.console.clear()

    def _quick_command(self, command: str) -> None:
        if command.endswith(" "):
            self.command_edit.setText(command)
            self.command_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self.command_edit.setText(command)
        self.send_command()

    def send_command(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        if process is None or not process.is_running:
            self.toast("服务端还没有运行", "info")
            return
        command = self.command_edit.text().strip()
        if not command:
            return
        if command.startswith("/"):
            command = command[1:]
        try:
            process.send(command)
        except ServerError as exc:
            self.toast(str(exc), "error")
            return
        self._append_console(info.folder, f"> {command}")
        self.command_edit.clear()

    def _copy_address(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(f"localhost:{info.port}")
        self.toast("服务器地址已复制", "success")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 启动 / 停止

    def start_server(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        if info.folder in self._processes:
            self.toast("服务端已经在运行", "info")
            return
        if self._install_worker is not None and self._install_folder == info.folder:
            self.toast("服务端仍在安装中，请稍候", "info")
            return
        if not info.installed:
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "服务端尚未安装完成",
                "这个服务端缺少可启动文件，请先在设置页重新安装。",
                button_text="知道了",
                icon_name="warning",
            ).exec()
            self.tabs.set_value("settings")
            self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(2)
            return

        required = required_java_major(info.mc_version)
        java = pick_java(
            self.main.java_installs,
            required,
            info.java_path or self.main.config.java_path,
        )
        if java is None or (java.major and java.major < required):
            self._java_problem(info, required, java)
            return

        if not info.eula:
            if not self._accept_eula(info, start_after=False):
                return

        if not check_port(info.port):
            dialog = ConfirmDialog(
                self,
                "端口被占用",
                f"端口 {info.port} 已被其他程序占用，服务端将无法监听。",
                primary_text="修改端口",
                secondary_text="取消",
                icon_name="warning",
                icon_color=colors()["orange"],
                details="可以换一个端口（例如 25566），保存后重新启动。"
                "如果占用端口的是另一个 Minecraft 服务端，请先关闭它。",
            )
            if dialog.exec():
                self.tabs.set_value("settings")
                self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(2)
                self.settings_port.setFocus()
            return

        process = ServerProcess(info, java_path=java.path, parent=self)
        process.output.connect(
            lambda line, f=info.folder: self._append_console(f, line)
        )
        process.started.connect(
            lambda pid, f=info.folder: self._on_process_started(f, pid)
        )
        process.ready.connect(
            lambda f=info.folder: self._on_process_ready(f)
        )
        process.state_changed.connect(
            lambda state, f=info.folder: self._on_process_state(f, state)
        )
        process.stopped.connect(
            lambda code, f=info.folder: self._on_process_stopped(f, code)
        )

        try:
            process.start()
        except ServerError as exc:
            self.toast(str(exc), "error")
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "无法启动服务端",
                str(exc),
                button_text="知道了",
                icon_name="warning",
            ).exec()
            return

        self._processes[info.folder] = process
        self._expected_stop.discard(info.folder)
        self._buffers[info.folder] = []
        self.console.clear()
        self._append_console(info.folder, f"正在启动 {info.type_name} {info.mc_version}…")
        self._append_console(info.folder, f"Java：{java.path}")
        info.last_started = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        save_server(info)
        self.tabs.set_value("console")
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _java_problem(self, info: ServerInfo, required: int, java) -> None:
        found = (
            f"当前选择的是 Java {java.major or '?'}（{java.path}），"
            if java is not None
            else "没有检测到可用的 Java。"
        )
        dialog = NoticeDialog(
            self,
            "需要 Java",
            f"{info.type_name} {info.mc_version} 需要 Java {required} 或更高版本。"
            f"{found}请先在设置页配置合适的 Java。",
            button_text="打开设置",
            icon_name="warning",
            secondary_text="取消",
        )
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.action_clicked:
            self.main.switch_page("settings")

    def _accept_eula_clicked(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self._accept_eula(info, start_after=False)

    def _accept_eula(self, info: ServerInfo, start_after: bool = True) -> bool:
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "同意 Minecraft EULA",
            "启动服务端需要接受 Minecraft 最终用户许可协议（EULA）。",
            primary_text="同意 EULA",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="warning",
            details="点击“同意 EULA”会写入 eula=true。条款地址："
            + EULA_URL
            + "。请确认你已阅读并同意该协议。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return False
        try:
            write_eula(info)
            save_server(info)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法写入 EULA：{exc}", "error")
            return False
        self._update_eula_badge(info)
        self.toast("已同意 Minecraft EULA", "success")
        if start_after:
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self.start_server)
        return True

    def stop_server(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        if process is None or not process.is_running:
            self.toast("服务端没有在运行", "info")
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "停止服务端",
            f"确定停止 {info.name} 吗？",
            primary_text="停止服务端",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="stop",
            icon_color=colors()["red"],
            details="启动器会先发送 stop 命令让世界安全保存。"
            "如果 20 秒内没有退出，进程会被强制结束。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self._expected_stop.add(info.folder)
        self._append_console(info.folder, "> stop")
        process.stop(20)
        self.toast("正在停止服务端…", "info")
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _on_process_started(self, folder: str, pid: int) -> None:
        self._append_console(folder, f"服务端进程已启动（PID {pid}）")
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _on_process_ready(self, folder: str) -> None:
        info = next((item for item in self.servers if item.folder == folder), None)
        name = info.name if info else folder
        self._append_console(folder, "服务端已就绪")
        self.toast(f"{name} 已就绪，可以连接了", "success")
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _on_process_state(self, folder: str, state: str) -> None:
        if folder == self._selected_folder:
            self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()

    def _on_process_stopped(self, folder: str, code: int) -> None:
        info = next((item for item in self.servers if item.folder == folder), None)
        name = info.name if info else folder
        expected = folder in self._expected_stop
        self._expected_stop.discard(folder)
        self._processes.pop(folder, None)
        self._append_console(
            folder, f"服务端进程已结束（退出代码 {code}）"
        )
        if code == 0:
            self.toast(f"{name} 已停止", "info")
        elif expected:
            self.toast(f"{name} 已停止（代码 {code}）", "info")
        else:
            self.toast(f"{name} 异常退出（代码 {code}），请查看控制台", "error")
        self._update_controls()
        self._refresh_rows_state()
        if info is not None:
            self._load_settings(info)

    def _refresh_rows_state(self) -> None:
        for row in self._rows:
            row.set_state(self._state_of(row.info))

    def _update_controls(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        state = process.state if process is not None else "stopped"
        self.state_badge.setText(STATE_TEXT.get(state, state))
        self.state_badge.setProperty("badge", STATE_BADGE.get(state, "gray"))
        repolish(self.state_badge)

        installing = (
            self._install_worker is not None and self._install_folder == info.folder
        )
        running = state in ("starting", "running", "stopping")
        self.start_btn.setVisible(state == "stopped")
        self.start_btn.setEnabled(not installing and info.installed)
        self.start_btn.setText("启动")
        self.stop_btn.setVisible(state != "stopped")
        self.stop_btn.setEnabled(state in ("starting", "running"))

        pid = ""
        if process is not None and process.process is not None:
            pid = f" · PID {process.process.pid}"
        hint = f"{info.type_name} {info.mc_version}"
        if state == "stopped":
            hint += " · 未启动"
        else:
            hint += f" · {STATE_TEXT.get(state, state)}{pid}"
        self.console_hint.setText(hint)
        self.address_label.setText(f"localhost:{info.port}")

        self.tab_hint.setText(
            "运行中修改的插件或设置需要重启后生效" if state != "stopped" else ""
        )
        self.command_edit.setEnabled(state == "running")
        self.send_btn.setEnabled(state == "running")
        self.eula_btn.setEnabled(not info.eula)
        self.settings_name.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.settings_memory.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.settings_port.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.settings_online.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.settings_java.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.save_btn.setEnabled(not installing)
        self.delete_btn.setEnabled(not running and not installing)
        self.reinstall_btn.setEnabled(not running and not installing)
        self.pack_btn.setEnabled(not running and not installing)
        self.pack_icon_btn.setEnabled(not running and not installing)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 插件

    def refresh_addons(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if not hasattr(self, "addon_layout"):
            return
        while self.addon_layout.count():
            item = self.addon_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget is not None:
                widget.setParent(None)
                widget.deleteLater()
        self.addon_layout.addStretch(1)
        self.addon_holder.setMinimumHeight(0)
        if info is None:
            self.addon_empty.setText("")
            self.addon_empty.setVisible(False)
            return

        self.addon_path_label.setText(str(addons_dir(info)))
        addons = list_addons(info)
        if not addons:
            self.addon_empty.setText(
                f"还没有{info.addon_label}。点击右上角“下载{info.addon_label}”"
                f"从 Modrinth 获取适配 {info.mc_version} 的项目。"
            )
            self.addon_empty.setVisible(True)
            return
        self.addon_empty.setVisible(False)
        for addon in addons:
            row = AddonRow(addon, info.is_plugin_server)
            row.toggled.connect(
                lambda item, checked, i=info: self._toggle_addon(i, item, checked)
            )
            self.addon_layout.insertWidget(self.addon_layout.count() - 1, row)
        self.addon_layout.activate()
        self.addon_holder.setMinimumHeight(self.addon_layout.sizeHint().height())

    def _toggle_addon(
        self, info: ServerInfo, addon: AddonFile, checked: bool
    ) -> None:
        if addon.enabled == checked:
            return
        try:
            toggle_addon(addon)
        except (ServerError, OSError) as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法切换{info.addon_label}状态：{exc}", "error")
            self.refresh_addons()
            return
        state = "启用" if checked else "禁用"
        self.toast(f"{addon.name} 已{state}", "success")
        if info.folder in self._processes:
            self.toast("需要重启服务端后生效", "info")
        self.refresh_addons()

    def open_addon_dialog(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        dialog = ServerAddonDialog(self.main, info)
        dialog.installed.connect(lambda _: self.refresh_addons())
        dialog.exec()
        self.refresh_addons()

    def _open_addons_folder(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        path = addons_dir(info)
        try:
            path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.toast(f"无法创建目录：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(path)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 设置

    def _refresh_java_sources(self, _installs=None) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self._populate_java_combo(info)

    def _populate_java_combo(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        current = self.settings_java.currentData() if self.settings_java.count() else ""
        preferred = current or info.java_path or ""
        self.settings_java.blockSignals(True)
        self.settings_java.clear()
        self.settings_java.addItem("自动选择（推荐）", "")
        paths = {str(item.path) for item in self.main.java_installs}
        for java in self.main.java_installs:
            self.settings_java.addItem(java.display, java.path)
        if preferred and preferred not in paths:
            self.settings_java.addItem(f"已配置：{preferred}", preferred)
        index = self.settings_java.findData(preferred)
        self.settings_java.setCurrentIndex(index if index >= 0 else 0)
        self.settings_java.blockSignals(False)
        self._update_java_hint(info)

    def _update_java_hint_for_current(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self._update_java_hint(info)

    def _update_java_hint(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        required = required_java_major(info.mc_version)
        chosen = pick_java(
            self.main.java_installs,
            required,
            self.settings_java.currentData() or "",
        )
        if chosen is None:
            self.java_hint.setText(f"需要 Java {required}+")
            self.java_hint.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )
        else:
            self.java_hint.setText(f"Java {chosen.major} · 需要 {required}+")
            color = colors()["green"] if chosen.major >= required else colors()["orange"]
            self.java_hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px;")

    def _load_settings(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        self.settings_name.setText(info.name)
        self.settings_memory.setValue(max(1024, min(32768, info.memory_mb)))
        self.settings_port.setValue(max(1024, min(65535, info.port)))
        self.settings_online.setChecked(info.online_mode)
        self._populate_java_combo(info)
        self._update_eula_badge(info)
        self._update_online_hint()
        self._update_port_hint()
        self.reinstall_btn.setVisible(not info.installed or bool(info.install_error))
        if info.install_error and not info.installed:
            self.install_error_label.setText(f"上次安装失败：{info.install_error}")
            self.install_error_label.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['red']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )
            self.install_error_label.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.install_error_label.setVisible(False)

    def save_settings(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        name = self.settings_name.text().strip()
        if not name:
            self.toast("名称不能为空", "error")
            self.settings_name.setFocus()
            return
        running = info.folder in self._processes
        info.name = name
        info.memory_mb = int(self.settings_memory.value())
        info.port = int(self.settings_port.value())
        info.online_mode = self.settings_online.isChecked()
        info.java_path = str(self.settings_java.currentData() or "")
        try:
            save_server(info)
            update_server_properties(info)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.toast(f"保存失败：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.toast("服务端设置已保存", "success")
        if running:
            self.toast("设置会在重启服务端后生效", "info")
        self.refresh_servers(info.folder)
        self._update_online_hint()

    def _update_online_hint(self) -> None:
        if self.settings_online.isChecked():
            self.online_hint.setText("仅正版账户可进入")
        else:
            self.online_hint.setText("允许离线玩家进入")

    def _update_port_hint(self) -> None:
        port = int(self.settings_port.value())
        if check_port(port):
            self.port_hint.setText(f"端口 {port} 可用")
            self.port_hint.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['green']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )
        else:
            self.port_hint.setText(f"端口 {port} 已被占用，服务端可能无法启动")
            self.port_hint.setStyleSheet(
                f"color: {colors()['orange']}; font-size: 11px;"
            )

    def _update_eula_badge(self, info: ServerInfo) -> None:
        self.eula_badge.setText("已同意" if info.eula else "未同意")
        self.eula_badge.setProperty("badge", "green" if info.eula else "orange")
        repolish(self.eula_badge)
        self.eula_btn.setEnabled(not info.eula)

    def delete_server(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
        if process is not None and process.is_running:
            self.toast("请先停止服务端再删除", "error")
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "删除服务端",
            f"确定删除 {info.name} 吗？",
            primary_text="删除",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="trash",
            icon_color=colors()["red"],
            details=f"整个服务端文件夹（包括世界存档、插件和配置）将移动到回收站：\n{info.path}",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        ok, message = send_to_recycle_bin(info.path)
        if not ok:
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "删除失败",
                f"无法移动服务端文件夹：{message}",
                button_text="知道了",
                icon_name="warning",
            ).exec()
            return
        self._buffers.pop(info.folder, None)
        self._selected_folder = ""
        self.toast(message, "success")
        self.refresh_servers()

    def export_server_pack(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            self.toast("先选一个服务端，猫猫才有东西可打包", "info")
            return
        if self._state_of(info) != "stopped":
            self.toast("请先停止服务端再打包，避免存档正在写入", "error")
            return
        if self._install_worker is not None and self._install_folder == info.folder:
            self.toast("服务端还在安装，等装完再打包", "info")
            return
        from ..server_pack_dialog import ServerPackExportDialog

        ServerPackExportDialog(self.main, info).exec()

    def open_import_dialog(self, path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
        from ..server_pack_dialog import ServerPackImportDialog

        dialog = ServerPackImportDialog(self.main, initial_path=path)
        dialog.exec()
        if dialog.imported_folder:
            self.refresh_servers(dialog.imported_folder)
            self.toast("服务端已经导入，世界和玩家数据都搬过来了喵。", "success")

    def _open_server_folder(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self.main.open_path(info.path)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 重新安装

    def _retry_install(self) -> None:
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is None:
            return
        if self._install_worker is not None:
            self.toast("已有服务端安装任务正在进行", "info")
            return
        required = required_java_major(info.mc_version)
        java = pick_java(
            self.main.java_installs,
            required,
            info.java_path or self.main.config.java_path,
        )
        if java is None:
            self.toast("没有可用的 Java，无法安装", "error")
            return
        if info.kind in ("spigot", "forge", "neoforge") and java.major < required:
            self.toast(f"安装需要 Java {required}+", "error")
            return

        worker = ServerInstallWorker(
            info,
            java_path=java.path,
            accept_eula=info.eula,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
        )
        self._install_worker = worker
        self._install_folder = info.folder
        self.install_box.setVisible(True)
        self.install_progress.setValue(0)
        self.install_note.setText("正在准备重新安装…")
        self.tabs.set_value("console")
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self._append_console(info.folder, "开始重新安装服务端…")
        worker.progress.connect(
            lambda percent, message, f=info.folder: self._on_install_progress(
                f, percent, message
            )
        )
        worker.log_line.connect(
            lambda line, f=info.folder: self._append_console(f, line)
        )
        worker.finished.connect(
            lambda success, message, f=info.folder, w=worker: self._on_install_finished(
                f, success, message, w
            )
        )
        self._update_controls()
        self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"重装服务端 · {info.name}",
            content_type="server-install",
            target=info.path,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            metadata={
                "folder": info.folder,
                "name": info.name,
                "kind": info.kind,
                "ui_handled": True,
            },
            forward_log=False,
        )

    def _on_install_progress(self, folder: str, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        if folder != self._install_folder:
            return
        self.install_progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, int(percent))))
        self.install_note.setText(message)

    def _on_install_finished(
        self,
        folder: str,
        success: bool,
        message: str,
        worker: ServerInstallWorker,
    ) -> None:
        if worker is not self._install_worker:
            return
        self._install_worker = None
        self._install_folder = ""
        self.install_box.setVisible(False)
        self.refresh_servers(folder)
        if success:
            self.toast("服务端重新安装完成", "success")
        else:
            self.toast(f"安装失败：{message}", "error")
            NoticeDialog(
                self,
                "服务端安装失败",
                message,
                button_text="知道了",
                icon_name="warning",
            ).exec()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 对话框 / 生命周期

    def open_create_dialog(self) -> None:
        if self._install_worker is not None:
            self.toast("已有服务端安装任务正在进行", "info")
            return
        dialog = ServerCreateDialog(self.main)
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.server is not None:
            self.refresh_servers(dialog.server.folder)

    def _current_info(self) -> ServerInfo | None:
        return next(
            (
                info
                for info in self.servers
                if info.folder == self._selected_folder
            ),
            None,
        )

    def _on_tab_changed(self, value: str) -> None:
        index = {"console": 0, "addons": 1, "settings": 2}.get(value, 0)
        self.tab_stack.setCurrentIndex(index)
        if value == "addons":
            self.refresh_addons()
        elif value == "settings":
            info = self._current_info()
            if info is not None:
                self._load_settings(info)
                self._update_port_hint()

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self.create_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("plus", "#FFFFFF", 15))
        self.empty_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("plus", "#FFFFFF", 15))
        self.import_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("package", colors()["accent"], 15))
        self.empty_import_btn.setIcon(
            icons.icon("package", colors()["accent"], 15)
        )
        self.empty_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap("server", colors()["muted"], 46))
        self.start_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("play", "#FFFFFF", 15))
        self.stop_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("stop", "#FFFFFF", 13))
        self.pack_icon_btn.setIcon(
            icons.icon("package", colors()["text2"], 16)
        )
        self.pack_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("package", colors()["accent"], 14))
        self.addon_open_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("folder", colors()["text2"], 14))
        self.addon_download_btn.setIcon(
            icons.icon("download", colors()["accent"], 14)
        )
        for row in self._rows:
            row.refresh_theme()
        for label in self.findChildren(QLabel):
            if label.property("badge"):
                repolish(label)
        info = self._current_info()
        if info is not None:
            self._apply_detail_icon(info)
            self.detail_icon.setStyleSheet(
                f"background: {colors()['accent_soft']}; border-radius: 11px;"
            )
            self._update_online_hint()
            self._update_java_hint(info)
            self._update_port_hint()
            self._update_controls()

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self.main.ensure_java_detected()
        self.refresh_servers(self._selected_folder)
        self.refresh_addons()

    def running_server_names(self) -> list[str]:
        names: list[str] = []
        for info in self.servers:
            process = self._processes.get(info.folder)
            if process is not None and process.state != "stopped":
                names.append(info.name)
        return names

    def shutdown(self) -> None:
        worker = self._install_worker
        if worker is not None:
            try:
                worker.cancel()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._install_worker = None
        processes = list(self._processes.values())
        if not processes:
            return
        for process in processes:
            try:
                process.stop(6)
            except Exception:
                pass
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 6
        for process in processes:
            remaining = max(0.2, deadline - time.monotonic())
            process.wait(remaining)
        for process in processes:
            proc = process.process
            if proc is None or proc.poll() is not None:
                continue
            try:
                proc.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                proc.wait(timeout=1)
            except Exception:
                try:
                    proc.kill()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        self._processes.clear()

    def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        self.main.toast(text, kind)

def _total_ram_mb() -> int:
    try:
        class MEMORYSTATUSEX(ctypes.Structure):
            _fields_ = [
                ("dwLength", ctypes.c_ulong),
                ("dwMemoryLoad", ctypes.c_ulong),
                ("ullTotalPhys", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullAvailPhys", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullTotalPageFile", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullAvailPageFile", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullTotalVirtual", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullAvailVirtual", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
                ("ullAvailExtendedVirtual", ctypes.c_ulonglong),
            ]

        stat = MEMORYSTATUSEX()
        stat.dwLength = ctypes.sizeof(MEMORYSTATUSEX)
        if ctypes.windll.kernel32.GlobalMemoryStatusEx(ctypes.byref(stat)):
            return int(stat.ullTotalPhys / 1024 / 1024)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return 16384
