    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def refresh_account(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        self.client_edit.setText(self.main.config.microsoft_client_id)
        self.email_edit.setText(self.main.config.microsoft_email)
        if account.is_msa:
            self.account_badge.setText("微软正版")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.account_name.setText(account.name or "正版账户")
            uid = account.uuid or ""
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}" if uid else "已登录 Microsoft 账户"
            )
            self.login_btn.setText("重新登录")
            self.verify_btn.setVisible(False)
            self.logout_btn.setVisible(True)
        else:
            self.account_badge.setText("离线模式")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            self.account_name.setText(f"离线账户 · {self.main.config.player_name}")
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                "未登录 Microsoft 账户，启动时使用上面的离线名称。"
            )
            self.login_btn.setText("邮箱登录")
            self.verify_btn.setVisible(True)
            self.logout_btn.setVisible(False)
        repolish(self.account_badge)

    def _save_client_id(self) -> None:
        value = self.client_edit.text().strip()
        if value == self.main.config.microsoft_client_id:
            return
        self.main.config.microsoft_client_id = value
        self.main.config.save()

    def _save_email(self) -> None:
        value = self.email_edit.text().strip()
        if value == self.main.config.microsoft_email:
            return
        self.main.config.microsoft_email = value
        self.main.config.save()

    def _open_azure_portal(self) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(
            QUrl(
                "https://portal.azure.com/#view/"
                "Microsoft_AAD_RegisteredApps/ApplicationsListBlade"
            )
        )

    def _login_microsoft(self) -> None:
        client_id = self.client_edit.text().strip()
        try:
            client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
        except MicrosoftAuthError as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            self.client_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self._save_client_id()
        self._save_email()
        dialog = BrowserLoginDialog(
            self.main, client_id, self.main.config.microsoft_email
        )
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.account is not None:
            self._apply_account(dialog.account)

    def _login_device_code(self) -> None:
        client_id = self.client_edit.text().strip()
        try:
            client_id = normalize_client_id(client_id)
        except MicrosoftAuthError as exc:
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            self.client_edit.setFocus()
            return
        self._save_client_id()
        dialog = MicrosoftLoginDialog(self.main, client_id)
        if dialog.exec() and dialog.account is not None:
            self._apply_account(dialog.account)

    def _apply_account(self, account) -> None:
        self.main.config.account = account.to_config()
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self.main.toast(f"已登录 Microsoft 账户：{account.name}", "success")

    def _logout_microsoft(self) -> None:
        if not self.main.current_account().is_msa:
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "退出正版账户",
            "退出后将以离线账户启动游戏，正版服务器将无法进入。确定退出吗？",
            primary_text="退出登录",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="warning",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self.main.config.account = {}
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self.main.toast("已退出正版账户", "info")

    def _save_isolation(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        checked = bool(checked)
        if checked == bool(self.main.config.version_isolation):
            return
        self.main.config.version_isolation = checked
        self.main.config.save()
        if hasattr(self.main, "mods_page"):
            self.main.mods_page.on_show()
        self.main.toast(
            "版本隔离已开启，新的 Mod 会进入版本目录"
            if checked
            else "版本隔离已关闭，将使用游戏目录下的公共 mods",
            "success",
        )

    def _browse_game_dir(self) -> None:
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self, "选择 .minecraft 文件夹", str(self.main.config.game_path)
        )
        if not folder:
            return
        self.main.config.game_dir = folder
        self.main.config.save()
        self.game_dir.setText(folder)
        self.main.refresh_versions()
        self.main.toast("游戏目录已更新", "success")

    def _save_name(self) -> None:
        name = self.name_edit.text().strip()
        if name == self.main.config.player_name:
            return
        if not valid_player_name(name):
            self.main.toast("名称需为 3-16 位字母、数字或下划线", "error")
            self.name_edit.setText(self.main.config.player_name)
            return
        self.main.config.player_name = name
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()
        self.main.toast("玩家名称已更新", "success")

    def _on_memory(self, value: int) -> None:
        value = int(round(value / 512) * 512)
        self.memory_value.setText(f"{value} MB · {value / 1024:.1f} GB")
        if value != self.main.config.memory_mb:
            self.main.config.memory_mb = value
            if hasattr(self, "_save_timer"):
                self._save_timer.start(350)

    def _populate_java(self, installs: list[JavaInfo]) -> None:
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.java_combo.clear()
        self.java_combo.addItem("自动选择（推荐）", "")
        paths: set[str] = set()
        for info in installs:
            self.java_combo.addItem(info.display, info.path)
            paths.add(info.path.lower())
        config_path = self.main.config.java_path
        if config_path and config_path.lower() not in paths:
            self.java_combo.addItem(
                f"手动指定 · {config_path}", config_path
            )
        if config_path:
            index = self.java_combo.findData(config_path)
            if index >= 0:
                self.java_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(False)

        if installs:
            self.java_hint.setText(
                f"已检测到 {len(installs)} 个 Java。"
                "启动时会自动选择满足版本要求的最低版本。"
            )
        else:
            self.java_hint.setText(
                "未检测到 Java。请安装 Java 运行环境，或手动选择 java.exe。"
            )
        self._update_java_requirement()

    def _update_java_requirement(self) -> None:
        profile_id, _instance_id = self.main.launch_profile(
            self.main.selected_version
        )
        summary = next(
            (v for v in self.main.versions if v.id == profile_id),
            None,
        )
        if summary and summary.java_major and self.main.java_installs:
            self.java_hint.setText(
                f"当前版本 {self.main.selected_version or summary.id} 需要 Java "
                f"{summary.java_major}+，"
                f"已检测到 {len(self.main.java_installs)} 个 Java。"
            )

    def _on_java_changed(self, _index: int) -> None:
        path = self.java_combo.currentData() or ""
        if path == self.main.config.java_path:
            return
        self.main.config.java_path = path
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast("Java 设置已保存", "success")

    def _browse_java(self) -> None:
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, "选择 java.exe", "", "Java 可执行文件 (java.exe);;所有文件 (*)"
        )
        if not path:
            return
        info = probe_java(path)
        if info is None:
            self.main.toast("无法运行该 Java，请确认路径是否正确", "error")
            return
        self.main.config.java_path = path
        self.main.config.save()
        self._populate_java(self.main.java_installs)
        self.main.toast(f"已选择 Java {info.version}", "success")

    def _rescan_java(self) -> None:
        self.java_hint.setText("正在检测 Java…")
        self.main.ensure_java_detected(force=True)

    def _save_jvm_args(self) -> None:
        text = self.jvm_edit.text().strip()
        if text != self.main.config.jvm_args:
            self.main.config.jvm_args = text
            self.main.config.save()
            self.main.toast("JVM 参数已保存", "success")

    def _save_source(self, _index: int) -> None:
        source = self.source_combo.currentData() or "official"
        if source == self.main.config.download_source:
            return
        self.main.config.download_source = source
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast("下载源已更新，下次安装生效", "success")

    def _save_threads(self, _index: int) -> None:
        value = int(self.thread_combo.currentData() or 8)
        value = max(1, min(16, value))
        if value == self.main.config.download_threads:
            return
        self.main.config.download_threads = value
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast(f"下载线程已设为 {value}，下次下载生效", "success")

    def refresh_shortcut_state(self) -> None:
        from ...shortcut import shortcut_exists

        exists = shortcut_exists()
        self.shortcut_btn.setText(
            "重新创建快捷方式" if exists else "创建桌面快捷方式"
        )
        self.shortcut_btn.setToolTip(
            "覆盖桌面上已有的同名快捷方式"
            if exists
            else "在桌面创建 Darkitten Launcher 快捷方式"
        )

    def _create_shortcut(self) -> None:
        self.main.create_desktop_shortcut()

    def _cleanup_partials(self) -> None:
        if self._cleanup_worker is not None:
            return
        if self.main.install_active:
            self.main.toast("有安装任务正在进行，请先完成或取消安装", "info")
            return
        root = self.main.config.game_path
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self,
            "清理下载残留",
            "将扫描游戏目录，删除未完成的 .part 分片临时文件。"
            "已下载完成的文件不会受影响。",
            primary_text="开始清理",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="trash",
            icon_color=colors()["orange"],
            details=f"扫描目录：{root}",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return
        self.cleanup_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.cleanup_btn.setText("正在清理…")
        self.main.set_status("正在清理下载残留…", "busy")
        worker = CleanupWorker(root, self)
        self._cleanup_worker = worker
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_cleanup_finished)
        worker.start()

    def _on_cleanup_finished(self, removed: int, freed: int) -> None:
        self._cleanup_worker = None
        self.cleanup_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.cleanup_btn.setText("清理下载残留")
        if removed:
            size = (
                f"{freed / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB"
                if freed >= 1024 * 1024
                else f"{max(0, freed) / 1024:.0f} KB"
            )
            self.main.set_status(f"已清理 {removed} 个下载残留", "success")
            self.main.toast(f"已清理 {removed} 个临时文件（{size}）", "success")
        else:
            self.main.set_status("没有发现下载残留", "idle")
            self.main.toast("没有发现未完成的下载文件", "info")

    def _save_theme(self, theme_value: str) -> None:
        if theme_value == self.main.config.theme:
            return
        self.main.config.theme = theme_value
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.apply_theme(theme_value)

    def _save_auto(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        if bool(self.main.config.auto_complete) == bool(checked):
            return
        self.main.config.auto_complete = bool(checked)
        self.main.config.save()

    def refresh_update_state(self) -> None:
        if not hasattr(self, "update_status"):
            return
        palette = {
            "idle": colors()["muted"],
            "busy": colors()["accent"],
            "accent": colors()["accent"],
            "success": colors()["green"],
            "error": colors()["red"],
        }
        color = palette.get(self.main.update_state_kind, colors()["muted"])
        self.update_status.setText(self.main.update_state_text)
        self.update_status.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;"
        )
        last = str(self.main.config.update_last_check or "").strip()
        self.update_status.setToolTip(
            f"上次检查：{last}" if last else "还没有检查过更新"
        )
        busy = bool(getattr(self.main, "_update_busy", False))
        self.update_btn.setEnabled(not busy)
        self.update_btn.setText("正在检查…" if busy else "检查更新")
        self.update_auto_switch.setChecked(
            bool(self.main.config.update_auto_check)
        )
        self.update_url_edit.setText(DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL)

    def _check_updates(self) -> None:
        self.main.check_for_updates(manual=True)

    def _open_update_site(self) -> None:
        self.main.open_update_site()

    def _save_update_auto(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        if bool(self.main.config.update_auto_check) == bool(checked):
            return
        self.main.config.update_auto_check = bool(checked)
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.toast(
            "启动时会自动检查更新" if checked else "已关闭启动时自动检查更新",
            "success",
        )

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self.refresh_account()
        self.isolation_switch.setChecked(bool(self.main.config.version_isolation))
        source_index = self.source_combo.findData(self.main.config.download_source)
        self.source_combo.setCurrentIndex(max(0, source_index))
        thread_index = self.thread_combo.findData(self.main.config.download_threads)
        if thread_index >= 0:
            self.thread_combo.setCurrentIndex(thread_index)
        self._populate_java(self.main.java_installs)
        self.refresh_shortcut_state()
        self.refresh_update_state()
        self.main.ensure_java_detected()

def _rounded_face(image: QImage, size: int = 48) -> QPixmap:
    if image.isNull():
        image = default_skin()
    face = image.copy(8, 8, 8, 8)
    scaled = face.scaled(
        size, size, Qt.IgnoreAspectRatio, Qt.FastTransformation
    )
    canvas = QImage(size, size, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    canvas.fill(Qt.transparent)
    painter = QPainter(canvas)
    painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
    path = QPainterPath()
    path.addRoundedRect(0.5, 0.5, size - 1, size - 1, 11, 11)
    painter.setClipPath(path)
    painter.drawImage(0, 0, scaled)
    painter.end()
    return QPixmap.fromImage(canvas)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _load_initial_skin(self) -> None:
        candidates: list[Path] = []
        configured = self.main.config.skin_path.strip()
        if configured:
            candidates.append(Path(configured))
        local = local_skin_path()
        if local not in candidates:
            candidates.append(local)

        for path in candidates:
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            try:
                skin = load_skin_file(path)
            except SkinError as exc:
                self._set_status(str(exc), "error")
                continue
            self._skin_file = skin
            if skin.legacy and self.variant_tabs.current() == "slim":
                self.variant_tabs.set_value("classic")
                self.main.config.skin_variant = "classic"
                self.main.config.save()
            self._show_skin(skin.image, skin.legacy)
            self.file_edit.setText(str(path))
            self.file_edit.setToolTip(str(path))
            return

        self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
        self.current_label.setText("使用默认皮肤预览。选择本地 PNG 即可开始。")

    def _show_skin(self, image: QImage, legacy: bool) -> None:
        self.preview.set_skin(image, legacy)
        self.preview.set_variant(self.main.config.skin_variant)
        self.size_badge.setText("64×32 · 旧版" if legacy else "64×64")
        self.size_badge.setProperty("badge", "orange" if legacy else "blue")
        self._update_model_badge()
        self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(image, 48))
        repolish(self.size_badge)

    def _update_model_badge(self) -> None:
        variant = self.variant_tabs.current()
        self.model_badge.setText("Slim" if variant == "slim" else "Classic")
        self.model_badge.setProperty("badge", "purple" if variant == "slim" else "gray")
        repolish(self.model_badge)

    def _apply_local_file(self, path: str | Path, *, original: str = "") -> None:
        try:
            skin = load_skin_file(path)
            saved = save_local_skin(skin)
        except SkinError as exc:
            self._set_status(str(exc), "error")
            self.main.toast(str(exc), "error")
            return
        self._skin_file = skin
        legacy_note = ""
        if skin.legacy:
            if self.variant_tabs.current() != "classic":
                self.variant_tabs.set_value("classic")
            legacy_note = " 旧版 64×32 皮肤只支持 Classic 模型。"
        self.main.config.skin_variant = "classic" if skin.legacy else self.variant_tabs.current()
        self.main.config.skin_path = str(saved)
        self.main.config.save()
        self._show_skin(skin.image, skin.legacy)
        self.file_edit.setText(original or str(Path(path)))
        self.file_edit.setToolTip(
            f"原始文件：{original or path}\n预览副本：{saved}"
        )
        self.current_label.setText(
            "本地皮肤已就绪，可以预览 3D 效果。"
            + ("点击“上传并使用”同步到正版账户。" if self.main.current_account().is_msa else "离线模式下只能预览。")
            + legacy_note
        )
        self._set_status(f"已加载皮肤：{Path(original or path).name}{legacy_note}", "success")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    def _choose_skin(self) -> None:
        start = str(Path.home() / "Pictures")
        configured = self.main.config.skin_path.strip()
        if configured:
            parent = Path(configured).parent
            if parent.is_dir():
                start = str(parent)
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "选择 Minecraft 皮肤",
            start,
            "Minecraft 皮肤 (*.png)",
        )
        if path:
            self._apply_local_file(path, original=path)

    def _on_variant_changed(self, value: str) -> None:
        if value == "slim" and self.preview.is_legacy():
            self.variant_tabs.set_value("classic")
            value = "classic"
            self._set_status(
                "64×32 旧版皮肤没有独立的细手臂纹理，已保持 Classic 模型。",
                "info",
            )
        self.main.config.skin_variant = "slim" if value == "slim" else "classic"
        self.main.config.save()
        self.preview.set_variant(value)
        self._update_model_badge()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _set_status(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        color = {
            "error": colors()["red"],
            "success": colors()["green"],
            "busy": colors()["accent"],
            "info": colors()["muted"],
        }.get(kind, colors()["muted"])
        self.status_label.setText(text)
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {color}; font-size: 11px;")

    def _update_buttons(self) -> None:
        online = self.main.current_account().is_msa
        available = not self._busy
        has_file = self._skin_file is not None
        self.refresh_skin_btn.setEnabled(online and available)
        self.reset_skin_btn.setEnabled(online and available)
        self.upload_btn.setEnabled(online and available and has_file)
        self.select_btn.setEnabled(available)
        if not online and available:
            self.upload_btn.setToolTip("登录 Microsoft 正版账户后才能上传皮肤")
        else:
            self.upload_btn.setToolTip(
                "" if has_file else "请先选择一张 64×64 或 64×32 的 PNG 皮肤"
            )

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool, text: str = "") -> None:
        self._busy = busy
        if text:
            self._set_status(text, "busy")
        self._update_buttons()

    def _save_account(self, account) -> None:
        self.main.config.account = account.to_config()
        self.main.config.save()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    def _client_id(self, silent: bool = False) -> str | None:
        client_id = str(self.main.config.microsoft_client_id or "").strip()
        if not client_id:
            if not silent:
                self.main.toast("请先在设置中填写 Azure 客户端 ID", "error")
                self.main.switch_page("settings")
            return None
        return client_id

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _fetch_current_skin(self, silent: bool = False) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if not account.is_msa:
            if not silent:
                self.main.toast("请先登录 Microsoft 正版账户", "info")
            return
        if self._busy:
            return
        client_id = self._client_id(silent=silent)
        if client_id is None:
            return
        self._auto_fetch_done.add(account.uuid or account.name)
        self._set_busy(True, "正在读取正版皮肤…")
        worker = SkinFetchWorker(account, client_id, self)
        self._fetch_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(lambda text: self._set_status(text, "busy"))
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_skin_loaded)
        worker.start()

    def _on_skin_loaded(self, skin, account, error: str) -> None:
        self._fetch_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._save_account(account)
        if error:
            self._set_status(f"读取皮肤失败：{error}", "error")
            self._update_buttons()
            return
        if skin is None:
            self._current_skin = None
            self.current_label.setText("该正版账户目前使用默认皮肤（Steve/Alex）。")
            self._set_status("账户当前没有自定义皮肤。", "info")
            if self._skin_file is None:
                self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
            self._update_buttons()
            return
        self._current_skin = skin
        if skin.image.height() == 32:
            skin.variant = "classic"
        self.main.config.skin_variant = (
            "slim" if skin.variant == "slim" else "classic"
        )
        self.main.config.save()
        self.variant_tabs.set_value(self.main.config.skin_variant)
        if self._skin_file is None:
            self._show_skin(skin.image, skin.image.height() == 32)
        else:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(skin.image, 48))
            self._update_model_badge()
        self.current_label.setText(
            f"正版当前皮肤 · {variant_text(skin.variant)}"
            + (f" · {skin.alias}" if skin.alias else "")
        )
        if not self.main.config.skin_path.strip():
            try:
                local = local_skin_path()
                if skin.image.save(str(local), "PNG"):
                    self.main.config.skin_path = str(local)
                    self.main.config.save()
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._set_status("已读取正版账户当前皮肤。", "success")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    def _upload_skin(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if not account.is_msa:
            self.main.toast("请先登录 Microsoft 正版账户", "error")
            return
        if self._busy:
            return
        if self._skin_file is None:
            self.main.toast("请先选择一张本地 PNG 皮肤", "info")
            return
        client_id = self._client_id()
        if client_id is None:
            return
        variant = self.variant_tabs.current()
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "上传并更换皮肤",
            f"将把当前预览的皮肤上传到 {account.name or '正版账户'}，"
            "并立即替换该账户正在使用的 Minecraft 皮肤。",
            primary_text="上传并使用",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="shirt",
            details="上传后通常几秒内生效；其他玩家和皮肤站点的缓存可能需要更长时间同步。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return

        self._set_busy(True, "正在准备上传皮肤…")
        worker = SkinUploadWorker(
            account, client_id, self._skin_file.data, variant, self
        )
        self._upload_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(lambda text: self._set_status(text, "busy"))
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_skin_uploaded)
        worker.start()

    def _on_skin_uploaded(self, success: bool, message: str, account) -> None:
        self._upload_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._save_account(account)
        if success:
            if self._skin_file is not None:
                self._current_skin = CurrentSkin(
                    image=self._skin_file.image,
                    variant=self.variant_tabs.current(),
                )
                self.current_label.setText(
                    f"正版当前皮肤 · 刚刚上传 · {variant_text(self.variant_tabs.current())}"
                )
            self._set_status(message, "success")
            self.main.toast(message, "success")
        else:
            self._set_status(f"上传失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"皮肤上传失败：{message}", "error")
        self._update_buttons()

    def _reset_skin(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if not account.is_msa:
            self.main.toast("请先登录 Microsoft 正版账户", "error")
            return
        if self._busy:
            return
        client_id = self._client_id()
        if client_id is None:
            return
        dialog = ConfirmDialog(
            self.main,
            "恢复默认皮肤",
            f"将移除 {account.name or '该账户'} 当前的自定义皮肤，恢复为默认皮肤。",
            primary_text="恢复默认",
            secondary_text="取消",
            icon_name="warning",
            details="这个操作会修改正版账户皮肤，但不会删除启动器 skins 文件夹中的本地图片。",
        )
        if not dialog.exec():
            return

        self._set_busy(True, "正在恢复默认皮肤…")
        worker = SkinResetWorker(account, client_id, self)
        self._reset_worker = worker
        worker.status.connect(lambda text: self._set_status(text, "busy"))
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_skin_reset)
        worker.start()

    def _on_skin_reset(self, success: bool, message: str, account) -> None:
        self._reset_worker = None
        self._busy = False
        self._save_account(account)
        if success:
            self._current_skin = None
            self._skin_file = None
            self.main.config.skin_path = ""
            self.main.config.save()
            self.file_edit.clear()
            self.file_edit.setToolTip("")
            self.current_label.setText("正版账户已恢复默认皮肤。")
            self._show_skin(default_skin(), False)
            self._set_status(message, "success")
            self.main.toast(message, "success")
        else:
            self._set_status(f"恢复失败：{message}", "error")
            self.main.toast(f"恢复默认皮肤失败：{message}", "error")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.main.account_changed.emit()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def refresh_account(self) -> None:
        account = self.main.current_account()
        self.main.config.skin_variant = self.variant_tabs.current()
        if account.is_msa:
            self.account_badge.setText("微软正版")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.mode_badge.setText("正版账户")
            self.mode_badge.setProperty("badge", "green")
            self.account_name.setText(account.name or "正版账户")
            uid = account.uuid or ""
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]}" if uid else "已登录 Microsoft 账户"
            )
        else:
            self.account_badge.setText("离线预览")
            self.account_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            self.mode_badge.setText("离线模式")
            self.mode_badge.setProperty("badge", "gray")
            name = self.main.config.player_name
            self.account_name.setText(f"离线预览 · {name}")
            uid = offline_uuid(name)
            self.account_uuid.setText(
                f"UUID {uid[:8]}…{uid[-4:]} · 登录正版后可上传皮肤"
            )
        repolish(self.account_badge)
        repolish(self.mode_badge)
        if not self._busy:
            online = account.is_msa
            if self._current_skin is not None and online:
                self._set_status("正版账户已连接，可以上传或恢复皮肤。", "info")
            elif not online:
                self._set_status("离线模式仅支持本地预览，不会修改任何账户。", "info")
            elif self._skin_file is not None:
                self._set_status("本地皮肤已就绪，可以上传。", "info")
            else:
                self._set_status("可以点击“读取正版皮肤”查看账户当前效果。", "info")
        self._update_buttons()
        self.preview.update()

    def on_show(self) -> None:
        self.refresh_account()
        account = self.main.current_account()
        if not account.is_msa:
            return
        key = account.uuid or account.name
        if self._skin_file is None and key not in self._auto_fetch_done:
            self._auto_fetch_done.add(key)
            self._fetch_current_skin(silent=True)

    def refresh_theme(self) -> None:
        self.preview.update()
        if self._skin_file is not None:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(self._skin_file.image, 48))
        elif self._current_skin is not None:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(self._current_skin.image, 48))
        else:
            self.face_label.setPixmap(_rounded_face(default_skin(), 48))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _open_skin_folder(self) -> None:
        try:
            SKIN_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建皮肤文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(SKIN_DIR)

    @staticmethod
    def _open_url(url: str) -> None:
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(url))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def dragEnterEvent(self, event) -> None:
        urls = event.mimeData().urls()
        if any(url.toLocalFile().lower().endswith(".png") for url in urls):
            event.acceptProposedAction()
            return
        super().dragEnterEvent(event)

    def dropEvent(self, event) -> None:
        for url in event.mimeData().urls():
            path = url.toLocalFile()
            if path.lower().endswith(".png"):
                self._apply_local_file(path, original=path)
                event.acceptProposedAction()
                return
        super().dropEvent(event)

    def reject(self) -> None:
        worker = self._download_worker
        if worker is not None:
            self._download_worker = None
            try:
                worker.finished.disconnect(self._on_download_finished)
            except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
                pass
            worker.cancel()
        super().reject()

    @staticmethod
    def _meta_row(layout: QVBoxLayout, title: str) -> QLabel:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(6)
        label = QLabel(title)
        label.setObjectName("Tiny")
        label.setFixedWidth(48)
        value = QLabel("—")
        value.setObjectName("Tiny")
        value.setWordWrap(True)
        row.addWidget(label, 0, Qt.AlignTop)
        row.addWidget(value, 1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return value

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _search(self, page: int = 0) -> None:
        if self._polling:
            return
        page = max(0, int(page))
        self._polling = True
        self.search_btn.setEnabled(False)
        offset = page * PAGE_SIZE
        self._update_pager()
        if page == 0:
            self._render_results(loading=True)
        worker = ServerAddonSearchWorker(
            self.search.text().strip(),
            self.server.kind,
            self.server.mc_version,
            offset,
            PAGE_SIZE,
            self,
        )
        self._search_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, used, w=worker: self._search_ready(w, data, error, used)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _search_ready(self, worker, data, error: str, offset: int) -> None:
        if worker is not self._search_worker:
            return
        self._polling = False
        self.search_btn.setEnabled(True)
        if error or data is None:
            self._render_results(message=f"搜索失败：{_short(error, 70)}")
            return
        hits = [hit for hit in data.get("hits") or [] if isinstance(hit, dict)]
        self._hits = hits
        self._page = offset // PAGE_SIZE
        self._total = int(data.get("total_hits") or len(hits))
        self._render_results()
        if hits:
            first = str(hits[0].get("project_id") or hits[0].get("slug") or "")
            if first:
                self._select_project(first, hits[0])
        else:
            self._selected_project = ""
            self._project = None
            self._hit = None
            self._clear_detail("没有找到匹配的项目。")

    def _render_results(self, loading: bool = False, message: str = "") -> None:
        while self.results_layout.count() > 1:
            item = self.results_layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget:
                widget.setParent(None)
                widget.deleteLater()
        self._rows.clear()

        if loading:
            hint = QLabel("正在搜索 Modrinth…")
            hint.setObjectName("Tiny")
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.results_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
        elif message:
            hint = QLabel(message)
            hint.setObjectName("Muted")
            hint.setWordWrap(True)
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.results_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
        elif not self._hits:
            hint = QLabel(f"没有找到匹配的服务端{self.server.addon_label}。")
            hint.setObjectName("Muted")
            hint.setWordWrap(True)
            hint.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
            self.results_layout.insertWidget(0, hint)
        else:
            for hit in self._hits:
                row = ModResultRow(hit, self.server.kind)
                row.clicked.connect(
                    lambda project_id, h=hit: self._select_project(project_id, h)
                )
                row.set_selected(
                    str(hit.get("project_id") or hit.get("slug") or "")
                    == self._selected_project
                )
                self.results_layout.insertWidget(self.results_layout.count() - 1, row)
                self._rows.append(row)
                icon_url = str(hit.get("icon_url") or "")
                if icon_url:
                    image = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(icon_url)
                    if image is not None:
                        row.set_icon(image)
                    else:
                        self._load_image(icon_url, lambda img, r=row: r.set_icon(img))
        self._sync_results_height()
        self._update_pager()

    def _sync_results_height(self) -> None:
        self.results_layout.activate()
        self.results_holder.setMinimumHeight(self.results_layout.sizeHint().height())

    def _update_pager(self) -> None:
        pages = max(1, (self._total + PAGE_SIZE - 1) // PAGE_SIZE)
        current = min(self._page + 1, pages)
        self.page_label.setText(f"第 {current} / {pages} 页" if self._total else "第 1 页")
        self.result_count.setText(f"共 {self._total} 个" if self._total else "")
        self.prev_btn.setEnabled(not self._polling and self._page > 0)
        self.next_btn.setEnabled(
            not self._polling and (self._page + 1) * PAGE_SIZE < self._total
        )

    def _prev_page(self) -> None:
        if self._page > 0 and not self._polling:
            self._search(self._page - 1)

    def _next_page(self) -> None:
        if not self._polling and (self._page + 1) * PAGE_SIZE < self._total:
            self._search(self._page + 1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _select_project(
        self, project_id: str, hit: dict, *, keep_nav: bool = False
    ) -> None:
        if not project_id:
            return
        if not keep_nav:
            self._nav_stack.clear()
            self._pending_project_id = ""
            self._pending_version_id = ""
        self._selected_project = project_id
        self._hit = hit
        for row in self._rows:
            row.set_selected(row.project_id == project_id)
        same = self._project is not None and str(self._project.get("id") or "") == project_id
        if not same:
            self._project = None
            worker = ModProjectWorker(project_id, self)
            self._project_worker = worker
            worker.ready.connect(self._project_ready)
            worker.start()

        self.detail_title.setText(str(hit.get("title") or hit.get("slug") or "项目"))
        author = str(hit.get("author") or "")
        categories = [str(item) for item in hit.get("categories") or [] if item]
        meta_parts = []
        if author:
            meta_parts.append(f"作者：{author}")
        if categories:
            meta_parts.append(f"分类：{', '.join(categories[:3])}")
        self.detail_author.setText(" · ".join(meta_parts) or "Modrinth")
        self.detail_desc.setText(str(hit.get("description") or ""))
        self.downloads_badge.setText(f"{_human_number(hit.get('downloads'))} 下载")
        self.followers_badge.setText("0 关注")
        self.updated_label.setText("")
        self.version_combo.clear()
        self.version_combo.setEnabled(False)
        self.version_combo.addItem("正在获取可用文件…", "")
        self._sync_download_button()
        self.dep_label.setText("")
        self.dep_bar.set_state(
            [], show_back=bool(self._nav_stack), projects=self._dep_projects
        )
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.body_excerpt.setText("")
        for label in (
            self.meta_categories,
            self.meta_loaders,
            self.meta_versions,
            self.meta_license,
        ):
            label.setText("—")
        self._set_detail_icon(str(hit.get("icon_url") or ""))

        versions_worker = ServerAddonVersionsWorker(
            project_id, self.server.kind, self.server.mc_version, self
        )
        self._versions_worker = versions_worker
        versions_worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=versions_worker, pid=project_id: self._versions_ready(
                w, pid, data, error
            )
        )
        versions_worker.start()

    def _project_ready(self, project_id: str, data, error: str) -> None:
        if project_id != self._selected_project or error or not isinstance(data, dict):
            return
        self._project = data
        title = str(data.get("title") or self.detail_title.text())
        self.detail_title.setText(title)
        description = str(data.get("description") or "")
        if description:
            self.detail_desc.setText(description)
        categories = [str(item) for item in data.get("categories") or [] if item]
        author = str((self._hit or {}).get("author") or "")
        meta_parts = []
        if author:
            meta_parts.append(f"作者：{author}")
        if categories:
            meta_parts.append(f"分类：{', '.join(categories[:3])}")
        if meta_parts:
            self.detail_author.setText(" · ".join(meta_parts))
        self.downloads_badge.setText(f"{_human_number(data.get('downloads'))} 下载")
        self.followers_badge.setText(f"{_human_number(data.get('followers'))} 关注")
        updated = str(data.get("updated") or "")[:10]
        self.updated_label.setText(f"更新于 {updated}" if updated else "")
        self.meta_categories.setText(" / ".join(categories[:5]) or "—")
        loaders = [str(item) for item in data.get("loaders") or [] if item]
        self.meta_loaders.setText(" / ".join(loaders[:4]) or "—")
        versions = [str(item) for item in data.get("game_versions") or [] if item]
        text = "、".join(versions[:8])
        if len(versions) > 8:
            text += f" 等 {len(versions)} 个"
        self.meta_versions.setText(text or "—")
        license_data = data.get("license")
        if isinstance(license_data, dict):
            license_text = str(license_data.get("name") or license_data.get("id") or "")
        else:
            license_text = str(license_data or "")
        self.meta_license.setText(license_text or "—")
        excerpt = _plain_excerpt(str(data.get("body") or ""), 260)
        self.body_excerpt.setText(excerpt)
        self.body_excerpt.setVisible(bool(excerpt))
        self._set_detail_icon(
            str(data.get("icon_url") or (self._hit or {}).get("icon_url") or "")
        )

    def _versions_ready(self, worker, project_id: str, data, error: str) -> None:
        if worker is not self._versions_worker or project_id != self._selected_project:
            return
        preferred = (
            self._pending_version_id
            if project_id == self._pending_project_id
            else ""
        )
        self._pending_project_id = ""
        self._pending_version_id = ""

        self.version_combo.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            self.version_combo.clear()
            if error:
                self.version_combo.addItem("获取版本失败", "")
                self.dep_label.setText(error)
                self.dep_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']};")
                self._sync_download_button()
                return
            if not data:
                self.version_combo.addItem("没有适配当前服务端的文件", "")
                self.dep_label.setText(
                    f"该项目没有适配 {self.server.type_name} {self.server.mc_version} 的文件，"
                    "可以尝试搜索其他项目。"
                )
                self.dep_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['orange']};")
                self._sync_download_button()
                return
            target_index = 0
            for index, version in enumerate(data):
                file = primary_file(version) or {}
                version_number = str(
                    version.get("version_number") or version.get("name") or ""
                )
                filename = str(file.get("filename") or "")
                version_type = str(version.get("version_type") or "")
                suffix = f" · {version_type}" if version_type else ""
                self.version_combo.addItem(
                    f"{_short(version_number, 34)}{suffix}", version
                )
                tip = f"{version_number}\n{filename}" if filename else version_number
                self.version_combo.setItemData(index, tip, Qt.ToolTipRole)
                if preferred and str(version.get("id") or "") == preferred:
                    target_index = index
            self.version_combo.setCurrentIndex(target_index)
            self.version_combo.setEnabled(True)
        finally:
            self.version_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self.dep_label.setStyleSheet("")
        self._on_version_changed()

    def _on_version_changed(self) -> None:
        self._update_dependencies()
        self._sync_download_button()

    def _update_dependencies(self) -> None:
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if not isinstance(version, dict):
            self.dep_bar.set_state(
                [], show_back=bool(self._nav_stack), projects=self._dep_projects
            )
            return
        deps = required_dependencies(version)
        visible = [dep for dep in deps if str(dep.get("project_id") or "")]
        file = primary_file(version) or {}
        size = int(file.get("size") or 0)
        parts = []
        if size:
            parts.append(f"{size / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB")
        if visible:
            parts.append(
                f"需要 {len(visible)} 个前置 {self.server.addon_label}，"
                "点击下方按钮直接下载"
            )
        elif deps:
            parts.append(f"声明了 {len(deps)} 个必需前置，请确认已一并安装")
        else:
            parts.append("没有声明必需前置")
        self.dep_label.setText(" · ".join(parts))
        self.dep_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"color: {colors()['orange']};" if deps else ""
        )
        if visible:
            self._request_dependency_projects(visible)
        self.dep_bar.set_state(
            visible,
            show_back=bool(self._nav_stack),
            projects=self._dep_projects,
        )

    def _request_dependency_projects(self, deps: list[dict]) -> None:
        ids = [
            str(dep.get("project_id") or "")
            for dep in deps
            if isinstance(dep, dict)
        ]
        ids = [
            project_id
            for project_id in dict.fromkeys(ids)
            if project_id
            and project_id not in self._dep_projects
            and project_id not in self._dep_projects_pending
        ]
        if not ids:
            return
        self._dep_projects_pending.update(ids)
        worker = ModProjectsWorker(ids, self)
        self._dep_projects_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=worker: self._dep_projects_ready(w, data, error)
        )
        worker.start()

    def _dep_projects_ready(
        self, worker: ModProjectsWorker, data, error: str
    ) -> None:
        self._dep_projects_pending.difference_update(worker.project_ids)
        if worker is self._dep_projects_worker:
            self._dep_projects_worker = None
        if isinstance(data, dict) and data:
            self._dep_projects.update(data)
            self.dep_bar.update_projects(data)

    def _current_version_id(self) -> str:
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if isinstance(version, dict):
            return str(version.get("id") or "")
        return ""

    @staticmethod
    def _dependency_hit(project_id: str, project: dict | None) -> dict:
        data = project if isinstance(project, dict) else {}
        return {
            "project_id": str(data.get("id") or project_id),
            "slug": str(data.get("slug") or ""),
            "title": str(data.get("title") or data.get("slug") or project_id),
            "description": str(data.get("description") or ""),
            "author": str(data.get("author") or ""),
            "downloads": data.get("downloads") or 0,
            "categories": data.get("categories") or [],
            "icon_url": str(data.get("icon_url") or ""),
        }

    def _open_dependency(self, project_id: str, version_id: str) -> None:
        project_id = str(project_id or "")
        if not project_id:
            return
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast(
                f"请先等待当前{self.server.addon_label}下载结束，再查看前置项目", "info"
            )
            return
        project = self._dep_projects.get(project_id) or {}
        canonical = str(project.get("id") or project_id)
        if canonical == self._selected_project:
            return
        self._nav_stack.append(
            (
                self._selected_project,
                dict(self._hit or {}),
                self._current_version_id(),
            )
        )
        self._pending_project_id = canonical
        self._pending_version_id = str(version_id or "")
        self._select_project(
            canonical, self._dependency_hit(canonical, project), keep_nav=True
        )

    def _go_back_dependency(self) -> None:
        if not self._nav_stack:
            return
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.main.toast("请先等待当前下载结束，再返回", "info")
            return
        project_id, hit, version_id = self._nav_stack.pop()
        if not project_id:
            self.dep_bar.set_state(
                [], show_back=False, projects=self._dep_projects
            )
            return
        self._pending_project_id = project_id
        self._pending_version_id = version_id
        self._select_project(project_id, hit, keep_nav=True)

    def _set_detail_icon(self, url: str) -> None:
        fallback = "plug" if self.server.is_plugin_server else "cube"
        if not url:
            self.detail_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap(fallback, colors()["accent"], 27))
            return
        image = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(url)
        if image is not None:
            self.detail_icon.setPixmap(_cover_pixmap(image, 52, 11))
            return
        self.detail_icon.setPixmap(icons.pixmap(fallback, colors()["accent"], 27))
        self._load_image(
            url,
            lambda image, expected=url: self._detail_icon_ready(expected, image),
        )

    def _detail_icon_ready(self, url: str, image) -> None:
        expected = {
            str((self._hit or {}).get("icon_url") or ""),
            str((self._project or {}).get("icon_url") or ""),
        }
        if url not in expected:
            return
        if image is not None and not getattr(image, "isNull", lambda: True)():
            self.detail_icon.setPixmap(_cover_pixmap(image, 52, 11))

    def _clear_detail(self, message: str = "") -> None:
        self.detail_title.setText(f"选择一个{self.server.addon_label}查看详情")
        self.detail_author.setText("从左侧搜索结果中选择项目。")
        self.detail_desc.setText(message)
        self.downloads_badge.setText("0 下载")
        self.followers_badge.setText("0 关注")
        self.updated_label.setText("")
        self.version_combo.clear()
        self.version_combo.setEnabled(False)
        self.version_combo.addItem("请选择一个项目", "")
        self._sync_download_button()
        self.dep_label.setText("")
        self._nav_stack.clear()
        self._pending_project_id = ""
        self._pending_version_id = ""
        self.dep_bar.clear()
        self.progress_box.setVisible(False)
        self.body_excerpt.setText("")
        for label in (
            self.meta_categories,
            self.meta_loaders,
            self.meta_versions,
            self.meta_license,
        ):
            label.setText("—")
        self.detail_icon.setPixmap(
            icons.pixmap(
                "plug" if self.server.is_plugin_server else "cube",
                colors()["accent"],
                27,
            )
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _load_image(self, url: str, callback) -> None:
        if not url:
            return
        cached = _IMAGE_CACHE.get(url)
        if cached is not None:
            try:
                callback(cached)
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
            return
        self._image_waiters.setdefault(url, []).append(callback)
        if url in self._image_workers:
            return
        worker = ImageFetchWorker(url, self)
        self._image_workers[url] = worker
        worker.ready.connect(self._image_ready)
        worker.start()

    def _image_ready(self, url: str, image) -> None:
        self._image_workers.pop(url, None)
        if image is not None and not getattr(image, "isNull", lambda: True)():
            _cache_image(url, image)
        callbacks = self._image_waiters.pop(url, [])
        for callback in callbacks:
            try:
                callback(image)
            except RuntimeError:
                continue

    def _sync_download_button(self) -> None:
        """下载中始终允许点“取消下载”，不被切换项目等刷新流程重新禁用。"""
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(
                isinstance(self.version_combo.currentData(), dict)
            )

    def _set_download_button(self, downloading: bool) -> None:
        if downloading:
            self.download_btn.setObjectName("Danger")
            self.download_btn.setText("取消下载")
            self.download_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("stop", colors()["red"], 15))
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(True)
        else:
            self.download_btn.setObjectName("Primary")
            self.download_btn.setText(f"下载到 {self.server.addon_dir_name}")
            self.download_btn.setIcon(icons.icon("download", "#FFFFFF", 15))
            self._sync_download_button()
        repolish(self.download_btn)

    def _download(self) -> None:
        if self._download_worker is not None:
            self._download_worker.cancel()
            self.download_btn.setText("正在取消…")
            self.download_btn.setEnabled(False)
            return
        version = self.version_combo.currentData()
        if not isinstance(version, dict):
            return
        target = addons_dir(self.server)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText(f"准备下载到 {self.server.addon_dir_name}…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        worker = ModDownloadWorker(
            version,
            target,
            threads=self.main.config.download_threads,
            parent=self.main,
        )
        self._download_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_download_finished)
        self._set_download_button(True)
        worker.start()

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, percent)))
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _on_download_finished(self, success: bool, message: str, filename: str) -> None:
        self._download_worker = None
        self._set_download_button(False)
        if success:
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText(f"已安装 {filename}")
            self.main.toast(f"{filename} 已下载到 {self.server.addon_dir_name}", "success")
            self.installed.emit(filename)
            page = getattr(self.main, "server_page", None)
            if page is not None:
                page.refresh_addons()
        elif "取消" in str(message):
            self.progress_text.setText("下载已取消")
            self.main.toast("已取消下载，临时文件已清理", "info")
        else:
            self.progress_text.setText(message)
            self.main.toast(f"下载失败：{message}", "error")

    def _open_folder(self) -> None:
        path = addons_dir(self.server)
        try:
            path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError as exc:
            self.main.toast(f"无法创建文件夹：{exc}", "error")
            return
        self.main.open_path(path)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _row_label(self, text: str) -> QLabel:
        label = QLabel(text)
        label.setFixedWidth(78)
        label.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px;")
        return label

    def _add_line_row(self, layout: QVBoxLayout, title: str, placeholder: str) -> QLineEdit:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(10)
        row.addWidget(self._row_label(title))
        edit = QLineEdit()
        edit.setPlaceholderText(placeholder)
        edit.setMaxLength(48)
        row.addWidget(edit, 1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return edit

    def _add_combo_row(self, layout: QVBoxLayout, title: str) -> QComboBox:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(10)
        row.addWidget(self._row_label(title))
        combo = QComboBox()
        row.addWidget(combo, 1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return combo

    def _add_spin_row(
        self,
        layout: QVBoxLayout,
        title: str,
        minimum: int,
        maximum: int,
        value: int,
        step: int,
    ) -> QSpinBox:
        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.setSpacing(10)
        row.addWidget(self._row_label(title))
        spin = QSpinBox()
        spin.setRange(minimum, maximum)
        spin.setSingleStep(step)
        spin.setValue(max(minimum, min(maximum, value)))
        spin.setMinimumWidth(180)
        row.addWidget(spin)
        row.addStretch(1)
        layout.addLayout(row)
        return spin

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _current_kind(self) -> str:
        return self.type_tabs.current() or "paper"

    def _current_mc(self) -> str:
        return self.mc_combo.currentText().strip()

    def _on_name_edited(self, _text: str) -> None:
        self._name_auto = False

    def _update_name(self) -> None:
        if self._name_auto:
            kind = self._current_kind()
            mc = self._current_mc()
            self.name_edit.setText(f"{SERVER_NAMES[kind]} {mc}".strip())

    def _on_type_changed(self, _value: str) -> None:
        kind = self._current_kind()
        self.loader_widget.setVisible(kind in LOADER_KINDS)
        self.hint_label.setText(TYPE_HINTS.get(kind, ""))
        self._update_name()
        self._refresh_loader_versions()
        self._update_action()

    def _on_mc_changed(self) -> None:
        self._update_name()
        self._refresh_loader_versions()
        self._refresh_java()
        self._update_port_note()
        self._update_action()

    def _refresh_loader_versions(self) -> None:
        kind = self._current_kind()
        if kind not in LOADER_KINDS:
            self.loader_widget.setVisible(False)
            self._versions_worker = None
            return
        self.loader_widget.setVisible(True)
        self.loader_combo.clear()
        self.loader_combo.addItem("正在获取版本…", "")
        self.loader_combo.setEnabled(False)
        mc = self._current_mc()
        self._update_action()
        if not mc:
            self.loader_combo.clear()
            self.loader_combo.addItem("请先填写游戏版本", "")
            return
        worker = LoaderVersionsWorker(kind, mc, self)
        self._versions_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(
            lambda data, error, w=worker, k=kind, m=mc: self._loader_versions_ready(
                w, k, m, data, error
            )
        )
        worker.start()

    def _loader_versions_ready(
        self,
        worker: LoaderVersionsWorker,
        kind: str,
        mc: str,
        data,
        error: str,
    ) -> None:
        if worker is not self._versions_worker:
            return
        if kind != self._current_kind() or mc != self._current_mc():
            return
        self.loader_combo.clear()
        if error:
            self.loader_combo.addItem("获取失败", "")
            self.hint_label.setText(f"获取 {SERVER_NAMES[kind]} 版本失败：{error}")
            self._update_action()
            return
        if not data:
            self.loader_combo.addItem("没有可用版本", "")
            self.hint_label.setText(f"{SERVER_NAMES[kind]} 目前没有适配 Minecraft {mc} 的版本。")
            self._update_action()
            return
        for item in data:
            version = str(item.get("version") or "")
            if not version:
                continue
            suffix = "  ·  推荐" if item.get("stable") else ""
            self.loader_combo.addItem(version + suffix, version)
        self.loader_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self.loader_combo.setEnabled(True)
        self._update_action()

    def _load_manifest(self) -> None:
        worker = ManifestWorker(self.main.config.download_source, parent=self)
        self._manifest_worker = worker
        worker.ready.connect(self._manifest_ready)
        worker.start()

    def _manifest_ready(self, data, error: str) -> None:
        if error or not isinstance(data, dict):
            return
        current = self._current_mc()
        existing = {self.mc_combo.itemText(i) for i in range(self.mc_combo.count())}
        releases = [
            str(item.get("id") or "")
            for item in data.get("versions") or []
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "release"
        ]
        self.mc_combo.blockSignals(True)
        for version in releases:
            if version and version not in existing:
                self.mc_combo.addItem(version)
        if current:
            index = self.mc_combo.findText(current)
            if index >= 0:
                self.mc_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
            else:
                self.mc_combo.setEditText(current)
        self.mc_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _refresh_java(self, installs=None) -> None:
        installs = list(installs if installs is not None else self.main.java_installs or [])
        current = self.java_combo.currentData()
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.java_combo.clear()
        self.java_combo.addItem("自动选择（推荐）", "")
        for info in installs:
            if not isinstance(info, JavaInfo):
                continue
            self.java_combo.addItem(info.display, info.path)
        if current:
            index = self.java_combo.findData(current)
            if index >= 0:
                self.java_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        self.java_combo.blockSignals(False)
        self._update_java_note()
        self._update_action()

    def _chosen_java(self) -> JavaInfo | None:
        required = required_java_major(self._current_mc())
        preferred = str(self.java_combo.currentData() or "")
        installs = list(self.main.java_installs or [])
        if preferred:
            for info in installs:
                if info.path.lower() == preferred.lower():
                    return info
            return None
        return pick_java(installs, required)

    def _update_java_note(self) -> None:
        required = required_java_major(self._current_mc())
        chosen = self._chosen_java()
        if chosen is None:
            self.java_note.setText(f"没有找到 Java，Minecraft {self._current_mc()} 至少需要 Java {required}。")
            self.java_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']};")
            return
        if chosen.major < required:
            self.java_note.setText(
                f"当前选择的 Java {chosen.major or '?'} 过低，"
                f"Minecraft {self._current_mc()} 至少需要 Java {required}。"
            )
            self.java_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['red']};")
        else:
            self.java_note.setText(f"需要 Java {required}+ · 当前 Java {chosen.major}")
            self.java_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['green']};")
        self._update_action()

    def _update_port_note(self) -> None:
        port = int(self.port_spin.value())
        if check_port(port):
            self.port_note.setText(f"端口 {port} 可用。")
            self.port_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['muted']};")
        else:
            self.port_note.setText(f"端口 {port} 已被占用，启动前请修改端口或关闭占用程序。")
            self.port_note.setStyleSheet(f"color: {colors()['orange']};")

    def _update_action(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(True)
            return
        kind = self._current_kind()
        mc = self._current_mc()
        chosen = self._chosen_java()
        required = required_java_major(mc)
        enabled = bool(self.name_edit.text().strip() and mc)
        enabled = enabled and chosen is not None and chosen.major >= required
        enabled = enabled and self.eula_check.isChecked()
        if kind in LOADER_KINDS:
            enabled = enabled and bool(self.loader_combo.currentData())
        self.install_btn.setEnabled(enabled)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _install(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            self._cancel_install()
            return
        if not self.install_btn.isEnabled():
            return
        kind = self._current_kind()
        mc = self._current_mc()
        chosen = self._chosen_java()
        if chosen is None:
            self.main.toast("没有可用的 Java", "error")
            return
        loader_version = (
            str(self.loader_combo.currentData() or "")
            if kind in LOADER_KINDS
            else ""
        )
        if kind in LOADER_KINDS and not loader_version:
            self.main.toast("请选择加载器版本", "error")
            return

        if self._pending_info is not None:
            info = self._pending_info
            info.name = self.name_edit.text().strip()
            info.kind = kind
            info.mc_version = mc
            info.loader_version = loader_version
            info.java_path = chosen.path
            info.memory_mb = self.memory_spin.value()
            info.port = self.port_spin.value()
            info.online_mode = self.online_switch.isChecked()
        else:
            name = self.name_edit.text().strip()
            folder = new_server_folder(name, kind, mc)
            info = ServerInfo(
                folder=folder,
                name=name,
                kind=kind,
                mc_version=mc,
                loader_version=loader_version,
                java_path=chosen.path,
                memory_mb=self.memory_spin.value(),
                port=self.port_spin.value(),
                online_mode=self.online_switch.isChecked(),
            )
            self._pending_info = info
        save_server(info)

        self._installing = True
        self._set_form_enabled(False)
        self.progress.setValue(0)
        self.progress_text.setText("准备安装…")
        self.progress_box.setVisible(True)
        self.log.clear()
        self.log.setVisible(True)
        self.install_btn.setText("取消安装")
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setText("后台运行")
        self.adjustSize()

        worker = ServerInstallWorker(
            info,
            java_path=chosen.path,
            accept_eula=True,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            parent=self,
        )
        self._install_worker = worker
        worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        worker.log_line.connect(self._append_log)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_finished)
        self._task = self.main.download_center.start_worker(
            worker,
            title=f"安装服务端 · {info.name}",
            content_type="server-install",
            target=info.path,
            source=self.main.config.download_source,
            metadata={
                "folder": info.folder,
                "name": info.name,
                "kind": info.kind,
            },
            forward_log=False,
        )

    def _cancel_install(self) -> None:
        if self._install_worker:
            self.progress_text.setText("正在取消…")
            self.install_btn.setEnabled(False)
            self._install_worker.cancel()

    def _detach_download_center(self, _result: int = 0) -> None:
        if self._task is not None and not self._task.running:
            self._task = None

    def _set_form_enabled(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
        for widget in self._form_widgets:
            widget.setEnabled(enabled)
        if enabled:
            self.loader_widget.setEnabled(self._current_kind() in LOADER_KINDS)
            self._update_java_note()
            self._update_action()

    def _on_progress(self, percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        self.progress.setValue(max(0, min(100, percent)))
        self.progress_text.setText(message)

    def _append_log(self, line: str) -> None:
        self.log.appendPlainText(line)
        bar = self.log.verticalScrollBar()
        bar.setValue(bar.maximum())

    def _on_finished(self, success: bool, message: str) -> None:
        self._installing = False
        self._install_worker = None
        if self._task is not None:
            self._task.metadata["ui_handled"] = True
        self._set_form_enabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.close_btn.setText("关闭")
        self.install_btn.setText("创建并安装")
        if success and self._pending_info is not None:
            self.progress.setValue(100)
            self.progress_text.setText("安装完成")
            self.server = self._pending_info
            if hasattr(self.main, "server_page"):
                self.main.server_page.refresh_servers(self.server.folder)
            self.main.toast(f"{self.server.name} 服务端已就绪", "success")
            QTimer.singleShot(500, self.accept)
            return
        if "取消" in str(message):
            self.progress_text.setText("安装已取消")
            self.main.toast("服务端安装已取消", "info")
            return
        self.progress_text.setText(message)
        self.install_btn.setText("重试安装")
        self.main.toast(f"服务端安装失败：{message}", "error")

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._installing:
            self.main.toast(
                "服务端安装已转到顶栏继续，可以继续操作启动器；"
                "点击顶栏进度可以查看任务",
                "info",
            )
        super().reject()

def _json_count(path: Path) -> int:
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except Exception:
        return 0
    return len(data) if isinstance(data, list) else 0


def _server_snapshot(root: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    worlds: list[str] = []
    try:
        for item in root.iterdir():
            if item.is_dir() and (item / "level.dat").is_file():
                worlds.append(item.name)
    except OSError:
        pass
    players = 0
    for world in worlds:
        folder = root / world / "playerdata"
        if not folder.is_dir():
            continue
        try:
            players += sum(
                1 for item in folder.iterdir() if item.suffix.lower() == ".dat"
            )
        except OSError:
            pass
    return {
        "worlds": len(worlds),
        "players": players,
        "whitelist": _json_count(root / "whitelist.json"),
        "ops": _json_count(root / "ops.json"),
        "banned": _json_count(root / "banned-players.json")
        + _json_count(root / "banned-ips.json"),
    }


def _unique_directory(path: Path) -> Path:
    result = path
    index = 2
    while result.exists():
        result = path.with_name(f"{path.name}-{index}")
        index += 1
    return result


def _unique_server_name(name: str) -> str:
    base = str(name or "Minecraft 服务端").strip() or "Minecraft 服务端"
    names = {item.name.strip().casefold() for item in scan_servers()}
    candidate = base
    index = 2
    while candidate.casefold() in names:
        candidate = f"{base} ({index})"
        index += 1
    return candidate
