from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from darkitten.config import Config
from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow
from darkitten.ui.migration_dialog import MigrationDialog
from darkitten.ui.social_dialog import SocialDialog

QA = PROJECT / "qa"
SOCIAL = PROJECT / "social.json"
app = QApplication(sys.argv)
window: MainWindow | None = None
dialog = None
temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
backup = Path(temp_dir.name) / "social.backup"
had_social = SOCIAL.is_file()
if had_social:
    shutil.copy2(SOCIAL, backup)


def build_window() -> None:
    global window
    window = MainWindow(Config.load())
    window.resize(1464, 920)
    window.apply_theme("dark")
    window.switch_page("home")
    window.show()
    QTimer.singleShot(700, poke_and_capture)


def poke_and_capture() -> None:
    assert window is not None
    window.home_page.hero_art._poke()
    QTimer.singleShot(260, save_home_dark)


def save_home_dark() -> None:
    assert window is not None
    window.grab().save(str(QA / "dkl_190_home_dark.png"))
    window.apply_theme("light")
    QTimer.singleShot(500, save_home_light)


def save_home_light() -> None:
    assert window is not None
    window.grab().save(str(QA / "dkl_190_home_light.png"))
    window.apply_theme("dark")
    QTimer.singleShot(350, show_migration)


def show_migration() -> None:
    global dialog
    assert window is not None
    dialog = MigrationDialog(window)
    dialog.show()
    QTimer.singleShot(550, save_migration)


def save_migration() -> None:
    global dialog
    assert dialog is not None
    dialog.grab().save(str(QA / "dkl_190_migration.png"))
    dialog.reject()
    QTimer.singleShot(250, show_social)


def show_social() -> None:
    global dialog
    assert window is not None
    window.social_store.add_friend(
        "夜猫子", "DKL-TESTCAT1", "ROOM-7788", "1.21.1"
    )
    dialog = SocialDialog(window)
    dialog.show()
    QTimer.singleShot(550, save_social)


def save_social() -> None:
    assert dialog is not None
    dialog.grab().save(str(QA / "dkl_190_social.png"))
    dialog.reject()
    QTimer.singleShot(250, finish)


def finish() -> None:
    if window is not None:
        window.social_store.remove_friend("DKL-TESTCAT1")
        window.close()
    if had_social and backup.is_file():
        shutil.copy2(backup, SOCIAL)
    elif SOCIAL.is_file():
        SOCIAL.unlink()
    temp_dir.cleanup()
    app.quit()


QTimer.singleShot(300, build_window)
app.exec()

def vanilla(version_id: str, java: int = 21) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": version_id,
        "type": "release",
        "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
        "assets": "1.21",
        "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/a.json"},
        "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": java},
    }


def write_version(version_id: str, java: int = 21) -> None:
    folder = game / "versions" / version_id
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    (folder / f"{version_id}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(vanilla(version_id, java)), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (folder / f"{version_id}.jar").write_bytes(b"jar")

)

def png_bytes(pixmap) -> bytes:
    image = pixmap.toImage()
    buffer = QBuffer()
    buffer.open(QIODevice.WriteOnly)
    image.save(buffer, "PNG")
    return bytes(buffer.data())


def vanilla(version_id: str, java: int = 21) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": version_id,
        "type": "release",
        "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
        "assets": "1.21",
        "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/a.json"},
        "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": java},
    }


def write_version(version_id: str, java: int = 21) -> None:
    folder = game / "versions" / version_id
    folder.mkdir(parents=True)
    (folder / f"{version_id}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(vanilla(version_id, java)), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (folder / f"{version_id}.jar").write_bytes(b"jar")

def make_mod(filename: str, name: str, version: str, description: str) -> Path:
    path = mods_dir / filename
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr(
            "fabric.mod.json",
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "id": name.lower().replace(" ", "_"),
                    "name": name,
                    "version": version,
                    "description": description,
                    "icon": "assets/icon.png",
                }
            ),
        )
        zf.writestr("assets/icon.png", oc_icon)
    return path

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from darkitten.config import Config
from darkitten.ui.animations import GameLoadingOverlay, SplashScreen
from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow
from darkitten.ui.widgets import ChibiCompanion

QA = PROJECT / "qa"
app = QApplication(sys.argv)
window: MainWindow | None = None
splash: SplashScreen | None = None
overlay: GameLoadingOverlay | None = None

PAGES = ("download", "mods", "skin", "room", "server", "settings")
index = 0


def build_window() -> None:
    global window
    window = MainWindow(Config.load())
    window.resize(1464, 920)
    window.apply_theme("dark")
    window.switch_page("home")
    window.show()
    QTimer.singleShot(800, capture_home)


def capture_home() -> None:
    assert window is not None
    window.home_page.hero_art._poke()
    QTimer.singleShot(300, save_home)


def save_home() -> None:
    assert window is not None
    window.grab().save(str(QA / "dkl_194_home_dark.png"))
    QTimer.singleShot(120, next_page)


def next_page() -> None:
    global index
    assert window is not None
    if index >= len(PAGES):
        QTimer.singleShot(200, show_splash)
        return
    name = PAGES[index]
    index += 1
    window.switch_page(name)
    QTimer.singleShot(700, lambda: capture_page(name))


def capture_page(name: str) -> None:
    assert window is not None
    companions = [
        child for child in window.findChildren(ChibiCompanion) if child.isVisible()
    ]
    if companions:
        companions[0]._poke()
    QTimer.singleShot(260, lambda: save_page(name))


def save_page(name: str) -> None:
    assert window is not None
    window.grab().save(str(QA / f"dkl_194_{name}.png"))
    QTimer.singleShot(120, next_page)


def show_splash() -> None:
    global splash
    splash = SplashScreen()
    splash._elapsed = 1000
    splash._progress = 0.55
    splash.show()
    QTimer.singleShot(420, save_splash)


def save_splash() -> None:
    global splash
    assert splash is not None
    splash.grab().save(str(QA / "dkl_194_splash.png"))
    splash.close()
    QTimer.singleShot(180, show_loading)


def show_loading() -> None:
    global overlay
    assert window is not None
    window.switch_page("home")
    overlay = GameLoadingOverlay(window)
    overlay.show_loading("1.21.1", "正在把猫猫送进世界…")
    overlay.set_status("正在检查 1.21.1 的文件…")
    QTimer.singleShot(420, save_loading)


def save_loading() -> None:
    global overlay
    assert overlay is not None
    overlay.grab().save(str(QA / "dkl_194_loading.png"))
    overlay.abort()
    QTimer.singleShot(200, finish)


def finish() -> None:
    if window is not None:
        window.close()
    app.quit()


QTimer.singleShot(300, build_window)
app.exec()

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from darkitten.config import Config
from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow

QA = PROJECT / "qa"
app = QApplication(sys.argv)
window: MainWindow | None = None
original_offered = False
import darkitten.shortcut as shortcut_module
original_exists = shortcut_module.shortcut_exists


def build_window() -> None:
    global window, original_offered
    window = MainWindow(Config.load())
    original_offered = bool(window.config.shortcut_offered)
    window.resize(1464, 920)
    window.apply_theme("dark")
    window.switch_page("settings")
    window.show()
    QTimer.singleShot(700, capture_settings)


def capture_settings() -> None:
    assert window is not None
    row = window.settings_page.shortcut_btn.parentWidget()
    card = row.parentWidget() if row is not None else None
    target = card if card is not None else window.settings_page
    target.grab().save(str(QA / "dkl_shortcut_settings.png"))
    print("settings card", target.size())
    QTimer.singleShot(250, show_prompt)


def show_prompt() -> None:
    assert window is not None
    window.config.shortcut_offered = False
    shortcut_module.shortcut_exists = lambda: False

    def capture_dialog() -> None:
        dialog = QApplication.activeModalWidget()
        if dialog is not None:
            dialog.grab().save(str(QA / "dkl_shortcut_prompt.png"))
            print("prompt", dialog.size())
            dialog.reject()
        else:
            print("no modal dialog")
            finish()

    QTimer.singleShot(450, capture_dialog)
    window.offer_shortcut_once()
    QTimer.singleShot(200, finish)


def finish() -> None:
    shortcut_module.shortcut_exists = original_exists
    if window is not None:
        window.config.shortcut_offered = original_offered
        window.config.save()
        window.close()
    app.quit()


QTimer.singleShot(300, build_window)
app.exec()

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import threading

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")

if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))


def check(label: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(f"{label} failed {detail}")
    print(f"ok  {label}" + (f" · {detail}" if detail else ""))


def make_version(root: Path, version_id: str) -> None:
    folder = root / "versions" / version_id
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = {
        "id": version_id,
        "type": "release",
        "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
        "releaseTime": "2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
        "assets": "5",
    }
    (folder / f"{version_id}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8"
    )


def test_migration() -> None:
    from darkitten.migration import (
        MigrationCancelled,
        collect_migration_plan,
        run_migration,
    )

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        make_version(root, "1.20.1")
        make_version(root, "1.21.1")
        source = root / "versions" / "1.20.1"
        target = root / "versions" / "1.21.1"
        (source / "saves" / "world").mkdir(parents=True)
        (source / "saves" / "world" / "level.dat").write_bytes(b"level-old")
        (source / "config").mkdir()
        (source / "config" / "demo.toml").write_text("key=1", encoding="utf-8")
        (source / "resourcepacks").mkdir()
        (source / "resourcepacks" / "pack.zip").write_bytes(b"pack")
        (source / "shaderpacks").mkdir()
        (source / "shaderpacks" / "shader.zip").write_bytes(b"shader")
        (source / "mods").mkdir()
        (source / "mods" / "example.jar").write_bytes(b"jar")
        (source / "mods" / "off.jar.disabled").write_bytes(b"off")
        (source / "options.txt").write_text("fov:0.5", encoding="utf-8")
        (source / "servers.dat").write_bytes(b"servers")

        plan = collect_migration_plan(root, "1.20.1", "1.21.1")
        check("plan counts", plan.total_files == 8, f"total={plan.total_files}")
        check(
            "plan categories",
            plan.file_counts
            == {
                "saves": 1,
                "config": 1,
                "resourcepacks": 1,
                "shaderpacks": 1,
                "options": 2,
                "mods": 2,
            },
            str(plan.file_counts),
        )
        check("plan mc versions", (plan.source_mc, plan.target_mc) == ("1.20.1", "1.21.1"))
        check("plan no conflict", plan.conflicts == 0, str(plan.conflicts))

        logs: list[str] = []
        report = run_migration(
            plan,
            match_mods=False,
            copy_unmatched=True,
            log_cb=logs.append,
        )
        check("copy all files", report.copied_files == 6, f"copied={report.copied_files}")
        check("copy mods", report.copied_mods == 2, f"mods={report.copied_mods}")
        check(
            "save copied",
            (target / "saves" / "world" / "level.dat").read_bytes() == b"level-old",
        )
        check("options copied", (target / "options.txt").is_file())
        check("servers copied", (target / "servers.dat").is_file())
        check("mod copied", (target / "mods" / "example.jar").read_bytes() == b"jar")
        check(
            "disabled mod preserved",
            (target / "mods" / "off.jar.disabled").read_bytes() == b"off",
        )
        check("warnings mention mods", any("example.jar" in line for line in logs))

        (target / "saves" / "world" / "level.dat").write_bytes(b"keep-me")
        plan2 = collect_migration_plan(root, "1.20.1", "1.21.1", ["saves"])
        check("conflict counted", plan2.conflicts == 1, str(plan2.conflicts))
        report2 = run_migration(plan2, match_mods=False, overwrite=False)
        check("conflict skipped", report2.skipped_files == 1, f"skip={report2.skipped_files}")
        check(
            "conflict kept target",
            (target / "saves" / "world" / "level.dat").read_bytes() == b"keep-me",
        )
        run_migration(plan2, match_mods=False, overwrite=True)
        check(
            "overwrite applied",
            (target / "saves" / "world" / "level.dat").read_bytes() == b"level-old",
        )

        flat = collect_migration_plan(root, "1.20.1", "1.21.1", ["saves"], isolated=False)
        check("shared dir detected", flat.same_dir)
        flat_report = run_migration(flat, match_mods=False)
        check("shared dir no copy", flat_report.copied_files == 0)

        cancel_plan = collect_migration_plan(root, "1.20.1", "1.21.1", ["config"])
        event = threading.Event()
        event.set()
        try:
            run_migration(cancel_plan, cancel_event=event)
        except MigrationCancelled:
            print("ok  migration cancellation")
        else:
            raise AssertionError("cancellation not raised")


def test_social() -> None:
    from darkitten.social import (
        SocialError,
        encode_invite,
        load_store,
        parse_invite,
    )

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        path = Path(tmp) / "social.json"
        store = load_store(path)
        profile = store.ensure_profile("Tester")
        check("profile id", profile.id.startswith("DKL-"), profile.id)
        check("profile persisted", path.is_file())
        check("profile reuse", load_store(path).profile.id == profile.id)

        store.rename_profile("猫猫")
        check("rename profile", load_store(path).profile.name == "猫猫")

        store.set_room("ROOM-1234", "1.21.1-fabric")
        check("room saved", load_store(path).profile.room_code == "ROOM-1234")

        card = encode_invite(profile, "ROOM-1234", "1.21.1-fabric", note="来玩")
        invite = parse_invite(card)
        check("invite roundtrip", invite.id == profile.id and invite.room_code == "ROOM-1234")
        check("invite version", invite.room_version == "1.21.1-fabric")
        check("invite note", invite.note == "来玩")

        try:
            store.add_invite(invite)
        except SocialError as exc:
            check("own invite rejected", "自己" in str(exc))
        else:
            raise AssertionError("own invite accepted")

        other = parse_invite(
            encode_invite(
                type(profile)(id="DKL-ABCD1234", name="好友"),
                "ROOM-9999",
                "1.20.1",
            )
        )
        friend = store.add_invite(other)
        check("friend added", friend.id == "DKL-ABCD1234", friend.id)
        check("friend persisted", load_store(path).friends[0].room_code == "ROOM-9999")

        store.update_room("DKL-ABCD1234", "ROOM-0000", "1.20.1")
        check(
            "friend room update",
            load_store(path).friends[0].room_code == "ROOM-0000",
        )
        check("remove friend", store.remove_friend("DKL-ABCD1234"))
        check("friends empty", load_store(path).friends == [])

        for bad in ("", "hello", "DKLF1:@@@"):
            try:
                parse_invite(bad)
            except SocialError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError(f"bad invite accepted: {bad!r}")
        print("ok  invalid invites rejected")


def test_visuals() -> None:
    from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint
    from PySide6.QtGui import QImage, QPainter
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    from darkitten.ui import icons
    from darkitten.ui.widgets import Avatar, HeroArt

    avatar = Avatar(48)
    avatar.refresh()
    check("avatar refresh", not avatar._pixmap.isNull())

    face = icons.skin_face_pixmap(64)
    check("skin face size", face.size().width() == 64, str(face.size()))
    active = icons.active_skin_image()
    check("active skin", not active.isNull(), f"{active.width()}x{active.height()}")

    icon = icons.app_icon()
    check("app icon loaded", not icon.isNull())
    sizes = sorted(size.width() for size in icon.availableSizes())
    check("app icon sizes", len(sizes) >= 5, str(sizes))

    ico = PROJECT / "assets" / "dkl.ico"
    payload = ico.read_bytes()
    reserved, kind, count = struct.unpack("<HHH", payload[:6])
    check("ico header", (reserved, kind, count) == (0, 1, 7), f"count={count}")

    art = HeroArt()
    art.resize(420, 260)
    art._poke()
    check("hero particles", len(art._particles) == 10, str(len(art._particles)))
    check("hero phrase", art._phrase in art.PHRASES, art._phrase)
    for _ in range(10):
        art._tick()
    image = QImage(420, 260, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    image.fill(0)
    painter = QPainter(image)
    art.render(painter, QPoint(0, 0))
    painter.end()
    check("hero painted", not image.isNull())
    app.processEvents()


def main() -> None:
    test_migration()
    test_social()
    test_visuals()
    print("ALL 1.9.0 FEATURE TESTS PASSED")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    from darkitten.config import Config
    from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow

    config = Config.load()
    window = MainWindow(config)
    store = window.social_store
    old_room = store.profile.room_code
    old_version = store.profile.room_version
    calls: list[str] = []
    window.room_page.join_room = lambda: calls.append("join")
    try:
        window.join_friend_room("127.0.0.1:25566", "1.21.1")
        QTest.qWait(60)
        assert calls == ["join"], calls
        assert window.room_page.code_edit.text() == "127.0.0.1:25566"
        assert "127.0.0.1:25566" in window.room_page.code_hint.text()
        print("ok  friend room join invoked")

        window.join_friend_room("127.0.0.1:25566", "9.9.9")
        QTest.qWait(30)
        assert calls == ["join"], calls
        assert "9.9.9" in window.room_page.guest_status.text()
        print("ok  missing version blocked", window.room_page.guest_status.text())

        window.room_page._sync_social_room("ROOM-TEST-1")
        assert store.profile.room_code == "ROOM-TEST-1"
        assert store.profile.room_version == str(window.selected_version or "")
        print("ok  room shared to social profile")
        window.room_page._clear_social_room()
        assert store.profile.room_code == ""
        print("ok  room cleared from social profile")
    finally:
        store.profile.room_code = old_room
        store.profile.room_version = old_version
        store.save()
        window.close()
        app.processEvents()
    print("ROOM FLOW OK")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        PASS += 1

def png_bytes(size: int = 64, color: str = "#e84545") -> bytes:
    image = QImage(size, size, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    image.fill(QColor(color))
    from PySide6.QtCore import QBuffer, QIODevice

    buffer = QBuffer()
    buffer.open(QIODevice.WriteOnly)
    image.save(buffer, "PNG")
    return bytes(buffer.data())


def make_mod_jar(path: Path) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr(
            "fabric.mod.json",
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "id": "demo_mod",
                    "name": "Demo Mod",
                    "version": "1.0.0",
                    "description": "A demo mod.",
                    "icon": "assets/demo.png",
                }
            ),
        )
        zf.writestr("assets/demo.png", png_bytes(64, "#3fb3aa"))

def mod_meta_test() -> None:

            "description_zh": "这是一个用于测试的中文介绍。",
            "project_url": "https://example.invalid/demo",
            "source_label": "Modrinth",
        },
        info.icon_bytes,
    )
    meta = load_mod_meta(mods_dir, jar.name)

    check("sidecar_project_url", saved_info.project_url.endswith("/demo"))
    temp.cleanup()


def download_center_test(app: QApplication) -> DownloadTask | None:
    temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    root = Path(temp.name)
    mods_dir = root / "mods"
    main = FakeMain(Config(game_dir=str(root / "game")))
    center = main.download_center

    def fake_download(version, target_dir, progress_cb=None, cancel_event=None, threads=8):
        target = Path(target_dir) / "demo_mod.jar"
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if progress_cb:
            progress_cb(15, "开始下载")
        make_mod_jar(target)
        if progress_cb:
            progress_cb(100, "下载完成")
        return target

    import darkitten.workers as workers

    original = workers.download_mod_file
    workers.download_mod_file = fake_download
    finished: list[DownloadTask] = []
    loop = QEventLoop()
    center.task_finished.connect(lambda task: (finished.append(task), loop.quit()))
    QTimer.singleShot(6000, loop.quit)
    task = center.start_mod_download(
        {"files": [{"filename": "demo_mod.jar"}]},
        mods_dir,
        threads=2,
        title="演示 Mod",
        content_type="mod",
        source="modrinth",
        metadata={
            "title": "演示 Mod",
            "project_id": "demo",
            "description": "A demo mod.",
            "description_zh": "下载后保存的中文介绍。",
            "content_type": "mod",
        },
    )
    loop.exec()
    workers.download_mod_file = original

    check("download_center_finished", bool(finished) and finished[0].id == task.id)
    check("download_center_success", task.status == dc.TASK_SUCCESS, task.status)
    check("download_center_filename", task.filename == "demo_mod.jar")
    saved = read_mod(mods_dir / "demo_mod.jar")
    check("download_center_icon", len(saved.icon_bytes) > 50, f"{len(saved.icon_bytes)} bytes")
    check("download_center_zh", saved.intro == "下载后保存的中文介绍。")

    chip = TopDownloadChip()
    chip.resize(196, 38)
    task.progress = 42
    task.status = dc.TASK_RUNNING
    task.message = "正在下载资源"
    center._tasks[task.id] = task
    center._order = [task.id]
    chip.sync(center)
    check(
        "chip_running",
        not chip.isHidden() and chip.percent_label.text() == "42%",
        chip.status_label.text(),
    )
    check("chip_progress", chip.progress.value() == 42)

    task.status = dc.TASK_SUCCESS
    task.progress = 100
    task.message = "下载完成"
    chip.sync(center)
    check(
        "chip_finished",
        chip.status_label.text() == "已完成" and chip._hide_timer.isActive(),
        chip.status_label.text(),
    )
    chip.close()
    temp.cleanup()
    return None


def dialog_detach_test(app: QApplication) -> None:
    temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    root = Path(temp.name)
    main = FakeMain(Config(game_dir=str(root / "game")))
    import darkitten.ui.mod_dialog as mod_dialog

    old_search = mod_dialog.ModSearchWorker.start
    mod_dialog.ModSearchWorker.start = lambda self: None
    dialog = ModBrowserDialog(main)
    task = DownloadTask(
        id=77,
        title="仍在下载",
        content_type="mod",
        source="modrinth",
        target=root / "mods",
    )
    main.download_center._tasks[77] = task
    main.download_center._order = [77]
    dialog._download_task = task
    dialog._download_bound = True
    cancelled: list[int] = []
    main.download_center.cancel = lambda task_id: cancelled.append(task_id)
    dialog.reject()
    mod_dialog.ModSearchWorker.start = old_search

    check("dialog_close_keeps_task", not cancelled, f"cancel={cancelled}")
    check("dialog_close_detaches", dialog._download_task is None)
    check(
        "dialog_close_toast",
        any("顶栏" in text for text, _kind in main.messages),
        str(main.messages),
    )
    check("task_still_running", main.download_center.has_running())
    temp.cleanup()

def server_icon_test(app: QApplication) -> None:
    import darkitten.servers as servers

    temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    old_dir = servers.SERVERS_DIR
    servers.SERVERS_DIR = Path(temp.name) / "servers"
    try:
        info = ServerInfo(
            folder="RedServer",
            name="RedServer",
            kind="paper",
            mc_version="1.21.1",
            installed=True,
        )
        info.path.mkdir(parents=True)
        (info.path / "server-icon.png").write_bytes(png_bytes(64, "#ff2020"))
        save_server(info)

        pixmap = _server_icon_pixmap(info, 38, 9)
        check("server_icon_pixmap", pixmap is not None and pixmap.size().width() == 38)
        if pixmap is not None:
            color = pixmap.toImage().pixelColor(19, 19)
            check(
                "server_icon_color",
                color.red() > 200 and color.green() < 80,
                f"{color.red()},{color.green()},{color.blue()}",
            )

        Config.save = lambda self: None
        from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow

        window = MainWindow(Config(game_dir=str(Path(temp.name) / "game"), update_auto_check=False))
        try:
            window.server_page.refresh_servers("RedServer")
            check(
                "server_row_custom_icon",
                bool(window.server_page._rows)
                and window.server_page._rows[0].icon_label.pixmap().toImage().pixelColor(19, 19).red()
                > 200,
            )
            detail_color = window.server_page.detail_icon.pixmap().toImage().pixelColor(23, 23)
            check(
                "server_detail_custom_icon",
                detail_color.red() > 200 and detail_color.green() < 80,
                f"{detail_color.red()},{detail_color.green()},{detail_color.blue()}",
            )
        finally:
            window.close()
    finally:
        servers.SERVERS_DIR = old_dir
        temp.cleanup()

from __future__ import annotations

import os

def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    global PASS, FAIL
    if condition:
        PASS += 1
        print(f"{name}: OK{(' (' + detail + ')') if detail else ''}")
    else:
        FAIL += 1

class FakeWorker(QObject):
    progress = Signal(int, str)
    finished = Signal(bool, str, str)
    log_line = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.started = False
        self.cancelled = False

    def start(self) -> None:
        self.started = True

    def cancel(self) -> None:
        self.cancelled = True


class FakeMain(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, config: Config) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.messages: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        self.statuses: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        self.selected: list[str] = []
        self.opened: list[str] = []
        self.refreshed = 0
        self.download_center = DownloadCenter(self)

    def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        self.messages.append((text, kind))

    def log(self, _message: str) -> None:
        pass

    def set_status(self, text: str, kind: str = "idle") -> None:
        self.statuses.append((text, kind))

    def refresh_versions(self) -> None:
        self.refreshed += 1

    def select_version(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        self.selected.append(version_id)

    def open_path(self, path) -> None:
        self.opened.append(str(path))

    def open_local_import(self, path) -> None:
        self.opened.append(str(path))


def pump(app: QApplication) -> None:
    for _ in range(3):
        app.processEvents()


def start_fake(
    center: DownloadCenter,
    root: Path,
    content_type: str,
    title: str = "测试任务",
) -> tuple[object, FakeWorker]:
    worker = FakeWorker()
    task = center.start_worker(
        worker,
        title=title,
        content_type=content_type,
        target=root,
    )
    return task, worker


def center_lifecycle_test(app: QApplication) -> None:
    temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    root = Path(temp.name)
    main = FakeMain(Config(game_dir=str(root / "game")))
    center = main.download_center

    task, worker = start_fake(center, root, "version-install", "安装 1.21.1")
    check("generic_worker_started", worker.started)
    check("generic_worker_owned_by_center", worker.parent() is center)
    check("install_action_text", task.action_text == "安装中", task.action_text)
    check("task_tracked", center.has_running() and center.active_tasks() == [task])

    worker.progress.emit(37, "正在补全资源")
    pump(app)
    check("task_progress", task.progress == 37, str(task.progress))

    chip = TopDownloadChip()
    chip.show()
    chip.sync(center)
    pump(app)
    check(
        "chip_shows_install",
        chip.isVisible() and chip.status_label.text() == "安装中" and chip.percent_label.text() == "37%",
        f"{chip.status_label.text()} {chip.percent_label.text()}",
    )

    worker.finished.emit(True, "安装完成", "")
    pump(app)
    check("install_finished_success", task.status == dc.TASK_SUCCESS, task.status)
    check("install_finished_message", task.message == "安装完成", task.message)
    chip.sync(center)
    check("chip_final_state", chip.status_label.text() == "已完成", chip.status_label.text())

    task2, worker2 = start_fake(center, root, "modpack", "导入整合包")
    center.cancel(task2.id)
    check("cancel_reaches_worker", worker2.cancelled)
    worker2.finished.emit(False, "下载已取消", "")
    pump(app)
    check("cancel_state", task2.status == dc.TASK_CANCELLED, task2.status)

    center.clear_finished()
    chip.sync(center)
    pump(app)
    check(
        "idle_chip_visible",
        chip.isVisible() and chip.status_label.text() == "下载中心",
        chip.status_label.text(),
    )
    check("idle_chip_compact", chip.maximumWidth() == 48, str(chip.maximumWidth()))
    check("idle_chip_tooltip", "下载中心" in chip.toolTip())

    clicked: list[bool] = []
    chip.clicked.connect(lambda: clicked.append(True))
    QTest.mouseClick(chip, Qt.LeftButton)
    pump(app)
    check("idle_chip_clickable", bool(clicked), str(clicked))

    chip.close()
    temp.cleanup()


def dialog_close_test(app: QApplication, kind: str) -> None:
    temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    root = Path(temp.name)
    main = FakeMain(Config(game_dir=str(root / "game")))
    center = main.download_center

    if kind == "pack":
        dialog = PackImportDialog(main)
    elif kind == "zip":
        dialog = VersionZipDialog(main)
    else:
        dialog = LocalImportDialog(main)

    task, worker = start_fake(center, root, "modpack", "后台导入")
    if kind == "local":
        dialog._mode = "import"
    else:
        dialog._mode = "import"
    dialog._task = task

    cancelled: list[int] = []
    original_cancel = center.cancel
    center.cancel = lambda task_id: cancelled.append(int(task_id))
    dialog.reject()
    pump(app)
    center.cancel = original_cancel

    check(f"{kind}_close_keeps_task", not cancelled and task.running, f"cancel={cancelled}")
    check(
        f"{kind}_close_toast",
        any("顶栏" in text for text, _kind in main.messages),
        str(main.messages),
    )
    check(f"{kind}_worker_not_cancelled", not worker.cancelled)

    worker.progress.emit(64, "仍在后台导入")
    worker.finished.emit(True, "导入完成", "后台版本")
    pump(app)
    check(f"{kind}_task_finishes_in_background", task.status == dc.TASK_SUCCESS, task.status)
    check(f"{kind}_filename_saved", task.filename == "后台版本", task.filename)

    dialog.deleteLater()
    pump(app)
    temp.cleanup()


def import_routing_test(app: QApplication) -> None:
    temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    root = Path(temp.name)
    main = FakeMain(Config(game_dir=str(root / "game")))
    center = main.download_center
    target = root / "cache"
    target.mkdir(parents=True)
    archive = target / "pack.zip"
    archive.write_bytes(b"PK\x05\x06" + b"\x00" * 18)

    task = dc.DownloadTask(
        id=91,
        title="下载整合包",
        content_type="pack-fetch",
        source="url",
        target=target,
        pack_mode=True,
        progress=100,
        message="下载完成",
        status=dc.TASK_SUCCESS,
        filename=archive.name,
    )
    center._tasks[task.id] = task
    center._order = [task.id]

    dialog = DownloadTasksDialog(main)
    check("tasks_dialog_empty_hint", "导入" in dialog.empty.text(), dialog.empty.text())
    check("tasks_dialog_has_row", task.id in dialog._rows)
    if task.id in dialog._rows:
        row = dialog._rows[task.id]
        check("tasks_dialog_import_visible", not row.import_btn.isHidden())
        row.import_btn.click()
        pump(app)
    check(
        "tasks_dialog_import_routes",
        main.opened == [str(archive)],
        str(main.opened),
    )
    dialog.deleteLater()
    pump(app)
    temp.cleanup()


def main() -> int:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    center_lifecycle_test(app)
    dialog_close_test(app, "pack")
    dialog_close_test(app, "zip")
    dialog_close_test(app, "local")
    import_routing_test(app)
    print(f"RESULT: {'PASS' if FAIL == 0 else 'FAIL'} ({PASS} ok, {FAIL} failed)")
    return 0 if FAIL == 0 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))


def check(label: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(f"{label} failed {detail}")
    print(f"ok  {label}" + (f" · {detail}" if detail else ""))


def main() -> int:
    from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint
    from PySide6.QtGui import QImage, QPainter
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QWidget

    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    from darkitten.ui import icons
    from darkitten.ui.widgets import ChibiCompanion, GrassLogo, HeroArt

    logo = icons.logo_pixmap(32)
    app_icon = icons.app_icon_pixmap(32)
    check("internal logo size", logo.size().width() == 32, str(logo.size()))
    logo_image = logo.toImage()
    icon_image = app_icon.toImage()
    same = True
    for x, y in ((10, 1), (10, 30), (7, 18), (5, 12), (27, 18)):
        if logo_image.pixelColor(x, y) != icon_image.pixelColor(x, y):
            same = False
    check("internal logo matches app icon", same)
    check("old dark badge removed", logo_image.pixelColor(0, 0).alpha() == 0)
    grass = GrassLogo(32)
    check("titlebar logo pixmap", not grass._pixmap.isNull())

    face = icons.chibi_face_pixmap(128)
    face_image = face.toImage()
    check("chibi face size", face.size().width() == 128, str(face.size()))
    check("chibi face transparent margin", face_image.pixelColor(0, 0).alpha() == 0)
    check("chibi face opaque centre", face_image.pixelColor(64, 64).alpha() > 0)

    body = icons.chibi_pixmap(240)
    body_image = body.toImage()
    check("chibi body height", body.height() == 240, str(body.size()))
    check("chibi body aspect", body.width() > 150, str(body.size()))
    check("chibi body transparent corner", body_image.pixelColor(0, 0).alpha() == 0)

    host = QWidget()
    host.resize(520, 220)
    host.show()
    companion = ChibiCompanion(60, "download", host)
    companion.move(30, 30)
    companion.show()
    app.processEvents()
    companion._poke()
    check("companion phrase context", companion._phrase in companion.PHRASES["download"], companion._phrase)
    check("companion particles", len(companion._particles) == 7, str(len(companion._particles)))
    check("companion bubble", companion._bubble is not None and companion._bubble.isVisible())
    check("companion bubble text", companion._bubble.text() == companion._phrase)
    for _ in range(8):
        companion._tick()
    image = QImage(520, 220, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    image.fill(0)
    painter = QPainter(image)
    companion.render(painter, QPoint(0, 0))
    painter.end()
    check("companion painted", not image.isNull())
    companion._hide_bubble()
    check("companion bubble hides", not companion._bubble.isVisible())

    hero = HeroArt()
    hero.resize(420, 240)
    hero._poke()
    check("hero phrase", hero._phrase in hero.PHRASES, hero._phrase)
    check("hero particles", len(hero._particles) == 10, str(len(hero._particles)))
    body_rect = hero._body_rect()
    check("hero portrait", body_rect.height() > 180, str(body_rect))
    check("hero hit area", hero._hit(body_rect.center()))
    hero_image = QImage(420, 240, QImage.Format_ARGB32)
    hero_image.fill(0)
    painter = QPainter(hero_image)
    hero.render(painter, QPoint(0, 0))
    painter.end()
    check("hero painted", not hero_image.isNull())

    host.close()
    app.processEvents()
    print("all 1.9.12 chibi checks passed")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QEventLoop, Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from darkitten.config import APP_NAME, APP_SHORT_NAME, Config
from darkitten.ui.animations import GameLoadingOverlay, SplashScreen
from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow


def wait(ms: int) -> None:
    loop = QEventLoop()
    QTimer.singleShot(ms, loop.quit)
    loop.exec()


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    ok = True

    branding_ok = (
        APP_NAME == "Darkitten Launcher" and APP_SHORT_NAME == "DKL"
    )
    print("branding:", "OK" if branding_ok else "FAIL", APP_NAME, APP_SHORT_NAME)
    ok &= branding_ok

    splash = SplashScreen()
    fired: list[bool] = []
    splash.finished.connect(lambda: fired.append(True))
    splash.start()
    wait(3200)
    splash_closed = len(fired) == 1
    print("splash_auto_finish:", "OK" if splash_closed else "FAIL", len(fired))
    ok &= splash_closed
    splash.close()
    splash.deleteLater()

    skipped = SplashScreen()
    skipped_fired: list[bool] = []
    skipped.finished.connect(lambda: skipped_fired.append(True))
    skipped.start()
    wait(80)
    QTest.mouseClick(skipped, Qt.LeftButton)
    wait(500)
    skip_ok = len(skipped_fired) == 1
    print("splash_skip:", "OK" if skip_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= skip_ok
    skipped.close()
    skipped.deleteLater()

    window = MainWindow(Config.load())
    window.show()
    app.processEvents()
    overlay: GameLoadingOverlay = window.loading_overlay
    overlay.show_loading("1.21.1", "正在检查 Java…")
    wait(80)
    shown = overlay.isVisible() and overlay.cancel_btn.isVisible()
    status_ok = overlay._status == "正在检查 Java…"
    overlay.set_status("正在拼装参数…")
    status_ok = status_ok and overlay._status == "正在拼装参数…"
    print("overlay_show:", "OK" if shown else "FAIL")
    print("overlay_status:", "OK" if status_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= shown and status_ok

    cancelled: list[bool] = []
    overlay.cancel_requested.connect(lambda: cancelled.append(True))
    overlay.cancel_btn.click()
    cancel_ok = (
        cancelled == [True]
        and not overlay.cancel_btn.isEnabled()
        and overlay.cancel_btn.text() == "正在收回猫爪…"
    )
    print("overlay_cancel:", "OK" if cancel_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= cancel_ok

    overlay.abort()
    abort_ok = not overlay.isVisible()
    print("overlay_abort:", "OK" if abort_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= abort_ok

    overlay.show_loading("1.21.1")
    overlay.finish("世界已加载，去玩吧喵。", 120)
    wait(260)
    finish_ok = not overlay.isVisible()
    print("overlay_finish:", "OK" if finish_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= finish_ok

    window.close()
    app.processEvents()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# FILE: qa/test_cancel_install.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEventLoop, QTimer

from darkitten.downloader import partial_files
from darkitten.workers import InstallWorker

ROOT = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "darkitten_shots" / "cancel_game"


def main() -> int:
    ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    app = QCoreApplication.instance() or QCoreApplication(sys.argv)
    worker = InstallWorker(ROOT, "1.21.1", source="auto", threads=8)
    result: dict = {"done": False}

    def on_finished(success: bool, message: str) -> None:
        result.update(done=True, success=success, message=message)
        app.quit()

    worker.finished.connect(on_finished)
    worker.log_line.connect(lambda line: print(f"LOG {line}", flush=True))
    loop = QEventLoop()
    guard = QTimer()
    guard.setSingleShot(True)
    guard.timeout.connect(loop.quit)
    guard.start(120000)
    worker.finished.connect(loop.quit)
    worker.start()

    started = time.time()
    QTimer.singleShot(6000, worker.cancel)
    loop.exec()
    guard.stop()

    leftovers = partial_files(ROOT)
    print(f"elapsed={time.time() - started:.1f}s", flush=True)
    print(f"finished={result.get('done')} success={result.get('success')}", flush=True)
    print(f"message={result.get('message')}", flush=True)
    print(f"partials={[str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in leftovers]}", flush=True)
    ok = (
        result.get("done")
        and result.get("success") is False
        and "取消" in str(result.get("message"))
        and not leftovers
    )
    print("CANCEL_INSTALL_OK" if ok else "CANCEL_INSTALL_FAIL", flush=True)
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import json

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QWidget

from darkitten import curseforge as cf

def check(label: str, value: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if value else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail else ""))
    return bool(value)


def modrinth_tests() -> bool:
    ok = True
    captured: list[str] = []

    def fake_get_json(url, timeout=30):
        captured.append(url)
        return {"hits": [], "total_hits": 0}

    original = mr._get_json
    try:
        mr._get_json = fake_get_json
        cases = [
            ("shader", "fabric", "1.20.1", [["project_type:shader"], ["versions:1.20.1"]]),
            ("resourcepack", "fabric", "", [["project_type:resourcepack"]]),
            (
                "modpack",
                "forge",
                "1.21.1",
                [["project_type:modpack"], ["versions:1.21.1"]],
            ),
            ("mod", "fabric", "", [["project_type:mod"], ["categories:fabric"]]),
        ]
        for kind, loader, version, expected in cases:
            mr.search_mods("x", loader=loader, game_version=version, project_type=kind)
            params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(
                urllib.parse.urlparse(captured[-1]).query
            )
            facets = json.loads(params["facets"][0])
            ok &= check(
                f"modrinth_{kind}_facets",
                facets == expected,
                str(facets),
            )

        def fake_versions(url, timeout=30):
            captured.append(url)
            return [
                {
                    "id": "v1",
                    "files": [
                        {
                            "primary": True,
                            "url": "https://cdn.modrinth.com/a.zip",
                            "filename": "a.zip",
                        }
                    ],
                }
            ]

        mr._get_json = fake_versions
        versions = mr.fetch_mod_versions(
            "abc", "fabric", "1.20.1", content_type="shader"
        )
        params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(
            urllib.parse.urlparse(captured[-1]).query
        )
        ok &= check(
            "modrinth_shader_versions",
            len(versions) == 1
            and "loaders" not in params
            and json.loads(params["game_versions"][0]) == ["1.20.1"],
            str(params),
        )
    finally:
        mr._get_json = original
    return ok


def curseforge_tests() -> bool:
    ok = True
    captured: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []

    def fake_json(path, params=None, timeout=35):
        captured.append((path, dict(params or {})))
        return {"data": [], "pagination": {"totalCount": 0}}

    original = cf._request_json
    try:
        cf._request_json = fake_json
        for kind, expected in (
            ("mod", 6),
            ("modpack", 4471),
            ("resourcepack", 12),
            ("shader", 6552),
        ):
            cf.search_mods("", loader="fabric", content_type=kind)
            params = captured[-1][1]
            ok &= check(
                f"curseforge_{kind}_class",
                params.get("classId") == expected
                and ("modLoaderType" in params) == (kind == "mod"),
                str(params),
            )

        cf.fetch_mod_versions("123", "fabric", "1.20.1", content_type="resourcepack")
        params = captured[-1][1]
        ok &= check(
            "curseforge_resourcepack_versions",
            "modLoaderType" not in params and params.get("gameVersion") == "1.20.1",
            str(params),
        )
    finally:
        cf._request_json = original

    shader = cf.normalize_file(
        {
            "id": 5,
            "displayName": "Demo Shader",
            "fileName": "demo.zip",
            "fileLength": 10,
            "downloadUrl": "https://edge.forgecdn.net/files/0/5/demo.zip",
            "gameVersions": ["1.20.1"],
            "hashes": [],
        },
        project_slug="demo-shader",
        content_type="shader",
    )
    ok &= check(
        "curseforge_shader_page_url",
        "/shaders/demo-shader/files/5" in shader["page_url"],
        shader["page_url"],
    )

    hit = cf.normalize_hit(
        {
            "id": 1,
            "name": "Demo Pack",
            "slug": "demo-pack",
            "classId": 4471,
            "latestFilesIndexes": [],
        }
    )
    ok &= check(
        "curseforge_pack_url",
        hit["project_url"].endswith("/modpacks/demo-pack")
        and hit["content_type"] == "modpack",
        hit["project_url"],
    )
    return ok


def make_pack(path: Path) -> None:
    manifest = {
        "manifestType": "minecraftModpack",
        "manifestVersion": 1,
        "name": "猫猫测试整合包",
        "version": "1.0.0",
        "author": "LFELKEEA",
        "minecraft": {
            "version": "1.21.1",
            "modLoaders": [{"id": "fabric-0.16.9", "primary": True}],
        },
        "files": [{"projectID": 111, "fileID": 222, "required": True}],
        "overrides": "overrides",
    }
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr("manifest.json", json.dumps(manifest))
        zf.writestr("overrides/config/demo.toml", "enabled = true\n")
        zf.writestr("overrides/resourcepacks/extra.zip", b"pk")
        zf.writestr("overrides/shaderpacks/demo.zip", b"shader")


def pack_tests() -> bool:
    ok = True
    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cf_pack_"))
    pack = root / "demo.zip"
    make_pack(pack)

    ok &= check("looks_like_pack", looks_like_curseforge_pack(pack))
    info = inspect_curseforge_pack(pack)
    ok &= check(
        "inspect_pack",
        info.name == "猫猫测试整合包"
        and info.minecraft_version == "1.21.1"
        and info.loader_key == "fabric"
        and info.loader == "Fabric"
        and info.loader_version == "0.16.9"
        and len(info.files) == 1
        and len(info.overrides) == 3
        and info.counts["mods"] == 1
        and info.counts["config"] == 1
        and info.counts["resourcepacks"] == 1
        and info.counts["shaderpacks"] == 1
        and info.total_files == 4,
        f"files={len(info.overrides)} counts={info.counts}",
    )

    bad = root / "bad.zip"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(bad, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr(
            "manifest.json",
            json.dumps({"manifestType": "somethingElse", "manifestVersion": 1}),
        )
    ok &= check("not_curseforge_pack", not looks_like_curseforge_pack(bad))
    try:
        inspect_curseforge_pack(bad)
    except CurseForgePackError:
        ok &= check("inspect_rejects_bad_manifest", True)
    else:
        ok &= check("inspect_rejects_bad_manifest", False)

    game_dir = root / "game"
    calls: list[tuple] = []
    downloads: list[str] = []
    progress: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    logs: list[str] = []

    def fake_loader(game, mc, kind, version, **kwargs):
        calls.append(("loader", str(game), mc, kind, version))
        return "fabric-loader-0.16.9-1.21.1"

    def fake_fetch(project_id, file_id, content_type="mod"):
        calls.append(("fetch", project_id, file_id, content_type))
        return {
            "files": [
                {
                    "primary": True,
                    "url": "https://edge.forgecdn.net/files/111/222/coolmod.jar",
                    "filename": "coolmod.jar",
                    "size": 4,
                    "hashes": {"sha1": "abc"},
                }
            ]
        }

    def fake_download(url, dest, **kwargs):
        downloads.append(url)
        Path(dest).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(dest).write_bytes(b"data")
        return 4

    try:
        result = import_curseforge_pack(
            pack,
            game_dir,
            "DemoPack",
            loader_installer=fake_loader,
            file_fetcher=fake_fetch,
            download_func=fake_download,
            progress_cb=lambda p, m: progress.append((p, m)),
            log_cb=lambda m: logs.append(m),
        )
        version_json = game_dir / "versions" / "DemoPack" / "DemoPack.json"
        run_dir = game_dir / "versions" / "DemoPack"
        ok &= check(
            "import_pack",
            result.version_id == "DemoPack"
            and result.downloaded_files == 1
            and result.imported_files == 4
            and version_json.is_file()
            and json.loads(version_json.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["inheritsFrom"]
            == "fabric-loader-0.16.9-1.21.1"
            and (run_dir / "mods" / "coolmod.jar").read_bytes() == b"data"
            and (run_dir / "config" / "demo.toml").is_file()
            and (run_dir / "resourcepacks" / "extra.zip").is_file()
            and (run_dir / "shaderpacks" / "demo.zip").is_file()
            and progress[-1][0] == 100
            and any("CurseForge 整合包" in line for line in logs),
            f"result={result} progress={progress[-1] if progress else None}",
        )
        ok &= check(
            "import_loader_args",
            ("loader", str(game_dir), "1.21.1", "fabric", "0.16.9") in calls,
            str(calls),
        )
        ok &= check(
            "import_fetch_args",
            ("fetch", "111", "222", "mod") in calls,
            str(calls),
        )
        ok &= check(
            "import_cdn_url",
            downloads and downloads[0].startswith("https://mod.mcimirror.top/"),
            str(downloads),
        )

        try:
            import_curseforge_pack(
                pack,
                game_dir,
                "DemoPack",
                loader_installer=fake_loader,
                file_fetcher=fake_fetch,
                download_func=fake_download,
            )
        except CurseForgePackError as exc:
            ok &= check("import_rejects_existing", "已经存在" in str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("import_rejects_existing", False)

        blocked = root / "blocked.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(blocked, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr(
                "manifest.json",
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "manifestType": "minecraftModpack",
                        "manifestVersion": 1,
                        "name": "Blocked",
                        "version": "1",
                        "minecraft": {
                            "version": "1.21.1",
                            "modLoaders": [
                                {"id": "fabric-0.16.9", "primary": True}
                            ],
                        },
                        "files": [{"projectID": 1, "fileID": 2, "required": True}],
                    }
                ),
            )
        try:
            import_curseforge_pack(
                blocked,
                root / "game2",
                "Blocked",
                loader_installer=fake_loader,
                file_fetcher=lambda *a, **k: {
                    "files": [
                        {
                            "primary": True,
                            "url": "",
                            "filename": "blocked.jar",
                            "size": 1,
                            "hashes": {},
                        }
                    ]
                },
                download_func=fake_download,
            )
        except CurseForgePackError as exc:
            ok &= check("import_blocked_file", "第三方下载" in str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("import_blocked_file", False)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
    return ok


def worker_tests() -> bool:
    ok = True
    QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    captured: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    original = (
        wk.search_mods,
        wk.search_curseforge_mods,
        wk.fetch_mod_versions,
        wk.fetch_curseforge_mod_versions,
    )

    def fake_mr_search(query, **kwargs):
        captured.append(("mr_search", dict(kwargs)))
        return {"hits": [], "total_hits": 0}

    def fake_cf_search(query, **kwargs):
        captured.append(("cf_search", dict(kwargs)))
        return {"hits": [], "total_hits": 0}

    def fake_mr_versions(project_id, loader="", game_version="", **kwargs):
        captured.append(("mr_versions", dict(kwargs)))
        return []

    def fake_cf_versions(project_id, loader="", game_version="", **kwargs):
        captured.append(("cf_versions", dict(kwargs)))
        return []

    try:
        wk.search_mods = fake_mr_search
        wk.search_curseforge_mods = fake_cf_search
        wk.fetch_mod_versions = fake_mr_versions
        wk.fetch_curseforge_mod_versions = fake_cf_versions

        results: list[tuple] = []
        worker = wk.ModSearchWorker(
            "q", "fabric", "1.21.1", source="modrinth", content_type="shader"
        )
        worker.ready.connect(lambda data, error, offset: results.append((data, error)))
        worker._run()
        ok &= check(
            "worker_modrinth_type",
            captured[-1][0] == "mr_search"
            and captured[-1][1].get("project_type") == "shader"
            and results == [({"hits": [], "total_hits": 0}, "")],
            str(captured[-1]),
        )

        worker = wk.ModSearchWorker(
            "q", "fabric", "1.21.1", source="curseforge", content_type="modpack"
        )
        worker._run()
        ok &= check(
            "worker_curseforge_type",
            captured[-1][0] == "cf_search"
            and captured[-1][1].get("content_type") == "modpack",
            str(captured[-1]),
        )

        worker = wk.ModVersionsWorker(
            "abc", "fabric", "1.21.1", source="modrinth", content_type="resourcepack"
        )
        worker._run()
        ok &= check(
            "worker_version_type",
            captured[-1][0] == "mr_versions"
            and captured[-1][1].get("content_type") == "resourcepack",
            str(captured[-1]),
        )
    finally:
        (
            wk.search_mods,
            wk.search_curseforge_mods,
            wk.fetch_mod_versions,
            wk.fetch_curseforge_mod_versions,
        ) = original
    return ok

def ui_tests() -> bool:
    ok = True
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    mod_dialog.ModSearchWorker.start = lambda self: None
    mod_dialog.ModProjectWorker.start = lambda self: None
    mod_dialog.ModVersionsWorker.start = lambda self: None
    mod_dialog.ModProjectsWorker.start = lambda self: None

    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ct_ui_"))
    for version_id, data in (
        ("1.21.1", {"id": "1.21.1"}),
        ("1.21.1-Fabric", {"id": "1.21.1-Fabric", "inheritsFrom": "1.21.1"}),
    ):
        folder = root / "versions" / version_id
        folder.mkdir(parents=True)
        (folder / f"{version_id}.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8"
        )

    versions = [
        VersionSummary(
            id="1.21.1-Fabric",
            loader="Fabric",
            parent_id="1.21.1",
            base_id="1.21.1",
        )
    ]
    window = FakeMain(Config(game_dir=str(root)), versions)
    window.config.version_isolation = True
    dialog = ModBrowserDialog(window)
    app.processEvents()
    dialog._polling = False
    dialog.search_btn.setEnabled(True)

    ok &= check(
        "default_content_type",
        dialog._content_type == "mod"
        and dialog.type_tabs.current() == "mod"
        and dialog.title_label.text() == "下载 Mod",
        f"{dialog._content_type} {dialog.title_label.text()}",
    )

    dialog._set_content_type("resourcepack")
    app.processEvents()
    worker = dialog._search_worker
    ok &= check(
        "resourcepack_mode",
        dialog._content_type == "resourcepack"
        and dialog.type_tabs.current() == "resourcepack"
        and dialog.title_label.text() == "下载 材质"
        and dialog.loader_tabs.isHidden()
        and dialog.download_btn.text() == "下载到 resourcepacks"
        and dialog._folder_btn.text() == "打开 resourcepacks 文件夹"
        and worker is not None
        and worker.content_type == "resourcepack"
        and dialog._target_version_id == "1.21.1-Fabric"
        and dialog._target_dir()
        == root / "versions" / "1.21.1-Fabric" / "resourcepacks",
        f"target={dialog._target_version_id} dir={dialog._target_dir()}",
    )

    dialog._polling = False
    dialog.search_btn.setEnabled(True)
    dialog._set_content_type("shader")
    app.processEvents()
    ok &= check(
        "shader_mode",
        dialog.title_label.text() == "下载 光影"
        and dialog.download_btn.text() == "下载到 shaderpacks"
        and dialog._target_dir()
        == root / "versions" / "1.21.1-Fabric" / "shaderpacks",
        dialog.download_btn.text(),
    )

    dialog._polling = False
    dialog.search_btn.setEnabled(True)
    dialog._set_content_type("modpack")
    app.processEvents()
    dialog.version_combo.clear()
    dialog.version_combo.addItem(
        "Demo Pack",
        {
            "source": "modrinth",
            "files": [
                {
                    "primary": True,
                    "url": "https://cdn.modrinth.com/demo.mrpack",
                    "filename": "demo.mrpack",
                }
            ],
        },
    )
    dialog._sync_download_button()
    ok &= check(
        "modpack_mode",
        dialog.title_label.text() == "下载 整合包"
        and dialog.download_btn.text() == "下载并导入整合包"
        and dialog._folder_btn.text() == "打开整合包缓存"
        and not dialog.loader_tabs.isVisible()
        and dialog._target_version_id == ""
        and dialog.download_btn.isEnabled(),
        f"button={dialog.download_btn.text()} enabled={dialog.download_btn.isEnabled()}",
    )

    dialog._polling = False
    dialog.search_btn.setEnabled(True)
    dialog._set_content_type("mod")
    app.processEvents()
    ok &= check(
        "back_to_mod",
        dialog.title_label.text() == "下载 Mod"
        and not dialog.loader_tabs.isHidden()
        and dialog._download_button_text() == "下载到 mods",
        dialog.title_label.text(),
    )

    dialog._polling = False
    dialog.search_btn.setEnabled(True)
    dialog._set_source("curseforge")
    app.processEvents()
    dialog._polling = False
    dialog.search_btn.setEnabled(True)
    dialog._set_content_type("shader")
    app.processEvents()
    worker = dialog._search_worker
    ok &= check(
        "curseforge_shader_search",
        worker is not None
        and worker.source == "curseforge"
        and worker.content_type == "shader",
        f"source={getattr(worker, 'source', '')} type={getattr(worker, 'content_type', '')}",
    )

    from darkitten.ui.pack_dialog import PackImportDialog

    pack = root / "demo.zip"
    make_pack(pack)
    pack_dialog = PackImportDialog(window, initial_path=pack)
    app.processEvents()
    ok &= check(
        "pack_dialog_curseforge",
        pack_dialog._kind == "curseforge"
        and pack_dialog.preview_name.text() == "猫猫测试整合包"
        and "CurseForge" in pack_dialog.preview_meta.text()
        and "Minecraft 1.21.1" in pack_dialog.preview_mc.text()
        and "Fabric 0.16.9" in pack_dialog.preview_loader.text()
        and pack_dialog.import_btn.isEnabled()
        and bool(pack_dialog.name_edit.text()),
        f"kind={pack_dialog._kind} meta={pack_dialog.preview_meta.text()}",
    )
    pack_dialog.deleteLater()

    dialog.close()
    window.close()
    app.processEvents()
    shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
    return ok


def main() -> int:
    ok = modrinth_tests()
    ok &= curseforge_tests()
    ok &= pack_tests()
    ok &= worker_tests()
    ok &= ui_tests()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def check(label: str, value: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if value else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail else ""))
    return bool(value)

def unit_tests() -> bool:
    ok = True

    hit = cf.normalize_hit(MOD)
    ok &= check(
        "hit_fields",
        hit["project_id"] == "238222"
        and hit["title"] == "Just Enough Items"
        and hit["author"] == "mezz"
        and hit["downloads"] == 638976999
        and hit["source"] == "curseforge"
        and hit["icon_url"].endswith("/256/a.png"),
        str(hit),
    )

    project = cf.normalize_project(MOD)
    ok &= check(
        "project_fields",
        project["body"].startswith("<p>")
        and project["followers"] == 12345
        and project["loaders"] == ["Fabric", "Forge"]
        and project["game_versions"] == ["1.21.1", "1.20.1"]
        and project["gallery"][0]["full_url"].endswith("full.png")
        and project["source_url"].startswith("https://github.com/")
        and project["project_url"].endswith("/mc-mods/jei"),
        str(project["loaders"]) + " " + str(project["game_versions"]),
    )

    version = cf.normalize_file(FILE)
    file = version["files"][0]
    ok &= check(
        "file_fields",
        version["id"] == "9298210"
        and version["version_type"] == "beta"
        and version["source"] == "curseforge"
        and file["filename"].endswith(".jar")
        and file["size"] == 6928789
        and file["hashes"]["sha1"].startswith("21081fe")
        and version["loaders"] == ["fabric"]
        and version["game_versions"] == ["1.20.1"]
        and version["dependencies"]
        == [{"project_id": "419699", "version_id": "", "dependency_type": "required"}],
        str(version),
    )

    no_url = dict(FILE, downloadUrl=None)
    no_url_version = cf.normalize_file(no_url)
    ok &= check(
        "file_without_url",
        no_url_version["files"][0]["url"] == "",
        str(no_url_version["files"]),
    )

    captured: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []

    def fake_json(path, params=None, timeout=35):
        captured.append((path, dict(params or {})))
        return {
            "data": [MOD],
            "pagination": {"index": 0, "pageSize": 5, "totalCount": 42},
        }

    original_json = cf._request_json
    try:
        cf._request_json = fake_json
        result = cf.search_mods(
            "jei", loader="fabric", game_version="1.21.1", limit=5, offset=10
        )
        params = captured[-1][1]
        ok &= check(
            "search_query_params",
            params.get("sortField") == 11
            and "sortOrder" not in params
            and params.get("modLoaderType") == 4
            and params.get("gameVersion") == "1.21.1"
            and params.get("index") == 10
            and params.get("searchFilter") == "jei"
            and result["total_hits"] == 42
            and result["hits"][0]["source"] == "curseforge",
            str(params),
        )
        cf.search_mods("", loader="forge", game_version="1.20.1", limit=5)
        params = captured[-1][1]
        ok &= check(
            "search_browse_params",
            params.get("sortField") == 2
            and params.get("sortOrder") == "desc"
            and params.get("modLoaderType") == 1
            and "searchFilter" not in params,
            str(params),
        )
    finally:
        cf._request_json = original_json

    # fetch_mod_versions 只保留匹配加载器/游戏版本的文件。
    captured.clear()

    def fake_files(path, params=None, timeout=35):
        captured.append((path, dict(params or {})))
        return {
            "data": [
                dict(FILE),
                dict(FILE, id=2, fileName="jei-forge.jar", gameVersions=["1.20.1", "Forge"]),
                dict(FILE, id=3, fileName="jei-1211.jar", gameVersions=["1.21.1", "Fabric"]),
            ]
        }

    try:
        cf._request_json = fake_files
        versions = cf.fetch_mod_versions("238222", "fabric", "1.20.1")
        ok &= check(
            "versions_filter",
            len(versions) == 1
            and versions[0]["files"][0]["filename"] == "jei-1.20.1-fabric-15.74.0.229.jar"
            and captured[-1][1].get("modLoaderType") == 4
            and captured[-1][1].get("gameVersion") == "1.20.1",
            str([v["files"][0]["filename"] for v in versions]),
        )
    finally:
        cf._request_json = original_json

    urls = cf.candidate_download_urls(FILE["downloadUrl"])
    ok &= check(
        "cdn_fallback_urls",
        urls[0].startswith("https://mod.mcimirror.top/files/9298/210/")
        and any("mediafilez.forgecdn.net" in url for url in urls)
        and urls[-1] == FILE["downloadUrl"],
        str(urls),
    )
    ok &= check(
        "non_cdn_url",
        cf.candidate_download_urls("https://example.com/a.jar")
        == ["https://example.com/a.jar"],
    )

    # 下载：第一个镜像失败后自动回退到第二个地址。
    calls: list[str] = []

    def fake_download(url, dest, **kwargs):
        calls.append(url)
        if len(calls) == 1:
            raise OSError("mirror down")
        Path(dest).write_bytes(b"x" * 10)
        return 10

    original_download = cf.download_to_file
    root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cf_unit_"))
    try:
        cf.download_to_file = fake_download
        version = {
            "source": "curseforge",
            "files": [
                {
                    "primary": True,
                    "url": FILE["downloadUrl"],
                    "filename": "demo.jar",
                    "size": 10,
                    "hashes": {"sha1": "abc"},
                }
            ],
        }
        path = cf.download_mod_file(version, root)
        ok &= check(
            "download_fallback",
            path.name == "demo.jar"
            and len(calls) == 2
            and calls[0].startswith("https://mod.mcimirror.top/")
            and calls[1].startswith("https://mediafilez.forgecdn.net/"),
            str(calls),
        )
        calls.clear()
        cf.download_mod_file(version, root)
        ok &= check("download_skip_existing", not calls, str(calls))

        no_url = {
            "files": [
                {
                    "primary": True,
                    "url": "",
                    "filename": "blocked.jar",
                    "size": 10,
                    "hashes": {},
                }
            ]
        }
        try:
            cf.download_mod_file(no_url, root)
        except cf.CurseForgeError as exc:
            ok &= check("download_blocked", "第三方下载" in str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("download_blocked", False)

        def cancel_download(url, dest, **kwargs):
            raise DownloadCancelled()

        cf.download_to_file = cancel_download
        try:
            cf.download_mod_file(version, root / "cancel")
        except DownloadCancelled:
            ok &= check("download_cancel", True)
        else:
            ok &= check("download_cancel", False)
    finally:
        cf.download_to_file = original_download
        import shutil

        shutil.rmtree(root, ignore_errors=True)
    return ok

# FILE: qa/test_download_optimizations.py
