from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from darkitten.downloader import (  # noqa: E402
    BatchDownload,
    TransferError,
    download_batch,
    download_to_file,
)

CHECKS: list[str] = []


def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(f"{name} FAILED {detail}")
    CHECKS.append(name)
    print(f"{name}: OK")


class Stats:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.requests = 0
        self.connections: set[int] = set()
        self.bytes = 0
        self.ranges: list[str] = []
        self.broken: set[str] = set()

    def connection(self, port: int) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.connections.add(port)

    def begin(self, range_header: str) -> tuple[int, bool]:
        with self.lock:
            self.requests += 1
            self.ranges.append(range_header)
            should_break = False
            if (
                range_header
                and range_header not in self.broken
                and len(self.broken) < 4
            ):
                self.broken.add(range_header)
                should_break = True
            return self.requests, should_break

    def sent(self, count: int) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.bytes += count

    def snapshot(self) -> tuple[int, int, int]:
        with self.lock:
            return self.requests, len(self.connections), self.bytes


def handler_for(stats: Stats, data: bytes, *, range_support: bool, break_once: bool):
    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

        def setup(self) -> None:
            super().setup()
            stats.connection(self.client_address[1])

        def handle(self) -> None:
            try:
                super().handle()
            except (ConnectionAbortedError, ConnectionResetError, BrokenPipeError):
                pass

        def log_message(self, _format, *_args) -> None:
            return

        def do_GET(self) -> None:
            range_header = self.headers.get("Range") or ""
            _request_no, should_break = stats.begin(range_header)
            start = 0
            end = len(data) - 1
            status = 200
            if range_support and range_header.startswith("bytes="):
                spec = range_header.split("=", 1)[1].split(",", 1)[0]
                left, _, right = spec.partition("-")
                try:
                    if left:
                        start = int(left)
                        if right:
                            end = min(int(right), len(data) - 1)
                    elif right:
                        start = max(0, len(data) - int(right))
                except ValueError:
                    start, end = 0, len(data) - 1
                status = 206

            body = data[start : end + 1]
            if break_once and should_break and len(body) > 1:
                half = len(body) // 2
                self.send_response(status)
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                self.send_header(
                    "Accept-Ranges", "bytes" if range_support else "none"
                )
                if status == 206:
                    self.send_header(
                        "Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{len(data)}"
                    )
                self.end_headers()
                try:
                    self.wfile.write(body[:half])
                    self.wfile.flush()
                    stats.sent(half)
                finally:
                    self.close_connection = True
                return

            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.send_header("Accept-Ranges", "bytes" if range_support else "none")
            if status == 206:
                self.send_header(
                    "Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{len(data)}"
                )
            self.end_headers()
            try:
                self.wfile.write(body)
                self.wfile.flush()
                stats.sent(len(body))
            except (ConnectionAbortedError, ConnectionResetError, BrokenPipeError):
                self.close_connection = True

    return Handler


class Server:
    def __init__(
        self,
        data: bytes,
        *,
        range_support: bool = True,
        break_once: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self.stats = Stats()
        handler = handler_for(
            self.stats, data, range_support=range_support, break_once=break_once
        )
        self.httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), handler)
        self.httpd.daemon_threads = True
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.httpd.server_address[1]}/file"

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.httpd.shutdown()
        self.httpd.server_close()
        self.thread.join(timeout=5)


def sha1(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()


def test_probe_behavior() -> None:
    data = bytes(range(256)) * (4 * 1024 * 1024 // 256)
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dkl-known-"))
    server = Server(data)
    try:
        download_to_file(
            server.url,
            work / "known.bin",
            sha1=sha1(data),
            size=len(data),
            connections=4,
        )
        requests, connections, _ = server.stats.snapshot()
        check("known-size-no-probe", requests == 4, f"requests={requests}")
        check("known-size-segments", connections == 4, f"connections={connections}")
    finally:
        server.close()

    server = Server(data)
    try:
        download_to_file(
            server.url,
            work / "unknown.bin",
            sha1=sha1(data),
            size=0,
            connections=4,
        )
        requests, _connections, _ = server.stats.snapshot()
        check("unknown-size-probes", requests == 5, f"requests={requests}")
    finally:
        server.close()


def test_batch_keepalive() -> None:
    files = {
        f"small-{index}.bin": bytes([index]) * 65536 for index in range(30)
    }

    class MultiHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
        stats = Stats()
        lock = threading.Lock()

        def setup(self) -> None:
            super().setup()
            self.stats.connection(self.client_address[1])

        def handle(self) -> None:
            try:
                super().handle()
            except (ConnectionAbortedError, ConnectionResetError, BrokenPipeError):
                pass

        def log_message(self, _format, *_args) -> None:
            return

        def do_GET(self) -> None:
            self.stats.begin(self.headers.get("Range") or "")
            name = self.path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
            data = files.get(name)
            if data is None:
                self.send_error(404)
                return
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.end_headers()
            try:
                self.wfile.write(data)
                self.wfile.flush()
                self.stats.sent(len(data))
            except (ConnectionAbortedError, ConnectionResetError, BrokenPipeError):
                self.close_connection = True

    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), MultiHandler)
    httpd.daemon_threads = True
    thread = threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{httpd.server_address[1]}"
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dkl-batch-"))
    try:
        tasks = [
            BatchDownload(
                dest=work / name,
                urls=[f"{base}/{name}"],
                sha1=sha1(data),
                size=len(data),
                label=name,
            )
            for name, data in files.items()
        ]
        success, failures = download_batch(
            tasks, connections=2, max_workers=6, percent_range=(10, 90)
        )
        check("batch-success", success == len(files), str(failures))
        check("batch-files", all((work / name).read_bytes() == data for name, data in files.items()))
        requests, connections, _ = MultiHandler.stats.snapshot()
        check("batch-requests", requests == len(files), f"requests={requests}")
        check(
            "batch-keepalive",
            connections <= 8,
            f"connections={connections} workers=6",
        )
    finally:
        httpd.shutdown()
        httpd.server_close()
        thread.join(timeout=5)


def test_range_fallback() -> None:
    data = bytes(range(256)) * (4 * 1024 * 1024 // 256)
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dkl-norange-"))
    server = Server(data, range_support=False)
    try:
        download_to_file(
            server.url,
            work / "norange.bin",
            sha1=sha1(data),
            size=len(data),
            connections=4,
        )
        check("range-fallback", (work / "norange.bin").read_bytes() == data)
        requests, _connections, _ = server.stats.snapshot()
        check("range-fallback-requests", requests == 5, f"requests={requests}")
    finally:
        server.close()


def test_segment_resume() -> None:
    data = bytes(range(256)) * (8 * 1024 * 1024 // 256)
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dkl-resume-"))
    server = Server(data, break_once=True)
    try:
        download_to_file(
            server.url,
            work / "resume.bin",
            sha1=sha1(data),
            size=len(data),
            connections=4,
        )
        check("segment-resume-file", (work / "resume.bin").read_bytes() == data)
        requests, _connections, sent = server.stats.snapshot()
        check("segment-resume-retried", requests >= 8, f"requests={requests}")
        check(
            "segment-resume-not-restarted",
            sent <= len(data) + 512 * 1024,
            f"sent={sent} size={len(data)}",
        )
    finally:
        server.close()


def test_batch_progress_and_failure() -> None:
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dkl-progress-"))
    percentages: list[int] = []
    payload = b"x" * 1024

    def fake(url, dest, **kwargs):
        dest = Path(dest)
        callback = kwargs.get("progress_cb")
        if "bad" in url:
            if callback:
                callback(512, 1024)
            raise RuntimeError("模拟失败")
        dest.write_bytes(payload)
        if callback:
            callback(1024, 1024)
        return len(payload)

    task = BatchDownload(
        dest=work / "retry.bin",
        urls=["http://example.invalid/bad", "http://example.invalid/good"],
        size=len(payload),
        label="retry.bin",
    )
    success, failures = download_batch(
        [task],
        max_workers=1,
        progress_cb=lambda percent, _message: percentages.append(percent),
        download_func=fake,
    )
    check("batch-retry-success", success == 1, str(failures))
    check("batch-retry-file", (work / "retry.bin").read_bytes() == payload)
    check(
        "batch-progress-monotonic",
        percentages == sorted(percentages),
        str(percentages),
    )
    check("batch-progress-final", percentages and percentages[-1] == 100, str(percentages))


def test_sha1_failure_cleans_up() -> None:
    data = bytes(range(256)) * (2 * 1024 * 1024 // 256)
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dkl-sha-"))
    server = Server(data)
    try:
        try:
            download_to_file(
                server.url,
                work / "bad.bin",
                sha1="0" * 40,
                size=len(data),
                connections=4,
            )
        except TransferError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError("sha1 mismatch should fail")
        check("sha1-failure", not (work / "bad.bin").exists())
        check(
            "sha1-cleanup",
            not list(work.glob("*.part")) and not list(work.glob("*.seg*")),
        )
    finally:
        server.close()


def main() -> int:
    test_probe_behavior()
    test_batch_keepalive()
    test_range_fallback()
    test_segment_resume()
    test_batch_progress_and_failure()
    test_sha1_failure_cleans_up()
    print(f"RESULT: PASS ({len(CHECKS)} checks)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# FILE: qa/test_downloader.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from darkitten.downloader import (
    DownloadCancelled,
    cleanup_partial_files,
    download_to_file,
    partial_files,
)

SIZE = 8 * 1024 * 1024
DATA = bytes((i * 37 + 11) % 256 for i in range(SIZE))
SHA1 = hashlib.sha1(DATA).hexdigest()


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def log_message(self, *args) -> None:
        pass

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path not in ("/file.bin", "/slow.bin"):
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        data = DATA
        start = 0
        end = len(data) - 1
        header = self.headers.get("Range") or ""
        if header.startswith("bytes="):
            part = header.split("=", 1)[1]
            left, _, right = part.partition("-")
            start = int(left or 0)
            end = int(right) if right else len(data) - 1
            end = min(end, len(data) - 1)
            self.send_response(206)
            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{len(data)}")
        else:
            self.send_response(200)
        body = data[start : end + 1]
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
        self.end_headers()
        delay = 0.02 if self.path == "/slow.bin" else 0.002
        try:
            for offset in range(0, len(body), 65536):
                self.wfile.write(body[offset : offset + 65536])
                self.wfile.flush()
                time.sleep(delay)
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            pass


def main() -> None:
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}"
    ok = True
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
            root = Path(raw)
            progress = []
            dest = root / "multi.bin"
            written = download_to_file(
                f"{base}/file.bin",
                dest,
                sha1=SHA1,
                size=SIZE,
                progress_cb=lambda done, total: progress.append((done, total)),
                connections=4,
            )
            good = (
                written == SIZE
                and dest.read_bytes() == DATA
                and not dest.with_name(dest.name + ".part").exists()
            )
            print("multi_stream:", "OK" if good else "FAIL", written, len(progress))
            ok &= good

            slow_dest = root / "cancel.bin"
            cancel = threading.Event()

            def cancel_later() -> None:
                time.sleep(0.35)
                cancel.set()

            threading.Thread(target=cancel_later, daemon=True).start()
            try:
                download_to_file(
                    f"{base}/slow.bin",
                    slow_dest,
                    cancel_event=cancel,
                    connections=4,
                )
            except DownloadCancelled:
                cancelled_ok = not slow_dest.exists() and not partial_files(root)
                print("cancel_cleanup:", "OK" if cancelled_ok else "FAIL")
                ok &= cancelled_ok
            else:
                print("cancel_cleanup: FAIL (not cancelled)")
                ok = False

            (root / "keep.txt").write_text("keep", encoding="utf-8")
            (root / "stale.part").write_bytes(b"x" * 1024)
            (root / "stale2.part.seg1").write_bytes(b"y" * 2048)
            removed, freed = cleanup_partial_files(root)
            cleanup_ok = (
                removed == 2
                and freed == 3072
                and (root / "keep.txt").exists()
                and not partial_files(root)
            )
            print("partial_cleanup:", "OK" if cleanup_ok else "FAIL", removed, freed)
            ok &= cleanup_ok
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# FILE: qa/test_game_finished.py

"""回归测试：游戏主进程退出后，即使子进程占着 stdout，也必须立刻通知界面。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QTimer

from darkitten.launch import GameProcess, LaunchPlan


def main() -> int:
    workdir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dkl-game-finished-"))
    pid_file = workdir / "child.pid"
    script = workdir / "parent.py"
    script.write_text(
        "import subprocess, sys\n"
        "child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', 'import time; time.sleep(8)'])\n"
        f"open({str(pid_file)!r}, 'w').write(str(child.pid))\n"
        "print('parent finished', flush=True)\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    app = QCoreApplication([])
    plan = LaunchPlan(
        command=[sys.executable, str(script)],
        cwd=str(workdir),
        java=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        version=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    )
    process = GameProcess(plan)
    started = time.monotonic()
    result: dict[str, object] = {"elapsed": None, "code": None, "output": []}

    def on_output(line: str) -> None:
        result["output"].append(line)

    def on_finished(code: int) -> None:
        result["elapsed"] = time.monotonic() - started
        result["code"] = code
        QTimer.singleShot(50, app.quit)

    process.output.connect(on_output)
    process.game_finished.connect(on_finished)
    process.start()

    def timeout() -> None:
        if result["elapsed"] is None:
            result["timeout"] = True
            app.quit()

    QTimer.singleShot(5000, timeout)
    app.exec()

    child_pid = ""
    try:
        child_pid = pid_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    except OSError:
        pass
    if child_pid and sys.platform == "win32":
        subprocess.run(
            ["taskkill", "/PID", child_pid, "/F"],
            capture_output=True,
            creationflags=0x08000000,
        )

    elapsed = result["elapsed"]
    print(f"finished code={result['code']} elapsed={elapsed}")
    print("output:", result["output"])
    if result.get("timeout"):
        print("FAIL: game_finished was not emitted while the inherited stdout stayed open")
        return 1
    if result["code"] != 0:
        print("FAIL: unexpected exit code")
        return 1
    if elapsed is None or float(elapsed) > 3.5:
        print("FAIL: game_finished took too long")
        return 1
    print("PASS: game_finished fired promptly")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:

def check(label: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(f"{label} failed {detail}")
    print(f"ok  {label}" + (f" · {detail}" if detail else ""))


def test_pixel_art() -> None:
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
    from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QGuiApplication

    _app = QGuiApplication.instance() or QGuiApplication([])
    from darkitten.ui import icons

    image = icons.app_icon_image(32)
    check("32px canvas", image.size().width() == 32 and image.size().height() == 32)
    check("rounded corner transparent", image.pixelColor(0, 0).alpha() == 0)
    check(
        "rose badge top",
        image.pixelColor(10, 1).name() == "#e92e64",
        image.pixelColor(10, 1).name(),
    )
    check(
        "rose badge bottom",
        image.pixelColor(10, 30).name() == "#690b23",
        image.pixelColor(10, 30).name(),
    )
    check(
        "ivory ear on the left",
        image.pixelColor(5, 12).name() == "#fff6ee",
        image.pixelColor(5, 12).name(),
    )
    check(
        "ivory body on the right",
        image.pixelColor(18, 18).name() == "#fff6ee",
        image.pixelColor(18, 18).name(),
    )
    check(
        "crimson eye",
        image.pixelColor(7, 18).name() == "#d81b4a",
        image.pixelColor(7, 18).name(),
    )
    check(
        "tail on the right",
        image.pixelColor(27, 18).name() == "#fff6ee",
        image.pixelColor(27, 18).name(),
    )
    check(
        "cheek blush",
        image.pixelColor(9, 20).name() == "#f7dfe1",
        image.pixelColor(9, 20).name(),
    )
    check(
        "haunch shading",
        image.pixelColor(22, 19).name() == "#f7dfe1",
        image.pixelColor(22, 19).name(),
    )

    body_colors = set()
    for y in range(32):
        for x in range(32):
            color = image.pixelColor(x, y)
            if color.alpha():
                body_colors.add(color.name())
    check("rose gradient palette", 28 <= len(body_colors) <= 36, f"{len(body_colors)} colors")
    check("old grass green removed", "#7ec850" not in body_colors and "#5ebb3e" not in body_colors)

    small = icons.app_icon_image(16)
    check("eye survives 16px", small.pixelColor(3, 9).name() == "#d81b4a")
    check("eye slit survives 16px", small.pixelColor(3, 10).name() == "#d81b4a")

    large = icons.app_icon_image(256)
    check("256px canvas", large.size().width() == 256 and large.size().height() == 256)
    uniform = True
    for y in range(120, 128):
        for x in range(80, 88):
            if large.pixelColor(x, y).name() != "#fff6ee":
                uniform = False
    check("nearest-neighbour pixels", uniform)

    for size in (16, 24, 48, 64, 128, 256):
        scaled = icons.app_icon_image(size)
        check(f"{size}px generated", scaled.width() == size and scaled.height() == size)


def test_ico() -> None:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QImage

    ico = PROJECT / "assets" / "dkl.ico"
    payload = ico.read_bytes()
    check("ico exists", ico.is_file() and len(payload) > 1000, f"{len(payload)} bytes")
    reserved, kind, count = struct.unpack("<HHH", payload[:6])
    check("ico header", (reserved, kind, count) == (0, 1, 7), f"count={count}")

    expected = {16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256}
    found = set()
    for index in range(count):
        entry = payload[6 + index * 16 : 6 + (index + 1) * 16]
        width, height, _, _, _, _, length, offset = struct.unpack("<BBBBHHII", entry)
        size = 256 if width == 0 else width
        found.add(size)
        data = payload[offset : offset + length]
        decoded = QImage.fromData(data, "PNG")
        check(
            f"ico {size}px decodes",
            not decoded.isNull() and decoded.width() == size,
            f"{decoded.width()}x{decoded.height()}",
        )
    check("ico sizes", found == expected, str(sorted(found)))


def main() -> int:
    test_pixel_art()
    test_ico()
    print("all icon checks passed")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# FILE: qa/test_install_repair.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from darkitten.installer import Installer
from darkitten.versions import check_installation, resolve_version

ROOT = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "darkitten_shots" / "game"
VERSION = "1.21.1"


def main() -> int:
    root = ROOT
    if not (root / "versions" / VERSION / f"{VERSION}.json").is_file():
        # 这是依赖本地已装好 1.21.1 的联网修复测试，缺少夹具时跳过而不是误报失败。
        print(f"SKIP install_repair: 缺少本地测试夹具 {root}")
        return 0
    resolved = resolve_version(root, VERSION)
    before = check_installation(root, resolved, check_assets=True)
    print(f"before: missing={len(before)}", flush=True)

    started = time.time()
    last = {"t": 0.0}

    def progress(percent: int, message: str) -> None:
        now = time.time()
        if now - last["t"] >= 2 or percent >= 100:
            last["t"] = now
            print(f"[{now - started:6.1f}s] {percent:3d}% {message}", flush=True)

    installer = Installer(
        root,
        source="auto",
        threads=8,
        progress_cb=progress,
        log_cb=lambda m: print(f"  LOG {m}", flush=True),
    )
    installer.install(VERSION, check_assets=True)
    elapsed = time.time() - started

    after = check_installation(root, resolve_version(root, VERSION), check_assets=True)
    print(f"elapsed={elapsed:.1f}s", flush=True)
    print(f"after: missing={len(after)}", flush=True)
    if after:
        print("missing sample:", after[:10], flush=True)
    ok = not after and not installer.cancel_event.is_set()
    print("REPAIR_OK" if ok else "REPAIR_FAIL", flush=True)
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# FILE: qa/test_launch_flow.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEventLoop, QTimer

import darkitten.workers as workers
from darkitten.accounts import Account
from darkitten.config import Config
from darkitten.launch import GameProcess


def test_launch_cancel(app: QCoreApplication) -> bool:
    def slow_prepare(*_args, **_kwargs):
        time.sleep(0.8)
        return SimpleNamespace(warnings=[])

    original = workers.prepare_launch
    workers.prepare_launch = slow_prepare
    try:
        worker = workers.LaunchWorker(
            Path("."), "test", Config(), [], Account.offline("Tester")
        )
        state: list[str] = []
        loop = QEventLoop()
        guard = QTimer()
        guard.setSingleShot(True)
        guard.timeout.connect(loop.quit)
        guard.start(4000)
        worker.cancelled.connect(lambda: (state.append("cancelled"), loop.quit()))
        worker.ready.connect(lambda *_: (state.append("ready"), loop.quit()))
        worker.failed.connect(lambda *_: (state.append("failed"), loop.quit()))
        worker.start()
        QTimer.singleShot(150, worker.cancel)
        loop.exec()
        guard.stop()
        ok = state == ["cancelled"]
        print("launch_worker_cancel:", "OK" if ok else f"FAIL {state}")
        return ok
    finally:
        workers.prepare_launch = original


def test_game_close(app: QCoreApplication) -> bool:
    command = [sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(20)"]
    plan = SimpleNamespace(command=command, cwd=str(Path.cwd()))
    process = GameProcess(plan)
    state: list[object] = []
    started: list[int] = []
    loop = QEventLoop()
    guard = QTimer()
    guard.setSingleShot(True)
    guard.timeout.connect(loop.quit)
    guard.start(15000)
    process.started_ok.connect(started.append)
    process.game_finished.connect(lambda code: (state.append(code), loop.quit()))
    begin = time.time()
    process.start()
    QTimer.singleShot(600, lambda: process.stop(graceful=True))
    loop.exec()
    guard.stop()
    elapsed = time.time() - begin
    ok = bool(started) and bool(state) and not process.running and elapsed < 14
    print(
        "game_graceful_close:",
        "OK" if ok else "FAIL",
        f"pid={started[0] if started else '-'}",
        f"code={state[0] if state else '-'}",
        f"{elapsed:.1f}s",
    )
    return ok


def main() -> None:
    app = QCoreApplication.instance() or QCoreApplication(sys.argv)
    ok = test_launch_cancel(app)
    ok &= test_game_close(app)
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# FILE: qa/test_loader_binding.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QCheckBox

import darkitten.config as config_module
from darkitten.config import Config
from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow
from darkitten.ui.pages.loaders import LoaderCard
from darkitten.ui.version_settings_dialog import VersionSettingsDialog
from darkitten.versions import game_versions, loader_profiles, scan_versions

VANILLA = "1.21.1"
FABRIC = "fabric-loader-0.16.5-1.21.1"
PACK = "MyPack"


def write_json(path: Path, data: dict) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")


def build_game(root: Path) -> None:
    write_json(
        root / "versions" / VANILLA / f"{VANILLA}.json",
        {
            "id": VANILLA,
            "type": "release",
            "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
            "releaseTime": "2024-08-08T14:00:00+00:00",
            "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
            "assets": "17",
            "assetIndex": {"id": "17"},
            "libraries": [],
        },
    )
    write_json(
        root / "versions" / FABRIC / f"{FABRIC}.json",
        {
            "id": FABRIC,
            "inheritsFrom": VANILLA,
            "type": "release",
            "mainClass": "net.fabricmc.loader.impl.launch.knot.KnotClient",
            "releaseTime": "2024-09-01T00:00:00+00:00",
            "libraries": [
                {"name": "net.fabricmc:fabric-loader:0.16.5"},
                {"name": "net.fabricmc:intermediary:1.21.1"},
            ],
        },
    )
    write_json(
        root / "versions" / PACK / f"{PACK}.json",
        {
            "id": PACK,
            "inheritsFrom": FABRIC,
            "type": "release",
            "mainClass": "net.fabricmc.loader.impl.launch.knot.KnotClient",
            "releaseTime": "2024-09-02T00:00:00+00:00",
            "libraries": [],
        },
    )


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    ok = True

    def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
        nonlocal ok
        print(f"{name}: {'OK' if condition else 'FAIL'} {detail}".rstrip())
        ok &= bool(condition)

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        game = root / "minecraft"
        build_game(game)
        config_module.CONFIG_PATH = root / "config.json"
        config = Config(game_dir=str(game))

        scans = scan_versions(game)
        check("loader_profile_scan", len(loader_profiles(scans)) == 1)
        check("game_version_scan", len(game_versions(scans)) == 2)
        check(
            "pack_not_loader_profile",
            next(v for v in scans if v.id == PACK).is_loader_profile is False,
        )

        window = MainWindow(config)
        try:
            check(
                "home_excludes_loader_profiles",
                set(window.home_page._version_rows) == {VANILLA, PACK},
            )
            check(
                "auto_bind_base",
                window.config.loader_for(VANILLA) == FABRIC,
            )
            check("migration_flag_saved", window.config.loaders_migrated is True)
            check(
                "pack_not_auto_bound",
                window.config.loader_for(PACK) == "",
            )
            profile_id, instance_id = window.launch_profile(VANILLA)
            check(
                "launch_uses_profile_and_instance",
                profile_id == FABRIC and instance_id == VANILLA,
                f"{profile_id}|{instance_id}",
            )
            pack_profile, pack_instance = window.launch_profile(PACK)
            check(
                "pack_keeps_builtin_loader",
                pack_profile == PACK and pack_instance == PACK,
                f"{pack_profile}|{pack_instance}",
            )
            check(
                "mode_note_builtin_loader",
                "Fabric" in window._launch_mode_note(PACK, PACK),
                window._launch_mode_note(PACK, PACK),
            )
            check(
                "loader_page_card",
                len(window.loader_page.findChildren(LoaderCard)) == 1,
            )
            check(
                "version_settings_offers_loader",
                VersionSettingsDialog(window, VANILLA).mode_combo.count() == 2,
            )
            check(
                "compatible_games_for_profile",
                [g.id for g in window.compatible_game_versions(FABRIC)]
                == [VANILLA],
            )

            window.bind_loader(VANILLA, "")
            check("unbind_switches_vanilla", window.launch_profile(VANILLA) == (VANILLA, VANILLA))
            window.refresh_versions()
            check(
                "unbind_survives_refresh",
                window.config.loader_for(VANILLA) == "",
            )
            window.bind_loader(VANILLA, FABRIC)
            check("rebind_loader", window.launch_profile(VANILLA) == (FABRIC, VANILLA))

            # 删除加载器后，绑定必须一起清掉，不能留下悬空配置。
            window.config.version_loaders[PACK] = FABRIC
            shutil.rmtree(game / "versions" / FABRIC)
            window._on_version_deleted(FABRIC, True, "")
            check(
                "delete_clears_bindings",
                FABRIC not in window.config.version_loaders.values(),
            )
        finally:
            window.deleteLater()
            app.processEvents()

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from darkitten.loaders import (
    _find_loader_version,
    _installer_urls,
    _short_forge_version,
)
from darkitten.config import Config
from darkitten.java import JavaInfo
from darkitten.launch import _ignore_client_jar, prepare_launch
from darkitten.versions import detect_loader, scan_versions


def write_version(root: Path, version_id: str, data: dict) -> None:
    folder = root / "versions" / version_id
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / f"{version_id}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
    )


def main() -> int:
    ok = True

    forge_urls, forge_name = _installer_urls("forge", "1.20.1", "47.1.106")
    forge_ok = (
        forge_name == "forge-1.20.1-47.1.106-installer.jar"
        and any(
            "net/minecraftforge/forge/1.20.1-47.1.106/" in url
            for url in forge_urls
        )
    )
    print("forge_url:", "OK" if forge_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= forge_ok

    forge_full_urls, forge_full_name = _installer_urls(
        "forge", "1.20.1", "1.20.1-47.1.106"
    )
    forge_full_ok = forge_full_name == forge_name and forge_full_urls == forge_urls
    print("forge_full_version_normalized:", "OK" if forge_full_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= forge_full_ok

    neo_legacy_urls, neo_legacy_name = _installer_urls(
        "neoforge", "1.20.1", "1.20.1-47.1.106"
    )
    neo_legacy_ok = (
        neo_legacy_name == "forge-1.20.1-47.1.106-installer.jar"
        and any(
            "net/neoforged/forge/1.20.1-47.1.106/" in url
            for url in neo_legacy_urls
        )
        and not any("neoforge-1.20.1-47.1.106" in url for url in neo_legacy_urls)
    )
    print("neoforge_1201_url:", "OK" if neo_legacy_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= neo_legacy_ok

    neo_urls, neo_name = _installer_urls("neoforge", "1.21.1", "21.1.80")
    neo_ok = (
        neo_name == "neoforge-21.1.80-installer.jar"
        and any(
            "net/neoforged/neoforge/21.1.80/neoforge-21.1.80-installer.jar" in url
            for url in neo_urls
        )
    )
    print("neoforge_modern_url:", "OK" if neo_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= neo_ok

    short_ok = (
        _short_forge_version("1.20.1", "1.20.1-47.1.106") == "47.1.106"
        and _short_forge_version("1.7.10", "10.13.4.1614-1.7.10")
        == "10.13.4.1614-1.7.10"
    )
    print("short_forge_version:", "OK" if short_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= short_ok

    ignore_args = _ignore_client_jar(
        [
            "-DignoreList=client-extra,neoforge-21.1.264.jar",
            "-DignoreList=client-extra,other.jar",
        ],
        "1.21.1.jar",
    )
    ignore_ok = (
        ignore_args[0]
        == "-DignoreList=client-extra,neoforge-21.1.264.jar,1.21.1.jar"
        and ignore_args[1] == "-DignoreList=client-extra,other.jar,1.21.1.jar"
        and _ignore_client_jar(ignore_args, "1.21.1.jar") == ignore_args
        and _ignore_client_jar(["-p", "x"], "1.21.1.jar") == ["-p", "x"]
    )
    print("ignore_client_jar:", "OK" if ignore_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= ignore_ok

    neo_loaders = detect_loader(
        ["1.20.1", "1.20.1-forge-47.1.106"],
        "cpw.mods.bootstraplauncher.BootstrapLauncher",
        [{"name": "net.neoforged:neoforge:47.1.106"}],
    )
    forge_loader = detect_loader(
        ["1.20.1", "1.20.1-forge-47.2.0"],
        "cpw.mods.bootstraplauncher.BootstrapLauncher",
        [{"name": "net.minecraftforge:forge:1.20.1-47.2.0"}],
    )
    detect_ok = neo_loaders == "NeoForge" and forge_loader == "Forge"
    print("detect_loader:", "OK" if detect_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= detect_ok

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        write_version(root, "1.20.1", {"id": "1.20.1", "type": "release"})
        write_version(
            root,
            "1.20.1-forge-47.1.106",
            {
                "id": "1.20.1-forge-47.1.106",
                "inheritsFrom": "1.20.1",
                "type": "release",
                "mainClass": "cpw.mods.bootstraplauncher.BootstrapLauncher",
                "libraries": [{"name": "net.neoforged:neoforge:47.1.106"}],
            },
        )
        summaries = {item.id: item for item in scan_versions(root)}
        scan_ok = summaries["1.20.1-forge-47.1.106"].loader == "NeoForge"
        print("scan_neoforge_1201:", "OK" if scan_ok else "FAIL")
        ok &= scan_ok

        fresh = _find_loader_version(
            root, "1.20.1", "neoforge", "1.20.1-47.1.106", set()
        )
        reinstall = _find_loader_version(
            root,
            "1.20.1",
            "neoforge",
            "1.20.1-47.1.106",
            {"1.20.1-forge-47.1.106"},
        )
        short = _find_loader_version(
            root,
            "1.20.1",
            "neoforge",
            "47.1.106",
            {"1.20.1-forge-47.1.106"},
        )
        lookup_ok = (
            fresh == "1.20.1-forge-47.1.106"
            and reinstall == fresh
            and short == fresh
        )
        print("find_generated_version:", "OK" if lookup_ok else "FAIL")
        ok &= lookup_ok

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        (root / "versions" / "1.21.1").mkdir(parents=True)
        (root / "versions" / "1.21.1" / "1.21.1.jar").write_bytes(b"jar")
        (root / "assets" / "indexes").mkdir(parents=True)
        (root / "assets" / "indexes" / "1.21.1.json").write_text(
            '{"objects": {}}', encoding="utf-8"
        )
        jvm_args = ["-DignoreList=client-extra,${version_name}.jar"]
        write_version(
            root,
            "1.21.1",
            {
                "id": "1.21.1",
                "type": "release",
                "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
                "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21.1"},
                "arguments": {
                    "game": ["--version", "${version_name}"],
                    "jvm": jvm_args,
                },
            },
        )
        write_version(
            root,
            "neoforge-21.1.264",
            {
                "id": "neoforge-21.1.264",
                "inheritsFrom": "1.21.1",
                "type": "release",
                "mainClass": "cpw.mods.bootstraplauncher.BootstrapLauncher",
                "arguments": {
                    "game": ["--version", "${version_name}"],
                    "jvm": jvm_args,
                },
            },
        )
        plan = prepare_launch(
            root,
            "neoforge-21.1.264",
            Config(),
            java_info=JavaInfo(path="java", major=21),
        )
        ignores = [a for a in plan.command if a.startswith("-DignoreList=")]
        launch_ok = bool(ignores) and all("1.21.1.jar" in item for item in ignores)
        print("launch_ignorelist:", "OK" if launch_ok else "FAIL")
        ok &= launch_ok

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# FILE: qa/test_local_import.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from darkitten.local_import import (
    LocalImportError,
    detect_local_import,
    import_version_folder,
    inspect_content_path,
    inspect_version_folder,
    install_local_contents,
)


def check(label: str, value: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if value else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail else ""))
    return value


def version_data(version_id: str, inherits: str = "") -> dict:
    data = {
        "id": version_id,
        "type": "release",
        "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
        "assets": "1.21",
        "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/a.json"},
        "downloads": {"client": {"url": "", "size": 0, "sha1": ""}},
        "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
        "libraries": [],
    }
    if inherits:
        data["inheritsFrom"] = inherits
    return data


class FakeInstaller:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[str] = []

    def install(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        self.calls.append(version_id)


def make_version_zip(path: Path) -> None:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr(
            "versions/ZipCat/ZipCat.json",
            json.dumps(version_data("ZipCat"), ensure_ascii=False),
        )
        zf.writestr("versions/ZipCat/ZipCat.jar", b"jar")
        zf.writestr("versions/ZipCat/mods/demo.jar", b"mod")


def make_server_zip(path: Path) -> None:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr("CatServer/server.jar", b"server")
        zf.writestr("CatServer/server.properties", "server-port=25566\n")
        zf.writestr("CatServer/world/level.dat", b"level")


def make_mrpack(path: Path) -> None:
    manifest = {
        "game": "minecraft",
        "formatVersion": 1,
        "versionId": "1.0",
        "name": "PackCat",
        "dependencies": {"minecraft": "1.21.1"},
        "files": [],
    }
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr("modrinth.index.json", json.dumps(manifest))
        zf.writestr("overrides/config/demo.toml", "x=1\n")


def make_mod(path: Path, name: str = "CatMod.jar") -> Path:
    target = path / name
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr("fabric.mod.json", json.dumps({"id": "catmod", "version": "1"}))
    return target


def main() -> None:
    ok = True
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        game = root / "game"
        version_dir = game / "versions" / "Base"
        version_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
        (version_dir / "Base.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(version_data("Base")), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        (version_dir / "Base.jar").write_bytes(b"base-jar")
        (version_dir / "mods").mkdir()
        (version_dir / "resourcepacks").mkdir()
        (version_dir / "shaderpacks").mkdir()

        mod = make_mod(root)
        result = install_local_contents([mod], game, "Base", isolated=True)
        ok &= check("mod_copied", (version_dir / "mods" / "CatMod.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check("mod_source_kept", mod.is_file())
        ok &= check("mod_count", result.imported_files == 1, str(result.imported_files))
        install_local_contents([mod], game, "Base", isolated=True)
        ok &= check(
            "mod_unique",
            (version_dir / "mods" / "CatMod (2).jar").is_file(),
            str(list((version_dir / "mods").iterdir())),
        )

        rp = root / "CatPack.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(rp, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("pack.mcmeta", json.dumps({"pack": {"pack_format": 34}}))
            zf.writestr("assets/cat/textures/x.png", b"PNG")
        plan = inspect_content_path(rp)
        ok &= check("rp_plan_copy", plan.mode == "copy", plan.mode)
        install_local_contents([rp], game, "Base", isolated=True)
        ok &= check("rp_zip_kept", (version_dir / "resourcepacks" / "CatPack.zip").is_file())
        ok &= check(
            "rp_not_extracted",
            not (version_dir / "resourcepacks" / "assets").exists(),
        )

        sp = root / "CatShaders.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(sp, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("shaders/final.fsh", "void main() {}")
        install_local_contents([sp], game, "Base", isolated=True)
        ok &= check("shader_zip_kept", (version_dir / "shaderpacks" / "CatShaders.zip").is_file())

        nested = root / "NestedPack.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(nested, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("NestedPack/pack.mcmeta", "{}")
            zf.writestr("NestedPack/assets/a.txt", "A")
        plan = inspect_content_path(nested)
        ok &= check("nested_plan_extract", plan.mode == "extract_package", plan.mode)
        install_local_contents([nested], game, "Base", isolated=True)
        ok &= check(
            "nested_extracted",
            (version_dir / "resourcepacks" / "NestedPack" / "pack.mcmeta").is_file(),
        )

        bundle = root / "ModsOnly.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(bundle, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("mods/a.jar", b"A")
            zf.writestr("mods/b.litemod", b"B")
            zf.writestr("readme.txt", "hello")
        plan = inspect_content_path(bundle)
        ok &= check("bundle_mod_mode", plan.mode == "extract_mods", plan.mode)
        install_local_contents([bundle], game, "Base", isolated=True)
        ok &= check("bundle_mod_a", (version_dir / "mods" / "a.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check("bundle_mod_b", (version_dir / "mods" / "b.litemod").is_file())

        content_bundle = root / "ContentBundle.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(content_bundle, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("mods/bundle.jar", b"MOD")
            zf.writestr("resourcepacks/bundle.zip", b"RP")
            zf.writestr("shaderpacks/bundle.zip", b"SH")
            zf.writestr("config/skip.toml", "new=2\n")
        existing = version_dir / "config" / "skip.toml"
        existing.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        existing.write_text("old=1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        plan = inspect_content_path(content_bundle)
        ok &= check("content_bundle_mode", plan.mode == "extract_bundle", plan.mode)
        result = install_local_contents([content_bundle], game, "Base", isolated=True)
        ok &= check("content_bundle_mod", (version_dir / "mods" / "bundle.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check(
            "content_bundle_rp", (version_dir / "resourcepacks" / "bundle.zip").is_file()
        )
        ok &= check("content_bundle_skip", existing.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "old=1\n")
        ok &= check("content_bundle_skip_count", result.skipped_files == 1, str(result.skipped_files))

        evil = root / "evil.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(evil, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("../escape.txt", b"bad")
        try:
            inspect_content_path(evil)
            ok &= check("zip_slip_rejected", False)
        except LocalImportError:
            ok &= check("zip_slip_rejected", True)

        # 版本文件夹：直接复制、重写 JSON、重命名客户端 jar。
        source = root / "MyCatVersion"
        source.mkdir()
        (source / "MyCatVersion.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(version_data("MyCatVersion")), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        (source / "MyCatVersion.jar").write_bytes(b"client")
        (source / "mods").mkdir()
        (source / "mods" / "inside.jar").write_bytes(b"inside")
        folder_info = inspect_version_folder(source)
        ok &= check("folder_candidate", folder_info.primary.version_id == "MyCatVersion")
        installer = FakeInstaller()
        imported = import_version_folder(
            source, game, "FolderCat", installer=installer
        )
        target = game / "versions" / "FolderCat"
        ok &= check("folder_imported", target.is_dir())
        ok &= check("folder_installer", installer.calls == ["FolderCat"], str(installer.calls))
        ok &= check("folder_json_renamed", (target / "FolderCat.json").is_file())
        ok &= check("folder_json_id", json.loads((target / "FolderCat.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["id"] == "FolderCat")
        ok &= check("folder_jar_renamed", (target / "FolderCat.jar").read_bytes() == b"client")
        ok &= check("folder_mods", (target / "mods" / "inside.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check("folder_no_staging", not any((game / "versions").glob(".dkl-folder-*")))

        try:
            import_version_folder(source, game, "FolderCat", installer=FakeInstaller())
            ok &= check("folder_collision_rejected", False)
        except LocalImportError:
            ok &= check("folder_collision_rejected", True)

        # 完整游戏目录：共享 libraries/assets 直接合并。
        full = root / "FullGame"
        full_version = full / "versions" / "SharedCat"
        full_version.mkdir(parents=True)
        (full_version / "SharedCat.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(version_data("SharedCat")), encoding="utf-8"
        )
        (full_version / "SharedCat.jar").write_bytes(b"jar")
        (full / "libraries" / "a" / "b.jar").parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        (full / "libraries" / "a" / "b.jar").write_bytes(b"lib")
        (full / "assets" / "indexes" / "21.json").parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        (full / "assets" / "indexes" / "21.json").write_bytes(b"{}")
        import_version_folder(full, game, "SharedCopy", installer=FakeInstaller())
        ok &= check("full_version", (game / "versions" / "SharedCopy" / "SharedCopy.json").is_file())
        ok &= check("full_lib", (game / "libraries" / "a" / "b.jar").is_file())
        ok &= check("full_asset", (game / "assets" / "indexes" / "21.json").is_file())

        # 统一识别
        kinds = {
            "jar": detect_local_import(mod).kind,
            "folder": detect_local_import(source).kind,
        }
        vz = root / "version.zip"
        make_version_zip(vz)
        kinds["version_zip"] = detect_local_import(vz).kind
        sv = root / "server.zip"
        make_server_zip(sv)
        kinds["server"] = detect_local_import(sv).kind
        mr = root / "pack.mrpack"
        make_mrpack(mr)
        kinds["modpack"] = detect_local_import(mr).kind
        ok &= check("detect_kinds", kinds == {
            "jar": "content",
            "folder": "version_folder",
            "version_zip": "version_zip",
            "server": "server",
            "modpack": "modpack",
        }, str(kinds))

        try:
            detect_local_import(root / "missing.jar")
            ok &= check("missing_rejected", False)
        except LocalImportError:
            ok &= check("missing_rejected", True)

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def vanilla_json(version_id: str) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": version_id,
        "type": "release",
        "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
        "assets": "1.21",
        "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/a.json"},
        "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
    }


def write_version(game: Path, version_id: str) -> None:
    folder = game / "versions" / version_id
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / f"{version_id}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(vanilla_json(version_id)), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (folder / f"{version_id}.jar").write_bytes(b"jar")


def write_loader(game: Path, profile_id: str, base_id: str) -> None:
    folder = game / "versions" / profile_id
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    data = {
        "id": profile_id,
        "inheritsFrom": base_id,
        "type": "release",
        "mainClass": "net.fabricmc.loader.impl.launch.knot.KnotClient",
        "libraries": [{"name": "net.fabricmc:fabric-loader:0.19.5"}],
        "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
    }
    (folder / f"{profile_id}.json").write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")
    (folder / f"{profile_id}.jar").write_bytes(b"loader")


def make_version_zip(path: Path) -> None:
    version = vanilla_json("DragCat")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr("versions/DragCat/DragCat.json", json.dumps(version))
        zf.writestr("versions/DragCat/DragCat.jar", b"jar")


def mime_for(path: Path) -> QMimeData:
    mime = QMimeData()
    mime.setUrls([QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(path))])
    return mime


def check(label: str, value: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if value else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail else ""))
    return value


def wait_until(app: QApplication, predicate, timeout: float = 10.0) -> bool:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        app.processEvents()
        if predicate():
            return True
        time.sleep(0.02)
    app.processEvents()
    return bool(predicate())

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from darkitten.modrinth_pack import (  # noqa: E402
    ModrinthPackError,
    import_modrinth_pack,
    inspect_modrinth_pack,
    looks_like_modrinth_pack,
)

checks: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []


def check(name: str, value, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    checks.append((name, bool(value), str(detail)))
    return bool(value)


def sha1(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()


def make_pack(
    root: Path, *, deps: dict, files: list[dict], overrides: dict, tag: str = "test"
) -> Path:
    manifest = {
        "game": "minecraft",
        "formatVersion": 1,
        "versionId": "1.0.0",
        "name": "Test MR Pack",
        "summary": "A tiny test pack",
        "dependencies": deps,
        "files": files,
    }
    path = root / f"{tag}.mrpack"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr(
            "modrinth.index.json",
            json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False),
        )
        for name, data in overrides.items():
            zf.writestr(name, data)
    return path


def file_entry(path: str, data: bytes, url: str, client: str = "required") -> dict:
    entry = {
        "path": path,
        "hashes": {"sha1": sha1(data), "sha512": "x"},
        "downloads": [url],
        "fileSize": len(data),
    }
    if client != "required":
        entry["env"] = {"client": client, "server": "optional"}
    return entry


def fake_download(payloads: dict[str, bytes]):
    calls: list[str] = []

    def download(
        url,
        dest,
        *,
        sha1="",
        size=0,
        cancel_event=None,
        progress_cb=None,
        connections=4,
        probe=True,
    ):
        calls.append(url)
        data = payloads[url]
        Path(dest).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(dest).write_bytes(data)
        if progress_cb:
            progress_cb(len(data), len(data))
        return len(data)

    return download, calls


def fake_loader(calls: list[tuple]):
    def install(game_dir, mc, kind, version, **kwargs):
        calls.append((str(mc), kind, str(version)))
        loader_id = f"{kind}-loader-{version}-{mc}"
        path = Path(game_dir) / "versions" / loader_id / f"{loader_id}.json"
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(
            json.dumps({"id": loader_id, "inheritsFrom": mc, "libraries": []}),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        return loader_id

    return install


class FakeInstaller:
    def __init__(self, calls: list[str]):
        self.calls = calls

    def install(self, version_id, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append(version_id)


def main() -> int:
    temp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dkl_mrpack_"))
    try:
        root = temp / "pack"
        root.mkdir()
        mod = b"fake mod jar"
        optional = b"client mod"
        unsupported = b"server only"
        progress: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
        pack = make_pack(
            root,
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11", "fabric-loader": "0.19.5"},
            files=[
                file_entry("mods/cat.jar", mod, "https://example.test/cat.jar"),
                file_entry(
                    "mods/optional.jar",
                    optional,
                    "https://example.test/optional.jar",
                    client="optional",
                ),
                file_entry(
                    "mods/server-only.jar",
                    unsupported,
                    "https://example.test/server-only.jar",
                    client="unsupported",
                ),
            ],
            overrides={
                "overrides/config/app.json": "config",
                "overrides/options.txt": "options",
                "client-overrides/options.txt": "client-options",
                "client-overrides/config/client-only.json": "client-config",
            },
        )

        ok = True
        ok &= check("looks_like", looks_like_modrinth_pack(pack))
        info = inspect_modrinth_pack(pack)
        ok &= check("name", info.name == "Test MR Pack", info.name)
        ok &= check("mc", info.minecraft_version == "1.21.11", info.minecraft_version)
        ok &= check("loader", info.loader == "Fabric", info.loader)
        ok &= check("loader_version", info.loader_version == "0.19.5", info.loader_version)
        ok &= check("file_count", len(info.files) == 2, str([f.path for f in info.files]))
        ok &= check("skip_unsupported", all("server-only" not in f.path for f in info.files))
        options_entry = [o for o in info.overrides if o.relative == "options.txt"][0]
        ok &= check("options_identical", options_entry.size == len(b"options"))
        ok &= check("mods_count", info.counts["mods"] == 2, info.counts["mods"])
        ok &= check("config_count", info.counts["config"] == 2, info.counts["config"])

        game_dir = temp / "game"
        loader_calls: list[tuple] = []
        payloads = {
            "https://example.test/cat.jar": mod,
            "https://example.test/optional.jar": optional,
        }
        direct_urls = lambda item: item.urls  # noqa: E731
        download, calls = fake_download(payloads)
        result = import_modrinth_pack(
            pack,
            game_dir,
            "MRCat",
            isolated=True,
            progress_cb=lambda p, m: progress.append((p, m)),
            loader_installer=fake_loader(loader_calls),
            download_func=download,
            url_resolver=direct_urls,
        )
        run_dir = game_dir / "versions" / "MRCat"
        ok &= check("result_version", result.version_id == "MRCat")
        ok &= check("downloaded", result.downloaded_files == 2, result.downloaded_files)
        ok &= check("imported", result.imported_files == 6, result.imported_files)
        ok &= check("loader_called", loader_calls == [("1.21.11", "fabric", "0.19.5")], loader_calls)
        ok &= check("mod_file", (run_dir / "mods" / "cat.jar").read_bytes() == mod)
        ok &= check(
            "optional_mod",
            (run_dir / "mods" / "optional.jar").read_bytes() == optional,
        )
        ok &= check("unsupported_absent", not (run_dir / "mods" / "server-only.jar").exists())
        ok &= check(
            "override_config",
            (run_dir / "config" / "app.json").read_text() == "config",
        )
        ok &= check(
            "client_override_wins",
            (run_dir / "options.txt").read_text() == "client-options",
        )
        ok &= check("download_calls", len(calls) == 2, calls)
        wrapper = json.loads((run_dir / "MRCat.json").read_text())
        ok &= check(
            "wrapper_inherits",
            wrapper.get("inheritsFrom") == "fabric-loader-0.19.5-1.21.11",
            wrapper,
        )
        ok &= check("progress_end", progress[-1][0] == 100, progress[-1])

        # resume / overwrite
        download2, calls2 = fake_download(payloads)
        result2 = import_modrinth_pack(
            pack,
            game_dir,
            "MRCat",
            resume=True,
            overwrite=True,
            isolated=True,
            loader_installer=fake_loader([]),
            download_func=download2,
            url_resolver=direct_urls,
        )
        ok &= check("resume_downloaded", result2.downloaded_files == 0)
        ok &= check("resume_skipped", result2.skipped_files == 2, result2.skipped_files)
        ok &= check(
            "overwrite_config",
            (run_dir / "options.txt").read_text() == "client-options",
        )
        # no loader: vanilla install path
        vanilla = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="vanilla",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11"},
            files=[file_entry("mods/v.jar", b"v", "https://example.test/v.jar")],
            overrides={},
        )
        vanilla_calls: list[str] = []
        result3 = import_modrinth_pack(
            vanilla,
            game_dir,
            "VanillaCat",
            isolated=True,
            installer=FakeInstaller(vanilla_calls),
            download_func=fake_download({"https://example.test/v.jar": b"v"})[0],
            url_resolver=direct_urls,
        )
        ok &= check("vanilla_install", vanilla_calls == ["1.21.11"], vanilla_calls)
        ok &= check("vanilla_version", result3.version_id == "VanillaCat")
        wrapper3 = json.loads(
            (game_dir / "versions" / "VanillaCat" / "VanillaCat.json").read_text()
        )
        ok &= check("vanilla_inherits", wrapper3.get("inheritsFrom") == "1.21.11")

        # unsafe path
        bad = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="bad",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11"},
            files=[file_entry("../evil.jar", b"x", "https://example.test/evil.jar")],
            overrides={},
        )
        try:
            inspect_modrinth_pack(bad)
        except ModrinthPackError as exc:
            ok &= check("traversal_rejected", "越界" in str(exc), str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("traversal_rejected", False)

        # fake sha1
        bad2 = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="bad2",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11"},
            files=[
                {
                    "path": "mods/nosha.jar",
                    "hashes": {},
                    "downloads": ["https://example.test/nosha.jar"],
                    "fileSize": 1,
                }
            ],
            overrides={},
        )
        try:
            inspect_modrinth_pack(bad2)
        except ModrinthPackError as exc:
            ok &= check("sha_rejected", "SHA1" in str(exc), str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("sha_rejected", False)

        # quilt unsupported
        quilt = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="quilt",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11", "quilt-loader": "0.20.0"},
            files=[file_entry("mods/q.jar", b"q", "https://example.test/q.jar")],
            overrides={},
        )
        try:
            inspect_modrinth_pack(quilt)
        except ModrinthPackError as exc:
            ok &= check("quilt_rejected", "Quilt" in str(exc), str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("quilt_rejected", False)

        # cancel
        cancel_pack = make_pack(
            root,
            tag="cancel",
            deps={"minecraft": "1.21.11", "fabric-loader": "0.19.5"},
            files=[file_entry("mods/c.jar", b"c", "https://example.test/c.jar")],
            overrides={},
        )
        cancel = threading.Event()
        cancel.set()
        try:
            import_modrinth_pack(
                cancel_pack,
                game_dir,
                "CancelCat",
                isolated=True,
                cancel_event=cancel,
                loader_installer=fake_loader([]),
                download_func=fake_download(payloads)[0],
                url_resolver=direct_urls,
            )
        except ModrinthPackError as exc:
            ok &= check("cancel", "取消" in str(exc), str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("cancel", False)

        for name, passed, detail in checks:
            print(f"{name}: {'OK' if passed else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail and not passed else ""))
        print("RESULT:", "PASS" if all(item[1] for item in checks) else "FAIL")
        return 0 if all(item[1] for item in checks) else 1
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(temp, ignore_errors=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# FILE: qa/test_pack_workers.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QEventLoop, QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

import darkitten.workers as workers
from darkitten.packs import inspect_pack


def make_version(game_dir: Path, version_id: str) -> None:
    path = game_dir / "versions" / version_id / f"{version_id}.json"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "id": version_id,
                "type": "release",
                "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
                "assets": "1.21",
                "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/a.json"},
                "downloads": {
                    "client": {
                        "url": "http://example.invalid/client.jar",
                        "size": 10,
                        "sha1": "",
                    }
                },
                "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def run_worker(worker, timeout_ms: int = 15000):
    loop = QEventLoop()
    captured: list[tuple] = []

    def on_signal(*args) -> None:
        captured.append(args)
        loop.quit()

    worker.finished.connect(on_signal)
    worker.start()
    QTimer.singleShot(timeout_ms, loop.quit)
    loop.exec()
    try:
        worker.finished.disconnect(on_signal)
    except (RuntimeError, TypeError):
        pass
    return captured[0] if captured else None


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
    data = b""

    def log_message(self, *args) -> None:
        pass

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path != "/pack.dklpack":
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        body = self.data
        start = 0
        end = len(body) - 1
        header = self.headers.get("Range") or ""
        if header.startswith("bytes="):
            left, _, right = header.split("=", 1)[1].partition("-")
            start = int(left or 0)
            end = min(int(right), len(body) - 1) if right else end
            self.send_response(206)
            self.send_header("Content-Range", f"bytes {start}-{end}/{len(body)}")
        else:
            self.send_response(200)
        chunk = body[start : end + 1]
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(chunk)))
        self.send_header("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
        self.end_headers()
        try:
            self.wfile.write(chunk)
        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
            pass


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    ok = True
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as raw:
        root = Path(raw)
        source = root / "game"
        make_version(source, "WorkerPack")
        run = source / "versions" / "WorkerPack"
        (run / "mods").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "mods" / "worker.jar").write_bytes(b"worker-mod")
        (run / "config").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "config" / "worker.toml").write_text("cat=1", encoding="utf-8")

        pack_path = root / "worker.dklpack"
        export = workers.PackExportWorker(
            source, "WorkerPack", pack_path, name="Worker 猫猫包"
        )
        exported = run_worker(export)
        export_ok = (
            exported is not None
            and exported[0] is True
            and pack_path.is_file()
        )
        print("pack_export_worker:", "OK" if export_ok else "FAIL", exported)
        ok &= export_ok

        info = inspect_pack(pack_path)
        print("pack_export_manifest:", "OK" if info.name == "Worker 猫猫包" else "FAIL")
        ok &= info.name == "Worker 猫猫包"

        Handler.data = pack_path.read_bytes()
        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}/pack.dklpack"
        original_app_dir = workers.APP_DIR
        workers.APP_DIR = root
        try:
            fetch = workers.PackFetchWorker(url, threads=4)
            fetched = run_worker(fetch)
            fetched_ok = (
                fetched is not None
                and fetched[1] == ""
                and Path(fetched[0]).is_file()
                and inspect_pack(Path(fetched[0])).name == "Worker 猫猫包"
            )
            print("pack_fetch_worker:", "OK" if fetched_ok else "FAIL", fetched)
            ok &= fetched_ok

            invalid = workers.PackFetchWorker("file:///tmp/x.dklpack")
            invalid_result = run_worker(invalid)
            invalid_ok = invalid_result is not None and "http" in invalid_result[1]
            print("pack_fetch_invalid_url:", "OK" if invalid_ok else "FAIL", invalid_result)
            ok &= invalid_ok
        finally:
            workers.APP_DIR = original_app_dir
            server.shutdown()

    app.processEvents()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# FILE: qa/test_package_rename.py
