from __future__ import annotations

import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from darkitten import config as config_module
from darkitten.updater import (
    CODE_PATHS,
    UpdateError,
    apply_update_code,
    prepare_update,
    read_version,
)

VERSION = config_module.APP_VERSION


def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL {name} {detail}")
    print(f"ok  {name} {detail}".rstrip())


def make_zip(package: Path, target: Path, root_name: str = "") -> Path:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for path in package.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file():
                relative = path.relative_to(package).as_posix()
                zf.write(path, f"{root_name}/{relative}" if root_name else relative)
    return target


def build_payload(root: Path, include_legacy_shim: bool) -> Path:
    package = root / f"DKL-{VERSION}"
    shutil.copytree(ROOT / "darkitten", package / "darkitten")
    shutil.copytree(ROOT / "assets", package / "assets")
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / "app.py", package / "app.py")
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / "requirements.txt", package / "requirements.txt")
    if include_legacy_shim:
        (package / "stellar").mkdir()
        (package / "stellar" / "__init__.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
        (package / "stellar" / "config.py").write_text(
            f'APP_VERSION = "{VERSION}"\n', encoding="utf-8"
        )
        (package / "stellar" / "updater.py").write_text(
            "def apply_update_code(*args, **kwargs):\n    return None\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
    return package


def build_old_install(root: Path) -> Path:
    install = root / "install"
    (install / "stellar").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "assets").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "minecraft" / "versions" / "1.21.1" / "mods").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "app.py").write_text(
        "from stellar.config import APP_NAME\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (install / "stellar" / "__init__.py").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (install / "stellar" / "config.py").write_text(
        'APP_VERSION = "1.9.14"\n', encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (install / "stellar" / "old_module.py").write_text("OLD = True\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (install / "assets" / "old.txt").write_text("old", encoding="utf-8")
    (install / "minecraft" / "versions" / "1.21.1" / "mods" / "sodium.jar").write_bytes(
        b"MOD"
    )
    (install / "config.json").write_text('{"player_name": "Steve"}', encoding="utf-8")
    return install


def main() -> int:
    check("darkitten_package", (ROOT / "darkitten" / "config.py").is_file())
    check("no_stellar_package", not (ROOT / "stellar").exists())
    check("version_current", config_module.APP_VERSION == VERSION, config_module.APP_VERSION)
    check(
        "code_paths",
        "darkitten" in CODE_PATHS and "stellar" not in CODE_PATHS,
        repr(CODE_PATHS),
    )
    for path in [ROOT / "app.py", *sorted((ROOT / "darkitten").rglob("*.py"))]:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        check(
            f"no_legacy_import_{path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}",
            "stellar" not in text.lower(),
        )

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        payload = build_payload(root / "payload", include_legacy_shim=True)
        check("payload_version", read_version(payload) == VERSION)
        archive = make_zip(payload, root / "update.zip", payload.name)
        prepared = prepare_update(archive, root / "staging", VERSION)
        check("prepare_new_payload", read_version(prepared) == VERSION)

        legacy_only = root / "legacy-only"
        (legacy_only / "stellar").mkdir(parents=True)
        (legacy_only / "app.py").write_text("x\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (legacy_only / "stellar" / "config.py").write_text(
            f'APP_VERSION = "{VERSION}"\n', encoding="utf-8"
        )
        legacy_zip = make_zip(legacy_only, root / "legacy.zip")
        try:
            prepare_update(legacy_zip, root / "legacy-staging", VERSION)
        except UpdateError:
            rejected = True
        else:
            rejected = False
        check("stellar_only_payload_rejected", rejected)

        install = build_old_install(root / "old")
        backup = apply_update_code(prepared, install)
        check(
            "installed_darkitten",
            (install / "darkitten" / "config.py").is_file()
            and read_version(install) == VERSION,
        )
        check(
            "shim_not_installed_as_code",
            (install / "stellar" / "old_module.py").is_file()
            and not (install / "stellar" / "updater.py").exists(),
        )
        check(
            "legacy_backed_up",
            (backup / "app.py").is_file()
            and "stellar" in (backup / "app.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        )
        check(
            "user_data_kept",
            (install / "minecraft" / "versions" / "1.21.1" / "mods" / "sodium.jar").read_bytes()
            == b"MOD"
            and (install / "config.json").is_file(),
        )

    print("RESULT: PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from darkitten.packs import (
    PackError,
    PackOptions,
    export_pack,
    import_pack,
    inspect_pack,
    normalize_version_id,
    unique_version_id,
)
from darkitten.ui.skin_preview import rotate_model_point


def make_version(game_dir: Path, version_id: str) -> Path:
    path = game_dir / "versions" / version_id / f"{version_id}.json"
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "id": version_id,
                "type": "release",
                "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
                "assets": "1.21",
                "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/a.json"},
                "downloads": {
                    "client": {
                        "url": "http://example.invalid/client.jar",
                        "size": 10,
                        "sha1": "",
                    }
                },
                "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return path


class FakeInstaller:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.calls: list[str] = []

    def install(self, version_id: str) -> None:
        self.calls.append(version_id)


def check(label: str, value: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if value else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail else ""))
    return value


def main() -> None:
    ok = True
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        source = root / "source-game"
        make_version(source, "TestPack")
        run = source / "versions" / "TestPack"
        (run / "mods").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "mods" / "demo.jar").write_bytes(b"jar-data")
        (run / "mods" / "disabled.jar.disabled").write_bytes(b"off")
        (run / "config").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "config" / "demo.toml").write_text("value=1", encoding="utf-8")
        (run / "defaultconfigs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "defaultconfigs" / "default.toml").write_text("x=1", encoding="utf-8")
        (run / "resourcepacks").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "resourcepacks" / "pack.zip").write_bytes(b"zip")
        (run / "saves" / "world").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (run / "saves" / "world" / "level.dat").write_bytes(b"level")

        pack_path = root / "pack.dklpack"
        export_pack(
            source,
            "TestPack",
            pack_path,
            name="猫猫测试包",
            description="只有一只猫",
            options=PackOptions(),
            isolated=True,
        )
        ok &= check("pack_created", pack_path.is_file())
        info = inspect_pack(pack_path)
        ok &= check("pack_name", info.name == "猫猫测试包", info.name)
        ok &= check("mods_count", info.counts.get("mods") == 2, str(info.counts))
        ok &= check("config_count", info.counts.get("config") == 1, str(info.counts))
        ok &= check(
            "defaultconfigs_count",
            info.counts.get("defaultconfigs") == 1,
            str(info.counts),
        )
        ok &= check("optional_excluded", not info.counts.get("resourcepacks"), str(info.counts))
        ok &= check("saves_excluded", not info.counts.get("saves"), str(info.counts))
        ok &= check("total_files", info.total_files == 5, str(info.total_files))

        target = root / "target-game"
        installer = FakeInstaller()
        result = import_pack(
            pack_path,
            target,
            "RestoredCat",
            isolated=True,
            installer=installer,
        )
        target_run = target / "versions" / "RestoredCat"
        ok &= check("installer_called", installer.calls == ["RestoredCat"], str(installer.calls))
        ok &= check("mod_restored", (target_run / "mods" / "demo.jar").read_bytes() == b"jar-data")
        ok &= check("disabled_restored", (target_run / "mods" / "disabled.jar.disabled").is_file())
        ok &= check("config_restored", (target_run / "config" / "demo.toml").is_file())
        ok &= check("optional_not_restored", not (target_run / "resourcepacks").exists())
        ok &= check("imported_count", result.imported_files == 4, str(result.imported_files))
        restored_json = json.loads(
            (target / "versions" / "RestoredCat" / "RestoredCat.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        ok &= check("version_id_rewritten", restored_json.get("id") == "RestoredCat")

        # 重名导入 + 覆盖策略
        overwrite_installer = FakeInstaller()
        result2 = import_pack(
            pack_path,
            target,
            "RestoredCat",
            resume=True,
            overwrite=True,
            isolated=True,
            installer=overwrite_installer,
        )
        ok &= check("resume_overwrite", result2.imported_files == 4, str(result2.imported_files))

        # 路径穿越拒绝
        bad = root / "bad.dklpack"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(bad, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("manifest.json", json.dumps({"format": "dklpack", "format_version": 1}))
            zf.writestr("version/version.json", json.dumps({"id": "Bad"}))
            zf.writestr("../evil.txt", "oops")
        try:
            inspect_pack(bad)
            ok &= check("path_traversal_rejected", False)
        except PackError:
            ok &= check("path_traversal_rejected", True)

        # 版本名安全处理
        ok &= check(
            "normalize_name",
            normalize_version_id("猫猫 1.21/../x") == "猫猫 1.21-..-x",
            normalize_version_id("猫猫 1.21/../x"),
        )
        unique = unique_version_id(target, "RestoredCat")
        ok &= check("unique_name", unique != "RestoredCat" and unique.startswith("RestoredCat"))

    # 3D 预览旋转中心
    pivot = rotate_model_point((0.0, 16.0, 0.0), 37.0, 22.0)
    ok &= check("pivot_fixed", all(abs(v) < 1e-9 for v in pivot), str(pivot))
    top = rotate_model_point((0.0, 24.0, 0.0), 90.0, 0.0)
    ok &= check("pivot_yaw", abs(top[0]) < 1e-9 and abs(top[1] - 8.0) < 1e-9, str(top))
    head = rotate_model_point((0.0, 8.0, 0.0), 0.0, 90.0)
    ok &= check("pivot_pitch", abs(head[1]) < 1e-9 and abs(head[2] + 8.0) < 1e-9, str(head))

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QPushButton, QWidget

from darkitten.config import Config
from darkitten.servers import ServerInfo
import darkitten.ui.server_addons as server_addons
from darkitten.ui.server_addons import ServerAddonDialog


class FakeMain(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, config: Config) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.versions: list = []
        self.selected_version = ""
        self.messages: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

    def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        self.messages.append((text, kind))

    def open_path(self, _path) -> None:
        pass


def make_version(version_id: str, number: str, deps=None) -> dict:
    return {
        "id": version_id,
        "version_number": number,
        "version_type": "release",
        "files": [
            {
                "primary": True,
                "url": "https://example.invalid/test.jar",
                "filename": f"{version_id}.jar",
                "size": 2048,
                "hashes": {},
            }
        ],
        "dependencies": deps or [],
    }


def dep_buttons(dialog: ServerAddonDialog) -> list[QPushButton]:
    return [
        button
        for button in dialog.dep_bar.findChildren(QPushButton)
        if button.text().startswith("前置：")
    ]


def back_buttons(dialog: ServerAddonDialog) -> list[QPushButton]:
    return [
        button
        for button in dialog.dep_bar.findChildren(QPushButton)
        if button.text() == "返回"
    ]


def main() -> int:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    server_addons.ServerAddonSearchWorker.start = lambda self: None
    server_addons.ServerAddonVersionsWorker.start = lambda self: None
    server_addons.ModProjectWorker.start = lambda self: None
    server_addons.ModProjectsWorker.start = lambda self: None

    main_window = FakeMain(Config.load())
    server = ServerInfo(
        folder="test-server",
        name="Test",
        kind="fabric",
        mc_version="1.20.1",
        installed=True,
    )
    dialog = ServerAddonDialog(main_window, server)
    app.processEvents()
    ok = True

    dialog._dep_projects["arch"] = {
        "id": "arch",
        "slug": "architectury-api",
        "title": "Architectury API",
        "description": "跨加载器前置库",
        "downloads": 123456,
        "categories": ["library"],
        "icon_url": "",
    }
    dialog.dep_bar.update_projects(dialog._dep_projects)

    dep_version = make_version(
        "jei-1",
        "15.0.0",
        deps=[
            {
                "project_id": "arch",
                "version_id": "arch-1",
                "dependency_type": "required",
                "file_name": "architectury-9.2.14.jar",
            }
        ],
    )
    hit = {
        "project_id": "jei",
        "slug": "jei",
        "title": "JEI",
        "description": "物品管理器",
        "author": "mezz",
        "downloads": 1000,
        "categories": ["utility"],
        "icon_url": "",
    }
    dialog._select_project("jei", hit)
    dialog._versions_ready(dialog._versions_worker, "jei", [dep_version], "")
    app.processEvents()

    combo_ok = (
        isinstance(dialog.version_combo.currentData(), dict)
        and str(dialog.version_combo.currentData().get("id")) == "jei-1"
    )
    deps_ok = not dialog.dep_bar.isHidden() and len(dep_buttons(dialog)) == 1
    name_ok = bool(dep_buttons(dialog)) and "Architectury API" in dep_buttons(dialog)[0].text()
    print("server_version_and_dep_bar:", "OK" if combo_ok and deps_ok else "FAIL")
    print("server_dep_project_name:", "OK" if name_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= combo_ok and deps_ok and name_ok

    dep_buttons(dialog)[0].click()
    app.processEvents()
    nav_ok = dialog._selected_project == "arch" and len(dialog._nav_stack) == 1
    print("server_open_dependency:", "OK" if nav_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= nav_ok

    arch_version = make_version("arch-1", "9.2.14")
    newer = make_version("arch-2", "9.3.0")
    dialog._versions_ready(
        dialog._versions_worker, "arch", [newer, arch_version], ""
    )
    app.processEvents()
    pending_ok = (
        isinstance(dialog.version_combo.currentData(), dict)
        and str(dialog.version_combo.currentData().get("id")) == "arch-1"
    )
    back_ok = bool(back_buttons(dialog))
    print("server_pending_dep_version:", "OK" if pending_ok else "FAIL")
    print("server_back_button:", "OK" if back_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= pending_ok and back_ok

    back_buttons(dialog)[0].click()
    app.processEvents()
    return_ok = dialog._selected_project == "jei" and not dialog._nav_stack
    print("server_back_to_project:", "OK" if return_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= return_ok

    dialog._versions_ready(dialog._versions_worker, "jei", [dep_version], "")
    app.processEvents()
    restore_ok = (
        isinstance(dialog.version_combo.currentData(), dict)
        and str(dialog.version_combo.currentData().get("id")) == "jei-1"
        and not back_buttons(dialog)
        and len(dep_buttons(dialog)) == 1
    )
    print("server_restore_version_and_bar:", "OK" if restore_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= restore_ok

    dialog.close()
    main_window.close()
    app.processEvents()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import zipfile
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

import darkitten.servers as servers_module
from darkitten.server_pack import (
    SERVER_PACK_MARKER,
    ServerPackCancelled,
    ServerPackError,
    export_server,
    import_server_pack,
    inspect_server_pack,
    looks_like_server_pack,
    suggest_server_folder,
)
from darkitten.servers import ServerInfo


def check(label: str, value: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if value else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail else ""))
    return value


def make_jar(path: Path, mc_version: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr(
            "version.json",
            json.dumps({"id": mc_version, "name": mc_version}),
        )
        zf.writestr("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF", "Manifest-Version: 1.0\n")


def write_json(path: Path, data) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")


def make_server(root: Path, folder: str = "cat-server") -> ServerInfo:
    path = root / "servers" / folder
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    make_jar(path / "server.jar", "1.21.1")
    (path / "eula.txt").write_text("eula=true\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (path / "server.properties").write_text(
        "\n".join(
            [
                "#Minecraft server properties",
                "level-name=world",
                "server-port=25566",
                "online-mode=false",
                "motd=Cat Server",
                "max-players=20",
                "",
            ]
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (path / "world" / "playerdata").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "world" / "region").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "world" / "level.dat").write_bytes(b"LEVEL-DATA")
    (path / "world" / "playerdata" / "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555.dat").write_bytes(
        b"PLAYER-DATA"
    )
    (path / "world" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").write_bytes(b"REGION-DATA")
    (path / "world" / "session.lock").write_bytes(b"lock")
    write_json(
        path / "whitelist.json",
        [{"uuid": "1111", "name": "Alice"}, {"uuid": "2222", "name": "Bob"}],
    )
    write_json(path / "ops.json", [{"uuid": "1111", "name": "Alice", "level": 4}])
    write_json(path / "banned-players.json", [{"uuid": "3333", "name": "Grief"}])
    write_json(path / "banned-ips.json", [{"ip": "203.0.113.9"}])
    write_json(
        path / "usercache.json",
        [{"name": "Alice", "uuid": "1111"}, {"name": "Bob", "uuid": "2222"}],
    )
    (path / "plugins").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "plugins" / "Demo.jar").write_bytes(b"PLUGIN-JAR")
    (path / "plugins" / "Demo").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "plugins" / "Demo" / "config.yml").write_text(
        "enabled: true\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (path / "config").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "config" / "cat.yml").write_text("meow: 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (path / "logs").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "logs" / "latest.log").write_text("secret log\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (path / "crash-reports").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "crash-reports" / "crash.txt").write_text("boom\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (path / "cache").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (path / "cache" / "tmp.bin").write_bytes(b"CACHE")
    (path / "orphan.tmp").write_bytes(b"TEMP")

    info = ServerInfo(
        folder=folder,
        name="猫猫生存服",
        kind="paper",
        mc_version="1.21.1",
        loader_version="",
        memory_mb=4096,
        port=25566,
        online_mode=False,
        eula=True,
        installed=True,
        launch_kind="jar",
        launch_target="server.jar",
        paper_build=123,
        created_at="2026-10-24 10:00:00",
    )
    write_json(path / "server.json", asdict(info))
    return info


def zip_names(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
        return zf.namelist()


def main() -> None:
    ok = True
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        servers_module.SERVERS_DIR = root / "servers"
        info = make_server(root)
        source = Path(info.path)

        pack_path = root / "out" / "猫猫服务端.zip"
        export_server(info, pack_path)
        ok &= check("zip_created", pack_path.is_file())
        names = zip_names(pack_path)
        prefix = "猫猫生存服/"
        ok &= check("zip_prefix", all(name.startswith(prefix) for name in names), names[:3])
        ok &= check("zip_marker", prefix + SERVER_PACK_MARKER in names)
        ok &= check("zip_world", prefix + "world/level.dat" in names)
        ok &= check(
            "zip_playerdata",
            prefix + "world/playerdata/11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555.dat"
            in names,
        )
        ok &= check("zip_whitelist", prefix + "whitelist.json" in names)
        ok &= check("zip_ops", prefix + "ops.json" in names)
        ok &= check("zip_banned", prefix + "banned-players.json" in names)
        ok &= check("zip_plugin_config", prefix + "plugins/Demo/config.yml" in names)
        ok &= check(
            "logs_excluded",
            not any("/logs/" in name or name.startswith(prefix + "logs/") for name in names),
            str([name for name in names if "logs" in name]),
        )
        ok &= check(
            "cache_excluded",
            not any("/cache/" in name or name.startswith(prefix + "cache/") for name in names),
        )
        ok &= check("session_lock_excluded", prefix + "world/session.lock" not in names)
        ok &= check("tmp_excluded", prefix + "orphan.tmp" not in names)

        with zipfile.ZipFile(pack_path) as zf:
            manifest = json.loads(zf.read(prefix + SERVER_PACK_MARKER))
        ok &= check("manifest_format", manifest.get("format") == "dkl-server")
        ok &= check("manifest_name", manifest.get("name") == "猫猫生存服")
        ok &= check("manifest_kind", manifest.get("kind") == "paper")
        ok &= check("manifest_mc", manifest.get("mc_version") == "1.21.1")
        ok &= check("manifest_worlds", "world" in manifest.get("worlds", []), manifest.get("worlds"))
        ok &= check("manifest_players", manifest.get("players") == 1, str(manifest.get("players")))
        permissions = manifest.get("permissions") or {}
        ok &= check("manifest_whitelist", permissions.get("whitelist") == 2, str(permissions))
        ok &= check("manifest_ops", permissions.get("ops") == 1, str(permissions))
        ok &= check(
            "manifest_banned",
            permissions.get("banned_players") == 1 and permissions.get("banned_ips") == 1,
            str(permissions),
        )

        inspected = inspect_server_pack(pack_path)
        ok &= check("inspect_zip", inspected.is_zip and inspected.installed)
        ok &= check("inspect_name", inspected.name == "猫猫生存服", inspected.name)
        ok &= check("inspect_type", inspected.type_name == "Paper", inspected.type_name)
        ok &= check("inspect_worlds", inspected.worlds == ["world"], str(inspected.worlds))
        ok &= check("inspect_players", inspected.players == 1, str(inspected.players))
        ok &= check(
            "inspect_permissions",
            inspected.has_whitelist and inspected.has_ops and inspected.has_banned,
        )
        ok &= check("looks_zip", looks_like_server_pack(pack_path))
        ok &= check("looks_folder", looks_like_server_pack(source))

        target_root = root / "imported"
        imported = import_server_pack(
            pack_path, name="导入猫猫服", servers_dir=target_root
        )
        imported_path = target_root / imported
        ok &= check("import_folder_created", imported_path.is_dir(), imported)
        ok &= check(
            "import_world",
            (imported_path / "world" / "level.dat").read_bytes() == b"LEVEL-DATA",
        )
        ok &= check(
            "import_playerdata",
            (
                imported_path
                / "world"
                / "playerdata"
                / "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555.dat"
            ).read_bytes()
            == b"PLAYER-DATA",
        )
        ok &= check(
            "import_region",
            (imported_path / "world" / "region" / "r.0.0.mca").read_bytes()
            == b"REGION-DATA",
        )
        ok &= check(
            "import_permissions",
            (imported_path / "whitelist.json").is_file()
            and (imported_path / "ops.json").is_file()
            and (imported_path / "banned-players.json").is_file()
            and (imported_path / "banned-ips.json").is_file(),
        )
        ok &= check(
            "import_plugin_config",
            (imported_path / "plugins" / "Demo" / "config.yml").is_file(),
        )
        properties = (imported_path / "server.properties").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        ok &= check("import_properties", "server-port=25566" in properties and "level-name=world" in properties)
        ok &= check("import_no_logs", not (imported_path / "logs").exists())
        ok &= check("import_no_session_lock", not (imported_path / "world" / "session.lock").exists())
        data = json.loads((imported_path / "server.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        ok &= check("import_json_name", data.get("name") == "导入猫猫服", data.get("name"))
        ok &= check("import_json_folder", data.get("folder") == imported, data.get("folder"))
        ok &= check("import_json_port", data.get("port") == 25566, str(data.get("port")))
        ok &= check("import_json_online", data.get("online_mode") is False)
        ok &= check("import_json_java", data.get("java_path") == "")
        ok &= check("import_json_installed", data.get("installed") is True)
        ok &= check("import_json_kind", data.get("kind") == "paper", data.get("kind"))

        second = import_server_pack(pack_path, name="导入猫猫服", servers_dir=target_root)
        ok &= check("unique_folder", second != imported and (target_root / second).is_dir(), second)

        folder_target = root / "folder-out" / "猫猫生存服"
        export_server(info, folder_target, as_zip=False)
        ok &= check("folder_created", folder_target.is_dir())
        ok &= check("folder_marker", (folder_target / SERVER_PACK_MARKER).is_file())
        ok &= check(
            "folder_world",
            (folder_target / "world" / "level.dat").read_bytes() == b"LEVEL-DATA",
        )
        ok &= check("folder_no_logs", not (folder_target / "logs").exists())
        folder_info = inspect_server_pack(folder_target)
        ok &= check("folder_inspect", folder_info.name == "猫猫生存服" and folder_info.players == 1)
        ok &= check(
            "folder_import",
            import_server_pack(
                folder_target, name="文件夹猫猫", servers_dir=root / "folder-imported"
            )
            == "文件夹猫猫",
        )
        folder_imported = root / "folder-imported" / "文件夹猫猫"
        ok &= check(
            "folder_import_world",
            (folder_imported / "world" / "level.dat").is_file(),
            str(folder_imported),
        )
        ok &= check(
            "folder_import_ops",
            (folder_imported / "ops.json").is_file(),
        )

        raw = root / "servers" / "raw-server"
        raw.mkdir(parents=True)
        make_jar(raw / "server.jar", "1.20.1")
        (raw / "server.properties").write_text(
            "server-port=25570\nonline-mode=true\nlevel-name=rawworld\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        (raw / "rawworld").mkdir()
        (raw / "rawworld" / "level.dat").write_bytes(b"RAW")
        raw_info = inspect_server_pack(raw)
        ok &= check("raw_detect", raw.is_dir() and raw_info.mc_version == "1.20.1", raw_info.mc_version)
        ok &= check("raw_world", raw_info.worlds == ["rawworld"], str(raw_info.worlds))
        ok &= check("raw_installed", raw_info.installed)
        raw_imported = import_server_pack(
            raw, name="原版猫猫", servers_dir=root / "raw-imported"
        )
        raw_data = json.loads(
            (root / "raw-imported" / raw_imported / "server.json").read_text(
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
        )
        ok &= check("raw_import_kind", raw_data.get("kind") == "paper", str(raw_data.get("kind")))
        ok &= check("raw_import_online", raw_data.get("online_mode") is True)
        ok &= check("raw_import_mc", raw_data.get("mc_version") == "1.20.1")
        ok &= check("raw_import_installed", raw_data.get("installed") is True)

        suggestion = suggest_server_folder(pack_path, root / "imported")
        ok &= check("suggest_unique", suggestion not in (imported, second), suggestion)

        bad = root / "evil.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(bad, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("pack/server.json", json.dumps({"kind": "paper", "mc_version": "1.21"}))
            zf.writestr("pack/server.properties", "server-port=25565\n")
            zf.writestr("pack/../../evil.txt", "evil")
        evil_root = root / "evil-imported"
        try:
            import_server_pack(bad, servers_dir=evil_root)
        except ServerPackError as exc:
            ok &= check("zip_slip_rejected", True, str(exc))
        else:
            ok &= check("zip_slip_rejected", False)
        ok &= check(
            "zip_slip_no_leftover",
            not evil_root.exists() or not any(evil_root.iterdir()),
            str(list(evil_root.glob("*")) if evil_root.exists() else []),
        )

        cancel = threading.Event()
        cancel.set()
        cancelled_path = root / "cancelled.zip"
        try:
            export_server(info, cancelled_path, cancel_event=cancel)
        except ServerPackCancelled:
            ok &= check("cancel_raises", True)
        else:
            ok &= check("cancel_raises", False)
        ok &= check("cancel_no_file", not cancelled_path.exists())
        ok &= check("cancel_no_part", not cancelled_path.with_name(cancelled_path.name + ".part").exists())

        version_zip = root / "version.zip"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(version_zip, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("versions/1.21.1/1.21.1.json", "{}")
            zf.writestr("1.21.1.jar", "jar")
        ok &= check("version_zip_not_server", not looks_like_server_pack(version_zip))

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def check(label: str, value: bool, detail: str = "") -> bool:
    print(f"{label}: {'OK' if value else 'FAIL'}" + (f" ({detail})" if detail else ""))
    return value


class FakeMain(QWidget):

        self.logs: list[str] = []
        self.messages: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

    def log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.logs.append(message)

    def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
        self.messages.append((text, kind))


def make_jar(path: Path) -> None:

    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as zf:
        zf.writestr("version.json", json.dumps({"id": "1.21.1"}))
        zf.writestr("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF", "Manifest-Version: 1.0\n")


def make_server(root: Path) -> ServerInfo:

def wait_for(app: QApplication, predicate, timeout: float = 15.0) -> bool:
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        app.processEvents()
        if predicate():
            return True
        time.sleep(0.02)
    app.processEvents()
    return bool(predicate())


def main() -> None:
    ok = True
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
        root = Path(temp)
        servers_module.SERVERS_DIR = root / "servers"
        server_pack_module.SERVERS_DIR = root / "servers"
        info = make_server(root)
        source_path = Path(info.path)
        main_window = FakeMain()

        export_zip = root / "ui-out" / "界面猫猫服.zip"
        export_zip.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        export_dialog = ServerPackExportDialog(main_window, info)
        export_dialog._target_dir = export_zip.parent
        export_dialog._sync_destination()
        export_dialog._start_export()
        ok &= check(
            "ui_export_finished",
            wait_for(app, lambda: bool(export_dialog.result_path())),
            export_dialog.path_edit.text(),
        )
        ok &= check("ui_export_file", export_zip.is_file(), str(export_zip))
        export_dialog.close()

        servers_module.SERVERS_DIR = root / "ui-imported"
        server_pack_module.SERVERS_DIR = root / "ui-imported"
        import_dialog = ServerPackImportDialog(main_window, export_zip)
        ok &= check("ui_import_preview", not import_dialog.preview.isHidden())
        ok &= check(
            "ui_import_name",
            "界面猫猫服" in import_dialog.name_edit.text(),
            import_dialog.name_edit.text(),
        )
        import_dialog.name_edit.setText("界面导入猫猫")
        import_dialog._start_import()
        ok &= check(
            "ui_import_finished",
            wait_for(app, lambda: bool(import_dialog.imported_folder)),
            import_dialog.imported_folder,
        )
        imported = root / "ui-imported" / import_dialog.imported_folder
        ok &= check("ui_import_folder", imported.is_dir(), str(imported))
        ok &= check("ui_import_world", (imported / "world" / "level.dat").is_file())
        ok &= check(
            "ui_import_playerdata",
            (imported / "world" / "playerdata" / "a.dat").is_file(),
        )
        ok &= check("ui_import_ops", (imported / "ops.json").is_file())
        data = json.loads((imported / "server.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        ok &= check("ui_import_display_name", data.get("name") == "界面导入猫猫", data.get("name"))
        import_dialog.close()

        from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow

        class Router:
            install_active = False
            launch_active = False

            def __init__(self) -> None:
                self.servers: list[Path] = []
                self.versions: list[Path] = []
                self.messages: list[str] = []

            def toast(self, text: str, kind: str = "info") -> None:
                self.messages.append(text)

            def open_server_import(self, path=None) -> None:
                self.servers.append(Path(path))

            def open_version_import(self, path=None) -> None:
                self.versions.append(Path(path))

            def open_local_import(self, paths=None) -> None:
                # 1.9.17 起拖拽统一走本地导入入口，这里保留真实的类型识别。
                from darkitten.local_import import detect_local_import

                raw = paths if isinstance(paths, (list, tuple)) else [paths]
                for item in raw:
                    info = detect_local_import(Path(item))
                    if info.kind == "server":
                        self.open_server_import(info.path)
                    elif info.kind == "version_zip":
                        self.open_version_import(info.path)

        router = Router()
        MainWindow._handle_dropped_archives(router, [source_path])
        MainWindow._handle_dropped_archives(router, [export_zip])
        version_zip = root / "version.zip"
        version_json = {
            "id": "1.21.1",
            "type": "release",
            "mainClass": "net.minecraft.client.main.Main",
            "assets": "1.21",
            "assetIndex": {"id": "1.21", "url": "http://example.invalid/a.json"},
            "javaVersion": {"majorVersion": 21},
        }
        with zipfile.ZipFile(version_zip, "w") as zf:
            zf.writestr("versions/1.21.1/1.21.1.json", json.dumps(version_json))
            zf.writestr("versions/1.21.1/1.21.1.jar", "jar")
        MainWindow._handle_dropped_archives(router, [version_zip])
        ok &= check(
            "drag_server_folder",
            router.servers[:1] == [source_path],
            str(router.servers),
        )
        ok &= check("drag_server_zip", router.servers[1:2] == [export_zip], str(router.servers))
        ok &= check(
            "drag_version_zip",
            router.versions == [version_zip],
            str(router.versions),
        )

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))


def check(label: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(f"{label} failed {detail}")
    print(f"ok  {label}" + (f" · {detail}" if detail else ""))


def read_shortcut(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    import base64

    script = (
        "[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; "
        "$ws = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; "
        f"$s = $ws.CreateShortcut('{str(path).replace(chr(39), chr(39) * 2)}'); "
        "Write-Output $s.TargetPath; Write-Output $s.Arguments; "
        "Write-Output $s.WorkingDirectory; Write-Output $s.IconLocation"
    )
    encoded = base64.b64encode(script.encode("utf-16le")).decode("ascii")
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [
            "powershell.exe",
            "-NoProfile",
            "-NonInteractive",
            "-EncodedCommand",
            encoded,
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
        timeout=30,
    )
    lines = completed.stdout.lstrip("\ufeff").splitlines()
    check("shortcut readable", completed.returncode == 0 and len(lines) >= 4, str(lines))
    return {
        "target": lines[0],
        "arguments": lines[1],
        "working": lines[2],
        "icon": lines[3],
    }


def test_create_shortcut() -> None:
    import darkitten.shortcut as shortcut

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        desktop = root / "Desktop"
        desktop.mkdir()
        app_dir = root / "Launcher"
        (app_dir / "assets").mkdir(parents=True)
        (app_dir / "app.py").write_text("print('hello')\n", encoding="utf-8")
        shutil.copy2(PROJECT / "assets" / "dkl.ico", app_dir / "assets" / "dkl.ico")

        original_desktop = shortcut._desktop_dir
        original_app_dir = shortcut.APP_DIR
        shortcut._desktop_dir = lambda: desktop
        shortcut.APP_DIR = app_dir
        try:
            path = shortcut.create_desktop_shortcut()
            check("shortcut created", path.is_file(), str(path))
            check("shortcut in desktop", path.parent == desktop)
            check("shortcut exists helper", shortcut.shortcut_exists())
            info = read_shortcut(path)
            check("target python", "python" in Path(info["target"]).name.lower(), info["target"])
            check("arguments app", "app.py" in info["arguments"], info["arguments"])
            check("working dir", Path(info["working"]) == app_dir, info["working"])
            check("icon set", "dkl.ico" in info["icon"], info["icon"])
        finally:
            shortcut._desktop_dir = original_desktop
            shortcut.APP_DIR = original_app_dir


def test_config_flag() -> None:
    import darkitten.config as config

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        original_path = config.CONFIG_PATH
        config.CONFIG_PATH = Path(tmp) / "config.json"
        try:
            config.CONFIG_PATH.write_text(
                json.dumps({"shortcut_offered": True}), encoding="utf-8"
            )
            loaded = config.Config.load()
            check("shortcut flag loaded", loaded.shortcut_offered is True)
            config.CONFIG_PATH.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
            check("shortcut flag default", config.Config.load().shortcut_offered is False)
        finally:
            config.CONFIG_PATH = original_path


def test_settings_button() -> None:
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    import darkitten.shortcut as shortcut

    original_exists = shortcut.shortcut_exists
    try:
        shortcut.shortcut_exists = lambda: False
        from darkitten.config import Config
        from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow

        window = MainWindow(Config.load())
        check(
            "settings button initial",
            window.settings_page.shortcut_btn.text() == "创建桌面快捷方式",
            window.settings_page.shortcut_btn.text(),
        )
        shortcut.shortcut_exists = lambda: True
        window.settings_page.refresh_shortcut_state()
        check(
            "settings button exists",
            window.settings_page.shortcut_btn.text() == "重新创建快捷方式",
            window.settings_page.shortcut_btn.text(),
        )
        original_offered = bool(window.config.shortcut_offered)
        window.config.shortcut_offered = True
        window.offer_shortcut_once()
        check("offer skipped when flagged", True)

        from darkitten.ui import dialogs

        original_exec = dialogs.ConfirmDialog.exec
        original_create = shortcut.create_desktop_shortcut
        try:
            target = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "qa-shortcut.lnk"
            shortcut.shortcut_exists = lambda: False
            shortcut.create_desktop_shortcut = lambda: target
            dialogs.ConfirmDialog.exec = lambda self: True
            window.config.shortcut_offered = False
            window.offer_shortcut_once()
            check("offer flag saved", window.config.shortcut_offered is True)
        finally:
            dialogs.ConfirmDialog.exec = original_exec
            shortcut.create_desktop_shortcut = original_create
            window.config.shortcut_offered = original_offered
            window.config.save()
        window.close()
        app.processEvents()
    finally:
        shortcut.shortcut_exists = original_exists


def main() -> None:
    test_create_shortcut()
    test_config_flag()
    test_settings_button()
    print("SHORTCUT TESTS PASSED")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# FILE: qa/test_startup.py
################################################################################
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer, Qt
from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

import app as entry
from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow


def main() -> None:
    original_exec = QApplication.exec
    snapshot: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    splash_keys = 0
    main_keys = 0

    def record() -> None:
        application = QApplication.instance()
        for widget in application.topLevelWidgets():
            snapshot.append(
                {
                    "type": type(widget).__name__,
                    "visible": widget.isVisible(),
                }
            )

    def press_splash_keys() -> None:
        nonlocal splash_keys
        application = QApplication.instance()
        for widget in application.topLevelWidgets():
            if type(widget).__name__ == "SplashScreen" and widget.isVisible():
                for key in (Qt.Key_A, Qt.Key_Space, Qt.Key_Return, Qt.Key_Escape):
                    QTest.keyClick(widget, key)
                    splash_keys += 1
                break

    def press_main_keys() -> None:
        nonlocal main_keys
        application = QApplication.instance()
        for widget in application.topLevelWidgets():
            if type(widget).__name__ == "MainWindow" and widget.isVisible():
                for key in (Qt.Key_A, Qt.Key_B, Qt.Key_Escape):
                    QTest.keyClick(widget, key)
                    main_keys += 1
                break

    def exec_with_autoclose(*args) -> int:
        application = QApplication.instance()
        QTimer.singleShot(60, press_splash_keys)
        poll = QTimer(application)
        poll.setInterval(100)

        def poll_main_window() -> None:
            press_main_keys()
            if main_keys:
                poll.stop()

        poll.timeout.connect(poll_main_window)
        poll.start()
        QTimer.singleShot(4600, record)
        QTimer.singleShot(5400, application.quit)
        return original_exec()

    QApplication.exec = exec_with_autoclose
    try:
        code = entry.main()
    finally:
        QApplication.exec = original_exec

    main_visible = [s for s in snapshot if s["type"] == "MainWindow" and s["visible"]]
    splash_visible = [
        s for s in snapshot if s["type"] == "SplashScreen" and s["visible"]
    ]
    ok = (
        code == 0
        and len(main_visible) == 1
        and not splash_visible
        and splash_keys == 4
        and main_keys == 3
    )
    print(
        "startup:",
        "OK" if ok else "FAIL",
        f"code={code}",
        f"splash_keys={splash_keys}",
        f"main_keys={main_keys}",
        f"snapshot={snapshot}",
    )
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QPushButton

from darkitten.config import Config
from darkitten.mods import ModInfo
from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow
from darkitten.ui.pages.mods import ModRow
from darkitten.ui.widgets import VersionRow


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = MainWindow(Config.load())
    ok = True

    if window.versions:
        summary = window.versions[0]
        row = VersionRow(summary)
        captured: list[str] = []
        row.delete_requested.connect(captured.append)
        buttons = [b for b in row.findChildren(QPushButton) if b.toolTip() == "删除此版本"]
        row_ok = bool(buttons) and not buttons[0].testAttribute(
            Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents
        )
        if buttons:
            buttons[0].click()
        row_ok = row_ok and captured == [summary.id]
        print("version_row_delete:", "OK" if row_ok else "FAIL")
        ok &= row_ok

        exported: list[str] = []
        row.export_requested.connect(exported.append)
        export_buttons = [
            b for b in row.findChildren(QPushButton)
            if b.toolTip().startswith("打包此版本")
        ]
        export_ok = bool(export_buttons) and not export_buttons[0].testAttribute(
            Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents
        )
        if export_buttons:
            export_buttons[0].click()
        export_ok = export_ok and exported == [summary.id]
        print("version_row_export:", "OK" if export_ok else "FAIL")
        ok &= export_ok

        try:
            from darkitten.ui.pack_dialog import PackExportDialog, PackImportDialog

            export_dialog = PackExportDialog(window, summary.id)
            import_dialog = PackImportDialog(window)
            dialogs_ok = (
                export_dialog.title_label.text() == "打包带走"
                and import_dialog.title_label.text() == "领养整合包"
            )
            export_dialog.deleteLater()
            import_dialog.deleteLater()
        except Exception as exc:
            print("pack_dialogs:", "FAIL", exc)
            dialogs_ok = False
        else:
            print("pack_dialogs:", "OK" if dialogs_ok else "FAIL")
        ok &= bool(dialogs_ok)

    home = window.home_page
    # 干净环境里可能没有已安装版本，给状态切换一个占位版本，避免 _refresh_status 提前返回。
    home._selected = home._selected or "ui-state-test"
    window.launch_active = True
    home.set_launching(True)
    launching_ok = (
        home.launch_btn.text() == "取消启动"
        and home.launch_btn.objectName() == "Danger"
        and home.launch_btn.isEnabled()
    )
    print("home_launching:", "OK" if launching_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= launching_ok

    window.launch_active = False
    window.game_running = True
    home.set_game_running(True)
    running_ok = (
        home.launch_btn.text() == "关闭游戏"
        and home.launch_btn.objectName() == "Danger"
    )
    print("home_running:", "OK" if running_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= running_ok

    home.set_game_closing()
    closing_ok = (
        home.launch_btn.text() == "正在关闭…"
        and not home.launch_btn.isEnabled()
    )
    print("home_closing:", "OK" if closing_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= closing_ok

    window.game_running = False
    home.set_game_running(False)
    idle_ok = (
        home.launch_btn.text() == "启动游戏"
        and home.launch_btn.objectName() == "Launch"
    )
    print("home_idle:", "OK" if idle_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= idle_ok

    download = window.download_page
    version_id = window.selected_version or "test"
    window.install_active = True
    window._install_cancelling = False
    download._on_install_started(version_id)
    cancel_visible = not download.cancel_btn.isHidden() and download.cancel_btn.isEnabled()
    window.install_active = False
    download._on_install_finished(False, "下载已取消", version_id)
    cancel_hidden = download.cancel_btn.isHidden()
    cancel_ok = cancel_visible and cancel_hidden
    print("download_cancel_button:", "OK" if cancel_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= cancel_ok

    settings = window.settings_page
    threads = [settings.thread_combo.itemData(i) for i in range(settings.thread_combo.count())]
    settings_ok = (
        len(threads) >= 4
        and settings.cleanup_btn.isEnabled()
        and settings.source_combo.findData("auto") >= 0
    )
    print("settings_controls:", "OK" if settings_ok else "FAIL", threads)
    ok &= settings_ok

    sample = ModInfo(
        path=window.config.game_path / "versions" / "x" / "mods" / "TestMod.jar",
        name="TestMod",
        version="1.0",
        loader="Fabric",
        enabled=True,
        size=1024,
    )
    mod_row = ModRow(sample)
    mod_captured: list[object] = []
    mod_row.delete_requested.connect(mod_captured.append)
    mod_buttons = [b for b in mod_row.findChildren(QPushButton) if b.toolTip() == "删除此 Mod"]
    mod_ok = bool(mod_buttons) and not mod_buttons[0].testAttribute(
        Qt.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents
    )
    if mod_buttons:
        mod_buttons[0].click()
    mod_ok = mod_ok and mod_captured == [sample]
    print("mod_row_delete:", "OK" if mod_ok else "FAIL")
    ok &= mod_ok

    window.close()
    app.processEvents()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# FILE: qa/test_update_migration.py

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

import darkitten.config as config_module
from darkitten.config import Config, DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL


def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise SystemExit(f"FAIL {name} {detail}")
    print(f"ok  {name} {detail}".rstrip())


def main() -> int:
    original = config_module.CONFIG_PATH
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "config.json"
            config_module.CONFIG_PATH = path
            path.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "player_name": "Steve",
                        "update_url": "http://127.0.0.1:8765/update.json",
                    }
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            cfg = Config.load()
            check("old_source_replaced", cfg.update_url == DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL, cfg.update_url)

            path.write_text(
                json.dumps({"update_url": "https://example.com/update.json"}),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            cfg = Config.load()
            check("custom_source_replaced", cfg.update_url == DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL, cfg.update_url)

            path.write_text(
                json.dumps({"update_url": DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL}),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            cfg = Config.load()
            check("official_source_kept", cfg.update_url == DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL, cfg.update_url)

            path.unlink()
            cfg = Config.load()
            check("default_url_used", cfg.update_url == DEFAULT_UPDATE_URL, cfg.update_url)
    finally:
        config_module.CONFIG_PATH = original
    print("RESULT: PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from PySide6.QtGui import QFont
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

from darkitten.config import APP_VERSION, Config
from darkitten.ui import theme
from darkitten.ui.main_window import MainWindow
from darkitten.ui.update_dialog import UpdateDialog
from darkitten.updater import ReleaseInfo


def make_release(version: str = "1.9.12") -> ReleaseInfo:
    return ReleaseInfo(
        version=version,
        notes=[
            "新增启动器更新检测与下载",
            "新增 DKL 下载站",
            "更新时保留游戏版本、Mod、账户、好友与设置",
        ],
        download_url="http://example.invalid/DKL-update.zip",
        page_url="http://example.invalid/",
        sha256="a" * 64,
        size=1024 * 1024,
        released="2026-10-23",
        manifest_url="http://example.invalid/update.json",
    )


def main() -> int:
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication(sys.argv)
    app.setFont(QFont("Microsoft YaHei UI", 9))
    cfg = Config.load()
    theme.set_current(cfg.theme)
    app.setStyleSheet(theme.stylesheet(cfg.theme))

    ok = True

    def check(name: str, condition: bool) -> None:
        nonlocal ok
        print(f"{name}: {'OK' if condition else 'FAIL'}")
        ok &= bool(condition)

    window = MainWindow(cfg)
    window.config.save = lambda: None
    window.show()
    app.processEvents()

    page = window.settings_page
    check(
        "settings_widgets",
        hasattr(page, "update_btn")
        and hasattr(page, "update_auto_switch")
        and hasattr(page, "update_url_edit")
        and page.update_url_edit.text() == window.config.update_url,
    )
    check(
        "settings_state",
        page.update_status.text() == window.update_state_text,
    )

    release = make_release()
    window.last_update_release = release
    window.update_state_text = f"发现新版本 v{release.version}"
    window.update_state_kind = "accent"
    window.refresh_update_state()
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "settings_show_update",
        page.update_status.text() == f"发现新版本 v{release.version}",
    )

    dialog = UpdateDialog(window, release)
    dialog.show()
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "dialog_layout",
        dialog.progress_box.isHidden()
        and dialog.primary_btn.text() == "下载并更新"
        and dialog.skip_btn.text() == "跳过此版本",
    )
    check("dialog_version", dialog.version_label.text() == f"v{release.version}")

    dialog._on_finished(True, "ok", r"C:\tmp\dkl_bug_work\fake-payload")
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "download_ready",
        not dialog.progress_box.isHidden()
        and dialog.progress_bar.value() == 100
        and dialog.primary_btn.text() == "重启并更新"
        and not dialog.skip_btn.isEnabled(),
    )

    calls: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    window.apply_update = lambda payload, version: calls.append((payload, version)) or False
    dialog.primary_btn.click()
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "apply_click",
        calls == [(r"C:\tmp\dkl_bug_work\fake-payload", "1.9.12")]
        and dialog.primary_btn.isEnabled(),
    )
    dialog.reject()
    app.processEvents()

    skipped_config = window.config.update_skipped_version
    skip_dialog = UpdateDialog(window, release)
    skip_dialog._skip()
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "skip_version",
        window.config.update_skipped_version == "1.9.12"
        and skip_dialog.result() == 0,
    )
    window.config.update_skipped_version = skipped_config

    opened: list[str] = []
    window.open_update_dialog = lambda rel: opened.append(rel.version)
    window.update_state_text = "尚未检查更新"
    window.update_state_kind = "idle"
    window._update_check_ready(None, "", False)
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "up_to_date",
        window.update_state_kind == "success"
        and f"v{APP_VERSION}" in window.update_state_text
        and not opened,
    )

    window.config.update_skipped_version = "1.9.12"
    window._update_check_ready(release, "", False)
    app.processEvents()
    check(
        "auto_skip",
        window.update_state_kind == "accent" and not opened,
    )
    window._update_check_ready(release, "", True)
    app.processEvents()
    check("manual_ignores_skip", opened == ["1.9.12"])

    window.game_running = True
    check("block_update_while_game_runs", window.apply_update("x", "1.9.12") is False)
    window.game_running = False

    page.update_status.setText("")
    window.update_state_text = "测试状态"
    window.update_state_kind = "error"
    window.refresh_update_state()
    app.processEvents()
    check("refresh_state_label", page.update_status.text() == "测试状态")

    window.close()
    app.processEvents()
    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import zipfile
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from darkitten.updater import (
    UpdateError,
    apply_update_code,
    check_for_update,
    download_update,
    is_newer,
    prepare_update,
    read_version,
    sha256_file,
    write_apply_script,
)


def build_payload(root: Path, version: str) -> Path:
    package = root / f"DarkittenLauncher-{version}-source"
    (package / "darkitten").mkdir(parents=True)
    (package / "assets").mkdir(parents=True)
    (package / "app.py").write_text(
        "from darkitten.config import APP_VERSION\nprint(APP_VERSION)\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (package / "darkitten" / "config.py").write_text(
        f'APP_VERSION = "{version}"\n', encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (package / "darkitten" / "new_module.py").write_text(
        "VALUE = 'new'\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (package / "darkitten" / "__pycache__").mkdir()
    (package / "darkitten" / "__pycache__" / "junk.pyc").write_bytes(b"junk")
    (package / "assets" / "new.txt").write_text("new asset", encoding="utf-8")
    (package / "requirements.txt").write_text(
        "PySide6-Essentials==6.12.0\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (package / "launch.bat").write_text("@echo off\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return package


def build_install(root: Path) -> Path:
    install = root / "install"
    (install / "darkitten").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "assets").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "minecraft" / "versions" / "1.21.1" / "mods").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "skins").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "servers" / "paper").mkdir(parents=True)
    (install / "app.py").write_text("OLD APP\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (install / "darkitten" / "config.py").write_text(
        'APP_VERSION = "1.9.11"\n', encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (install / "darkitten" / "old_module.py").write_text(
        "OLD = True\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    (install / "darkitten" / "__pycache__").mkdir()
    (install / "darkitten" / "__pycache__" / "old.pyc").write_bytes(b"old")
    (install / "assets" / "old.txt").write_text("old asset", encoding="utf-8")
    (install / "config.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "account": {"name": "LFELKEEA", "token": "encrypted"},
                "player_name": "Steve",
                "update_url": "http://keep.me/update.json",
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (install / "social.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"friends": ["Mimi", "Neko"]}, ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (install / "minecraft" / "versions" / "1.21.1" / "mods" / "sodium.jar").write_bytes(
        b"MODDATA"
    )
    (install / "skins" / "custom.png").write_bytes(b"SKIN")
    (install / "servers" / "paper" / "server.properties").write_text(
        "motd=DKL\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    return install


def make_zip(package: Path, target: Path, root_name: str = "") -> Path:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for path in package.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file():
                relative = path.relative_to(package)
                arcname = (
                    f"{root_name}/{relative.as_posix()}"
                    if root_name
                    else relative.as_posix()
                )
                zf.write(path, arcname)
    return target


class QuietHandler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, _format, *args) -> None:
        pass


def main() -> int:
    ok = True

    def check(name: str, condition: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
        nonlocal ok
        print(f"{name}: {'OK' if condition else 'FAIL'}{(' ' + detail) if detail and not condition else ''}")
        ok &= bool(condition)

    check("version_compare", is_newer("1.9.12", "1.9.11") and not is_newer("1.9.11", "1.9.12"))
    check("version_compare_minor", is_newer("1.10.0", "1.9.99") and is_newer("2.0", "1.99.99"))

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        install = build_install(root)
        payload = build_payload(root / "src", "1.9.12")
        web = root / "web"
        web.mkdir()
        archive = make_zip(
            payload, web / "DKL-1.9.12-update.zip", payload.name
        )
        digest = sha256_file(archive)
        manifest = {
            "version": "1.9.12",
            "released": "2026-10-23",
            "notes": ["启动器更新检测", "下载站", "保留游戏数据"],
            "download_url": "DKL-1.9.12-update.zip",
            "page_url": "index.html",
            "sha256": digest,
            "size": archive.stat().st_size,
        }
        (web / "update.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        (web / "index.html").write_text("<html>DKL</html>", encoding="utf-8")

        server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), lambda *a, **k: QuietHandler(*a, directory=str(web), **k))
        thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_address[1]}/"
        try:
            release = check_for_update("1.9.11", base + "update.json")
            check(
                "manifest_check",
                release is not None
                and release.version == "1.9.12"
                and release.download_url.endswith("DKL-1.9.12-update.zip")
                and release.page_url.endswith("index.html")
                and len(release.notes) == 3,
            )
            check("manifest_latest", check_for_update("1.9.12", base + "update.json") is None)

            updates = install / "updates"
            progress: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
            downloaded = download_update(
                release, updates, progress_cb=lambda p, m: progress.append((p, m))
            )
            check(
                "download_sha",
                downloaded.is_file() and sha256_file(downloaded) == digest,
            )
            check("download_progress", bool(progress) and progress[-1][0] == 100)

            prepared = prepare_update(downloaded, updates, "1.9.12")
            check(
                "prepare_payload",
                read_version(prepared) == "1.9.12"
                and (prepared / "darkitten" / "new_module.py").is_file(),
            )

            backup = apply_update_code(prepared, install)
            check(
                "applied_code",
                "from darkitten.config" in (install / "app.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                and (install / "darkitten" / "new_module.py").is_file()
                and not (install / "darkitten" / "old_module.py").exists()
                and read_version(install) == "1.9.12",
            )
            check(
                "preserved_config",
                json.loads((install / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))[
                    "account"
                ]["name"]
                == "LFELKEEA"
                and json.loads((install / "config.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))[
                    "update_url"
                ]
                == "http://keep.me/update.json",
            )
            check(
                "preserved_social",
                json.loads((install / "social.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))[
                    "friends"
                ]
                == ["Mimi", "Neko"],
            )
            check(
                "preserved_game",
                (
                    install
                    / "minecraft"
                    / "versions"
                    / "1.21.1"
                    / "mods"
                    / "sodium.jar"
                ).read_bytes()
                == b"MODDATA"
                and (install / "skins" / "custom.png").read_bytes() == b"SKIN"
                and (
                    install / "servers" / "paper" / "server.properties"
                ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                == "motd=DKL\n",
            )
            check(
                "backup_created",
                (backup / "app.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "OLD APP\n"
                and (backup / "darkitten" / "old_module.py").is_file(),
            )
            check(
                "pycache_ignored",
                not (install / "darkitten" / "__pycache__" / "junk.pyc").exists(),
            )

            bad_manifest = dict(manifest)
            bad_manifest["sha256"] = "0" * 64
            (web / "bad.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(bad_manifest, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
            )
            bad_release = check_for_update(
                "1.9.11", base + "bad.json"
            )
            try:
                download_update(bad_release, root / "bad-download")
            except UpdateError:
                bad_rejected = True
            else:
                bad_rejected = False
            check("sha_rejected", bad_rejected)

            missing_sha = dict(manifest)
            missing_sha.pop("sha256")
            (web / "missing.json").write_text(
                json.dumps(missing_sha, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
            )
            missing_release = check_for_update(
                "1.9.11", base + "missing.json"
            )
            try:
                download_update(missing_release, root / "missing-download")
            except UpdateError:
                missing_rejected = True
            else:
                missing_rejected = False
            check("missing_sha_rejected", missing_rejected)

            slip_zip = root / "slip.zip"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(slip_zip, "w") as zf:
                zf.writestr("../evil.txt", "bad")
                zf.writestr("DKL/app.py", "bad")
                zf.writestr("DKL/darkitten/config.py", "bad")
            try:
                prepare_update(slip_zip, root / "slip-out", "1.9.12")
            except UpdateError:
                slip_rejected = True
            else:
                slip_rejected = False
            check("zip_slip_rejected", slip_rejected)
            check(
                "zip_slip_no_file",
                not (root / "evil.txt").exists()
                and not (root / "slip-out" / "evil.txt").exists(),
            )

            script = write_apply_script(root / "script-out")
            check(
                "apply_script",
                script.is_file()
                and "apply_update_code" in script.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
            )
        finally:
            server.shutdown()
            server.server_close()

    print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
